title: SOC Analyst I
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

Responsibilities

  • Perform monitoring and data correlation to events of interest using multiple tools such as system event logs, SIEM, IPS/IDS logs, network traffic, anti-virus console and client end-point software to determine if there is an incident.

  • Respond to security incident and investigation requests in line with established processes and procedures within defined service level targets.

  • Must have extensive experience in multiple security areas such as SIEM, IDS and APT.

  • Drive containment strategy during data loss or breach events.

  • Triage and resolve advanced vector attacks such as botnets and advanced persistent threats (APTs).

  • Perform basic forensic activities e.g. conducting examinations of computers, system logs, applications and networks to locate evidence.

  • Perform Root cause analysis (RCA) for the incidents and update the knowledge management.

  • Tuning of IDS, proxy policy, in-line malware tools based on threat feeds, trust and reputation data, incidents, or vulnerabilities and exploits of downstream systems.

  • Provide tuning recommendations to administrators based on findings during investigations or threat information reviews.

  • Research and stay up to date on current security threats and vulnerabilities to relevant information systems.

  • Other duties as assigned.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proven experience in supporting complex global environments with a strong background in IT security technologies, including antivirus, firewalls, IDS, data loss prevention, and web content filtering.

  • Accredited certifications in Incident Handling such as CEH, GCIH, or ECIH, coupled with hands-on experience in investigation, log analysis, and using security tools like Netsparker, Nessus, Tenable Security Center, and Snort IDS.

  • Expertise in identifying, handling, and mitigating a wide range of cyber threats, including viruses, spoofing, hoaxes, malware, and web application attacks.

  • Proficient in security incident triage, root cause analysis, and a solid understanding of security protocols such as SSL/TLS, certificates, and encryption methods.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of operating systems (Unix/Linux, Windows), network security technologies (IPS/IDS, VPN, firewalls), and application security.


Perks & Benefits


Berkadia offers the best-in-class benefits to enable an enjoyable work environment for the employees. Key benefits include –

  • Leaves: Berkadia offers a comprehensive leave policy that not only helps you to plan holidays and personal milestones, but also covers exigencies such as sickness and bereavement.
  • Transportation: Berkadia offers free transportation to every employee, irrespective of their shift timings.
  • Medical Insurance: Berkadia has an inclusive medical insurance policy that covers the family members of the employees, including parents.
  • Learn while you Earn: Berkadia encourages employees to learn new skills by sponsoring degrees, certifications, training, and workshops.
  • Wellness: Berkadia has an extensive wellness program that includes annual health check, eye checkup, dental screening, OPD reimbursement, and Employee Assistance Program.


About Us


Berkadia, a joint venture of Berkshire Hathaway and Jefferies Financial Group, is a leader in the commercial real estate industry, offering a robust suite of services to our multifamily and commercial property clients. Powered by deep relationships and industry-changing technology, our people sell, finance, and service commercial real estate, providing support for the entire life cycle of our clients’ assets.


For details about India operations, please visit https://berkadia.com/india/

While this job description is intended to be an accurate reflection of the job requirements, management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties, as necessary.

title: Security Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Experience: 5+ years in application and cloud security

Stack: AWS/Azure IAM, KMS/Key Vault, Vault, WAF, Semgrep/SonarQube, ZAP/Burp, Trivy, SIEM, mTLS, OAuth2/OIDC

Role Summary:

Makes the platform secure by design and ready for enterprise security reviews: owns security architecture, vulnerability management, pen-test remediation and the compliance evidence needed for GA.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Threat modelling: Run STRIDE models for tenancy, identity, APIs, media upload/streaming, plugins and GPU workers; track mitigations to closure.
  • Tenant isolation: Review isolation at API, database, cache, queue and object-storage layers; define cross-tenant test cases with QA.
  • Encryption and secrets: Set TLS policy, encryption at rest, per-tenant envelope keys with rotation; enforce no secrets in code or images.
  • Zero-trust: Define service identity, mTLS, network segmentation, least-privilege IAM and Kubernetes workload identity.
  • Secure SDLC: Embed SAST, DAST, SCA, container and IaC scanning in CI/CD with severity SLAs; manage SBOMs; review AI-generated code.
  • API and identity review: Check OWASP Top 10 and API Top 10 (object-level authorisation, SSRF, unsafe media upload), SSO/SCIM, tokens, RBAC and audit logs.
  • Testing and response: Coordinate external pen tests and retests; define SIEM logging, alerting and incident response runbooks.
  • Compliance: Map controls to SOC 2 and ISO 27001, support GDPR, maintain audit evidence, answer customer questionnaires.

Required Skills:

  • 5+ years in application and cloud security; AWS or Azure IAM design.
  • OWASP Top 10, secure SDLC, threat modelling.
  • SAST/DAST/SCA tooling in CI/CD.
  • Encryption, KMS and secrets management.
  • SOC 2 or ISO 27001 controls and evidence collection.

Preferred:

  • Kubernetes and container security; SIEM and detection engineering; GDPR privacy engineering; CISSP, CCSP, CISM, OSCP or cloud security certification.

Key Deliverables:

  • Threat models and security architecture, controls matrix (SOC 2/ISO 27001), CI/CD security gates and vulnerability SLA policy, pen-test report with closed findings, incident response plan.

Education:

Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Information Security or equivalent experience.

Pay: ₹1,000,000.00 - ₹1,400,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Analyst, Global Safety and Security Operations
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

DoorDash is one of the world's most trusted on-demand logistics platforms. The Global Safety and Security team exists to keep it that way, protecting our people, property, operations, brand, and reputation across all our markets. We manage risk and create value through agility, technology, and a people-first approach. Our DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt brands now span more than 40 countries, dozens of offices, and tens of thousands of employees. We strive to stay ahead of emerging threats and be there for our people anytime, anywhere.

About the Role

We are hiring an Analyst, Global Safety and Security Operations to support DoorDash's 24/7 physical security operations center. The Regional Security Operations Center monitors physical security threats and coordinates responses to incidents affecting our people, facilities, and operations around the world. This is an in-person position based in Hyderabad, India. This is not a cybersecurity role.

Reporting to the Manager, Regional Security Operations Center (RSOC), you will monitor threats, triage incidents, and coordinate real-time responses to protect DoorDash's people, assets, and operations. As a frontline operator, you will assess risks, follow standard operating procedures, and escalate issues quickly and accurately. You will also validate information, distinguish signal from noise, and provide clear context to support timely escalation and informed decision-making.

You are excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Operate the RSOC in Real Time: Monitor dashboards, alerts, inbound reports, and open-source signals to identify security, safety, and operational incidents as they emerge.
  • Execute Incident Response with Precision: Triage incidents, follow established SOPs, and support incident command activities through accurate documentation, coordination, and information validation.
  • Maintain Situational Awareness: Track ongoing incidents, relevant global events, and operational conditions to maintain a clear, real-time understanding of risk across shifts and regions.
  • Apply Foundational Analytical Intelligence Tradecraft: Conduct initial fact-finding and source validation to distinguish signal from noise and support effective escalation in accordance with established Risk Intelligence guardrails
  • Support Escalation and Decision-Making: Identify when issues exceed thresholds and escalate to the RSOC Manager with clear, structured, and decision-ready information, without owning strategic risk interpretation.
  • Ensure Seamless Shift Handover: Produce concise shift reports and conduct disciplined handovers that capture incident status, risk context, and outstanding actions.
  • Contribute to Operational Excellence: Participate in drills, retrospectives, and continuous improvement efforts to strengthen RSOC readiness, workflows, and analytical rigor.
  • Operate Calmly Under Pressure: Demonstrate professionalism, composure, and sound judgment during fast-moving or high-impact incidents.

We are excited about you because you bring…

  • Experience and education: Three or more years in a GSOC, RSOC, SOC, or comparable 24/7 operations or incident response environment; bachelor's degree or equivalent professional or military experience.
  • Incident response and judgment: Ability to triage incidents, assess risk, follow playbooks, and escalate decisively under pressure.
  • Analytical and technical skills: Ability to validate information, identify trends, and use monitoring, ticketing, communication, and basic analytics tools. Basic OSINT familiarity preferred; training provided as needed.
  • Communication and reliability: Clear incident documentation, effective communication with leaders and partners, attention to detail, and consistent adherence to procedures.
  • Adaptability and availability: Willingness to learn and work rotating or extended shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays, to support 24/7 global operations.

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.

title: SOC Analyst L2
descriptionHtml:
Job role

SOC Analyst L2

Company name

CREDO Technology Services

LOCATION

Hyderabad

EXPERIENCE

3–4 years

EMPLOYMENT

Full-Time

JOINING

Immediate / short notice

About the Role

CREDO is hiring a SOC Analyst L2 with hands-on experience in security operations, threat detection, and incident response.

You will investigate escalated incidents, hunt for threats, improve detection coverage, and mentor L1 analysts while supporting customers across Microsoft security and cloud environments. This is a shift-based role, and rotational shifts may apply.

What You’ll Do

  • Investigate and respond to escalated and complex incidents across endpoint, identity, email, cloud, and network environments.
  • Analyze and correlate alerts from Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender XDR, and related platforms, using KQL to query and pivot across data sources.
  • Determine the scope, root cause, and impact of incidents; identify IOCs; and map attacker activity to the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
  • Lead containment, eradication, and recovery actions, coordinating with customer IT and security teams.
  • Perform proactive threat hunting based on threat intelligence and known attacker techniques.
  • Develop, tune, and test detection rules to improve coverage and reduce false positives.
  • Build and improve SOC playbooks and runbooks, and automate repetitive response tasks using Sentinel automation rules and playbooks (Logic Apps).
  • Prepare incident reports, post-incident reviews, and clear summaries for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Review the quality of L1 triage, provide guidance and mentorship, and escalate to L3 or incident response leads when required.
  • Track and report SOC metrics such as MTTD and MTTR.

What We’re Looking For

  • 3–4 years of experience in SOC operations, incident response, or security engineering, including time at L1 level or equivalent.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Sentinel and Microsoft Defender XDR (Endpoint, Identity, Office 365, and Cloud Apps), along with Microsoft 365 and Azure security.
  • Working proficiency in KQL for investigation and threat hunting.
  • Strong understanding of the incident response lifecycle, common attack techniques, and the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
  • Experience analyzing logs, email headers, network activity, and IOCs, including basic phishing and malware analysis.
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and documentation skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple investigations and priorities effectively, and to work in rotational shifts.

Preferred

  • Experience with SOAR and automation, including Azure Logic Apps, PowerShell, or Python scripting.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID security, Conditional Access, and Microsoft Purview.
  • Certifications such as SC-200, AZ-500, SC-300, Security+, CySA+, or CEH.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated CV with the CREDO HR team. Immediate and short-notice joiners are preferred.

Work Location: In person

title: Cyber Security Specialist
descriptionHtml:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

R&D Global Unit Lead


Your role and responsibilities:


As an OT Product Cybersecurity Engineer within ABB Electrification’s Smart Power division, based in Hyderabad, India, your primary focus will be to perform product cybersecurity assessments and support secure product development and compliance readiness. You will conduct risk and gap assessments, contribute to secure development activities, and collaborate with global product teams to demonstrate alignment with ISA/IEC 62443, the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), and other applicable cybersecurity requirements.


The work model for the role is: #LI-Onsite


This role is contributing to the Electrification Business Smart Power Division in Hyderabad, India.


You will be mainly accountable for:


  • Perform product cybersecurity assessments, gap analyses, and risk assessments against ISA/IEC 62443, the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), and other relevant cybersecurity regulations and standards; identify security weaknesses and recommend risk-based mitigation strategies.
  • Support the adoption of Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices through threat modeling, security requirements definition, secure design reviews, code review activities, security testing, and release readiness assessments.
  • Perform and coordinate product vulnerability management activities, including vulnerability triage, risk assessment, remediation tracking, coordinated vulnerability disclosure, and security incident response support.
  • Develop and evaluate cybersecurity tools, automation frameworks, and AI-assisted solutions that improve product security, assessment efficiency, and secure development practices.
  • Support internal and external audits, customer assessments, and product certification activities by preparing and reviewing cybersecurity evidence.
  • Collaborate with global R&D, product management, quality, legal, supply chain, and cybersecurity stakeholders across functions and regions.
  • Develop cybersecurity awareness within product teams by conducting knowledge-sharing sessions, preparing technical guidance documents, and supporting cybersecurity training initiatives.


Qualifications for the role :


  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, cybersecurity, information security, electronics, or a related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in product cybersecurity, secure development, vulnerability management, or cybersecurity compliance.
  • Experience in product cybersecurity, including secure development, risk assessment, and the application of ISA/IEC 62443-4-1, ISA/IEC 62443-4-2, or comparable cybersecurity standards and requirements.
  • Experience in the following: software or embedded systems, firmware, Linux, networked products, industrial communications, threat modeling, vulnerability analysis, software composition analysis, attack testing, or security verification
  • Experience with the EU Cyber Resilience Act, or product cybersecurity regulations.
  • Experience with ICS, OT, embedded systems, or industrial communication protocols.
  • Scripting or automation experience using Python or a similar language.


More about us :


ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.


Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Recruitment Fraud Warning

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.

View current job openings and apply at: https://careers.abb/global/en/home

For more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how-to-apply/fraud-warning

Support internal and external audits, customer assessments, and product certification activities by preparing and reviewing cybersecurity evidence.

title: Security Analyst, gTech Risk Solutions
descriptionHtml:
Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity a related technical field or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in security operations (SOC), incident response, threat hunting, IT compliance or equivalent.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with log analysis, data querying (SQL), and monitoring security controls.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional security incidents.
  • Understanding of common security frameworks, access governance models, and the vulnerability management lifecycle.
  • Ability to translate operational security findings into technical engineering requirements.

About the job

Security is at the core of Google's design and development process: it is built into the DNA of our products. The same is true of our offices. You're an expert who shares our seriousness about security and our commitment to confidentiality. You'll collaborate with our Facilities Management team to create innovative security strategies, investigate breaches and create risk assessment plans for the future. You believe that providing effective security doesn't come at the expense of customer service - you will be our bodyguard (and our long lost pal).

gTech Risk Solutions Engineering is executing a strategic transformation from a reactive, program-led organization to a proactive engineering powerhouse. Operating as a federated security partner to Google's central security organizations, we design and build highly contextualized security solutions tailored specifically for the gTech business ecosystem.

In this role, your mission is upfront risk prevention through technical delivery excellence, shifting the paradigm from unsustainable "risk-chasing" to "prevention by design."

Responsibilities

  • Construct queries to produce robust data interpretations.
  • Identify and mitigate risks to interconnected products and services.
  • Participate in triaging and documenting cybersecurity incidents.
  • Manage threats autonomously and recommend process enhancements.
  • Understand attacker methodologies and suggest new detection mechanisms.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. title: Cyber Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Why qlub

The end of a great meal shouldn't be the slow part. Waiting for the check, finding someone to take payment, splitting a bill by hand. qlub removes that friction. Guests scan a QR code and pay in seconds. No app, no download, no waiting.

From Pay-at-Table and Digital Menus to Order-and-Pay, Payment Links, and SoftPOS terminals, we handle the full payment experience so restaurants can focus on what they do best: great hospitality. Less friction means faster table turnover, smoother operations, and higher profit.

We're a fast-scaling fintech backed by Mastercard, Mubadala, e& and Shorooq. $72M raised, live across multiple markets worldwide, and headcount doubled in the past year. We're building the teams that take us to the next stage.

The role

As qlub expands across markets, so do our security challenges. From protecting our payments platform to meeting regulatory requirements and earning customer trust, security plays a critical role in how we grow. We are looking for a Cybersecurity Engineer to own our day-to-day security compliance and customer assurance including maintaining security standards and certifications, managing audits and supporting customer security assessments.

This isn't a role limited to compliance checklists. You'll be part of our security team, working closely with engineering and teams across the business. You'll also have opportunities to contribute to threat detection, application security, cloud security and penetration testing. You'll have the freedom to solve real problems and make a visible impact on how we secure our platform.

Things move quickly here and not every challenge comes with a playbook. What matters is strong security fundamentals, curiosity, adaptability and the ability to figure things out and get things done.


What you’ll own

  • Own day-to-day security compliance and ISMS activities across ISO 27001, PCI DSS, SOC 2 readiness and applicable regulatory requirements.

  • Manage internal and external audits, certifications and assessments end to end including auditor engagement, evidence validation and corrective action closure.

  • Own customer security questionnaires, due diligence and security assessments, working directly with business stakeholders and customer security teams.

  • Maintain security policies, risk assessments and control documentation, assess control effectiveness and drive compliance findings to closure.

  • Coordinate third-party security reviews, support data protection and security awareness activities and maintain continuous compliance monitoring.

  • Contribute to security operations including SIEM/EDR monitoring, threat detection, incident investigations, cloud security and vulnerability management.

  • Support application security and DevSecOps initiatives including secure SDLC practices, CI/CD security integration, SAST/DAST/SCA and vulnerability validation.

  • Leverage automation and AI to streamline security assessments, compliance activities and operational workflows.


Who you are

  • You take initiative, exercise sound judgement and drive work forward independently.

  • You are curious, resourceful and quick to learn unfamiliar tools, technologies and frameworks.

  • You communicate clearly, collaborate across teams and stay effective when priorities change.

  • You actively embrace AI to solve problems, automate repetitive work and find smarter ways to get things done.


What you’ll need

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science or a related field.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity or information security, including security compliance, assurance or GRC.

  • Hands-on experience maintaining an ISO 27001 ISMS, coordinating audits, validating controls and managing compliance evidence.

  • Experience handling customer security questionnaires, due diligence assessments and working with auditors and cross-functional teams.

  • Working knowledge of PCI DSS, security risk management and frameworks such as NIST CSF.

  • Solid technical foundations in cloud and SaaS architectures, networking, identity and access management and web security including OWASP Top 10.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills with fluency in English.

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted tools for research, analysis and automation with the judgment to validate outputs and handle sensitive information responsibly.


Nice to have

  • Experience in fintech, payments or cloud-based SaaS environments.

  • Familiarity with UAE IA/NESA, SOC 2 or GDPR requirements.

  • Experience with GRC platforms and security workflow automation.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud security (AWS/GCP), SIEM/EDR platforms such as CrowdStrike/Splunk or detection engineering.

  • Practical experience conducting web, API or mobile penetration testing.

  • Relevant certifications such as ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, CISA, eWPTx or OSCP are valued.

What we offer

  • Real ownership over products that impact millions of diners and thousands of restaurants globally
  • The opportunity to solve challenging problems in payments, hospitality, and customer experience
  • A fast-moving environment where great ideas quickly become reality
  • Close collaboration with experienced operators, builders, and industry experts
  • A chance to leave a visible mark on one of the fastest-growing restaurant technology companies globally

Ready to build? Join us and help shape how the world pays at the table. If that excites you, apply now.

title: Senior Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Description: Senior Security Engineer

Experience: 8–10 Years

Work Location: Hyderabad, India – Work from Office

Employment Type: Full-Time

Shift: 6:30 PM – 3:30 AM IST

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Security Engineer with 8–10 years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity operations, security monitoring, threat detection, incident investigation, and response.

The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise in identifying, analyzing, and responding to security incidents, investigating suspicious activities, analyzing security alerts, and supporting vulnerability remediation. This role focuses on day-to-day security operations and incident response. rather than enterprise security architecture, governance, or people management.

Key Responsibilities

1. Security Monitoring & Threat Detection

  • Monitor security alerts, events, and suspicious activities across enterprise systems, networks, endpoints, and cloud environments.
  • Analyze security events and identify potential threats, malicious activities, and indicators of compromise (IOCs).
  • Investigate alerts generated by SIEM, EDR, and other security monitoring tools.
  • Perform log analysis and correlate security events across multiple sources to identify potential incidents.
  • Identify patterns of suspicious behavior and recommend appropriate remediation actions.

2. Security Incident Response

  • Investigate, triage, contain, and support the remediation of cybersecurity incidents.
  • Respond to incidents involving malware, phishing, unauthorized access, compromised accounts, endpoint threats, and suspicious network activity.
  • Perform root-cause analysis and document incident findings, timelines, and corrective actions.
  • Collect and analyze relevant logs and security evidence to support investigations.
  • Coordinate with infrastructure, network, application, and IT support teams to resolve incidents.
  • Support incident recovery and post-incident reviews to help prevent recurrence.

3. SIEM, EDR & Security Tools

  • Work hands-on with SIEM platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel.
  • Use endpoint detection and response (EDR) solutions such as Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
  • Investigate alerts using endpoint telemetry, authentication logs, network logs, and cloud security events.
  • Develop or fine-tune detection rules, alert thresholds, and correlation logic to improve threat detection.
  • Use security dashboards, queries, and investigation tools to identify and analyze potential threats.

4. Threat Hunting & Vulnerability Management

  • Perform proactive threat hunting to identify suspicious activities that may not trigger standard security alerts.
  • Analyze indicators of compromise, threat intelligence feeds, and emerging attack techniques.
  • Support vulnerability identification, prioritization, remediation tracking, and validation.
  • Assist in investigating security weaknesses and recommend practical mitigation measures.
  • Apply knowledge of common attack techniques, including those described in the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

5. Security Operations & Documentation

  • Follow established security incident response procedures, escalation processes, and service-level agreements (SLAs).
  • Maintain accurate incident records, investigation notes, evidence, and remediation documentation.
  • Prepare incident summaries and operational reports for relevant technical stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with SOC, infrastructure, IAM, network, and application teams to strengthen day-to-day security operations.
  • Participate in continuous improvement of security monitoring, incident handling, and response processes.

Requirements

  • 8–10 years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity, security operations, SOC, threat detection, or incident response.
  • Strong practical experience investigating and responding to security incidents.
  • Hands-on experience with one or more SIEM platforms, such as Microsoft Sentinel.
  • Experience with EDR tools such as Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, CrowdStrike, or similar solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of security event analysis, log correlation, incident triage, and root-cause investigation.
  • Experience responding to phishing, malware, endpoint compromise, suspicious authentication, and unauthorized access incidents.
  • Working knowledge of network security, endpoint security, identity and access management, and cloud security fundamentals.
  • Familiarity with incident containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident analysis.
  • Knowledge of common cyberattack techniques, indicators of compromise, and threat intelligence.
  • Understanding of vulnerability management and security remediation practices.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender XDR.
  • Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK, threat hunting, and detection engineering.
  • Knowledge of incident response playbooks and digital forensics fundamentals.
  • Vulnerability Management: Tenable, Tenable Nessus
  • Exposure to Microsoft Azure.
  • Familiarity with scripting or query languages such as PowerShell, Python, KQL, or SPL.
  • Relevant certifications such as Security+, CySA+, GCIH, GCIA, or equivalent cybersecurity certifications.

Job Type: Full-time

Benefits:

  • Health insurance
  • Paid time off

Education:

  • Bachelor's (Required)

Shift availability:

  • Night Shift (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Security Researcher II
descriptionHtml:
Overview


The Defender Experts (DEX) Research team is at the forefront of Microsoft’s threat protection strategy, combining world-class hunting expertise with AI-driven analytics to protect customers from advanced cyberattacks. Our mission is to move protection left—disrupting threats early, before damage occurs—by transforming raw signals into intelligence that powers detection, disruption, and customer trust. We’re looking for a passionate and curious Senior Threat Researcher to join this high-impact team. In this role, you will collaborate closely with researchers, analysts, and detection engineers to advance managed Sentinel expertise and drive research on emerging cloud threats that impact both Microsoft and third-party products. Leveraging a deep understanding of multi-cloud environments and diverse security architectures, you will develop strategies and models that enhance threat detection and response capabilities within Microsoft Sentinel. Your research will directly contribute to the development of real-time protections for enterprises worldwide, ensuring comprehensive coverage across cloud platforms and strengthening the security posture of organizations leveraging a heterogeneous mix of technologies. This is a unique opportunity to work at scale, tackle complex cloud security challenges, and shape the evolution of threat research within Microsoft Security.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.


Responsibilities


We are seeking a Threat Researcher with a deep passion for advancing cloud security and a proven track record in high-throughput, multi-tenant environments. The successful candidate will demonstrate expertise in designing and deploying advanced detection engineering solutions—including Sentinel playbooks, workbooks, analytical rules, and custom detections. In this pivotal role, you will drive advanced research on emerging threats, architect innovative detection and response solutions, and play a key role in enhancing Microsoft Security’s capabilities to anticipate, detect, and disrupt sophisticated attacks across complex, heterogeneous cloud ecosystems.

Responsibilities include:

  • Lead and execute advanced research on emerging cloud-based threats impacting Microsoft and third-party security products across heterogeneous cloud environments.
  • Develop and refine detection and response strategies leveraging major SIEM platforms, with a strong emphasis on Microsoft Sentinel, to provide comprehensive threat coverage and response capabilities.

About Us

Skyroot Aerospace is a National award-winning growth-stage start-up, founded by former ISRO scientists.

We are a close-knit team of Space professionals building leading space launch vehicles and solutions from India for the world.

Job Description

Cyber Security Function Lead


Role Title


Cyber Security Function Lead


Department


IT Operations – Cyber Security


Reports To


Head of IT Operations


Location


Max‑Q


Role Purpose


The Cyber Security Function Lead is responsible for planning, implementing, and governing the organization’s cybersecurity strategy. This role ensures the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information systems by managing security operations, risk, compliance, incident response, and continuous improvement of security controls across infrastructure, applications, cloud, and endpoints.


Key Responsibilities


1. Cyber Security Strategy & Governance


  • Define and implement the cybersecurity roadmap aligned with business objectives.
  • Establish and maintain security policies, standards, and procedures.
  • Ensure alignment with industry frameworks (ISO 27001, NIST, CIS Controls).
  • Act as the primary point of contact for security governance and audits.


2. Security Operations Management


  • Oversee Security Operations (SOC) activities, including monitoring and alert handling.
  • Ensure effective use of SIEM, syslog, EDR/XDR, DLP, and monitoring tools.
  • Review and analyze security logs, alerts, and incidents.
  • Ensure timely escalation and resolution of security issues.


3. Incident Response & Threat Management


  • Lead incident response activities, including containment, eradication, and recovery.
  • Coordinate root cause analysis (RCA) and post‑incident reviews.
  • Ensure maintenance of incident response plans and conduct periodic drills.
  • Track and mitigate emerging cyber threats and vulnerabilities.


4. Risk, Compliance & Audit


  • Identify, assess, and manage cybersecurity risks.
  • Support internal and external audits, including VPN, network, and application audits.
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory and contractual security requirements.
  • Maintain audit evidence, reports, and corrective action plans.


5. Identity, Access & Data Security


  • Govern Identity and Access Management (IAM) processes.
  • Ensure least privilege access, MFA, and privileged access controls.
  • Oversee data protection controls, including encryption and DLP.
  • Review and approve administrative access based on business justification.


6. Infrastructure & Network Security


  • Ensure secure design and implementation of network, cloud, and hybrid environments.
  • Review firewall policies, VPN configurations, and network segmentation.
  • Coordinate with Infrastructure and Networking teams to eliminate security gaps.


7. Team Leadership & Coordination


  • Lead and mentor Cyber Security team members.
  • Assign tasks with clear ownership, tracking, and reporting.
  • Coordinate with IT Administration, Networking, and other stakeholders.
  • Ensure timely reporting to management with daily/weekly status updates.


8. Documentation & Reporting


  • Maintain detailed security reports, dashboards, and checklists.
  • Ensure email and ticket‑based communication for all security actions.
  • Provide regular management updates on security posture, risks, and improvements.


Key Accountabilities


  • Zero untracked or undocumented security actions.
  • No critical or high‑risk audit gaps.
  • Timely closure of security incidents and vulnerabilities.
  • Consistent security reporting and evidence availability.
  • Continuous improvement of the organization’s security posture.


Required Skills & Competencies


Technical Skills


  • Network and infrastructure security
  • SIEM, SOC operations, and incident response
  • Cloud security (Azure/AWS)
  • IAM, EDR/XDR, DLP
  • Vulnerability management and security monitoring


Professional Skills


  • Strong leadership and decision‑making
  • Risk management and analytical thinking
  • Excellent documentation and reporting
  • Stakeholder and audit communication


Qualifications & Experience


  • Bachelor’s degree in IT, Cyber Security, or related field
  • 5–8+ years of experience in Cyber Security
  • Relevant certifications (CISSP, CISM, CEH, Security+, Azure/AWS Security) preferred

title: Infrastructure Security and IAM Architect
descriptionHtml:
Infrastructure Security and IAM Architect

Role Summary

Designs the identity, access and infrastructure security architecture for a carve-out, covering the hybrid domain controller and Entra ID estate. Owns the target-state design and the technical approach for moving users, mailboxes and collaboration content. Re-architects only where the separation requires it.

Job Responsibilities

  • Design the target identity architecture across on-premises Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID
  • Define SSO, MFA, Conditional Access and privileged access models
  • Design directory synchronisation using Microsoft Entra Connect and tenant coexistence
  • Architect application sign-in and federation using SAML, OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect
  • Design network access authentication using RADIUS and 802.1X
  • Define infrastructure security controls: segmentation, firewalls, key and secrets management
  • Design landing zone security controls and guardrails across Azure and AWS
  • Select and configure migration tooling for user, mailbox, SharePoint and Teams moves
  • Produce high-level and low-level designs and review them with client architects
  • Define security logging requirements for identity and infrastructure events

Required Experience

  • 10+ years of relevant experience in infrastructure and security architecture
  • 5+ years designing and implementing identity, including on-premises domain controller clusters
  • Strong understanding of Active Directory, Kerberos, LDAP and DNS
  • Strong understanding of Microsoft Entra ID and Entra Connect version 2 or above, including Entra Domain Services
  • Hands-on experience with SSO, MFA and Conditional Access
  • Experience with at least one third-party identity provider such as Okta or Ping Identity
  • 3+ years of experience with SAML and OAuth 2.0, plus OpenID Connect
  • Understanding of RADIUS-based authentication and 802.1X
  • Experience with migration tools such as BitTitan, Quest and AvePoint
  • Experience with mailbox, SharePoint, Teams and user migration
  • Experience with at least two cloud providers (Azure and AWS)
  • Experience designing and implementing landing zones with security controls and guardrails
  • Experience with Azure Key Vault or equivalent key management services
  • Experience designing colocation architectures
  • Deep understanding of hyper-converged infrastructure
  • Exposure to at least two OEMs or two cloud providers in each technology area
  • Strong communication skills, with prior experience working with UK and EU clients
  • Willingness to travel as required and to work in the client time zone
  • Prior infrastructure background alongside the specialism above
  • Prior experience in IT consolidations, mergers, demergers and carve-outs (mandatory)
  • Relevant professional certifications strongly recommended

Pay: ₹1,000,000.00 - ₹1,800,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Security Operations Responder
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

  • Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
  • Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
  • Over $300 million raised in funding
  • 3,000 Tideans globally
  • We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Tide Security Engineering team is made up of three core areas: Product Security, Identity, Threat Detection & Response

Product Security consists of application and cloud security experts. Their mission is to protect the products we build, covering everything from secure design reviews to threat modelling and penetration testing, ensuring security is embedded from the ground up.

Threat Detection & Response (this role!) focuses on protecting the company by building a robust detection and automation platform. We're proactive in our defence, constantly hacking ourselves to improve our security posture and staying ahead of emerging threats. Our goal is to make Tide resilient against the ever-evolving threat landscape.

Identity is responsible for managing Tide's staff identity platform, ensuring that access to systems and infrastructure is secure, seamless, and aligned with modern security practices. The team uses strategies like zero trust, multi-factor authentication, and granular role-based access controls to safeguard our internal operations.

While each area has its own focus, collaboration is key - it's why we share the same Slack channel and hold our standups together as one cohesive team, ensuring alignment and seamless communication across all security functions.

As a Security Operations Responder, you'll be on the front line of defending Tide. Your primary focus is actively investigating threats through our security data lake and SOAR platform – but we don't want anyone working the same alert by hand twice. Your goal is to make investigation effective at scale: cutting manual effort through automation, and working hand-in-hand with our Detection Engineering team to improve the true positive / false positive efficacy of what lands in the queue.

When the security queue is empty, you'll be building – automations, enrichment and your own detections. An open mind and a curious approach are key: every investigation is a chance to make the next one faster and sharper.

As a Security Operations Responder, you'll be:

Investigating and responding to threats (your primary focus)

  • Actively triaging and investigating security alerts and threats through our security data lake and SOAR platform, across AWS, GCP, SaaS (such as Google Workspace and Okta), internal applications and employee endpoints (Windows, macOS).
  • Driving every investigation to a clear, well-evidenced outcome – establishing scope, impact and root cause, and taking containment and remediation actions quickly and confidently.
  • Leading the response to complex or high-severity incidents where needed, coordinating across security, IT and engineering teams through containment, remediation and recovery.
  • Documenting investigations clearly and consistently, and contributing to the runbooks and investigation standards the whole team works to.

Scaling investigation through automation & Improving detection efficacy

  • Reducing manual investigation by building SOAR playbooks, security automations and services – from data enrichment and context gathering through to automated response, such as removing phishing emails from employee mailboxes. We want you to run with the "anything is possible" mantra.
  • Spotting repetitive work in the queue and turning it into automated workflows, so the team's time goes on the investigations that genuinely need human judgement.
  • Identifying gaps in log sources, parsing and enrichment in the data lake, and working to close them so investigations have the visibility they need.
  • Feeding investigation outcomes back to the Detection Engineering team – flagging noisy rules, tuning false positives and highlighting coverage gaps – to continuously improve TP/FP efficacy.
  • Tracking investigation metrics (such as MTTD, MTTR, TP/FP rate and automation coverage) and using them to prioritise where to improve next.

Building when the queue is clear

  • Writing, testing and shipping your own detections alongside Detection Engineering, following our test-driven, detections-as-code practices.
  • Proactively hunting for sophisticated threats across our infrastructure, using threat intelligence and lessons from past investigations to stay ahead of attackers.
  • Building or enhancing internal tools that streamline investigation, improve data visibility and increase response efficiency.
  • Sharing knowledge and mentoring other members of the team, raising the bar for how we investigate and respond.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Significant hands-on experience in security operations, incident response or threat investigation, ideally in a cloud-native environment.
  • Strong investigative instincts and log analysis skills at scale, with the ability to query a security data lake or SIEM fluently – strong knowledge of one of the following: Splunk, Scanner, Sentinel, SecOps.
  • Strong understanding of modern attack and defence techniques which apply to Cloud (AWS, GCP), SaaS (such as Google Workspace and Okta) and desktop (Windows and macOS) environments, and the ability to map activity to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Strong experience in security automation, from writing scripts (e.g. Python) to creating end-to-end automated workflows. Familiarity with SOAR platforms and automating investigation and response tasks.
  • Experience writing or tuning detections, and a clear view of what separates a high-fidelity alert from a noisy one.
  • Calm, methodical judgement during live incidents, including knowing when and how to escalate.
  • An open mind and a curious approach – you enjoy pulling on threads, and you don't stop at "false positives" without understanding why.
  • Hands-on attitude and the ability to drive solutions to completion.
  • Passion for passing on knowledge to fellow colleagues.
  • Excellent spoken and written communication skills, including clear investigation write-ups for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Bonus points if you have a repository showcasing automations, detections or tooling you've built.

WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:

  • Competitive Compensation – competitive salary.
  • Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
  • Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
  • Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
  • Health Insurance – Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options.
  • Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
  • Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
  • Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
  • Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
  • WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
  • Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.
  • Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it's time for a replacement.
  • Snacks & Meals – Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent).

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members' diverse needs and lives.

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone's voice is heard.


At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone's voice is heard.


Disclaimer
It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:
  • Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
  • All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
  • Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
  • Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.


Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.

Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

Driving every investigation to a clear, well-evidenced outcome – establishing scope, impact and root cause, and taking containment and remediation actions quickly and confidently.
Leading the response to complex or high-severity incidents where needed, coordinating across security, IT and engineering teams through containment, remediation and recovery.
Documenting investigations clearly and consistently, and contributing to the runbooks and investigation standards the whole team works to.

Scaling investigation through automation & Improving detection efficacy

Reducing manual investigation by building SOAR playbooks, security automations and services – from data enrichment and context gathering through to automated response, such as removing phishing emails from employee mailboxes. We want you to run with the "anything is possible" mantra.
Spotting repetitive work in the queue and turning it into automated workflows, so the team's time goes on the investigations that genuinely need human judgement.
Identifying gaps in log sources, parsing and enrichment in the data lake, and working to close them so investigations have the visibility they need.
Feeding investigation outcomes back to the Detection Engineering team – flagging noisy rules, tuning false positives and highlighting coverage gaps – to continuously improve TP/FP efficacy.
Tracking investigation metrics (such as MTTD, MTTR, TP/FP rate and automation coverage) and using them to prioritise where to improve next.

Building when the queue is clear

Writing, testing and shipping your own detections alongside Detection Engineering, following our test-driven, detections-as-code practices.
Proactively hunting for sophisticated threats across our infrastructure, using threat intelligence and lessons from past investigations to stay ahead of attackers.
Building or enhancing internal tools that streamline investigation, improve data visibility and increase response efficiency.
Sharing knowledge and mentoring other members of the team, raising the bar for how we investigate and respond.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
Significant hands-on experience in security operations, incident response or threat investigation, ideally in a cloud-native environment.
Strong investigative instincts and log analysis skills at scale, with the ability to query a security data lake or SIEM fluently – strong knowledge of one of the following: Splunk, Scanner, Sentinel, SecOps.
Strong understanding of modern attack and defence techniques which apply to Cloud (AWS, GCP), SaaS (such as Google Workspace and Okta) and desktop (Windows and macOS) environments, and the ability to map activity to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.
Strong experience in security automation, from writing scripts (e.g. Python) to creating end-to-end automated workflows. Familiarity with SOAR platforms and automating investigation and response tasks.
Experience writing or tuning detections, and a clear view of what separates a high-fidelity alert from a noisy one.
Calm, methodical judgement during live incidents, including knowing when and how to escalate.
An open mind and a curious approach – you enjoy pulling on threads, and you don't stop at "false positives" without understanding why.
Hands-on attitude and the ability to drive solutions to completion.
Passion for passing on knowledge to fellow colleagues.
Excellent spoken and written communication skills, including clear investigation write-ups for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Bonus points if you have a repository showcasing automations, detections or tooling you've built.
WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:

Competitive Compensation – competitive salary.
Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
Health Insurance – Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options.
Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.
Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it's time for a replacement.
Snacks & Meals – Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent).
TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members' diverse needs and lives.

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone's voice is heard.

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone's voice is heard.

Disclaimer

Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.

title: Identity and Access Management / Consultant Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Some careers shine brighter than others.

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

Why HSBC


HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist

The Opportunity

HSBC Cyber Security Identity and Access Management is looking for a ServiceNow Technical Business Analyst to turn complex access-management needs into clear requirements that development teams can build and deploy with confidence. This role focuses on ServiceNow IAM workflows, partnering with product owners, engineers and stakeholders to define epics and user stories that meet HSBC IDAM controls. You’ll assess current workflows, identify gaps and translate findings into actionable requirements that stand up to technical review. Success means well-shaped epics, smooth UAT and deployments and clear visibility of progress risks and dependencies through to completion.

In this role, you will:

  • Gather and document business and technical requirements for ServiceNow access-related workflows
  • Identify and engage stakeholders to capture end-to-end requirements and confirm priorities
  • Conduct gap analysis of current as-is workflows and translate findings into implementable requirements
  • Validate requirements through technical reviews to ensure feasibility and delivery alignment
  • Embed compliance with HSBC IDAM (Identity and Access Management) controls across epics and stories
  • Create and maintain user stories and requirements in Jira aligned to delivery teams and product owners
  • Coordinate UAT by organising participants, managing test execution and tracking outcomes to sign-off
  • Oversee deployment planning and execution, acting as the point of contact for assigned epics through completion
  • Provide updates to senior management, managing dependencies and issues to reduce delivery delays
  • Strengthen delivery practices by identifying process improvements that increase efficiency scalability and security

To be successful, you will:

  • Hold CBAP CCBA or equivalent business analysis certification or bring equivalent demonstrable experience
  • Bring substantial experience as a Business Analyst in an IT environment
  • Apply strong knowledge of Identity and Access Management (IAM) controls in regulated environments
  • Demonstrate hands-on expertise with ServiceNow including functionality database structure and API use
  • Bring technical proficiency across IAM technologies such as SailPoint Delinea HashiCorp Active Directory UNIX iSeries and databases
  • Use Agile Scrum ways of working to shape stories estimate work and support predictable delivery
  • Produce clear high-quality requirements and user stories that enable efficient build and testing, Communicate effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders with strong facilitation skills
  • Interpret data usage patterns to spot quality issues and manage risks to delivery and hold CISA CISSP or equivalent security certification or bring equivalent demonstrable experience

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

www.hsbc.com/careers

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by – HSBC Software Development India

title: Infosec Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Company Description


Nemetschek India Private Limited is a global organization and with a legacy of over half a century.
It is a public company listed on MDAX and TecDAX (Germany) stock exchanges. The Nemetschek
Group is a forerunner of digital transformation in the AEC/O (Architecture, Engineering,
Construction & Operations) industry and covers the entire life cycle of construction and
infrastructure projects. With intelligent software solutions, we lead our customers into the future
of digitalization. By using our solutions customers can plan, build, manage, and operate buildings
and infrastructure projects.


Job Description


YOUR ROLE: A chance to make the difference.


We’re looking for a SOC Analyst for our permanent night shift in Hyderabad to focus on
high-quality alert triage and first-line incident handling. You’ll work mainly with CrowdStrike
Falcon, Microsoft Sentinel, and related security tools to keep our global environment safe while
most of the company is asleep.
Experience
  • 3–5 years in a SOC / security monitoring role (L1 or L1/L2 mix).
  • Prior experience in a 24/7 or shift-based SOC is a plus.
Shift details
  • Location: Hyderabad.
  • Permanent night shift, working with EMEA/US time zones.
  • Participation in a rotation that may include weekends and holidays.
  • Clear handover required at the end of each shift to the next region/shift.
ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITY: (Night Shift, triage-focused)
  • Monitor and triage security alerts from EDR/XDR (primarily CrowdStrike Falcon), SIEM
(Microsoft Sentinel), and other security tools.
  • Perform alert-driven incident handling at L1/L1.5 level:
o Quickly review new detections,
o Decide whether to close as benign/false positive, investigate further, or escalate,
o Apply standard playbook-based response actions where allowed (e.g. isolate
host, block hash/domain, disable account with approval).
  • For CrowdStrike Falcon in particular:
o Review detections, examine process trees and related activity,
o Validate severity and impact based on context,
o Close noise/false positives with clear justification or escalate meaningful events.
  • Use Microsoft Sentinel and other platforms to pull additional context during triage (host
history, user activity, geo/access patterns, related alerts).
  • Analyze and respond to phishing alerts and user-reported suspicious emails using
defined playbooks (header analysis, URL/file sandboxing, user follow-up, ticket
updates).
  • Review vulnerability scan results (e.g. Tenable) for basic risk context, confirm exposure
where needed, and follow up with the relevant teams according to priority and SLAs.
  • Conduct basic, playbook-driven “mini threat hunting” during quieter periods (e.g.
running saved queries/hunts in Sentinel and EDR to look for common attacker
techniques or newly published IOCs).
Keep tickets, incident records, and runbooks up to date with short, precise, and complete
investigation notes (what triggered, what you checked, what you decided, and why).
  • Produce clear shift-end handover notes for open incidents and important observations.
WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR:
Core SOC / triage skills
  • 3–5 years of hands-on SOC experience in monitoring, triage, and first-line incident
handling (L1 or L1/L2).
  • Strong focus on alert triage rather than deep forensics: able to work through a queue
efficiently, recognize patterns, and make clear decisions (close, investigate further,
escalate).
  • Experience with:
o At least one enterprise EDR/XDR platform (ideally CrowdStrike Falcon) for alert
analysis and basic response (host isolation, hash/domain blocking, evidence
collection).
o A SIEM platform (ideally Microsoft Sentinel) for correlating alerts and running
queries to gather additional context.
  • Good understanding of security fundamentals:
o Logs: endpoint, authentication, OS, and basic application logs.
o Endpoints: Windows and/or Linux basics, common processes and admin tools.
o Networks: TCP/IP basics, DNS, web traffic, VPN and remote access patterns.
o Common attack techniques across the kill chain (phishing, credential theft,
lateral movement, malware execution, C2, data exfiltration).
Tools and platforms
  • Familiarity with some of the following (or similar solutions):
o CrowdStrike Falcon or another modern EDR/XDR platform.
o Microsoft Sentinel or another SIEM (including experience running and
understanding queries; KQL is a plus).
o Vulnerability management tools such as Tenable.
o Email security / anti-phishing tools, sandboxing, or secure email gateways.
Ways of working and soft skills
Comfortable working permanently in night shift and collaborating with global teams
spread across regions.
  • Strong written communication: able to document alerts, investigations, and handovers in
clear, concise English.
  • Ability to stay calm, structured, and pragmatic during active incidents and high-alert
periods.
  • Habit of following runbooks and escalation paths, while also giving feedback when you
see gaps or improvement opportunities.
  • Ownership mindset: you close the loop on alerts you touch, or you hand them over with
enough context that the next person can continue smoothly.

Qualifications

Nice to have
  • Experience in a 24/7 SOC environment with strict SLAs.
  • Hands-on experience specifically with CrowdStrike Falcon and Microsoft Sentinel in a
production environment.
  • Exposure to SOAR / automation and working with automated playbooks for common use
cases (phishing, malware, brute force, etc.).
  • Familiarity with basic vulnerability prioritization (CVSS concepts, asset criticality).
  • Security certifications such as:
o CompTIA Security+, CySA+,
o CEH,
o Vendor-specific SOC/EDR/XDR certifications (including CrowdStrike, Microsoft,
etc.).
Growth and development
Even though this role is centered on triage, we want people who are interested in growing
further within the SOC. Over time, you’ll have opportunities to:
  • Take on more complex investigations and incident response tasks under guidance from
senior analysts.
  • Get involved in improving detection rules, tuning alerts, and enhancing runbooks.
  • Develop towards specialist tracks such as incident response, threat hunting, or detection
engineering depending on your strengths and interests.


Additional Information

title: Detection & Response Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At TechBiz Global, we are providing recruitment service to our TOP clients from our portfolio. We are currently seeking a Detection & Response Engineer to join one of our clients' teams. If you're looking for an exciting opportunity to grow in a innovative environment, this could be the perfect fit for you.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Investigate security cases and targeted hunts using CrowdStrike Falcon Next-Gen SIEM and CQL; correlate telemetry, assess scope and impact, document findings, and recommend appropriate actions.
  • Develop, test, deploy, tune, and maintain detection logic, queries, dashboards, analyst guides, and version-controlled detection content.
  • Build and maintain Falcon Fusion SOAR workflows for enrichment, evidence capture, routing, escalation, and authorized response.
  • Validate telemetry coverage and quality; troubleshoot parsing, normalization, mapping, and source-data issues.
  • Translate validated investigations into platform workflow specifications and co-build scripts, API integrations, workflow components, and prototypes with Product and Engineering.
  • Test workflows and detections against representative cases; monitor outcomes, exceptions, and production feedback, and document ownership and support handoffs.
  • Provide technical support, troubleshooting, knowledge transfer, and coaching; coordinate assigned analysis and platform work.


Must have:

  • 5+ years of relevant security experience, including at least 2 years developing, testing, and tuning detection logic, or equivalent demonstrated capability.
  • Production proficiency with CrowdStrike Falcon Next-Gen SIEM, including CQL, cross-source investigations, detection content, telemetry interpretation, and tuning.
  • Hands-on Falcon Fusion SOAR workflow experience and practical use of Charlotte AI with evidence verification and awareness of approval boundaries.
  • Practical Python, REST/Falcon APIs, JSON, authentication, error handling, and secure credential management; familiarity with PowerShell or another relevant scripting language.
  • Experience with telemetry onboarding, parser/normalization troubleshooting, MITRE ATT&CK, Windows/Linux events, and controlled changes, version control, peer review, and regression testing.
  • Strong investigation judgment, defensible documentation, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Nice to have:

  • Experience converting SOC runbooks or manual analysis into production workflows or internal security platforms.
  • CrowdStrike resident, responder, partner implementation, or customer-embedded Falcon experience; FalconPy or comparable API tooling.
  • Experience partnering with Product and Engineering on analyst-facing features, case lifecycle integration, acceptance testing, or iterative delivery.
  • Managed security services, multi-client or follow-the-sun SOC operations, and ITSM integrations such as ServiceNow or Jira.
  • Relevant CrowdStrike training or credentials, GIAC invest
