title: Cyber Engineering Manager - Security Event Monitoring
descriptionHtml:
Lead a global 24x7 Security Event Monitoring service as an Engineering Manager, guiding Tier 1 and Tier 2 operations across assigned security verticals. You will provide operational leadership during cybersecurity events, improve investigation quality and service continuity, and develop a capable, resilient team. This role combines security operations leadership, stakeholder engagement, and continuous improvement in a global environment. Because this position supports a global 24x7 operating environment, participation in significant incident escalations outside standard business hours may be required according to the operating model.

Work you'll do

As an Engineering Manager on the Security Operations team, you will be responsible for:

  • Act as Shift Lead, managing assigned Event Monitoring verticals, workload, priorities and operational/technical escalations; Ensure appropriate security-event monitoring, investigation, escalation and response coordination throughout the shift.
  • Provide senior operational leadership during significant cybersecurity incidents and ensure appropriate coordination with Tier 3, Incident Response and other security teams; Coordinate with Foundation teams and other security teams during incident investigation and response.
  • Manage shift rosters, staffing coverage, weekend schedules and on-call requirements to maintain service continuity; Manage Member Firm security requests and escalations, ensuring effective communication, ownership and follow-through.
  • Review investigation tickets and conduct periodic quality checks with other leads, focusing on evidence quality, investigation logic, documentation and escalation decisions; Prepare weekly and monthly Security Operations reports covering incident volumes, escalations, quality observations, operational trends, risks and improvement initiatives; Present service performance, key incidents, risks and recommendations to managers and other leads.
  • Track Root Cause Analysis and preventive actions arising from priority incidents and recurring operational issues; Support continuous improvement of SOC procedures, playbooks, knowledge articles and service quality.
  • Lead onboarding of new team members, conduct regular 1:1 discussions, provide feedback and identify training and cross-skilling opportunities; Mentor analysts and leads, support succession planning and maintain effective workforce capability across shifts; Ensure responsible use of AI-assisted investigations and automation with appropriate evidence validation, human accountability and operational controls.

The team

The Security Operations team provides 24x7 security-event monitoring, investigation, escalation, and response coordination across Deloitte's environment. The team works with Incident Response, Foundation, and other security teams to help investigate cybersecurity events, strengthen operational resilience, and improve service quality. This global team supports through coordinated monitoring, incident response, and continuous improvement.

Location: Hyderabad

Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM IST

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering.
  • 10-13 years of cybersecurity experience, including experience leading teams in a 24x7 Security Operations Center (SOC), Incident Response, or cyber-defense environment.
  • Experience managing Tier 1 and Tier 2 Security Operations, shift delivery, and operational escalations.
  • Experience using Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) or Extended Detection and Response (XDR) technologies, including Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk Enterprise Security, or Microsoft Defender XDR.
  • Experience conducting incident investigations, coordinating containment activities, performing service-quality reviews, and preparing Security Operations reports.
  • Experience with Incident, Change, and Problem Management; Root Cause Analysis; and Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) practices.
  • Experience managing staffing, rosters, on-call coverage, onboarding, coaching, performance development, operational metrics, and stakeholder presentations.

Preferred:

  • Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering.
  • Experience with Security Orchestration, Automation and Response (SOAR), threat intelligence, endpoint, identity, email, cloud, and network security technologies.
  • Experience with AI-assisted Security Operations and security automation governance.
  • One or more of the following certifications: Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) 4, or Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200).
Our purpose

Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
Our people and culture

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
Professional development

At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.
Benefits to help you thrive


At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. title: Application Security Engineer - Fully Remote
descriptionHtml:
Top 3 Reasons To Join Us

  • 100% remote, with a global, diverse team
  • Working on the latest tech for the Insurtech Market Leader
  • Lead and shape how an AI-native security function finds and prevents vulnerabilities at the AI-native insurance platform of choice for the world’s leading insurers

About Us

At CoverGo, our mission is to empower all insurance companies to make insurance 100% digital and accessible to everyone.

  • We are a leading global no-code insurance platform for health, life, and P&C
  • We’re the winner of the Insurtech of the Year in all of Asia and other awards globally
  • We work with insurance enterprise clients such as AXA, Bupa, MSIG, Dai-ichi, Bank of China Group Insurance, and many more
  • We're an international, diverse team of over 200 people with 30 nationalities and team members working remotely from all over the world
  • We are fully funded and backed by reputable VC funds and strategic institutional investors
  • We have a global presence in Asia, EMEA and the Americas
  • We’ve grown our annualized revenue by over 30x since January 2021
  • We’re constantly working towards making CoverGo a workplace that you love coming to. We deeply believe that bringing together a diversity of thoughts, expressions, and perspectives is key to building the best culture for equally diverse communities all over the world

About The Role

CoverGo is hiring an Application Security Engineer to use AI to find and prevent vulnerabilities before they reach production, and to give engineering teams the tools and guardrails that stop vulnerabilities from being introduced in the first place. The Security team is small and growing, and works AI-first: everyone uses AI to automate their own work and to scale security across a large engineering organisation.

What You Will Do

  • Use AI tools such as Claude and OpenAI models to find and triage vulnerabilities in code, dependencies and designs before changes are merged.
  • Embed security checks into developer workflows and CI/CD pipelines so issues surface as code is written.
  • Select, configure and tune code-security tools such as GitHub Advanced Security, Snyk and Checkmarx, keeping the signal high enough that engineers act on the findings.
  • Build self-service tools, guardrails and guidance that help engineering teams prevent common vulnerability classes.
  • Partner with engineering leads and security champions across product teams to prioritise and fix findings.
  • Review security-relevant designs and changes, ranking risk by what an attacker could realistically reach.
  • Track and report on application-security risk and remediation progress.

What We Need

  • 3+ years in application security or a closely related security role.
  • An AI-native approach to securing software: you already use LLMs to find, detect and explain vulnerabilities.
  • Enough fluency in at least one modern programming language to read, understand and fix vulnerable code. A software-engineering background is not required.
  • Hands-on experience with code-security tools such as GitHub Advanced Security, Snyk or Checkmarx.
  • A solid grasp of common vulnerability classes, such as the OWASP Top 10, and how to prevent them.
  • A practical, enabling style of working with engineers.

Nice to have

  • Experience building custom security tooling or automations on LLM APIs.
  • Experience securing applications on AWS, Azure or GCP.
  • Experience in insurance, financial services or another regulated SaaS environment.

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • Paid Annual Leaves
  • Annual Performance Bonus
  • Health Insurance
  • Remote Work Allowance
  • Anniversary Bonus
  • Company activities and events
  • Learning and development plan

CoverGo Company Video

title: Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Information

  • Date Opened 11/13/2026
  • Job Type Full time
  • Industry Technology
  • Work Experience 5+ years
  • City Hyderabad
  • State/Province Telangana
  • Country India
  • Zip/Postal Code 500032

Job Description

Job description


We are seeking a talented Security Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate should have a strong background in production security, DevSecOps, and extensive experience with SDLC practices and multiple security tools, including but not limited to Qualys, Black Duck, and Prisma. As a Security Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring robust security practices and implementing cutting-edge security measures to protect our systems and data.


Key Responsibilities

  • Vulnerability Management:


  • Own end-to-end vulnerability lifecycle for a given Business Unit consisting of multiple enterprise level products. (SaaS & on-prem).


  • Triage, track, Correlate and remediate vulnerabilities from tools like Black Duck, Prisma Cloud, Qualys, Jfrog Xray etc. Understanding the working of these tools and mapping in a common tool.


  • Co-ordinate with business security leads to plan patching strategies and risk mitigation.


  • Security Automation:


  • Integrate security scanning tools into common tools.


  • In progress and SLA tracking for all the vulnerabilities and work closely with respective business units.


  • Develop dashboards and reports for compliance and leadership visibility.


  • Write high level design to automate a few of the manual work.


  • Collaboration & Governance:


  • Work cross-functionally with product teams, and stakeholders.


  • Contribute to security policies, standards, and best practices.


  • Participate in incident response and post-mortem analysis.


  • Education & Awareness:


  • Publish security advisories on high-priority vulnerabilities (CVEs).


  • Helping Junior team members on security aspects.


  • Kubernetes, container build pipeline, and repository platform knowledge is a plus.


  • Familiarity with vulnerability scoring models like CVSS,EPSS,BDSA


Requirements


Key Technologies


  • Security Tools:     Black Duck, Prisma Cloud, Qualys, Snyk, Coverity, SonarQube, Nessus


  • DevOps Stack:     Jenkins, Kubernetes, Helm, Docker


  • Programming:     Python, Shell, YAML, JSON (Good to have)


  • Cloud Platforms:     AWS, GCP (Understanding basics of Cloud) Success Metrics


  • Reduction in high/critical vulnerabilities within SLA by working with security champion


  • Increasing automation for doing mundane tasks


  • Cross-team security engagement and support effectiveness


  • Strong communication skills.

title: Engineering Analyst, Threat Investigations
descriptionHtml:
Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience in data analysis, including identifying trends, generating summary statistics, and drawing insights from quantitative and qualitative data.
  • 2 years of experience with one or more of the following languages: SQL, R, Python, or C++.
  • 2 years of experience managing projects and defining project scope, goals, and deliverables.
  • Experience leading end-to-end incident response investigations, including network/log forensics, malware analysis, and disk/memory forensics.
  • Experience conducting legally compliant security investigations regarding threats, fraud, insider risk, or other corporate security issues.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in a Quantitative discipline.
  • 2 years of experience or familiarity with machine learning systems.
  • Experience tuning Large Language Model (LLM)-based models using prompt engineering for statistical metrics such as precision and recall.
  • Experience in identifying and mitigating fraud and abuse dynamics within online platforms.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

About the job

Fast-paced, dynamic, and proactive, YouTube’s Trust & Safety team is dedicated to making YouTube a safe place for users, viewers, and content creators around the world to create, and express themselves. Whether understanding and solving their online content concerns, navigating within global legal frameworks, or writing and enforcing worldwide policy, the Trust & Safety team is on the frontlines of enhancing the YouTube experience, building internet safety, and protecting free speech in our ever-evolving digital world.

As an Engineering Analyst, you will be passionate about technologies and have experience with analyzing large-scale data and scaled systems of review. You will grow in a fast, dynamic, demanding environment where no two days are ever the same. You will be a key contributor, independent, critical thinker with sound metrics judgment who has a passion for solving technological challenges and setting scalable standards.

descriptionHtml:
JD for security

Job Description : Security GRC Consultant

Essential Skills Experience

It is our expectation that successful applicants should be able to demonstrate many, if not all of the experience and skills listed below:
  • SAP security resource should have 8+ years of experience with atleast one end to end implementation.
  • Experience in handling Support Projects and Security Project.
  • Experience in SAP ECC, BI security, SAP GRC 10.1/12.0, SAP S/4 HANA, FIORI and Solution Manager.
  • Experience in SAP GRC to perform SOD risk analysis, simulations, mitigating controls assignment.
  • Hands on experience on GRC 10.1/12.0 and ruleset maintenance for any updates (functions/risks updated in rulebook)
  • Extensive experience on User Administration, Role Administration on various SAP Systems
  • Extensive experience with Profile Generator (PFCG), RSECADMIN etc
  • Experience in Transaction codes including SU22, SU24, SU25 etc
  • Extensive Grip on SAP Security tables and SUIM Reports.
  • Perform high level support including problem determination for all SAP security needs within
Development, QA, and Production SAP clients.

  • Deliver regular release items (problems and requests) understanding business requirements and completing the design, build, testing and deployment of functional components.

title: Senior Third-Party Cyber Risk & Continuous Monitoring Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Senior Third-Party Cyber Risk & Continuous Monitoring Analyst (5+ years’ experience, Hyderabad/Bangalore location)


Please prioritize candidates with experience in areas such as:

  • Third-party cyber risk management and vendor security assessments
  • Security rating and continuous monitoring platforms (Radar, BitSight, Security Scorecard, RiskRecon)
  • External attack surface and threat monitoring
  • Third-party cybersecurity incident response
  • AI-enabled vendor risk evaluation
  • Cybersecurity frameworks and standards (NIST CSF, NIST AI RMF, ISO 27001, FFIEC, SOC reporting)

Job Description:

  • Conduct cybersecurity and information security risk assessments of third-party vendors and service providers.
  • Administer continuous monitoring platforms such as Radar, BitSight, Security Scorecard, and RiskRecon.

  • Analyse changes in vendor security posture and determine materiality and business impact.
  • Participate in and coordinate third-party cybersecurity incident response activities.
  • Evaluate security, privacy, governance, compliance, and operational risks of AI-enabled vendors and technologies.
  • Escalate significant findings and facilitate remediation with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
  • Track vendor remediation commitments through closure and ensure appropriate risk disposition.

We're looking for innovators, strategists, and visionaries to join our team and make a meaningful impact. If you're ready to help shape the future with us, we'd love to hear from you!


Senior Cyber Security Engineer

Location : SNP Cloud Technologies, 12th Floor, Western Aqua, Cross Street 1, Whitefields, HITEC City, Hyderabad, Kondapur, Telangana 500081

Job Details : Full-time

Reports into : Practice Manager – Cyber Security

Job Description: Senior Cybersecurity Engineer – Data Security

Job Summary

Experienced Cybersecurity Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in implementing and managing Microsoft Purview and data security solutions. The candidate should have experience in data discovery, classification, data loss prevention (DLP), information protection, and compliance across enterprise environments. Experience with Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Entra ID, and Azure security services is desirable.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and manage Microsoft Purview solutions across Microsoft and other enterprise environments.
  • Configure and administer Information Protection, Sensitivity Labels, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Insider Risk Management, Data Lifecycle Management, eDiscovery, and Compliance Manager.
  • Implement Data Security Posture Management.
  • Integrate Microsoft Purview with Microsoft 365, Azure, and third-party data sources.
  • Collaborate with security and compliance teams to implement governance and regulatory controls.
  • Support customer solution design, implementation, and technical documentation.

Mandatory Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Purview and Microsoft 365 Compliance.
  • Experience implementing DLP, Information Protection, Sensitivity Labels, Insider Risk Management, and eDiscovery.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft 365, Azure, Microsoft Entra ID, and compliance frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of data governance, data classification, and regulatory compliance.
  • Excellent communication, troubleshooting, and customer-facing skills.

Good to Have

  • Microsoft Sentinel
  • Microsoft Defender XDR suite
  • Azure security and governance
  • KQL or scripting experience
  • Experience with security assessments and compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR,
    HIPAA, or PCI-DSS.

Preferred Certifications

  • SC-400 – Microsoft Information Protection Administrator
  • AZ-500 – Azure Security Engineer Associate

Education

We believe that fostering a sense of humor and creating an enjoyable workplace environment cultivates an atmosphere that drives exceptional creativity, outstanding client service, and thriving team members.

title: Lead Information Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Information Security Engineer. We believe in the power of working together because great ideas can come from anyone. Through collaboration, any employee can have an impact and make a difference for the entire company. Explore opportunities with us for a career in a supportive environment where you can learn and grow.


In this role, you will:

  • Lead computer security incident response activities for highly complex events
  • Conduct technical investigation of security related incidents and post incident digital forensics to identify causes and recommend future mitigation strategies
  • Provide security consulting on large projects for internal clients to ensure conformity with corporate information, security policy, and standards
  • Design, document, test, maintain, and provide issue resolution recommendations for highly complex security solutions related to networking, cryptography, cloud, authentication and directory services, email, internet, applications, and endpoint security
  • Review and correlate security logs
  • Utilize subject matter knowledge in industry leading security solutions and best practices to implement one or more components of information security such as availability, integrity, confidentiality, risk management, threat identification, modeling, monitoring, incident response, access management, and business continuity
  • Identify security vulnerabilities and issues, perform risk assessments, and evaluate remediation alternatives
  • Collaborate and influence all levels of professionals including managers
  • Lead a team to achieve objectives


Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of Information Security Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education


Desired Qualifications:

  • Advanced experience creating executive level dashboards, analytics, and reports using advanced visualization tools
  • Advanced experience gathering business requirements from various sources including end-users and stakeholders
  • Advanced business intelligence experience
  • Experience with Agile Scrum (Daily Standup, Sprint Planning and Sprint Retrospective meetings) and Kanban
  • Experience with one or more Agile tools used for tracking user stories or backlogs, such as Confluence or Jira
  • Familiarity with DataOps concepts and End to End Operational and Analytical Data Pipelines
  • Ability to translate and present complex data in a manner that educates, enhances understanding, and influence decisions
  • Experience preparing reporting, metrics, and presentation materials for various levels of leadership
  • Proven research and analytical skills with the ability to independently work through complex and ambiguous situations
  • Partner with stakeholders responsible to document, improve and strengthen processes that support the Services including ensuring adherence to data quality and control standards
  • Hands on experience using Power BI and Tableau with understanding in underlying framework necessary to create visualizations that accentuate insights
  • Advanced Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, and Access) skills
  • Proficient in using Python and / or R for data acquisition and analysis
  • Advanced SQL skills
  • Proficient in Excel including pivot tables, complex formulas, VBA, and charts
  • Strong analytical skills with high attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to work with complex teams; have global experience, specifically US banks
  • Comfortable with making and presenting recommendations to a wide audience of stakeholders


Job Expectations:

  • Translate business requirements into an array of business intelligence and metrics dashboards and reporting views in ServiceNow, Tableau, SharePoint, Power BI, Excel, and other platforms.
  • Translate business requirements into epics, features, and user stories
  • Update and create process and procedure documentation, detailed job aids, and training materials
  • Lead the development of new metrics and track/evaluate performance over time
  • Facilitate and host discussions to troubleshoot data issues that are out of line with requirements
  • Establish and promote Data Ops Best Practices in collaboration with multiple Product and Tech teams
  • Support Application Security’s technology and data environment modernization efforts
  • Research moderately complex business, operational, and strategic initiatives that require analytical skills, basic knowledge of organizational strategy and Business Execution, and understanding of international business
  • Collaborate and consult with team leaders in developing project plans, policies, and procedures
  • The ideal candidate for this position will possess exceptional people management, analytical, technical, problem-solving and execution skills - with strong business acumen, collaborative leadership abilities, risk and control self-assessment process proficiency and a focus on follow-through activities to deliver business priorities/objectives.

Posting End Date:

22 Nov 2026
  • Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

We Value Equal Opportunity

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.

Applicants with Disabilities

To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo.

Drug and Alcohol Policy


Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more.


Wells Fargo Recruitment and Hiring Requirements:


a. Third-Party recordings are prohibited unless authorized by Wells Fargo.

b. Wells Fargo requires you to directly represent your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process.

c. Please be prepared to provide accurate information and supporting documentation in connection with any lawful employment and education verification conducted by Wells Fargo.

descriptionHtml:
Top 3 Reasons To Join Us

  • 100% remote, with a global, diverse team
  • Working on the latest tech for the Insurtech Market Leader
  • Lead and shape how an AI-native security function finds and prevents vulnerabilities at the AI-native insurance platform of choice for the world’s leading insurers

About Us

At CoverGo, our mission is to empower all insurance companies to make insurance 100% digital and accessible to everyone.

  • We are a leading global no-code insurance platform for health, life, and P&C
  • We’re the winner of the Insurtech of the Year in all of Asia and other awards globally
  • We work with insurance enterprise clients such as AXA, Bupa, MSIG, Dai-ichi, Bank of China Group Insurance, and many more
  • We're an international, diverse team of over 200 people with 30 nationalities and team members working remotely from all over the world
  • We are fully funded and backed by reputable VC funds and strategic institutional investors
  • We have a global presence in Asia, EMEA and the Americas
  • We’ve grown our annualized revenue by over 30x since January 2021
  • We’re constantly working towards making CoverGo a workplace that you love coming to. We deeply believe that bringing together a diversity of thoughts, expressions, and perspectives is key to building the best culture for equally diverse communities all over the world

About The Role

CoverGo is hiring an ISMS Manager to own our internal and external audit programme and give management independent assurance on the state of our cybersecurity compliance and risk management. The Security team is small and growing, and works AI-first: everyone uses AI to automate their own work and to scale security across a large engineering organisation.

What You Will Do

  • Own the internal and external audit programme, including ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certification and surveillance audits.
  • Set up and run an internal audit framework: audit plan, scoping, control testing, findings and follow-up.
  • Design custom control frameworks that establish clear ownership and accountability in a matrix organisation, where several teams share responsibility for the same systems.
  • Define technical controls for the engineering organisation and test that they operate as designed.
  • Report to management on compliance status, control effectiveness and risk, with clear findings and named owners.
  • Maintain the risk register and drive remediation through to closure.
  • Prepare audit evidence for customer security reviews and due diligence.
  • Use AI to automate evidence collection, control testing and reporting.

What We Need

  • 3+ years in information security governance, risk and compliance, or audit.
  • Hands-on experience leading ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certifications through to a successful audit.
  • A track record of building internal audit frameworks with custom controls, not just adopting a standard template.
  • Experience designing control frameworks that assign accountability across a matrix organisation.
  • Enough technical depth to define and test controls for engineering teams, such as access management, change management, secure development and cloud configuration.
  • Practical experience using AI to automate compliance and audit workflows.
  • Clear writing for both engineers and executives.

Nice to have

  • ISO 27001 Lead Auditor or CISA certification.
  • Experience in insurance, financial services or another regulated SaaS environment.

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • Paid Annual Leaves
  • Annual Performance Bonus
  • Health Insurance
  • Remote Work Allowance
  • Anniversary Bonus
  • Company activities and events
  • Learning and development plan

CoverGo Company Video

title: Junior Network Development Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Opplane

Opplane helps organizations unlock the value of their data in a world increasingly shaped by artificial intelligence, connectivity, and regulation.

We work with businesses across complex, data-intensive industries to turn fragmented or difficult-to-use data into trusted, actionable intelligence. Our work spans connectivity technologies, AI and data solutions for banking and fintech, and data governance and modernization.

Our founders and leadership team bring decades of experience in networking, wireless and telecom, having built and scaled multiple technology companies, several of them acquired by leading networking and technology players. Drawing on years of selling networking infrastructure, we are involved in building critical infrastructure for telecom operators, developing carrier-grade, software-based solutions that help them deliver secure, scalable connectivity to their enterprise customers.

Why this role matters

Our telecom products run on networking software built close to the packet: code that handles traffic, protocols and tunnels at carrier scale. Keeping that software reliable means fixing issues quickly and understanding why they happened.

In this role, you’ll start by learning our products and working on smaller issues alongside senior engineers, helping them diagnose and fix problems. It’s a hands-on way to build real depth in networking software, where the answers come from understanding the code and the protocols.

What you’ll do

  • Learn how our networking products are built and how they run in operator environments

  • Investigate and fix smaller issues in existing C/C++ code, with guidance from senior engineers

  • Help senior engineers reproduce, debug and resolve product issues

  • Support the product by analysing logs and test results to find the root cause of problems

  • Test your changes, and document what you found and how you fixed it

  • Take on more complex work as your understanding of the product grows

What you’ll bring

Experience and expertise

  • A degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Telecommunications or a related field

  • 2+ years of experience in networking software development

  • Solid programming skills in C and/or C++

  • Familiarity with networking protocols across layers 2 to 4

  • Working knowledge of IPsec and SSL/TLS

  • Experience with overlays and tunnelling (e.g. VXLAN, GRE)

  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes

  • Good written and spoken English

How you work

  • Curious and keen to learn, and comfortable saying “I don’t know yet”

  • You can explain the code you’ve written

  • Methodical when debugging: you look for the root cause, not just a quick fix

  • Ask for help when you’re stuck, and take feedback on board

  • Communicate clearly with colleagues in a distributed team

Nice to have

  • Understanding of DPDK

  • Experience working in cloud environments

What you’ll have the opportunity to do

  • Build deep, hands-on expertise in networking software, working directly in the code

  • Learn from senior engineers with long experience in networking and telecom

  • Grow your scope as you learn the product, from small fixes to more complex work

How we work

Small team, big challenges, real ownership. At Opplane, you’ll work on software and technology across data, AI and connectivity, helping build solutions that address complex technical and business needs. You’ll have access to leadership, opportunities to contribute to technical decisions and room to influence how we approach problems and build our products.

Depending on your role, you may collaborate with colleagues, clients and stakeholders across the US, Portugal, Singapore and India. Our work brings together different areas of expertise and perspectives, making it important to stay curious, exchange ideas and understand the challenges others are working to solve. We value people who take initiative, share their knowledge and bring new perspectives to the way we work.

Ultimately, it’s about bringing people and technology together to build solutions that meet today’s needs and anticipate tomorrow’s challenges.

Interested?

If this opportunity sounds like a good fit for your experience and the kind of work you want to do, we’d like to hear from you.

Apply to learn more about the role and how you could contribute to Opplane.

Opplane is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, gender identity, disability, religion, caste, age or background.

title: Lead, AI Security Analyst
descriptionHtml:
About the Role:

Grade Level (for internal use):

11
Role Summary
We are seeking a seasoned GenAI Security Lead to design, implement, and continuously improve our enterprise AI security posture across all major cloud providers (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure) and on‑prem/edge environments. This role will own the AI risk framework, lead security architecture reviews for agentic AI systems, and drive secure design and lifecycle management of AI agents (including MCP, ACP, and A2A patterns). The ideal candidate blends deep security engineering experience with modern AI/ML and LLMOps knowledge, delivering secure-by-design solutions that are compliant, resilient, and business‑aligned.

Key Responsibilities –

  • Develop and implement comprehensive AI/ML security strategies, policies, standards, and guidelines to protect organizational assets and ensure the secure operation of AI and ML systems
  • Build security control framework and generic reference architectures for GenAI applications.
  • Assist with identifying security requirements to be followed by LoB/Dev teams when building GenAI applications.
  • Conduct threat modeling exercises to identify potential security risks and vulnerabilities in AI systems, working closely with AI development teams to integrate security into the design and development processes.
  • Provide thought leadership and creativity to mature Gen AI security governance embedding into our existing cyber security risk appetite framework.
  • Perform security assessments on AI applications and systems to identify and address vulnerabilities. Develop and implement testing methodologies to evaluate the security posture of AI models and frameworks.
  • Develop configuration hardening guidelines for Cloud Services including native Generative AL/ML services such as AWS SageMaker, SageMaker Notebooks, Bedrock, Kendra, OpenSearch, Lambda, Azure Cognitive Services, Open AI, GCP Vertex AI etc.
  • Stay updated on relevant regulations and standards related to AI security and ensure compliance. Collaborate with legal and compliance teams to align AI systems with industry and regulatory requirements.


Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of Information Security experience in areas of Information/Cloud Security

  • 5+ years of Software engineering and/or software development experience is required.

  • Certification in any of the AI/ML cloud services

  • Good understanding of application and data security, AI/Gen AI, Machine Learning, or data science

  • Strong understanding of GenAI, LLM, Prompt Engineering and OWASP LLM Top 10

  • Threat modelling using industry standard methodologies (e.g. STRIDE/DREAD)

  • Security architecture assessments for one or more IT systems such as Web, Mobile, APIs/Microservices, Cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure/Oracle)

  • Experience developing Reference Security Architecture and Design Patterns to support proactive and automated controls.

  • A demonstrated knowledge of information security standards, rules and regulations related to information security and data confidentiality and other various security standards and policies.

  • Ability to keep up to date with technology and security. Make informed decision and appropriate adjustments .

  • Good interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to influence at all levels of the organization, while being able to simplify complex IS topics

  • Excellent problems solving abilities and analytical skills

  • Ability to organize, prioritize, and lead multiple deliverables simultaneously across a large, global corporate environment.

What’s In It For You?

Our Mission:

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

Our People:

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.

Our Values:
Integrity, Discovery, Partnership


Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.

Benefits:

We take care of you, so you can take care of business. We care about our people. That’s why we provide everything you—and your career—need to thrive at S&P Global.

Our benefits include:

  • Health & Wellness: Health care coverage designed for the mind and body.

  • Flexible Downtime: Generous time off helps keep you energized for your time on.

  • Continuous Learning: Access a wealth of resources to grow your career and learn valuable new skills.

  • Invest in Your Future: Secure your financial future through competitive pay, retirement planning, a continuing education program with a company-matched student loan contribution, and financial wellness programs.

  • Family Friendly Perks: It’s not just about you. S&P Global has perks for your partners and little ones, too, with some best-in class benefits for families.

  • Beyond the Basics: From retail discounts to referral incentive awards—small perks can make a big difference.

For more information on benefits by country visit: https://spgbenefits.com/benefit-summaries

Global Hiring and Opportunity at S&P Global:

At S&P Global, we are committed to fostering a connected and engaged workplace where all individuals have access to opportunities based on their skills, experience, and contributions. Our hiring practices emphasize fairness, transparency, and merit, ensuring that we attract and retain top talent. By valuing different perspectives and promoting a culture of respect and collaboration, we drive innovation and power global markets.

If you receive an email from a spglobalind.com domain or any other regionally based domains, it is a scam and should be reported to reportfraud@spglobal.com . S&P Global never requires any candidate to pay money for job applications, interviews, offer letters, “pre-employment training” or for equipment/delivery of equipment. Stay informed and protect yourself from recruitment fraud by reviewing our guidelines, fraudulent domains, and how to report suspicious activity here .

title: Staff Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Our Company

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

What You’ll Do

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will design, develop, and evolve identity, security, and access management capabilities for Teradata’s cloud platform. You will work on authentication, authorization, identity federation, user provisioning, agent identity, agentic security, and secure integrations across Teradata cloud services.

This role will require you to:

  • Design and develop scalable, secure, and highly available cloud services.
  • Build identity capabilities using industry standards such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, JWT, and SCIM.
  • Design secure identity, authorization, and delegation models for AI agents and agentic applications.
  • Build and integrate AI agents that securely interact with enterprise services, data, tools, and other agents.
  • Address agentic-security concerns such as agent authentication, delegated authorization, least-privilege access, credential management, auditability, and protection against unauthorized actions.
  • Design APIs and integrations across distributed services and enterprise identity providers.
  • Lead complex technical initiatives across teams and services, from architecture and design through implementation and production deployment.
  • Use AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and similar tools for software development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and design.
  • Evaluate new AI development tools and agentic engineering practices, and educate the team on their effective, secure, and responsible use.
  • Improve overall team productivity by developing reusable AI-assisted workflows, agents, engineering practices, and automation.
  • Ensure the availability, reliability, security, and observability of production services.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across applications, cloud infrastructure, networking, identity providers, AI agents, and databases.
  • Participate in design and code reviews and provide technical guidance to other engineers.

Who You’ll Work With

You will join a high-performing engineering team responsible for foundational identity, agent identity, security, and platform capabilities across Teradata’s cloud ecosystem. You will collaborate with engineers, architects, security, SRE, product, AI, and operations teams.

This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Engineering Manager. The role requires hands-on technical leadership, strong ownership, energy, and a passion for driving new identity and agentic-security capabilities forward.

What Makes You a Qualified Candidate

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field from a leading institution, or equivalent demonstrated education and professional experience. Graduates from institutions such as IITs, NITs, BITS Pilani, and IIITs are preferred.
  • 8+ years of software engineering experience building production-grade backend, platform, security, or distributed systems.
  • Strong programming skills in Java, Go, Python, or a comparable modern programming language.
  • Experience designing REST APIs, microservices, and distributed systems.
  • Experience with cloud-native technologies, including containers, Kubernetes, and public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Experience designing or developing authentication, authorization, identity, or security-related capabilities for distributed systems.
  • Experience with AI-assisted software development using tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or comparable coding assistants.
  • Experience building or integrating AI agents, agentic applications, or AI-enabled software capabilities.
  • Understanding of security considerations for AI agents, including identity, authorization, delegation, credential handling, least-privilege access, auditability, and secure tool invocation.
  • Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and production troubleshooting.
  • Strong technical judgment, problem-solving, communication, and ownership skills.
  • Experience leading technical designs and complex engineering initiatives across teams as an individual contributor.
  • Ability to evaluate new engineering tools and practices, establish reusable patterns, and help other engineers adopt them effectively.

What You’ll Bring

You will be a preferred candidate if you have:

  • Experience building or operating Identity and Access Management services.
  • Experience with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, JWT, SCIM, token exchange, and delegated authorization.
  • Experience designing identity and authorization models for AI agents, agentic workflows, or multi-agent systems.
  • Knowledge of agentic-security risks and controls, including prompt injection, excessive agency, insecure tool use, identity propagation, credential exposure, and auditability.
  • Experience integrating with Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, PingFederate, or similar identity providers.
  • Experience with role-based or attribute-based access control.
  • Knowledge of workload identity, service-to-service authentication, or technologies such as SPIFFE/SPIRE.
  • Experience with AI-agent frameworks, model tool-calling, Model Context Protocol, or similar agent integration technologies.
  • Experience creating reusable prompts, coding workflows, agents, or automation that improve engineering-team productivity.
  • Working knowledge of LDAP, Kerberos, or related enterprise authentication technologies.
  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS or enterprise cloud platforms.
  • Knowledge of database authentication, authorization, or user management.

descriptionHtml:
Job Description – Associate Director / Principal SME – WAAP

**Experience:** 10+ Years

**Domain:** Cybersecurity / Network Security

**Joining:** Immediate Joiners Preferred

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **WAAP (Web Application and API Protection) SME** to lead enterprise-level application security initiatives. The candidate should have strong expertise in WAAP, WAF, API Security, OWASP vulnerabilities, and DDoS mitigation, with experience in designing, implementing, and managing security solutions.

Key Responsibilities

- Design, implement, and manage enterprise WAAP and WAF solutions.

- Identify and mitigate web application vulnerabilities and security threats.

- Implement API security controls and authentication mechanisms.

- Work on OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities and attack mitigation.

- Provide security architecture guidance and technical solutions.

- Lead complex cybersecurity projects and engagements.

- Collaborate with global security teams and mentor junior members.

Mandatory Skills

- WAAP and Web Application Firewall (WAF)

- OWASP Top 10 and CRS

- API Security and Application Security

- OAuth and Token-based Authentication

- Cloud Security and Network Security

- Vulnerability Assessment and Scanning

Good-to-Have Skills

- DDoS Mitigation and Content Filtering

- Load Balancing and Network Access Control (NAC)

- Network Segmentation

- Python / Perl Scripting

- SIEM and Incident Response

- Certifications: CISSP / CISA / CISM / CCNA / CCIE

**Ideal Candidate:** 10+ years of experience with strong hands-on WAAP and application security expertise. Immediate joiners preferred.

Pay: ₹1,190,000.00 - ₹2,000,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

  • Mention your last working date
  • Mention your preferred location

Experience:

  • WAAP: 10 years (Preferred)
  • Web application Firewall: 10 years (Preferred)
  • Owasp: 10 years (Preferred)
  • Cloud security : 10 years (Preferred)
  • Network security: 10 years (Preferred)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Hyderabad, Telangana

title: Engagement Lead, Incident Response
descriptionHtml:
ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Responds to Client, Counsel, Carrier (CCC) in accordance with Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and urgency of requests
  • Is solely responsible for the success, failure, and management of all team members’ activities and communications during the engagement
  • Engagement Management (External):
    • Leads the technical conversation and drive the direction and strategy of the engagement
    • Educates the Client on how to make an informed decision
    • Guides the Client on the importance of conducting a cost vs. benefit analysis
    • Maintains accountability for accurate and timely password changes within 24 hours
    • Builds the strategy for success and deliver it
    • Assists client with developing and executing their recovery plans
    • Establishes priorities for their IT and Arete engagement personnel
    • Is the subject matter expert on various technologies, infrastructure, and engagement-specific items
    • Tracks progress to completion
  • Engagement Management (Internal):
    • Communicates clearly and manages priorities by role ensuring each team member understands their tasks, values, and time to deliver
    • Ensures project workstreams are being delivered on-time
    • Monitors budget and team hours against allocated hours within the statement of work (SOW)
      • Ensures daily time entry is complete within Project management tool for the team
      • Ensures project workstreams are being delivered on-time
      • Ensures project budget is correct. Identifies potential overages and requests amendments when workstream budgets reach 75%, if necessary
      • Ensures the engagement team is utilized to a blended 70%
      • Easily identifies opportunities for add-on services to continue assisting Clients with Arete resources
    • Ensures teams execute tasks successfully and validates work product quality
    • Provides routine updates to CCC regarding overall engagement and action items
      • Delivers to the Client on-time based on agreed upon service level agreement (SLA) and/or as needed
  • Coaches and mentors junior team members
  • Proposes tactics and strategies that impact overall processes
  • May perform other duties as assigned by management

SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE

  • Excellent time management and organizational skills
  • Widely recognized technical abilities
  • Ability to teach others
  • Proficiency with reading the room and adjusting conversational style accordingly.
  • Ability to navigate difficult conversations effortlessly
  • Expert at managing client expectations
  • Ability to independently train, mentor, coach and lead team members globally and take ownership over their wins and losses
  • Ability to lead projects with security implementations
  • Thorough background or knowledge of network enterprise systems administration
  • Thorough knowledge and understanding of operating systems and hardware architectures: Linux/Unix, Mainframe, Windows, Cloud, etc.
  • Thorough knowledge and experience with core set of standard Industry technology and platforms and familiarity with cybersecurity tools. Hands-on not required but a plus
    • Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions
    • E-mail platforms: Microsoft Office (M365), On-premises Exchange, Google Workspace
    • Anti-virus (AV) vendors
    • Identity Access Management (IAM)/Zero Trust systems
    • Disaster Recover Plans
    • Firewall and Virtual Private Network (VPN) platforms
    • Remote access tools
  • Knowledge of Enterprise architecture
    • Network segmentation
    • Cloud Provider Platforms:
      • Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
    • On-premises technologies, Physical and Virtual
    • Servers, Firewalls, routers, storage, Security Information Event Management (SIEM), Multi-factor authentication
    • DMZ configurations
  • Thorough knowledge of containment, preservation, and acquisition of data within compromised IT environments
  • Thorough knowledge of email servers: on-premises, cloud hosted, and third-party hosted
    • Demonstrates deep understanding of configurations
    • Understands how email servers connect to or authenticate with Active Directory (AD)
    • Understands how to collect relevant logs from popular email services (Exchange, Exchange Online, Google Workspace, and M365)
      • Familiarity with or knowledge of how to familiarize oneself with additional platforms as required
    • Comfortable directing IT personnel to perform collection of required log information
    • Knowledgeable with securing email platforms and directing IT administrators on proper configuration techniquesAbility to establish priorities, work independently and proceed with objectives with minimal supervision

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Minimum of 7 years conducting digital investigations or leading full-cycle incident response investigations for a major consulting firm or global IR company
  • Bachelor's degree in a computer science related discipline and 8+ years related experience or Master's Degree and 6+ years related experience or J.D. and 4+ years related experience
  • Minimum of 1 industry certifications: GCFA, GCFE, GCIH, GISP, CISSP, Security+, MCSC, Network+, or equivalent

DISCLAIMER

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required personnel so classified.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

While performing the responsibilities of this position, the work environment characteristics listed below are representative of the environment the employee will encounter: Usual office working conditions. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable people with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this job.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • No physical exertion required
  • Travel within or outside of the state
  • Light work: Exerting up to 20 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 10 pounds of force as frequently as needed to move objects

TERMS OF EMPLOYMENT

Salary and benefits shall be paid consistent with Arete salary and benefit policy.

FLSA OVERTIME CATEGORY

Job is exempt from the overtime provisions of the Fair Labor Standards Act.

DECLARATION

The Arete Incident Response Human Resources Department retains the sole right and discretion to make changes to this job description.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer- and celebrate our employees’ differences, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or Veteran status. Different makes us better.

Arete Incident Response is an outstanding (and growing) company with a very dedicated, fun team. We offer competitive salaries, fully paid benefits including Medical/Dental, Life/Disability Insurance, 401(k) and the opportunity to work with some of the latest and greatest in the fast-growing cyber security industry.

When you join Arete…

You’ll be doing work that matters alongside other talented people, transforming the way people, businesses, and things connect with each other. Of course, we will offer you great pay and benefits, but we’re about more than that. Arete is a place where you can craft your own path to greatness. Whether you think in code, words, pictures or numbers, find your future at Arete, where experience matters.

Equal Employment Opportunity

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer- and celebrate our employees’ differences, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or Veteran status. Different makes us better.


About Us

Arete Incident Response is an elite team of the world’s leading cybersecurity and digital forensics experts who combat today’s sophisticated cyberattacks. We work tirelessly to provide unparalleled capabilities and solutions throughout the entire cyber incident life cycle. These include incident response readiness assessments and penetration tests as well as post-incident response, remediation, containment, and eradication services.

We work in close collaboration with industry leaders and government agencies along with leading cybersecurity technology platforms to deliver an innovative, intelligence-based approach to solving our client’s toughest challenges.

If you want to work with the most talented and experienced people in the industry with the desire to be a cyber hunter and industry expert, we want you to be a part of our team.

descriptionHtml:
ABOUT EVERNORTH:
Evernorth℠ exists to elevate health for all, because we believe health is the starting point for human potential and progress. As champions for affordable, predictable and simple health care,
we solve the problems others don’t, won’t or can’t.
Our innovation hub in India will allow us to work with the right talent, expand our global footprint, improve our competitive stance, and better deliver on our promises to stakeholders. We are passionate about making healthcare better by delivering world-class solutions that make a real difference.
We are always looking upward. And that starts with finding the right talent to help us get there.

Position Summary:
A successful Adversary Simulation member should possess a deep understanding of information security and computer science, paired with experience executing highly technical offensive assessments. They should understand advanced red and purple team campaign concepts such as performing social engineering and covert operations against complex networks while remaining entirely undetected, advanced application manipulation, and basic programming concepts. They should be able to improve the overall detection and response capabilities of the organization by understanding adversarial TTPs, developing engagements that emulate specific threat actors of concern, and engaging with the Blue Team during and post engagement.

At Cigna, you will be working with some of the best experts in the industry and faced with complex problem-solving opportunities daily. We help protect some of the most sensitive and valuable data for millions of members throughout the world and red teaming is critical to validating our global security posture. You are expected to quickly assimilate new information as you will face new environments across the globe on a regular basis. You will be expected to understand the relevant threat vectors to each environment and properly assess them, engage with peer teams (e.g., Cyber Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunt, and Incident Response) to develop engagements and effectively communicate results to a wide variety of audiences.

Job Description Responsibilities:
  • Design, scope, and lead complex technical assessments, including Purple Team engagements and other security initiatives to test attack detection and prevention effectiveness
  • Perform targeted offensive security assessments with a focus on detection and telemetry improvement
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Incident Response, Threat Hunt, Threat Intelligence, and Security Engineering to drive improved security outcomes and resiliency
  • Identify, develop, and promote new capabilities and improve Adversary Simulation’s overall program maturity
  • Support and mentor internal teams on secure architecture, detection logic, and adversary behaviors
Experience Required:
  • 13 - 15 years of combined experience in offensive security, red team, blue team, or purple team roles
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience executing advanced adversary TTPs across all phases of the kill chain
  • Proven ability to build, run, and measure adversary emulation exercises based on MITRE ATTCK or custom threat models
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (Python, PowerShell, Bash) and familiarity with programming languages (C/C, C#)
  • Experience building or tuning detection logic (KQL, Sigma, SPL, YARA, etc.) from detection engineering, threat hunt, or threat intelligence roles
  • Deep understanding of cybersecurity principles, network security, and modern attack vectors
  • Demonstrated ability to produce comprehensive reports and explain complex technical details in a concise, understandable manner
  • Excellent communication and time management skills
Experience Desired:
  • Prior experience performing offensive security operations within a mature enterprise or regulated environment
  • Knowledge of malware development concepts, evasion techniques, and offensive security research
  • Experience working within Agile or hybrid Agile/Scrum environments, including participating in sprint planning, backlog refinement, retrospectives, and cross‑team coordination
Education and Training Required:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field. Equivalent experience may be considered
  • Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSCE, OSEP, GXPN, CRTO, or similar
Primary Skills:
  • Advanced knowledge and experience in offensive security techniques and red teaming
  • Ability to emulate sophisticated adversaries and design realistic attack scenarios
  • Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills with keen attention to detail
Additional Skills:
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative environment with cross-functional teams
  • Flexibility to adapt to evolving security challenges and stay current with emerging threats
  • Willingness and ability to mentor and develop junior team members
Equal Opportunity Statement
Evernorth is an Equal Opportunity Employer actively encouraging and supporting organization-wide involvement of staff in diversity, equity, and inclusion efforts to educate, inform and advance both internal practices and external work with diverse client populations.

About Evernorth Health Services
Evernorth Health Services, a division of The Cigna Group, creates pharmacy, care and benefit solutions to improve health and increase vitality. We relentlessly innovate to make the prediction, prevention and treatment of illness and disease more accessible to millions of people. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

descriptionHtml:
Date: Nov 16, 2026
Job Requisition Id: 67095
Location: Hyderabad, TG, IN

YASH Technologies is a leading technology integrator specializing in helping clients reimagine operating models, enhance competitiveness, optimize costs, foster exceptional stakeholder experiences, and drive business transformation.


At YASH, we’re a cluster of the brightest stars working with cutting-edge technologies. Our purpose is anchored in a single truth – bringing real positive changes in an increasingly virtual world and it drives us beyond generational gaps and disruptions of the future.


We are looking forward to hire SAP Security Professionals in the following areas :


8–10+ years of hands-on SAP Security and GRC professional to lead security and access governance for an S/4HANA Public Cloud implementation. You will design a clean, SoD-compliant role model, integrate GRC with S/4HANA and other SAP applications, and partner with business, technical and audit stakeholders across global rollouts.
Key responsibilities
Requirements and design
  • Gather security requirements and run workshops with business, process and IT stakeholders.
  • Design business roles for S/4HANA Public Cloud using business role templates, business catalogs, restrictions and Fiori spaces/pages.
  • Design and customize Fiori roles with the right catalogs, groups and spaces for on-premise and private landscapes.
  • Build an SoD-clean role design from the start, so roles are free of conflicts before go-live.
Controls, compliance and rollout
  • Define system controls and write security procedures, standards and runbooks.
  • Support internal and external audits, including evidence, remediation and control testing.
  • Deliver global rollouts, adapting the role model to local and statutory (localization) needs.
  • Experience designing and customizing roles with Fiori catalogs, groups and spaces.
  • Clear understanding of business role concepts, especially in S/4HANA Public Cloud.
  • Internal or external audit experience (SOX, ITGC or similar).
  • SAP certification in Security, GRC or S/4HANA Cloud.
Soft skills
  • Strategic thinking, problem-solving and sound decision-making.

At YASH, you are empowered to create a career that will take you to where you want to go while working in an inclusive team environment. We leverage career-oriented skilling models and optimize our collective intelligence aided with technology for continuous learning, unlearning, and relearning at a rapid pace and scale.


Our Hyperlearning workplace is grounded upon four principles

  • Flexible work arrangements, Free spirit, and emotional positivity
  • Agile self-determination, trust, transparency, and open collaboration
  • All Support needed for the realization of business goals,
  • Stable employment with a great atmosphere and ethical corporate culture

title: Network Security Manager
descriptionHtml:
Company Description


Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.


Job Description


What you'll be doing:

You will be the architecture owner for Experian's endpoint-aligned secure access and data protection capabilities, bringing Proxy, CASB, and endpoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP) into consistent Zero Trust architecture. You will define the target architecture, standards, policy patterns, telemetry, and lifecycle roadmap while providing accountable leadership through the transition from the legacy Skyhigh, AnyConnect, Prisma, and Trellix estate.

  • Define Endpoint Security Architecture – Establish standards, reference architectures, policy guardrails, and configuration baselines for Proxy, CASB, Endpoint DLP, device posture, and identity-based access.
  • Lead SSE Transformation – Govern the Secure Service Edge (SSE) migration, including coexistence, cutover planning, rollback strategy, and operational readiness.
  • Integrate Proxy, CASB & DLP – Create a unified security model across web traffic inspection, data protection, CASB controls, and secure access policies.
  • Drive Zero Trust Access – Design access policies based on identity, device health, application context, and least-privilege principles, integrated with Okta and endpoint services.
  • Manage Technology Lifecycle – Maintain roadmaps and mitigate risks related to legacy and end-of-support security platforms.
  • Enhance Security Operations – Define monitoring, telemetry, alerting, reporting, and incident response capabilities to support sustainable operations.
  • Secure Collaboration Environments – Partner with Network, UC, and Facilities teams to ensure secure connectivity and monitoring for offices and conferencing spaces.
  • Provide Technical Leadership – Lead engagement with security vendors and collaborate across Security, Identity, Network, Endpoint, Risk, Compliance, and Audit teams.
  • Support Governance & Strategy – Deliver architecture decisions, roadmaps, risk assessments, and recommendations for leadership and governance forums.
  • You will be reporting to VP of Engineering

Qualifications


What are we looking for:

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in enterprise network security, endpoint security, secure web gateway/proxy, SSE/SASE, CASB, or DLP architecture within.
  • Proven experience designing and governing identity-aware Zero Trust access and data protection patterns across endpoints, virtual workspaces, cloud services, remote access, and office environments.
  • Deep technical expertise in secure web gateways, traffic inspection, policy design, endpoint DLP, CASB, identity integration (e.g., Okta), device posture, certificate lifecycle, logging, and telemetry.
  • Demonstrated leadership of major platform migrations and warm cutovers — including lifecycle transitions and end-of-life remediation — while maintaining operational continuity.
  • Strong cross-functional delivery leadership at the intersection of Workplace, Network, Endpoint, Identity, Security, Data Protection, and service operations, with disciplined program governance (incident, problem, change, capacity, risk, and vendor management).

Additional Information


Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose driven culture is multi award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or explore our Careers Site to understand why. Experian is also proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.

Recruitment Fraud Awareness - Experian's recruitment process is conducted only through authorised channels. Recruitment communications will only be sent from an @experian.com email address.

Experian will never ask candidates to make any payment as part of an application, interview, assessment, onboarding, or recruitment process. To apply for roles or verify opportunities, please visit experian.com/careers

Life at Experian:

  • Support for every family: Maternity, paternity and adoption leave for all parents, plus subsidised childcare for all employees.
  • Care when it matters most: Employee Assistance Program, Mental Health First Aiders, and compassionate and domestic violence leave.
  • Flexibility that fits your life: Flexible work arrangements, with generous annual, sick and family care leave.
  • A community where you belong: Employee Resource Groups, paid volunteer leave and recognition through our One Experian program.
  • Growth at every stage: Career mentoring, Harvard Manage Mentor, Experian University and e-learning platforms.

title: Senior Lead/Senior Engineer - Static Analysis & Agentic AI
descriptionHtml:
Company:

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Security Engineering

General Summary:

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. Qualcomm Security Engineers perform security assessments, develop company products, and collaborate across functions to ensure performance metrics and product requirements are met.



We are looking for a Senior Lead/Senior Engineer to provide hands-on technical leadership for static-analysis engineering across large Linux, Android, embedded, and kernel C/C++ software platforms.

The role combines deep expertise in program analysis, build/toolchain architecture, static-analysis platforms, and Agentic AI with technical leadership and cross-team execution.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field and 3+ years of Security Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Security Engineering or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field and 1+ year of Security Engineering or related work experience.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field, or M.Tech/MS in a related discipline or PhD.
  • 3-7 years of relevant experience in static analysis, compilers, program analysis, systems software, software security, or developer infrastructure.
  • Advanced programming skills in C/C++ and Python .
  • Demonstrated experience designing or scaling static-analysis solutions.
  • Hands-on experience building AI/LLM-enabled or Agentic AI solutions .
  • Experience leading technical projects and mentoring engineers.



Key Responsibilities

  • Architect and scale static-analysis solutions across Linux, Android, embedded, and kernel software.
  • Lead advanced program analysis, checker/model development, TP/FP analysis, and remediation strategies .
  • Design reusable integration across complex build systems, toolchains, product variants, and CI/CD .
  • Architect Agentic AI workflows for scan health, triage, root-cause analysis, remediation, patch generation, and validation.
  • Define standards for analysis quality, coverage, accuracy, AI evaluation, guardrails, and observability .
  • Lead technical designs, mentor engineers, and collaborate across software, build, compiler, security, DevOps, and AI teams.



Required Skills

  • Advanced C/C++ and Python development, debugging, and system-software expertise.
  • Strong understanding of AST/IR, control/data flow, interprocedural analysis, taint analysis, symbolic execution, alias/points-to, and object-lifetime analysis .
  • Strong experience with static-analysis platforms such as Klocwork, Coverity, Parasoft, CodeQL, Clang/LLVM , or equivalent.
  • Deep understanding of GCC/Clang, compilers, linkers, toolchains, cross-compilation, and build capture .
  • Strong experience with GNU Make/Kbuild/Kconfig and/or Android Soong/Ninja , plus familiarity with CMake, Bazel, Yocto/BitBake, Buildroot, or similar systems.
  • Hands-on expertise developing Agentic AI systems , including tool integration, stateful workflows, orchestration, guardrails, evaluation, and observability.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership and ability to scale engineering solutions across multiple projects.



Preferred Skills

  • Experience developing Clang/LLVM checkers, CodeQL queries, custom analysis rules, or compiler tooling .
  • Experience with Linux kernel, firmware, BSP, device drivers, hypervisors, or embedded platforms.
  • Knowledge of CWE, CERT C/C++, MISRA C/C++, AUTOSAR C++, ISO 26262, or ISO/SAE 21434 .
  • Experience with fuzzing, sanitizers, binary/runtime analysis, RAG, code search, MCP, and multi-agent orchestration .
