title: Security Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Role : Security Specialist

Drone Analytics Multi-Tenant SaaS Platform: MVP to GA

Experience : 5+ years in application and cloud security

Stack : AWS/Azure IAM, KMS/Key Vault, Vault, WAF, Semgrep/SonarQube, ZAP/Burp, Trivy, SIEM, mTLS, OAuth2/OIDC

Role Summary

Makes the platform secure by design and ready for enterprise security reviews: owns security architecture, vulnerability management, pen-test remediation and the compliance evidence needed for GA.

Key Responsibilities

  • Threat modelling: Run STRIDE models for tenancy, identity, APIs, media upload/streaming, plugins and GPU workers; track mitigations to closure.
  • Tenant isolation: Review isolation at API, database, cache, queue and object-storage layers; define cross-tenant test cases with QA.
  • Encryption and secrets: Set TLS policy, encryption at rest, per-tenant envelope keys with rotation; enforce no secrets in code or images.
  • Zero-trust: Define service identity, mTLS, network segmentation, least-privilege IAM and Kubernetes workload identity.
  • Secure SDLC: Embed SAST, DAST, SCA, container and IaC scanning in CI/CD with severity SLAs; manage SBOMs; review AI-generated code.
  • API and identity review: Check OWASP Top 10 and API Top 10 (object-level authorisation, SSRF, unsafe media upload), SSO/SCIM, tokens, RBAC and audit logs.
  • Testing and response: Coordinate external pen tests and retests; define SIEM logging, alerting and incident response runbooks.
  • Compliance: Map controls to SOC 2 and ISO 27001, support GDPR, maintain audit evidence, answer customer questionnaires.

Required Skills

  • 5+ years in application and cloud security; AWS or Azure IAM design.
  • OWASP Top 10, secure SDLC, threat modelling.
  • SAST/DAST/SCA tooling in CI/CD.
  • Encryption, KMS and secrets management.
  • SOC 2 or ISO 27001 controls and evidence collection.

Preferred

  • Kubernetes and container security; SIEM and detection engineering; GDPR privacy engineering; CISSP, CCSP, CISM, OSCP or cloud security certification.

Key Deliverables

  • Threat models and security architecture, controls matrix (SOC 2/ISO 27001), CI/CD security gates and vulnerability SLA policy, pen-test report with closed findings, incident response plan.

Education

Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Information Security or equivalent experience.

Pay: ₹800,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Staff Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Our Company

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

What You’ll Do

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will design, develop, and evolve identity, security, and access management capabilities for Teradata’s cloud platform. You will work on authentication, authorization, identity federation, user provisioning, agent identity, agentic security, and secure integrations across Teradata cloud services.

This role will require you to:

  • Design and develop scalable, secure, and highly available cloud services.
  • Build identity capabilities using industry standards such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, JWT, and SCIM.
  • Design secure identity, authorization, and delegation models for AI agents and agentic applications.
  • Build and integrate AI agents that securely interact with enterprise services, data, tools, and other agents.
  • Address agentic-security concerns such as agent authentication, delegated authorization, least-privilege access, credential management, auditability, and protection against unauthorized actions.
  • Design APIs and integrations across distributed services and enterprise identity providers.
  • Lead complex technical initiatives across teams and services, from architecture and design through implementation and production deployment.
  • Use AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and similar tools for software development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and design.
  • Evaluate new AI development tools and agentic engineering practices, and educate the team on their effective, secure, and responsible use.
  • Improve overall team productivity by developing reusable AI-assisted workflows, agents, engineering practices, and automation.
  • Ensure the availability, reliability, security, and observability of production services.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across applications, cloud infrastructure, networking, identity providers, AI agents, and databases.
  • Participate in design and code reviews and provide technical guidance to other engineers.

Who You’ll Work With

You will join a high-performing engineering team responsible for foundational identity, agent identity, security, and platform capabilities across Teradata’s cloud ecosystem. You will collaborate with engineers, architects, security, SRE, product, AI, and operations teams.

This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Engineering Manager. The role requires hands-on technical leadership, strong ownership, energy, and a passion for driving new identity and agentic-security capabilities forward.

What Makes You a Qualified Candidate

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field from a leading institution, or equivalent demonstrated education and professional experience. Graduates from institutions such as IITs, NITs, BITS Pilani, and IIITs are preferred.
  • 8+ years of software engineering experience building production-grade backend, platform, security, or distributed systems.
  • Strong programming skills in Java, Go, Python, or a comparable modern programming language.
  • Experience designing REST APIs, microservices, and distributed systems.
  • Experience with cloud-native technologies, including containers, Kubernetes, and public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Experience designing or developing authentication, authorization, identity, or security-related capabilities for distributed systems.
  • Experience with AI-assisted software development using tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or comparable coding assistants.
  • Experience building or integrating AI agents, agentic applications, or AI-enabled software capabilities.
  • Understanding of security considerations for AI agents, including identity, authorization, delegation, credential handling, least-privilege access, auditability, and secure tool invocation.
  • Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and production troubleshooting.
  • Strong technical judgment, problem-solving, communication, and ownership skills.
  • Experience leading technical designs and complex engineering initiatives across teams as an individual contributor.
  • Ability to evaluate new engineering tools and practices, establish reusable patterns, and help other engineers adopt them effectively.

What You’ll Bring

You will be a preferred candidate if you have:

  • Experience building or operating Identity and Access Management services.
  • Experience with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, JWT, SCIM, token exchange, and delegated authorization.
  • Experience designing identity and authorization models for AI agents, agentic workflows, or multi-agent systems.
  • Knowledge of agentic-security risks and controls, including prompt injection, excessive agency, insecure tool use, identity propagation, credential exposure, and auditability.
  • Experience integrating with Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, PingFederate, or similar identity providers.
  • Experience with role-based or attribute-based access control.
  • Knowledge of workload identity, service-to-service authentication, or technologies such as SPIFFE/SPIRE.
  • Experience with AI-agent frameworks, model tool-calling, Model Context Protocol, or similar agent integration technologies.
  • Experience creating reusable prompts, coding workflows, agents, or automation that improve engineering-team productivity.
  • Working knowledge of LDAP, Kerberos, or related enterprise authentication technologies.
  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS or enterprise cloud platforms.
  • Knowledge of database authentication, authorization, or user management.

#LI-PG1

Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.



Meet the team:

The R&D Cybersecurity team is a high-growth, fast-paced environment where you work with leading-edge, software teams in to ensure the security of modern diabetes medical device systems. You will work alongside highly skilled and passionate innovators who know how to deliver exceptional results.


As a GRC Analyst within R&D Cybersecurity, you will assess cybersecurity and privacy compliance across products and supporting processes, translate regulatory requirements into actionable controls, maintain audit-ready evidence, and drive identified gaps through remediation and validated closure. You will partner with Engineering, Legal, Privacy, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and business stakeholders to strengthen risk management and maintain compliance throughout the product lifecycle.

Where you come in:

  • You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure the interests of cybersecurity and privacy compliance are represented in the team’s processes.
  • You will facilitate the completion of security compliance questionnaires for vendors, partners, and regulators.
  • Own end-to-end cybersecurity and privacy compliance assessments across the product development lifecycle, ensuring alignment with standards and regulations such as NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, SOC 2, ISO 27001, ENS, DPDP, GDPR, and EU MDR.
  • You continuously analyze newly released or revised regulations, standards, and guidance documents to identify compliance gaps. You then collaborate with program managers and product owners to ensure corrective actions are taken.
  • You maintain audit-ready compliance evidence in the designated GRC platform, collaborating with Legal, Quality, and Regulatory teams to support ongoing compliance with applicable standards and requirements.
  • In the event of an internal or external audit, you will be responsible for facilitating the documentation as proof of compliance.
  • Conduct cybersecurity and privacy due diligence for vendors, products, and technology partners.
  • Map regulatory and contractual requirements to internal policies, procedures, and technical controls.
  • Support the creation, review, and periodic update of cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, and control documentation.
You partner with the team’s subject matter experts to ensure risk mitigation activities are well documented.

What makes you successful:

  • You possess excellent communication and collaboration skills, along with a sharp problem-solving aptitude and a proactive attitude.
  • The ideal candidate will have extensive technical knowledge associated with cybersecurity and privacy standards within the Medical Device field or other regulated industries
  • Experience performing cybersecurity compliance or control assessments in medical devices, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, financial services, or another regulated industry.
Preferred certifications: CISA, CRISC, CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor/Implementer, or equivalent.

What you’ll get:

  • A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave #dexcomwarriors community .
  • A full and comprehensive benefits program.
  • Growth opportunities on a global scale.
  • Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.
An exciting and innovative, industry-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve.

Travel Required:

0-5%

Experience and Education Requirements:

Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 5 – 8 years of related experience

To all Staffing and Recruiting Agencies: Our Careers Site is only for individuals seeking a job at Dexcom. Only authorized staffing and recruiting agencies may use this site or to submit profiles, applications or resumes on specific requisitions. Dexcom does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies. Please do not forward resumes to the Talent Acquisition team, Dexcom employees or any other company location. Dexcom is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/applications.


AI in Hiring Notice: We may use AI supported tools to help make our hiring process more efficient, consistent, and accessible for candidates around the world. All hiring decisions are made by people.


At Dexcom, we are committed to providing a fair and inclusive recruitment process, and welcome candidates of all genders and gender identities to apply. If any wording in this description appears unintentionally gendered or exclusionary, please be assured this is not intentional.

Should a reasonable accommodation be necessary to aid a disability, requests should be sent to Dexcom Talent Acquisition at talentacquisition@dexcom.com .

title: AM_Cyber Security consultant
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

About this Role

We are seeking a Cyber Security Engineer with 2–7 years of experience in cyber security incident response and threat mitigation to join our DDoS Security team in Bangalore or Pune.
In this role, you will monitor and analyse cyber security alerts and perform real-time threat and DDoS attack mitigation to protect customer and organisational infrastructure. You will use packet and traffic analysis to distinguish malicious activity from legitimate traffic, configure appropriate filters and countermeasures, and support customers during security incidents.
You will collaborate with global teams, markets, customers and technology vendors to optimise threat mitigation strategies and security configurations. The role also involves customer onboarding, platform management, technical consultation and support for pre-sales activities.
As real-time incident response is central to this position, 24x7 flexibility to work in shifts is required.

What you’ll do

  • Monitor and analyse cyber security alerts to identify genuine attacks and initiate appropriate mitigation.
  • Respond to security incidents within defined organisational SLAs.
  • Perform real-time DDoS attack detection and mitigation, including volumetric and application-layer attacks.
  • Conduct deep packet inspection and traffic analysis to identify attack patterns, vectors and malicious traffic.
  • Configure and optimise filters, countermeasures and security controls based on identified attack vectors.
  • Improve mitigation effectiveness through ongoing analysis and optimisation of security configurations.
  • Troubleshoot cyber security incidents with customers and recommend solutions to reduce infrastructure risk.
  • Consult customers on recent threats, attack scenarios and appropriate mitigation strategies.
  • Onboard new customers onto the security platform based on agreed requirements.
  • Provide technical consultation to pre-sales teams supporting prospective customers.
  • Manage the configuration lifecycle of security platforms and implement changes within defined SLAs.
  • Contribute to problem management and major incident management when required.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to share knowledge and implement effective security practices.
  • Engage with vendors to resolve platform issues and obtain threat-related technical consultation.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive operational and security activities.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, local work instructions and operational procedures.

Who you are

You have:
  • 2–7 years of experience in cyber security incident response and threat mitigation.
  • Experience in analysing cyber attacks and taking appropriate mitigation actions.
  • Strong packet analysis skills, with the ability to differentiate DDoS attacks from legitimate network traffic.
  • Hands-on experience in real-time cyber threat mitigation.
  • Knowledge of DDoS attack detection and mitigation.
  • Experience with deep packet inspection.
  • The ability to understand and configure filters and countermeasures for volumetric and application-based attacks.
  • Knowledge of the NIST incident response process and MITRE ATT&CK framework.
  • Experience or knowledge of Radware DefensePro.
  • Experience or knowledge of Radware DefenseFlow.
  • Experience or knowledge of Arbor DDoS protection.
  • Knowledge of application-layer attack mitigation.
  • The ability to collaborate with customers, global teams, internal stakeholders and technology vendors.
  • Flexibility to work in a 24x7 shift environment.
Relevant certifications are desirable, including:
  • Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)
  • ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity (CC)
  • CompTIA Security+
DDoS attack mitigation experience would be an added advantage.

Not a perfect fit?

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

What's in it for you

  • Opportunity to work on real-time cyber security incident response and DDoS threat mitigation across customer and organisational infrastructure.
  • Exposure to global teams, markets, customers and technology vendors while addressing complex cyber security incidents.
  • Hands-on experience with DDoS protection technologies including Radware DefensePro, Radware DefenseFlow and Arbor DDoS protection.
  • Opportunity to contribute to security platform optimisation, customer onboarding, major incident management and technical consultation.
  • Scope to identify and implement automation opportunities within day-to-day cyber security operations.

What skills you will learn

Through this role, you will have opportunities to further develop skills in:
  • Real-time cyber incident response and threat mitigation.
  • DDoS attack detection, analysis and mitigation.
  • Deep packet inspection and network traffic analysis.
  • Volumetric and application-layer attack mitigation.
  • Security filter and countermeasure configuration.
  • Radware DefensePro and DefenseFlow technologies.
  • Arbor DDoS protection.
  • NIST-aligned incident response processes.
  • MITRE ATT&CK-based threat analysis.
  • Security platform configuration lifecycle management.
  • Problem and major incident management.
  • Customer-facing cyber security consultation.
  • Security operations automation and technical documentation.

VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment

Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.

Join Us

At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

Alert

Apply for Vodafone jobs only through the official Vodafone Careers website to avoid job scams and fraud.
#JDEnhancedByTARA

Follow us on social media

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/vois/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/voisglobal
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/voisglobal/

descriptionHtml:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

R&D Team Lead


In this role, you will have the opportunity to support the strategic technology direction by contributing your own ideas for identifying, proposing, and implementing innovative technology, software and solutions. Each day, you will assist the Research and Development (R&D) team by executing your assigned tasks and using technical knowledge in a structured way. You will also showcase your expertise by staying abreast of the state of the art and actively applying this knowledge.

The work model for the role is: # Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Process Automation Business in Bangalore.


Roles and Responsibilities :


  • Security and network robustness assessment testing of embedded devices and host based industrial software’s, Web applications, API’s and Mobile Apps. In-depth analysis of results and writing technical reports.
  • Providing suggestion/fixes for improvement to device/software development teams.
  • Evaluation of new testing methodologies relevant for the organization Testing Wi-Fi and Bluetooth devices for Security vulnerabilities.
  • Research on testing security of Protocols, interfaces and Technologies used for communication to cloud based platforms and API Security.
  • Comfortable with Web frameworks, such as Flask or Django Demonstrable experience of using Python in an object-oriented environment In-depth knowledge of various Operating Systems (Linux, Windows Server/Desktop, MAC) Experience of Selenium, PyTest or similar Test Automation frameworks.
  • Hands on experience with Java, Shell script and Golang is preferred
  • Excellent partnership and interpersonal skills, and the ability to collaborate with all parties including Dev and QA teams, Program/Product managers, Technical Publications and other Project Partners.
  • Experience in python Automation framework/environment
  • Experience in Integrating the security tools to the build pipelines for automated scans. Experience in the Azure Devops.


Qualification for the role :


  • B.E/ B.Tech in Computer Science/ Electronics Engineering with 8+ years of working experience in security domain.
  • M.Tech in Cyber Security or Networking with CGPA of 6.5 and above Good knowledge of cryptographic and security protocols such as SSL, PKI etc.
  • In depth knowledge of TCP/IP networking and application protocols concepts (knowledge of control communication protocols and technologies is a major plus).
  • Understanding of software exploitation and common vulnerabilities. Good understanding of port scanning, Vulnerability assessment, penetration testing and Fuzzing tools.
  • Strong knowledge in web applications scanning, penetration testing and vulnerability Assessment reporting.
  • Good knowledge of the HTTP protocol, and all other protocols associated with web technologies Fair understanding of OWASP Top 10 & SANS 25 Vulnerabilities and their mitigations.
  • Good knowledge on Mobile app and APIs (REST, SOAP) security testing.


More about US:


ABB a provides a comprehensive range of integrated automation, electrical and digital systems and services for customers in the process, hybrid and maritime industries. These offerings, coupled with deep domain knowledge in each end market, help to optimize productivity, energy efficiency, sustainability and safety of industrial processes and operations.


Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Recruitment Fraud Warning

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.

View current job openings and apply at: https://careers.abb/global/en/home

For more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how-to-apply/fraud-warning

title: Sr. Analyst - IT Infrastructure Audit
descriptionHtml:
Nasdaq Technology is looking for a passionate Sr. Analyst – IT Infrastructure Audit with focus on IT Infrastructure & Technology Auditing, to join the Bangalore technology center in India. If innovation and efficiency drive you forward, this is the place for you!

Nasdaq is continuously revolutionizing markets and undergoing transformations while we accept new technologies to develop innovative solutions, seeking to rewrite tomorrow. You will plan and implement internal technology and infrastructure audit projects to evaluate internal controls across the organization, ensuring efficiency, alignment with industry protocols, and compliance with regulatory requirements.

We are looking for candidates with a genuine desire and drive to deliver top technology solutions to today’s markets.


With this position we offer

Join the Internal Audit organization, where you will be responsible for evaluating technology internal controls to protect the company from risks that could affect our business operations. You will work in a results-driven, high-performing international team in a creative and dynamic environment.


Role Responsibilities

As a Sr. Analyst – IT Infrastructure Audit, your focus will be planning and implementing technology and infrastructure audit projects. Besides working closely with your colleagues in Bangalore, you will also work closely with Nasdaq teams in other countries.

  • Conduct technology infrastructure and integrated audits, acting as both a team member and audit lead as appropriate.
  • Plan audit scope, draft risk and control matrices, and define test procedures for technology and cybersecurity audits.
  • Evaluate the adequacy and efficiency of technology controls across all risk areas through continuous auditing and monitoring.
  • Manage multiple concurrent audit projects, balancing priorities to deliver results on time.
  • Document findings and issues, ensuring alignment with corporate policies, procedures, and regulatory standards.
  • Communicate technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Participate in operational, regulatory, and project audits to identify and assess key IT risks and controls.


We expect you to have

  • 3 to 6 years of risk-focused technology internal audit or related experience (e.g., cybersecurity and infrastructure audits)
  • Experience auditing IT processes and governance, and IT infrastructure (networks, databases, operating systems, server configuration, virtualization platforms, container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, logging and monitoring, IaC, and cloud-native services).
  • Experience auditing data centers and Cloud environments (AWS and Azure).
  • Solid understanding of technology risk management principles and standards such as COBIT.
  • Ability to write audit reports independently with minimal direction.
  • Experience with audit tools such as TeamMate.
  • Strong team player with excellent interpersonal, project management, and communication skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field.


It would be phenomenal if you have:

  • Hold professional auditing certifications such as CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor) or CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional).
  • Have experience working with global teams.
  • Are proficient in English with a strong customer service mindset.


Does it sound like you?

As the selection process is ongoing, please submit your application in English as soon as possible. We will get back to you in 2–3 weeks.


Come as you are

Nasdaq is an equal opportunity employer. We positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of age, color, disability, national origin, ancestry, race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Nasdaq is a leading global provider of trading, clearing, exchange technology, listing, information, and public company services. As the creator of the world’s first electronic stock market, its technology powers more than 100 marketplaces in 50 countries. Nasdaq is home to over 4,000 total listings with a market value of approximately $12 trillion.

To learn more about our business, visit business.nasdaq.com. Check out more about our Life at Nasdaq.

Come as You Are

Nasdaq is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and identities.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives, experiences, and identities are valued and celebrated.

We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation throughout the hiring process.

companyDescription:
Welcome to the new Nasdaq. Where capital market logistics are solved by people, products and services that are as ambitious as you are.
 
In 1971, the microprocessor was born. Nasdaq wasted no time capitalizing on the new technology by bringing all-electronic trading to the market. Later in the decade, this provided the likes of Apple and Microsoft with the means to raise capital that was previously unavailable to them.
 
Sixteen years later on the other side of the Atlantic, OM became the world’s first publicly traded and listed exchange company. In 2007, Nasdaq merged with OMX with a vision to be a single company with a single mission: Deliver the kind of resources that would solve the logistics of the global capital markets.
 
That vision has served us well. So well, in fact, that Nasdaq transformed itself from a U.S.-based equities exchange to a diversified technology provider for thousands of global firms. Today, we’re the leading technology and information services provider to the capital markets. And our Global Trading and Market Service business have become a significant part of our client offerings.
 
All this can be traced to Nasdaq’s focus on synchronizing and optimizing market movement – an essential principle in the growth of business economies. No one else provides customers with such a high level of infrastructure, tools and strategic insight. Customers have taken advantage of the fact that we’re the single largest liquidity pool for U.S. equities (in volume traded). We’re also acclaimed for our top-rated data offerings. title: SOC Analyst I
descriptionHtml:
KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Perform and provide oversight for day-to-day security SOC operations duties, including the management of security analysts, the development and implementation of security policies and procedures, and the response to security alerts.
  • Develop and maintain KPI reports on SOC team performance and other aggregated performance metrics.
  • Develop reports on Security operations for executive management and regional teams.
  • Manage a team of SOC analysts including rostering / shifts planning, tasks allocation and coordination.
  • Continuously monitor security events and alerts generated by various security monitoring tools, such as SIEM (Security Information and Event Management) systems, IDS/IPS (Intrusion Detection/Prevention Systems), and endpoint protection platforms.
  • Identify and analyze security incidents based on the available information. Classify and prioritize incidents according to their severity and potential impact. Initiate and coordinate the incident response process, following predefined procedures and workflows.
  • Work with different IT teams to troubleshoot and resolve security-related issues and assist in configuring the logs to be forwarded from their respective systems to the centralized logging system.
  • Analyze vulnerability scan results and work with system owners and IT teams to remediate identified vulnerabilities within specified timeframes.
  • Provide recommendation for Security Use-case creation and optimization for any new/existing systems.
  • Conduct Network and Endpoint log analyses including threat hunting activities and present findings.
  • Studying vulnerabilities, identifying relevant threats, corrective actions recommendations and reporting results.
  • Document all incidents, investigations, and analysis activities accurately and thoroughly. Prepare incident reports, including detailed information on the incident timeline, impact, and recommended remediation actions.

OTHER

  • Act as an ambassador for DP World at all times when working; promoting and demonstrating positive behaviours in harmony with DP World’s Principles, values and culture; ensuring the highest level of safety is applied in all activities; understanding and following DP World’s Code of Conduct and Ethics policies.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS



Knowledge and Experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or equivalent.
  • Should have 5-7 years of experience in IT Security with at least 4 years’ experience in conducting analysis of log data and security operations center.
  • Technical and hands-on experience across Cyber Security and technology domains.
  • Background in security technologies, network protocols and operations and understanding of TCP/IP protocol and OSI Seven Layer Model.
  • Computer programming and scripting languages.
  • Strong understanding of the Cyber Kill Chain, pervasive threats attack methods and remediation.
  • Industry recognized professional certifications such as GSEC, Security+, CEH, CySA.
  • Good understanding in E-commerce, logistics, supply chain & port operations applications will be added advantage.

Soft Skills

  • Sound analytical and intellectual capabilities.
  • Excellent time management and organizational skills.
  • Decision-making abilities.
  • Team player and conflict management skills.
  • Ability to multi-task, prioritize, coordinate, and work well under pressure to meet deadlines.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills ability to work in a team environment.
  • Cultural awareness.
  • Must possess Excellent Reporting Skills.

Technical Skills

  • Knowledge of Security Orchestration and Automation (SOAR) solutions.
  • Experience with two or more analysis tools used in a CIRT or similar investigative environment.
  • Ability to analyse and triage IoCs.


#L1-MP1

title: OT Security Consultant and Cybersecurity Solution Architect
descriptionHtml:
Company Description


Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited is a 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, one of the world's leading global supplier of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT and Business Solutions. With over 27,000+ associates, it’s the largest software development center of Bosch, outside Germany, indicating that it is the Technology Powerhouse of Bosch in India with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe and the Asia Pacific region.


Job Description

Roles & Responsibilities :
  • OT Asset Discovery and Validation: Discover OT assets, connected devices and communication protocols across all in-scope plants, including unmanaged assets. Apply a safe mix of passive and active discovery and data collection methods and validate every finding with plant personnel.
  • Asset Classification and Data Acquisition: Classify every discovered asset in the client's data acquisition template by asset type, function, criticality (Critical, High, Medium, Low), owner (business owner, technical owner, support team, OEM) and location (plant, shop, line, zone, station). Capture technical details such as OEM, model, controller, firmware/software versions, IP, switch and VLAN details, protocols, end-of-life status and internet connectivity.
  • OT Network Mapping: Create visual OT network architecture diagrams, segment by segment, showing OT device local networks, OT system switches and OT device IP addresses. Identify segmentation gaps and undocumented connections.
  • OT Risk Assessment and IEC 62443 Alignment: Define and apply the OT risk scoring methodology and provide a written rationale for every asset's criticality rating. Assess findings against IEC 62443, including zones and conduits and security levels, and produce a risk register with prioritized, production-safe recommendations.
  • Methodology, Reporting and Stakeholder Management: Define assessment methodology, tools, validation process and report review process.
  • Lead solution design and technical responses for RFPs, RFIs and proactive proposals across OT/ICS security, product security, AI security and penetration testing (PTEST).
  • Conduct discovery workshops with client CISOs, security and engineering teams to capture requirements, pain points and compliance drivers.
  • Architect end-to-end solutions covering assessments, managed services, secure product development and subscription-based commercial models; define scope, effort, staffing and delivery approach.
  • Deliver client presentations, demos and proof-of-concepts; anchor technical due-diligence and clarification rounds.
  • Map solutions to regulatory and standards frameworks such as IEC 62443, CERT-In, NCSC CAF, EU CRA, EU AI Act, FDA / EU MDR and IEC 81001-5-1.
  • Collaborate with delivery partner and product teams (including AI security and OT IDS partners) to build reusable offerings, accelerators and reference architectures.
  • Support pricing and commercial construct decisions with effort estimates, risk assessment and assumptions.
  • Contribute to GTM collateral, thought leadership and analyst / partner engagements.
  • As Solution Architect you are supposed to work with Cybersecurity Presales Team on RFP , RFI , Proactive Cybersecurity Opp to solution it. Work with SMEs to capture Technical inputs and stich it for overall Solution story line in the proposal.
  • You will partner with sales, presales and business development to understand client Cybersecurity challenges, shape winning solutions, and translate BGSW’s cybersecurity portfolio into compelling proposals for clients across India, UK, EU, Nordics, Middle East and North America.

Qualifications

  • BTech in computer science, Electronics & Instrumentation, Cyber Security, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience performing OT risk assessments (asset criticality, threat and vulnerability analysis, risk scoring and prioritized remediation).
  • Strong working knowledge of IEC 62443, coupled with the ability to translate a compliance requirement directly into a technical control such as a firewall rule or network segmentation design. Familiarity with NERC CIP, NIST SP 800-82 and MITRE ATT&CK for ICS is a plus.
  • Hands-on experience with OT discovery and security monitoring tools (for example Claroty, Nozomi Networks, Dragos, Tenable OT or Microsoft Defender for IoT), and with Wireshark and OT-safe use of Nmap.
  • Foundational knowledge of networking protocols, firewalls, VPNs, IDS/IPS and industrial switching, with a strong understanding of network segmentation and the Purdue Model applied to OT environments.
  • Deep understanding of how industrial protocols function, such as Modbus, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, OPC UA and MQTT.
  • Working knowledge of common industrial control platforms (PLC, CNC, HMI, SCADA and robot controllers) and an understanding of the risks of scanning fragile or legacy devices.
  • Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GICSP, ISA/IEC 62443, OSCP, CEH or CCSP.
  • Exposure to automotive, manufacturing, energy & utilities, or healthcare / MedTech sectors.

Experience :

  • 10-14 years of experience in OT / ICS cybersecurity, with at least 2 years in presales, solution architecture or consulting roles, including hands-on delivery of OT asset discovery and network mapping in live manufacturing environments, ideally automotive or discrete manufacturing.
  • Strong understanding of two or more domains: OT/ICS & IIoT security, product / embedded security, application security, cloud security, or AI/ML security.
  • Hands-on familiarity with security assessments, penetration testing methodologies, threat modelling and secure SDLC.
  • Working knowledge of relevant standards and regulations (IEC 62443, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CERT-In guidelines, EU CRA / NIS2, MedTech cybersecurity guidance).
  • Proven ability to write high-quality proposals and present to CxO and technical audiences.
  • Experience engaging clients across multiple geographies; comfortable with travel and cross-time-zone collaboration.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management and commercial acumen.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent written communication for reports and network diagrams.
  • Willingness to travel to multiple plant locations and to follow plant safety and confidentiality requirements.


Mandatory/ Required Skills :

  • Strong understanding of two or more domains: OT/ICS & IIoT security, product / embedded security, application security, cloud security, or AI/ML security.
  • Hands-on familiarity with security assessments, penetration testing methodologies, threat modelling and secure SDLC.
  • Working knowledge of relevant standards and regulations (IEC 62443, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CERT-In guidelines, EU CRA / NIS2, MedTech cybersecurity guidance)

Additional Information

  • 10-14 years of experience in OT / ICS cybersecurity, with at least 2 years in presales, solution architecture or consulting roles, including hands-on delivery of OT asset discovery and network mapping in live manufacturing environments, ideally automotive or discrete manufacturing.

The Cybersecurity Solution Architect is the technical face of BGSW’s cybersecurity practice in the pursuit cycle. You will partner with sales and business development to understand client security challenges, shape winning solutions, and translate BGSW’s cybersecurity portfolio into compelling proposals for clients across India, UK, EU, Nordics, Middle East and North America.

title: Cybersecurity – SOC Analyst & Cloud Security Trainer
descriptionHtml:
Cybersecurity Trainer – SOC Analyst & Cloud Security

Scholar’sEdge Academy · J. P. Nagar 2nd Phase, Bengaluru · On-site · Full-time

Role at a glance

  • Teaches: Cybersecurity – SOC Analyst & Cloud Security (4.5 months + 2-month internship)
  • Reports to: Founder / Academic Head
  • Schedule: live batches of 3 hours a day, Saturday labs and workshops, and free demo classes
  • Experience: freshers, or minimum 1 year of experience
  • Salary: ₹15,000 – ₹20,000 per month
  • Email: contact@scholarsedgeacademy.in
  • Phone / WhatsApp: +91 99020 58603

About Scholar’sEdge Academy

Scholar’sEdge Academy is a skills-and-internship institute in J. P. Nagar, Bengaluru. Every program pairs 3–5 months of live, mentor-led training with a 2-month internship on real projects. Our promise to students is simple: you’ll leave able to show what you can do, not just with a certificate. We’re early, we’re building fast, and the trainer we hire now will shape how we teach cybersecurity.

The role

You’ll train students to work the way a real Security Operations Centre (SOC) team works: watching alerts, investigating suspicious activity, responding to incidents and writing clear reports. You’ll also teach them to secure cloud accounts, where most company data now lives. Everything is taught through hands-on labs, with AI tools used the way security teams use them today: to speed up investigations, never trusted blindly. You’ll be the face of our cybersecurity course, in the classroom, in demo classes and in short videos on our social pages.

What you’ll do

Teach

  • Deliver live, hands-on classes (3 hours a day) covering networking, operating systems, security fundamentals, SOC operations, incident response and cloud security. Spend most of the time in labs, not on slides.
  • Run Saturday labs, free weekend workshops and free demo classes for prospective students and parents.
  • Teach beginners from zero, including non-CS graduates and IT support staff moving into security.

Build proof with students

  • Guide every student through 4–6 lab projects and a capstone. Examples: a home SOC lab with a SIEM, a phishing investigation, brute-force detection from logs, an incident report, and an AWS or Azure security audit.
  • Make sure every student leaves with a GitHub portfolio of lab write-ups and a TryHackMe or similar profile showing completed rooms.
  • Review work every week. Give written feedback, require fixes and track each student’s progress.
  • Mentor students during the 2-month internship: plan real project work, run daily stand-ups and sign off the deliverables.

Keep the course current

  • Help update the syllabus, labs, assignments and quizzes as new threats and tools appear.
  • Run mock interviews for SOC Analyst (L1) roles, and help students prepare for entry-level certifications.

Be the face of the course

  • Appear on camera in 1–2 short teaching videos a week. Scripts and editing support are provided. Examples: “Spot the phishing mail in 30 seconds” or “What a SOC analyst sees on screen.”
  • Answer course questions honestly, and never promise jobs or salaries.
  • Teach ethics first: security skills are used only on systems you own or have written permission to test.

What you must know

Networking

  • Must have: OSI and TCP/IP models, IP addressing and subnetting, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, common ports and protocols, firewalls, VPNs
  • Good to have: packet analysis in depth, network segmentation design

Operating systems

  • Must have: Linux command line, Windows basics, Windows event logs, Active Directory concepts
  • Good to have: Sysmon, Linux log analysis (auth.log, syslog)

Security fundamentals

  • Must have: the CIA triad, common attacks (phishing, malware, ransomware, brute force, SQL injection, XSS), OWASP Top 10, encryption and hashing basics
  • Good to have: vulnerability scanning (Nessus, OpenVAS), Burp Suite basics

SOC operations

  • Must have: what a SIEM does, alert triage, log analysis, the incident response lifecycle, writing incident reports, hands-on with at least one SIEM in a lab (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Wazuh or Elastic)
  • Good to have: EDR tools (Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike), threat hunting, SOAR automation, digital forensics basics

Threat intelligence and frameworks

  • Must have: MITRE ATT&CK and the cyber kill chain at a working level, Wireshark, Nmap, VirusTotal and other threat-intelligence sites
  • Good to have: writing detection rules (Sigma, KQL or SPL)

Cloud security

  • Must have: identity and access management (IAM), the shared responsibility model, common cloud misconfigurations, in AWS or Azure
  • Good to have: AWS GuardDuty and Security Hub, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, cloud logging (CloudTrail, Azure Monitor)

AI in security

  • Must have: using AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude or similar) to explain logs, write queries and summarise incidents, and teaching students to verify everything they produce
  • Good to have: Microsoft Security Copilot or similar, awareness of AI-specific threats such as prompt injection and deepfake phishing

Scripting and compliance

  • Good to have: Python or PowerShell for automation, ISO 27001 basics, India’s DPDP Act and IT Act basics

Who we’re looking for

  • Freshers, or minimum 1 year of experience in a SOC, security, network or IT support role. Internships count.
  • Freshers must show hands-on proof: a home lab, TryHackMe or Hack The Box progress, CTF results, lab write-ups on GitHub or a blog, or a security certification.
  • Has taught or mentored others, as a trainer, tutor, teaching assistant or college security club lead. Not required, but a strong plus.
  • Explains technical attacks in simple, everyday language, and is patient with beginners.
  • Strong ethics: teaches only legal, permission-based testing.
  • Comfortable teaching in English. Kannada and/or Hindi is a plus for students and parents.
  • Degree in CS, IT, electronics or a related field (B.E., B.Tech, BCA, MCA, B.Sc.), or equivalent proven skill. Certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CEH, ISC2 CC, Microsoft SC-200 / SC-900, or AWS / Azure security fundamentals are a plus.

Not a fit: people who only know theory with no labs to show, or who treat hacking as a show-off skill rather than a responsibility.

What we offer

  • ₹15,000 – ₹20,000 per month, paid on time, every month.
  • Lab and certification support as you teach.
  • A real say in the curriculum of a growing course.
  • Your own visible teaching brand, through on-camera content credited to you.

How to apply

Send your resume, your GitHub, blog or TryHackMe / Hack The Box profile, one lab write-up or incident report and, if you have one, a short teaching video.

contact@scholarsedgeacademy.in
WhatsApp: +91 99020 58603

Subject: “Cybersecurity SOC & Cloud Security Trainer”

Hiring process

  • Screening (2 days): we check your resume, lab profile and write-up.
  • Intro call (15 min): background, availability, expectations.
  • Demo class (20 min + 10 min Q&A): teach a topic we send you 48 hours earlier, to real learners or our team.
  • Technical round (45 min): investigate a sample alert and its logs live, and explain your findings.
  • Offer (2–3 days): reference check, then the offer letter.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Cyber Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Why qlub

The end of a great meal shouldn't be the slow part. Waiting for the check, finding someone to take payment, splitting a bill by hand. qlub removes that friction. Guests scan a QR code and pay in seconds. No app, no download, no waiting.

From Pay-at-Table and Digital Menus to Order-and-Pay, Payment Links, and SoftPOS terminals, we handle the full payment experience so restaurants can focus on what they do best: great hospitality. Less friction means faster table turnover, smoother operations, and higher profit.

We're a fast-scaling fintech backed by Mastercard, Mubadala, e& and Shorooq. $72M raised, live across multiple markets worldwide, and headcount doubled in the past year. We're building the teams that take us to the next stage.

The role

As qlub expands across markets, so do our security challenges. From protecting our payments platform to meeting regulatory requirements and earning customer trust, security plays a critical role in how we grow. We are looking for a Cybersecurity Engineer to own our day-to-day security compliance and customer assurance including maintaining security standards and certifications, managing audits and supporting customer security assessments.

This isn't a role limited to compliance checklists. You'll be part of our security team, working closely with engineering and teams across the business. You'll also have opportunities to contribute to threat detection, application security, cloud security and penetration testing. You'll have the freedom to solve real problems and make a visible impact on how we secure our platform.

Things move quickly here and not every challenge comes with a playbook. What matters is strong security fundamentals, curiosity, adaptability and the ability to figure things out and get things done.


What you’ll own

  • Own day-to-day security compliance and ISMS activities across ISO 27001, PCI DSS, SOC 2 readiness and applicable regulatory requirements.

  • Manage internal and external audits, certifications and assessments end to end including auditor engagement, evidence validation and corrective action closure.

  • Own customer security questionnaires, due diligence and security assessments, working directly with business stakeholders and customer security teams.

  • Maintain security policies, risk assessments and control documentation, assess control effectiveness and drive compliance findings to closure.

  • Coordinate third-party security reviews, support data protection and security awareness activities and maintain continuous compliance monitoring.

  • Contribute to security operations including SIEM/EDR monitoring, threat detection, incident investigations, cloud security and vulnerability management.

  • Support application security and DevSecOps initiatives including secure SDLC practices, CI/CD security integration, SAST/DAST/SCA and vulnerability validation.

  • Leverage automation and AI to streamline security assessments, compliance activities and operational workflows.


Who you are

  • You take initiative, exercise sound judgement and drive work forward independently.

  • You are curious, resourceful and quick to learn unfamiliar tools, technologies and frameworks.

  • You communicate clearly, collaborate across teams and stay effective when priorities change.

  • You actively embrace AI to solve problems, automate repetitive work and find smarter ways to get things done.


What you’ll need

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science or a related field.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity or information security, including security compliance, assurance or GRC.

  • Hands-on experience maintaining an ISO 27001 ISMS, coordinating audits, validating controls and managing compliance evidence.

  • Experience handling customer security questionnaires, due diligence assessments and working with auditors and cross-functional teams.

  • Working knowledge of PCI DSS, security risk management and frameworks such as NIST CSF.

  • Solid technical foundations in cloud and SaaS architectures, networking, identity and access management and web security including OWASP Top 10.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills with fluency in English.

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted tools for research, analysis and automation with the judgment to validate outputs and handle sensitive information responsibly.


Nice to have

  • Experience in fintech, payments or cloud-based SaaS environments.

  • Familiarity with UAE IA/NESA, SOC 2 or GDPR requirements.

  • Experience with GRC platforms and security workflow automation.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud security (AWS/GCP), SIEM/EDR platforms such as CrowdStrike/Splunk or detection engineering.

  • Practical experience conducting web, API or mobile penetration testing.

  • Relevant certifications such as ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, CISA, eWPTx or OSCP are valued.

What we offer

  • Real ownership over products that impact millions of diners and thousands of restaurants globally
  • The opportunity to solve challenging problems in payments, hospitality, and customer experience
  • A fast-moving environment where great ideas quickly become reality
  • Close collaboration with experienced operators, builders, and industry experts
  • A chance to leave a visible mark on one of the fastest-growing restaurant technology companies globally

Ready to build? Join us and help shape how the world pays at the table. If that excites you, apply now.

title: Offensive Security & Threat Hunting Engineer
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT US

Glomo builds cross-border payment infrastructure. Our network connects local payment rails across countries, so customers move money across borders in seconds. We are a licensed Payment Service Provider at GIFT IFSC, regulated by IFSCA, and the first of our kind in India. We are also a Visa Principal Member, the first non-bank acquirer in India to join the network, so we acquire and process Visa card payments directly. The team behind Glomo has more than 100 years of combined experience in building large payment products.

YOUR IMPACT

Glomo moves real money across borders and handles card data and customer KYC records. That makes us a target. This role exists to find the ways into our systems before an attacker does, and to catch the ones who get in anyway. You split your time between offence and hunting. On offence, you test our cloud, APIs, networks, and employee endpoints the way a real attacker would. On the hunting side, you work through endpoint, network, and identity logs for what our alerts missed. You work alongside the IT and Infrastructure team and see each finding through to the fix. Your testing also backs our PCI-DSS and regulatory audits.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Penetration testing. Run regular internal and external tests across our networks, cloud environments, APIs, and employee endpoints to uncover weak points and misconfigurations.

Threat hunting. Dig through endpoint telemetry (EDR), network logs, and identity provider logs for unauthorised access, lateral movement, and anomalies that our automated alerts did not catch.

Adversary simulation and purple teaming. Simulate realistic attacks, including credential theft, phishing, and AI-assisted attacks, then work with our IT and Infrastructure team to close the gaps you find.

Automation. Write scripts and use AI-assisted security tools so that vulnerability discovery and attack surface monitoring run continuously.

Reporting. Write up each finding so that an engineer can act on it: what you did, what it exposes, and how to fix it, in priority order. No bloated, copy-pasted scanner reports.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING

Experience. 3+ years of hands-on work in penetration testing, red teaming, or threat hunting.

Endpoint and network depth. You know Windows and Linux internals, Active Directory and cloud identity attacks, and how Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) tools work.

Tooling and scripting. You are comfortable with Burp Suite, Nmap, BloodHound, and Metasploit, you write SIEM and EDR queries, and you script in Python, PowerShell, or Bash.

AI awareness. You know how attackers use AI, for example for automated recon, you can test LLM and API security, and you use automation to scale your own testing.

Practical credentials. Hands-on certifications such as OSCP, CRTO, PNPT, or GCTI matter more to us than a purely theoretical degree.

GOOD TO HAVE

  • An active bug bounty profile on HackerOne or Bugcrowd

  • Open-source security tools that you built or contribute to

  • Security testing in payments or fintech, including PCI-DSS penetration test requirements

  • GCP and Kubernetes attack paths

  • Detection engineering: turning hunt findings into alert rules

WHY JOIN US

High autonomy

You own how we test, harden, and monitor our entire technical footprint.

Builder culture

Your findings go straight to the engineers who fix them. No endless bureaucracy.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Ground-floor opportunity at a fast-growing company, where your work directly sets our direction

  • Accelerated career growth: we invest in your development

  • Competitive compensation with equity ownership

  • Comprehensive health insurance, flexible time off, and a professional development budget

  • A close team that celebrates wins and supports each other

Compensation Range: ₹18L - ₹22L

descriptionHtml:
Responsibilities

As a member of the incident/Workorder/Change handling team , you will have the following accountabilities:
  • Will be working as an SME for Zscaler Support in Operations for ZIA, ZPA and ZDX.

  • Identify and propose process improvements and identify opportunities for new processes and procedures to reduce risk.
  • Support security incident response as required; First line responder to reported or detected incidents.
  • Perform security research, analysis, security vulnerability assessments and penetration tests.
  • Provide security audit and investigation support
  • Monitor and track security systems for Vulnerability and respond to potential security Vulnerability.
  • Provide support for the Vulnerability management program.
  • Provide 24x7 support as operations team working in shifts.
  • Participate in on-call system administration support including but not limited to weekends, holidays and after-business hours as required to service the needs of the business.
Skills and Experience
  • 4 to 5 years+ in Information Security space.
  • Strong experiance in Service Now Ticketing tool, Dashboards and Integration.
  • Strong experience with Zscaler ZIA, ZPA and ZDX.

  • Strong experience with Qualys Vulnerability Management Tool.
  • Some good to have Experience with Crowdstrike EDR and SIEM.
  • Strong experience with multiple network operating systems, including two or more of the following: Cisco iOS, Juniper ScreenOS or Junos, Fortinet FortiOS, CheckPoint GAiA, or Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS; Tanium, Rapid 7, Nessus, Nitro ESM, Symantec SEP, Symantec Message labs, Thales encryption, Allgress, Forecpoint, Blue coat, Firepower, Cisco ISE, Carbon Black, Titus, Encase
  • Strong oral, written, and presentation abilities.
  • Experiance with M365 Copilot.
  • Some experience with Unix/Linux system administration.

  • Embrace a culture of continuous service improvement and service excellence.
  • Stay up to date on security industry trends.

title: Application Security Engineer - Fully Remote
descriptionHtml:
Top 3 Reasons To Join Us

  • 100% remote, with a global, diverse team
  • Working on the latest tech for the Insurtech Market Leader
  • Lead and shape how an AI-native security function finds and prevents vulnerabilities at the AI-native insurance platform of choice for the world’s leading insurers

About Us

At CoverGo, our mission is to empower all insurance companies to make insurance 100% digital and accessible to everyone.

  • We are a leading global no-code insurance platform for health, life, and P&C
  • We’re the winner of the Insurtech of the Year in all of Asia and other awards globally
  • We work with insurance enterprise clients such as AXA, Bupa, MSIG, Dai-ichi, Bank of China Group Insurance, and many more
  • We're an international, diverse team of over 200 people with 30 nationalities and team members working remotely from all over the world
  • We are fully funded and backed by reputable VC funds and strategic institutional investors
  • We have a global presence in Asia, EMEA and the Americas
  • We’ve grown our annualized revenue by over 30x since January 2021
  • We’re constantly working towards making CoverGo a workplace that you love coming to. We deeply believe that bringing together a diversity of thoughts, expressions, and perspectives is key to building the best culture for equally diverse communities all over the world

About The Role

CoverGo is hiring an Application Security Engineer to use AI to find and prevent vulnerabilities before they reach production, and to give engineering teams the tools and guardrails that stop vulnerabilities from being introduced in the first place. The Security team is small and growing, and works AI-first: everyone uses AI to automate their own work and to scale security across a large engineering organisation.

What You Will Do

  • Use AI tools such as Claude and OpenAI models to find and triage vulnerabilities in code, dependencies and designs before changes are merged.
  • Embed security checks into developer workflows and CI/CD pipelines so issues surface as code is written.
  • Select, configure and tune code-security tools such as GitHub Advanced Security, Snyk and Checkmarx, keeping the signal high enough that engineers act on the findings.
  • Build self-service tools, guardrails and guidance that help engineering teams prevent common vulnerability classes.
  • Partner with engineering leads and security champions across product teams to prioritise and fix findings.
  • Review security-relevant designs and changes, ranking risk by what an attacker could realistically reach.
  • Track and report on application-security risk and remediation progress.

What We Need

  • 3+ years in application security or a closely related security role.
  • An AI-native approach to securing software: you already use LLMs to find, detect and explain vulnerabilities.
  • Enough fluency in at least one modern programming language to read, understand and fix vulnerable code. A software-engineering background is not required.
  • Hands-on experience with code-security tools such as GitHub Advanced Security, Snyk or Checkmarx.
  • A solid grasp of common vulnerability classes, such as the OWASP Top 10, and how to prevent them.
  • A practical, enabling style of working with engineers.

Nice to have

  • Experience building custom security tooling or automations on LLM APIs.
  • Experience securing applications on AWS, Azure or GCP.
  • Experience in insurance, financial services or another regulated SaaS environment.

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • Paid Annual Leaves
  • Annual Performance Bonus
  • Health Insurance
  • Remote Work Allowance
  • Anniversary Bonus
  • Company activities and events
  • Learning and development plan

CoverGo Company Video

title: Principal Cybersecurity
descriptionHtml:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.


The Principal Cybersecurity Analyst role focuses on identifying, monitoring, and reducing external security exposure across internet-facing infrastructure, email systems, SaaS platforms, and the dark web. The role partners closely with Enterprise Security teams to ensure attack surface visibility is comprehensive, risks are prioritized effectively, and security controls are implemented in alignment with enterprise risk tolerance. Success in this role requires solid collaboration/judgment, the ability to lead through influence without direct authority, and comfort operating in environments with incomplete or rapidly evolving information.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a key player on the team that is accountable for delivering security controls/programs to acquired entities
  • Lead the enablement and deployment of various platforms/processes
  • Define patterns for discovering, classifying, and correlating external assets across infrastructure, cloud, SaaS, and third-party services
  • Translate external exposure data into risk-based insights for technical and executive stakeholders
  • Act as a trusted advisor to business and technology leaders by clearly articulating external risk, architectural trade-offs, and remediation options
  • Drive alignment across multiple teams with competing priorities using influence rather than authority
  • Own and evolve security processes/programs/designs related to:
    • Vulnerability Exposure Management
    • External asset discovery and inventory
    • Email and messaging security (SMTP, gateways, SaaS email platforms)
    • Internet-facing network, cloud, and application exposure
    • Secure the perimeter on network firewalls
  • Evaluate and document external security risks, assumptions, dependencies, and constraints
  • Produce high-quality internal artifacts including:
    • Security architecture diagrams and reference architectures
    • External exposure and capability gap assessments
    • Roadmap input and architectural recommendations
  • Ensure attack surface findings are:
  • oRisk-ranked based on exploitability and business impact
    • Mapped to accountable owners
    • Tracked through remediation or accepted risk
  • Promote automation where possible to reduce manual effort and accelerate exposure detection and response
  • Provide architectural oversight during implementation to ensure security intent is preserved
  • Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

Required Qualifications:

  • Associate's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of experience in security architecture, enterprise security, or platform security roles
  • Demonstrated experience designing or overseeing Vulnerability Exposure Management or external exposure programs
  • Solid understanding of:
    • Internet-facing infrastructure and cloud services
    • DNS, SMTP, TLS certificates, and SaaS exposure
    • Threat actor reconnaissance and exploitation techniques
    • Dark web monitoring and threat intelligence capabilities
    • Email security platforms, including Proofpoint
    • External vulnerability and exposure scanning tools
  • Proven ability to operate in ambiguous environments where requirements or solutions are not fully defined
  • Proven exceptional ability to communicate complex security concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Proven track record of leading through influence across organizational boundaries


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Hands-on or architectural experience with the following tools:
    • Proofpoint
    • Bright
    • Xpanse
    • Tenable (including external attack surface modules)
    • Splunk or similar SIEM platforms
  • Experience in healthcare or other highly regulated industries
  • Experience influencing enterprise security platforms or shared services
  • Experience working with executive stakeholders on risk visibility and prioritization
  • Mentorship or thought leadership experience within security or architecture communities
  • Familiarity with regulatory and compliance frameworks (e.g., HIPAA, NIST, ISO, SOC)


Behavioral Expectations

  • Thinks strategically while remaining pragmatic and delivery-focused
  • Proactively identifies risk before exploitation occurs
  • Comfortable challenging assumptions and advocating for long-term security outcomes
  • Operates with a solid sense of ownership and accountability
  • Demonstrates intellectual curiosity and continuous learning
  • Acts as a connector across teams, translating technical signals into business-relevant outcomes


At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.
