title: Principal Analyst - SOC I On-site, Bangalore
descriptionHtml:
This team provides 24/7 support. This role requires shift flexibility, including the ability to rotate between days, mids, and nights.

The Principal Analyst will provide deep-level analysis for client investigations utilizing customer-provided data sources, audit, and monitoring tools at both the government and enterprise levels. The Principal Analyst will work closely with our Technology Engineers, Architects, and Threat Analysts to service customers.


How you'll make an impact


  • Operate independently in a geographically dispersed team, while maintaining situational awareness and keeping the team up to date
  • Perform security monitoring and incident response activities across the networks, leveraging a variety of tools and techniques
  • Detect incidents through proactive “hunting” across security-relevant data sets
  • Thoroughly document incident response analysis activities
  • Review investigations conducted by more junior analysts to ensure quality standards are met
  • Develop new, repeatable methods for finding malicious activity across networks
  • Provide recommendations to enhance detection and protection capabilities
  • Regularly present technical topics to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Develop and follow detailed operational processes and procedures to appropriately analyze, escalate, and assist in the remediation of information security incidents
  • Prioritize multiple high-priority tasks and formulate responses/recommendations to customers and team members in a fast-paced environment
  • Collaborate with and aid other security teams
  • Continually develop new technical skills and push overall team capabilities forward
  • Engage with and mentor other team members
  • Work with other teams on major engineering and architecture initiatives
  • Be innovative with their understanding of attack methodologies, malware analysis, malicious toolkits, and how those may manifest within various security technologies
  • Advanced proactive threat hunting
  • Understands advanced adversary emulation concepts
  • Advanced use case design for insider threat, operational, threat detection and response
  • Review of defensive and detective controls to reduce client attack surface


What we’re looking for


  • 9+ years of hands-on cybersecurity operations experience across complex security investigations, incident response, threat hunting, detection engineering, and security control assessment in enterprise environments.
  • Demonstrate hands-on experience with Crowdstrike, Defender, Splunk, and cloud security platforms such as AWS and Azure, with the ability to complete end-to-end triage and investigations.
  • Develop use-case logic across multiple telemetry and source platforms and identify and deploy tuning opportunities to improve detection accuracy.
  • Demonstrate familiarity with incident response (IR) frameworks and participate in incident response activities.
  • Advanced understanding of the cyber threat landscape and adversary TTPs, with extensive experience applying MITRE ATT&CK to investigations, threat hunting, detection engineering, adversary behavior analysis, and detection coverage assessment.
  • Lead complex, multi-source investigations using endpoint, network, identity, cloud, SaaS, memory, disk, and log evidence; preserve evidence, reconstruct attacker timelines, determine root cause and scope, and produce technically defensible findings.
  • Investigate identity- and cloud-centric attacks involving privileged accounts, federation, OAuth applications, tokens, service identities, control-plane/API activity, cloud workloads, SaaS audit records, and cross-account or cross-tenant access.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in SIEM, EDR/XDR, UEBA, and security data platforms, including developing and optimizing complex queries including but not limited to Crowdstrike CQL & FQL, Splunk SPL & SPL2, Defender KQL etc. and correlating telemetry across endpoint, identity, cloud, SaaS, and network environments.
  • Use Python, PowerShell, or comparable scripting languages, REST APIs, and orchestration/SOAR platforms to automate enrichment, evidence collection, threat hunting, detection deployment, and repeatable response activities.
  • Own the detection lifecycle end-to-end, including requirements, data validation, use-case and rule development, peer review, testing, deployment, performance monitoring, tuning, documentation, and retirement, with analysis of both false positives and false negatives.
  • Design and execute hypothesis-driven and exploratory threat hunts based on adversary behavior, threat intelligence, MITRE ATT&CK coverage gaps, and incident learnings, converting validated findings into detections, analytics, or response content.
  • Assess telemetry quality and detection visibility, identify logging, ingestion, normalization, retention, and coverage gaps, and collaborate with engineering and architecture teams to improve security monitoring and investigation capabilities.
  • Serve as technical lead for significant security incidents, defining investigative priorities, evidence-preservation requirements, scoping decisions, containment strategies, remediation validation, and technical handoffs while considering operational and business impact.
  • Demonstrate advanced endpoint and network investigation capabilities, including Windows/Linux security artifacts, EDR/XDR telemetry, packet captures, DNS, proxy, firewall, flow, and related data to identify command-and-control, lateral movement, persistence, exfiltration, and attacker infrastructure.
  • Operationalize threat intelligence by translating adversary TTPs, infrastructure, vulnerabilities, and campaign intelligence into prioritized hunts, behavioral analytics, detection logic, investigation guidance, and defensive-control improvements.
  • Perform advanced phishing and malware analysis, including malicious URLs, attachments, sender infrastructure, authentication artifacts, behavioral/static malware analysis, persistence, execution, and communications; advanced reverse engineering is not required.
  • Provide Principal-level technical leadership, including reviewing complex investigations and detections for quality and accuracy, mentoring analysts, developing repeatable investigation and response methodologies, and collaborating with Security Engineering, Architecture, Threat Intelligence, Incident Response, Cloud, and Identity teams.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to operate independently in a globally distributed environment and communicate complex technical findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrate excellent written and verbal English communication skills, as fluency is required for both internal and client communications.
  • Work from the office, as this is not a remote role.
  • Work in a shift-based model that provides 24x7 operational coverage, with the flexibility to support any shift that falls within that 24-hour period.

#LI-SK1


What you can expect from Optiv

  • A company committed to our inclusive value through our Employee Resource Groups
  • Work/life balance
  • Professional training resources
  • Creative problem-solving and the ability to tackle unique, complex projects
  • Volunteer Opportunities. “Optiv Chips In” encourages employees to volunteer and engage with their teams and communities.
  • The ability and technology necessary to productively work remotely/from home (where applicable)

EEO Statement

Optiv is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants for employment will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age 40 and over, marital status, genetic information, national origin, status as an individual with a disability, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.

Optiv Security is the world’s leading security solutions integrator (SSI). With years of experience supporting thousands of enterprise-level clients, we know the solutions landscape better than anyone. We understand the challenges our clients face every day – because many of our people have occupied a seat on the other side of the table. Our unique team of former CISOs, security technologists and operations experts leverage an “I’ve experienced that, and solved that” perspective to deliver solutions that help our clients maximize and communicate the effectiveness of their cybersecurity programs.

As the world’s leading SSI, we take a strategic inside-out approach to cybersecurity. While the traditional threat-centric “outside-in” approach focuses first on identifying specific threats and then reacting with technology procurement, Optiv starts with core requirement of every enterprise - risk mitigation - and builds out from there with strategy, infrastructure rationalization, operations optimization, and ongoing measurement.

This enables clients to build a sustainable risk-centric foundation for implementing proactive and measurable security programs that are far more effective at reducing current and future risk than is possible with the reactive outside-in model. And unlike the big accounting firms that provide strategy without execution, we stay with you all the way – delivering the clarity to get and keep your security tight and right.

title: Digital Technology Specialist - Cyber Intelligence
descriptionHtml:
Digital Technology Senior Specialist - Cyber Security Engineering

Baker Hughes is seeking a Strategic Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) Analyst to deliver intelligence that shapes senior and executive decision-making. In this role, you will analyze the evolving cyber threat landscape and turn complex information about threat actors, malware, campaigns, emerging technologies, and geopolitical events into clear, high-impact insights.

Your work will help leaders understand trends, anticipate risk, and make informed choices that protect Baker Hughes' people, operations, and equities in cyberspace.


Partner with the best

Baker Hughes has a new opportunity for Cyber Security Engineering to join the team in India.

As a Cyber Security Engineering, you will be responsible for:

  • Strategic Reporting: Produce monthly and quarterly CTI deliverables that provide trend analysis and actionable insight to inform strategic decisions about Baker Hughes' equities in cyberspace.
  • Landscape Monitoring: Identify and assess events that shift the strategic threat landscape, including threat actors' adoption of new technologies such as AI within their attack flows.
  • Executive Briefings: Develop event-driven and opportunity-based summary products that prompt executive critical thinking about cyber threats and risk management.
  • Geopolitical Analysis: Assess how geopolitical developments influence threat actor intent, capability, and targeting relevant to the energy and industrial technology sectors.
  • Team Fusion: Collaborate across tactical, operational, and strategic CTI functions to align workflows and drive a unified intelligence picture for Baker Hughes decision-makers.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Tailor intelligence products and briefings to diverse audiences, from technical security teams to senior leadership.


Fuel your passion

  • Bachelor's degree in cybersecurity, information technology, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in a cybersecurity role, including at least 2 years as a CTI analyst in a tactical, fusion, or strategic analyst capacity.
  • In-depth working knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
  • Strong writing, editing, and briefing skills, with demonstrated ability to communicate with diverse audiences, including senior and executive leaders.
  • Industry certification in threat intelligence (e.g., GIAC GCTI, EC-Council CTIA) or related security credentials.
  • Familiarity with analytic frameworks such as the Diamond Model, Cyber Kill Chain, and structured analytic techniques.
  • Experience using threat intelligence platforms and open-source intelligence (OSINT) sources.
  • Knowledge of threats facing the energy, oil and gas, or operational technology (OT) sectors.
  • Background in geopolitical, regional, or international affairs analysis.
  • Proficiency in additional languages relevant to the role's locations (Spanish, Italian, or Hindi) is a plus.


Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive Working remotely


Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.


Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

  • Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
  • Comprehensive private medical care options
  • Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
  • Tailored financial programs

descriptionText:
Digital Technology Senior Specialist - Cyber Security Engineering

Baker Hughes is seeking a Strategic Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) Analyst to deliver intelligence that shapes senior and executive decision-making. In this role, you will analyze the evolving cyber threat landscape and turn complex information about threat actors, malware, campaigns, emerging technologies, and geopolitical events into clear, high-impact insights.

Your work will help leaders understand trends, anticipate risk, and make informed choices that protect Baker Hughes' people, operations, and equities in cyberspace.

Partner with the best

Baker Hughes has a new opportunity for Cyber Security Engineering to join the team in India.

As a Cyber Security Engineering, you will be responsible for:

Strategic Reporting: Produce monthly and quarterly CTI deliverables that provide trend analysis and actionable insight to inform strategic decisions about Baker Hughes' equities in cyberspace.
Landscape Monitoring: Identify and assess events that shift the strategic threat landscape, including threat actors' adoption of new technologies such as AI within their attack flows.
Executive Briefings: Develop event-driven and opportunity-based summary products that prompt executive critical thinking about cyber threats and risk management.
Geopolitical Analysis: Assess how geopolitical developments influence threat actor intent, capability, and targeting relevant to the energy and industrial technology sectors.
Team Fusion: Collaborate across tactical, operational, and strategic CTI functions to align workflows and drive a unified intelligence picture for Baker Hughes decision-makers.
Stakeholder Engagement: Tailor intelligence products and briefings to diverse audiences, from technical security teams to senior leadership.

Fuel your passion

Bachelor's degree in cybersecurity, information technology, or related field.
5+ years of experience in a cybersecurity role, including at least 2 years as a CTI analyst in a tactical, fusion, or strategic analyst capacity.
In-depth working knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
Strong writing, editing, and briefing skills, with demonstrated ability to communicate with diverse audiences, including senior and executive leaders.
Industry certification in threat intelligence (e.g., GIAC GCTI, EC-Council CTIA) or related security credentials.
Familiarity with analytic frameworks such as the Diamond Model, Cyber Kill Chain, and structured analytic techniques.
Experience using threat intelligence platforms and open-source intelligence (OSINT) sources.
Knowledge of threats facing the energy, oil and gas, or operational technology (OT) sectors.
Background in geopolitical, regional, or international affairs analysis.
Proficiency in additional languages relevant to the role's locations (Spanish, Italian, or Hindi) is a plus.

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive Working remotely

Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
Comprehensive private medical care options
Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
Tailored financial programs

descriptionHtml:
Who we are

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

About this Role

We are seeking a Cyber Security Engineer with 2–7 years of experience in cyber security incident response and threat mitigation to join our DDoS Security team in Bangalore or Pune.
In this role, you will monitor and analyse cyber security alerts and perform real-time threat and DDoS attack mitigation to protect customer and organisational infrastructure. You will use packet and traffic analysis to distinguish malicious activity from legitimate traffic, configure appropriate filters and countermeasures, and support customers during security incidents.
You will collaborate with global teams, markets, customers and technology vendors to optimise threat mitigation strategies and security configurations. The role also involves customer onboarding, platform management, technical consultation and support for pre-sales activities.
As real-time incident response is central to this position, 24x7 flexibility to work in shifts is required.

What you’ll do

  • Monitor and analyse cyber security alerts to identify genuine attacks and initiate appropriate mitigation.
  • Respond to security incidents within defined organisational SLAs.
  • Perform real-time DDoS attack detection and mitigation, including volumetric and application-layer attacks.
  • Conduct deep packet inspection and traffic analysis to identify attack patterns, vectors and malicious traffic.
  • Configure and optimise filters, countermeasures and security controls based on identified attack vectors.
  • Improve mitigation effectiveness through ongoing analysis and optimisation of security configurations.
  • Troubleshoot cyber security incidents with customers and recommend solutions to reduce infrastructure risk.
  • Consult customers on recent threats, attack scenarios and appropriate mitigation strategies.
  • Onboard new customers onto the security platform based on agreed requirements.
  • Provide technical consultation to pre-sales teams supporting prospective customers.
  • Manage the configuration lifecycle of security platforms and implement changes within defined SLAs.
  • Contribute to problem management and major incident management when required.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to share knowledge and implement effective security practices.
  • Engage with vendors to resolve platform issues and obtain threat-related technical consultation.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive operational and security activities.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, local work instructions and operational procedures.

Who you are

You have:
  • 2–7 years of experience in cyber security incident response and threat mitigation.
  • Experience in analysing cyber attacks and taking appropriate mitigation actions.
  • Strong packet analysis skills, with the ability to differentiate DDoS attacks from legitimate network traffic.
  • Hands-on experience in real-time cyber threat mitigation.
  • Knowledge of DDoS attack detection and mitigation.
  • Experience with deep packet inspection.
  • The ability to understand and configure filters and countermeasures for volumetric and application-based attacks.
  • Knowledge of the NIST incident response process and MITRE ATT&CK framework.
  • Experience or knowledge of Radware DefensePro.
  • Experience or knowledge of Radware DefenseFlow.
  • Experience or knowledge of Arbor DDoS protection.
  • Knowledge of application-layer attack mitigation.
  • The ability to collaborate with customers, global teams, internal stakeholders and technology vendors.
  • Flexibility to work in a 24x7 shift environment.
Relevant certifications are desirable, including:
  • Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)
  • ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity (CC)
  • CompTIA Security+
DDoS attack mitigation experience would be an added advantage.

Not a perfect fit?

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

What's in it for you

  • Opportunity to work on real-time cyber security incident response and DDoS threat mitigation across customer and organisational infrastructure.
  • Exposure to global teams, markets, customers and technology vendors while addressing complex cyber security incidents.
  • Hands-on experience with DDoS protection technologies including Radware DefensePro, Radware DefenseFlow and Arbor DDoS protection.
  • Opportunity to contribute to security platform optimisation, customer onboarding, major incident management and technical consultation.
  • Scope to identify and implement automation opportunities within day-to-day cyber security operations.

What skills you will learn

Through this role, you will have opportunities to further develop skills in:
  • Real-time cyber incident response and threat mitigation.
  • DDoS attack detection, analysis and mitigation.
  • Deep packet inspection and network traffic analysis.
  • Volumetric and application-layer attack mitigation.
  • Security filter and countermeasure configuration.
  • Radware DefensePro and DefenseFlow technologies.
  • Arbor DDoS protection.
  • NIST-aligned incident response processes.
  • MITRE ATT&CK-based threat analysis.
  • Security platform configuration lifecycle management.
  • Problem and major incident management.
  • Customer-facing cyber security consultation.
  • Security operations automation and technical documentation.

VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment

Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.

Join Us

At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

title: Governance, Risk and Compliance Analyst (Information Security)
descriptionHtml:
Our Information Security team is a trusted partner to the business, integrating security, privacy, and trust into Talkdesk's operations and customer service. We emphasize practical, scalable controls that safeguard customers and employees while allowing the business to operate swiftly. As Talkdesk leads in Customer Experience Automation, our team is crucial in building and maintaining customer trust in our AI development, deployment, and governance.

Are you someone who prefers to automate controls rather than chase evidence quarterly?

As a GRC Analyst on the Information Security team, you will actively manage Talkdesk's compliance programs from start to finish — overseeing our GRC platform, collaborating with engineering to gather audit evidence, and preparing for new certifications as our customer base grows.


What you'll do

  • Manage Talkdesk's GRC platform daily, including control owner assignments, evidence requests, automated test configurations, and exception tracking.
  • Maintain integrations between the GRC platform and source systems (cloud providers, identity, ticketing, code repositories) to automate evidence collection wherever possible.
  • Identify manual control activities suitable for automation and collaborate with security and engineering teams to implement them.
  • Oversee the evidence collection cycle for SOC 2 (Type II), ISO surveillances, recertifications, and HIPAA assessments.
  • Work with engineering, IT, HR, and platform teams to gather, validate, and prepare audit artifacts, addressing evidence gaps before they escalate into findings.
  • Manage the control library and framework crosswalks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, ISO 22301, ISO 42001, HIPAA), ensuring mappings are current as standards evolve.
  • Conduct initial gap assessments against new frameworks (e.g., FedRAMP Moderate, HITRUST, StateRAMP, ISO 42001 expansions), document control gaps and effort estimates, and support readiness once leadership approves a path forward.
  • Track the remediation of any non-conformities to closure.
  • Utilize AI-assisted tools (control narrative drafting, evidence summarization, policy review) to minimize manual effort while ensuring output accuracy.
  • Maintain compliance documentation in Confluence and track work in Jira for team visibility.
  • Foster a culture of compliance — making controls easier to follow than bypass.

Must have

  • 5-8 years of experience in GRC, IT audit, or information security operations, preferably in a B2B SaaS environment.
  • Working knowledge of common security frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF) and privacy regulations (GDPR).
  • Hands-on experience with GRC platforms (e.g., Vanta, Drata, OneTrust, Hyperproof, AuditBoard).
  • Comfortable collaborating with engineers: able to read cloud architecture diagrams and discuss IAM, logging, and encryption choices, with basic terminal or cloud console skills.
  • Familiarity with the SDLC and the implementation of security controls in CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with Google Workspace, Confluence, and Jira.
  • Understanding of AI security and governance topics (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of translating compliance requirements into clear, actionable requests for engineering and partner teams.
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken).
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.
  • Comfortable in fast-paced, high-pressure situations, including audit periods.

Nice to have

  • Exposure to ISO 27701, ISO 22301, ISO 42001, HIPAA, FedRAMP, StateRAMP, or HITRUST.
  • Experience supporting a new framework certification from gap assessment through the first audit.
  • Basic scripting skills (Python, Bash, SQL) for evidence gathering and ad-hoc analysis.
  • Experience with AWS or other major cloud providers — audit log fluency, IAM, Config rules.
  • Familiarity with additional security standards and frameworks (e.g., NIST 800-53, CIS Benchmarks, OWASP, SANS).
  • Relevant certifications such as ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer / Lead Auditor, CISA, CRISC, or CompTIA Security+.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Talkdesk is pioneering a new era of Customer Experience Automation (CXA), redefining how the world's most admired brands interact with their customers through AI. Our global team of courageous innovators is customer-obsessed, building AI-first solutions that put empathy, trust, and transparency at the center of every interaction. We foster an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives drive our success and every voice belongs. Combining the stability of a global leader with the agility of a disruptor, Talkdeskers are empowered with the autonomy to drive meaningful impact, while giving back to the communities and environment around us.

Talkdesk has been recognized as a Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) and in the G2 Overall Grid® Reports for AI Agents and Contact Center. With seven consecutive years on the Forbes Cloud 100 and multiple AI Breakthrough awards, there has never been a more exciting time to join us as we shape the future of customer experience automation!

Work Environment and Physical Requirements:

Primarily office-environment work, extended periods of sitting or standing, computer-based work. Limited lifting, and equipment usage limited to computer-related equipment (keyboards, mouse, etc.)

The Talkdesk story hinges on empathy and acceptance. It is the shared goal among all Talkdeskers to empower a new kind of customer hero through our innovative software solution, and we firmly believe that the best path to success for our mission is inclusivity, diversity, and genuine acceptance. To that end, we will hire, promote, work along, cheer for, bond with, and warmly welcome into the Talkdesk family all persons without regard to ethnic and racial identity, indigenous heritage, national origin, religion, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

title: Security / Cloud Engineer-Contract
descriptionHtml:
Job Description
Transition Support
Position
Security / Cloud Engineer

Quantity
1


Focus
Legacy security operations and Microsoft security-platform transition

Experience
6-10+ years in infrastructure/cloud/security; 3-5+ years in security operations


Role Summary

The Security / Cloud Engineer will maintain security operations across legacy environment while supporting transition to Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel, Intune and Purview. The role requires strong Microsoft security capability plus transferable experience across endpoint security, MDR/SOC, vulnerability management, application control, privileged access, DLP and Zero Trust technologies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor, investigate, document, and coordinate response to security alerts and incidents.
  • Support the existing security toolset and coordinate with MDR, SOC, GRC, and penetration-testing providers.
  • Document current integrations, alerts, operational processes, exceptions, and risk dependencies.
  • Support endpoint detection and response, application control, endpoint hardening and vulnerability remediation.
  • Support privileged-access, secure-connectivity, browser-security and data-protection controls.
  • Onboard and validate endpoints and telemetry for Microsoft Defender XDR and Microsoft Sentinel.
  • Configure Sentinel data connectors, analytics rules, incidents, workbooks, automation and KQL queries.
  • Support Microsoft Intune compliance, endpoint security, security baselines and Conditional Access integration.
  • Support Microsoft Purview DLP, sensitivity labels, information protection and data-classification activities.
  • Perform security validation during migration waves and track remediation through closure.
  • Participate in structured knowledge transfer from the incumbent provider, Kevlar.
  • Operate within Client security, access, incident, request and change-management procedures.
  • Create and maintain SOPs, runbooks, knowledge articles and operational handover documentation.
  • Support migration and cutover windows, including planned after-hours coverage when required.
  • Complete applicable background checks and comply with customer confidentiality requirements.
  • Work closely with Pomeroy Managed Services to enable a controlled transition to steady-state support.

Mandatory Microsoft Security Skills

  • Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Office 365, Identity and Cloud Apps
  • Microsoft Defender XDR incident investigation and Advanced Hunting
  • Microsoft Sentinel and Log Analytics
  • KQL, data connectors, analytics rules, workbooks and automation
  • Microsoft Intune compliance and endpoint-security policies
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Purview DLP and Information Protection

Legacy Tool Exposure

  • EDR/MDR/SOC: Heimdall, Cynet, Xcybero, FutureSafe or equivalent
  • Application control: ThreatLocker or equivalent allowlisting technology
  • Hardening/vulnerability: Senteon, ConnectSecure or equivalent
  • Browser security/DLP: Atakama, BrowserScan or equivalent
  • Privileged access: Keeper or equivalent PAM/password management
  • Secure connectivity: Cytracom, TIMS or equivalent Zero Trust/secure access
  • GRC/penetration testing coordination: Blacksmith InfoSec, Galactic Advisors or equivalent

Additional Security Skills

  • Incident response and threat investigation
  • Vulnerability management and remediation tracking
  • Zero Trust and identity security
  • Privileged access management
  • Cloud and endpoint security
  • Security hardening and risk management

Preferred Certifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate
  • Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate
  • CISSP, CCSP or comparable security certification

Key Competencies

  • Ability to operate across unfamiliar security products
  • Strong incident ownership and analytical thinking
  • Clear communication with customer, SOC, vendors and project teams
  • Structured risk, remediation and operational documentation
  • Ability to balance operational stability with platform transition

Success Measures

  • Continuous security coverage during the transition
  • Timely incident investigation and escalation
  • Successful onboarding and validation of Microsoft security capabilities
  • Documented legacy controls, integrations, risks and handover procedures

title: SOC System Support Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Build a career where values meet worldwide opportunity.

Job Description:
  • Deep understanding of general access control systems and hardware and their operations.
  • Understanding of computer systems and basic IT networking structures.
  • Candidates for this position must have a security systems background and knowledge of a variety of Physical Access Control systems.
  • Leading contributor as an individual and as a team member, providing leadership with program implementation.
  • Working knowledge of word processing and Excel spreadsheet skills is required.
  • Outstanding interpersonal and customer service skills.
  • Works well in a security operations center environment.
  • Work is non-routine and complex at times, involving the application of technical and business skills and customer service on a daily basis.
  • Strong organizational and clear communication skills are required.
  • Individuals in this position must be self-motivated and forward-thinking, willing to deep-dive into complex support issues to find the root cause.
  • They must demonstrate strong multitasking ability to manage multiple different tasks.
  • Experienced in access control system programming.
  • Preferred in-depth technical experience with credential management systems.
  • Working knowledge of Lenel OnGuard access control systems is desirable.

Additional Details:

  • Programs and maintains access levels within the credential management system.
  • Works with GPS, OCI, and other LOBs to collect needed information and manage system programming.
  • Performs regular reviews of credential management systems to ensure global standards are maintained.
  • Monitors and responds to support emails and calls from OCI and GPS organizations.
  • Monitors global security devices via a dashboard application and notifies systems teams of outages.
  • Respond to questions from the GPS and OCI teams.
  • Works with local DCO teams worldwide to maintain system configuration in the credential management system.
  • Maintains system programming for biometric reading systems as they relate to OCI.

title: Senior Cybersecurity Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Job Requirements

At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.


Key Responsibilities
. Lead cybersecurity reviews across MRS, PRS, and TRS documents and manage compliance checklist reporting
. Support product teams in translating business, customer, and regulatory cybersecurity requirements into technical product requirements
. Lead gate review security assessments, delivering clear sign-off recommendations
. Track product security risks and issues, providing actionable recommendations for resolution.
. Maintain requirement traceability records and validate evidence for security implementation and closure.
. Promote cybersecurity awareness across engineering teams and project stakeholders.


We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.


We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21,000 difference-makers in our workplace.


Work Experience
  • Good understanding of cyber security principles like, cyber security architecture, defense in depth, default deny, least privilege, compartmentalization, privileged initiation, AAA, etc.
  • Good understanding of cyber security controls like; IDS/IPS (host and network), hardening, security policies, Malware Protection, Filtering, NGFW, etc.
  • Knowledge in Networking, patch management, Industrial protocols like DNP/MODBUS/IEC 61850 etc.
  • Hands on Experience with protocols like HTTP, HTTPS, SSL, SSH, ICMP, DHCP, L2TP, PPTP, DNS, SNMP, RDP, and NTP.
  • Windows and Virtual Machine Administration.
  • Experience with Security tools like NMAP, Nessus, Wireshark, etc.
  • Certifications like MCP/MCITP/MCSE/CEH/CISSP are advantage.
  • Knowledge on security standards like IEC 62443, ISO 27001.

title: Incident Responder
descriptionHtml:
Company Overview



Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).


What you'll do



We are seeking a dedicated Incident Responder to join our Cyber Security Incident Response Team to investigate, analyze, and contain cyber threats. In this role, you will play a critical part in identifying and mitigating security incidents, collaborating closely with internal teams to ensure swift threat containment and recovery. You will leverage your technical expertise in log analysis, intrusion detection, and digital forensics to protect our environment while helping to refine established response procedures. This role requires a self-motivated professional capable of prioritizing tasks under time constraints, participating in on-call rotations outside of standard business hours, and maintaining detailed incident documentation. If you are passionate about cybersecurity and eager to make a tangible impact on our security posture, we encourage you to apply.


This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Manager - CSIRT.
Responsibility

  • Leverage AI and machine learning tools to enhance the efficiency of log analysis, alert triage, and threat hunting
  • Monitor for and investigate security incidents involving AI/ML models, such as adversarial attacks, prompt injection, and model evasion
  • Conduct thorough investigations into security incidents, identify root causes, and recommend remediation efforts to prevent future occurrences
  • Participate in proactive threat hunting utilizing various security tools and platforms to identify vulnerabilities, suspicious activity, and potential security gaps
  • Analyze suspicious files and indicators of compromise (IoCs) to understand the scope of an incident and identify compromised systems or data
  • Assist in the creation, maintenance, and optimization of incident response playbooks and procedures to address evolving threats
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, such as Security Operations, Engineering, and Legal, during active security incidents to ensure effective containment and mitigation
  • Utilize internal and external threat intelligence sources to proactively identify and mitigate emerging threats before they materialize
  • Work hands-on with security tools (SIEM, EDR, SOAR, threat intelligence platforms) to investigate alerts, reduce false positives, and support the continuous improvement of detection capabilities
  • Perform post-incident analysis and daily reporting, providing detailed documentation of lessons learned and suggesting areas for security posture improvement


Job Designation



Hybrid: Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)


Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.


What you bring



Basic

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity, with a focus on Security Operations (SOC) and/or Incident Response
  • Solid understanding of cybersecurity principles, incident response lifecycles, and security best practices
  • Experience with SIEM tools (e.g., Splunk, QRadar, Sentinel) for alert analysis and log correlation
  • Familiarity with EDR solutions and their role in incident investigation
  • Strong familiarity with digital forensics principles and techniques and enterprise forensic solutions
  • Knowledge of scripting languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash) for automation and data analysis
  • Deep understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and cyber kill chain
  • Understanding of AI-driven security threats, including adversarial attacks and model evasion, and the ability to leverage AI/ML tools to enhance incident response and threat hunting

Preferred


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field
  • Industry certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CySA+, GCIH, GCFA, or CEH
  • Hands-on experience with SOAR platforms
  • Exposure to cloud security concepts (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen eye for detail
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a team and independently under pressure
  • Knowledge of how to protect against AI threats and using it in day to day work
  • Experience with AI security frameworks such as MITRE ATLAS or OWASP Top 10 for LLMs


Life at Docusign



Working here
Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.


We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.


Accommodation
Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.


If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.


AI in Our Hiring Process
At Docusign, we embrace technology to enhance efficiency and create a better candidate experience. We may record or transcribe interviews using enterprise AI tools to assist with meeting notes and interview documentation so our teams can stay fully engaged in the conversation. All hiring decisions remain 100% human-led. You have the right to opt out at any time by notifying your recruiter or interview team, with zero impact on your candidacy.
We encourage using AI tools to research and prepare beforehand. However, to ensure an authentic evaluation, live AI assistance or external recording bots during interviews are not permitted.

title: SeniorAdministrator - Security Analysis, SIEM
descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

The Sr. Security Administrator plays a critical role in ensuring the operational integrity and security of the organization's systems. This position is responsible for advanced technical support, troubleshooting complex incidents, and performing root cause analysis to enhance customer satisfaction and maintain a robust security posture.

Key Responsibilities

1. Perform Security Event Analysis Using Siem Tools To Monitor, Detect, And Respond To Security Threats, Ensuring Adherence To Quality Standards And Regulatory Requirements.
2. Provide Technical Support For Complex Incidents Escalated By Analysts, Conducting Thorough Root Cause Analysis And Implementing Effective Solutions For Technical And Security Challenges.
3. Lead Value-Adding Initiatives Such As Updating And Managing The Knowledge Base, Providing Training For New Team Members, And Coaching Analysts To Enhance Team Performance.
4. Resolve Complex Support Tickets Within Agreed Slas, Collaborating With Cross-Functional Teams To Ensure Seamless Operations And A Robust Security Posture.
5. Enhance Customer Experience And Csat By Achieving First Call Resolution, Minimizing Rejected Resolutions, Reducing Case Reopenings, And Proactively Mitigating Security Threats.

Skill Requirements

1. Advanced Proficiency In Security Event Analysis And Implementation Of Technical Solutions Using Siem Tools.
2. Solid Understanding Of Security Operations And Incident Management Processes.
3. Familiarity With Soar Platforms To Automate Security Workflows Effectively.
4. Strong Analytical And Problem-Solving Skills With Attention To Detail.

Must Have Skill

Security Event Analysis,Technical solution implementation-SIEM

Good to Have Skill

Data Pipelines,ETL Tool - Others,Foundation models and API Integration

Other Requirements

1. Optional But Valuable Certifications: Certified Information Systems Security Professional (Cissp), Certified Information Security Manager (Cism), Or Security+ Certification

title: Detection & Response Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At TechBiz Global, we are providing recruitment service to our TOP clients from our portfolio. We are currently seeking a Detection & Response Engineer to join one of our clients' teams. If you're looking for an exciting opportunity to grow in a innovative environment, this could be the perfect fit for you.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Investigate security cases and targeted hunts using CrowdStrike Falcon Next-Gen SIEM and CQL; correlate telemetry, assess scope and impact, document findings, and recommend appropriate actions.
  • Develop, test, deploy, tune, and maintain detection logic, queries, dashboards, analyst guides, and version-controlled detection content.
  • Build and maintain Falcon Fusion SOAR workflows for enrichment, evidence capture, routing, escalation, and authorized response.
  • Validate telemetry coverage and quality; troubleshoot parsing, normalization, mapping, and source-data issues.
  • Translate validated investigations into platform workflow specifications and co-build scripts, API integrations, workflow components, and prototypes with Product and Engineering.
  • Test workflows and detections against representative cases; monitor outcomes, exceptions, and production feedback, and document ownership and support handoffs.
  • Provide technical support, troubleshooting, knowledge transfer, and coaching; coordinate assigned analysis and platform work.


Must have:

  • 5+ years of relevant security experience, including at least 2 years developing, testing, and tuning detection logic, or equivalent demonstrated capability.
  • Production proficiency with CrowdStrike Falcon Next-Gen SIEM, including CQL, cross-source investigations, detection content, telemetry interpretation, and tuning.
  • Hands-on Falcon Fusion SOAR workflow experience and practical use of Charlotte AI with evidence verification and awareness of approval boundaries.
  • Practical Python, REST/Falcon APIs, JSON, authentication, error handling, and secure credential management; familiarity with PowerShell or another relevant scripting language.
  • Experience with telemetry onboarding, parser/normalization troubleshooting, MITRE ATT&CK, Windows/Linux events, and controlled changes, version control, peer review, and regression testing.
  • Strong investigation judgment, defensible documentation, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Nice to have:

  • Experience converting SOC runbooks or manual analysis into production workflows or internal security platforms.
  • CrowdStrike resident, responder, partner implementation, or customer-embedded Falcon experience; FalconPy or comparable API tooling.
  • Experience partnering with Product and Engineering on analyst-facing features, case lifecycle integration, acceptance testing, or iterative delivery.
  • Managed security services, multi-client or follow-the-sun SOC operations, and ITSM integrations such as ServiceNow or Jira.
  • Relevant CrowdStrike training or credentials, GIAC invest

title: DLP Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Data Loss Prevention (DLP) Engineer

Experience: 2-4 Years

Location: Bengaluru

Department: Information Security / Cyber Security

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly motivated Data Loss Prevention (DLP) Engineer to join

our Information Security team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for

implementing, monitoring, and enhancing DLP controls to protect sensitive

organizational data across endpoints, email, cloud applications, and collaboration

platforms.

The role requires strong technical expertise in DLP technologies, incident

investigation, policy management, and collaboration with business and technology

teams to ensure compliance with security and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

 Implement, manage, and optimize Data Loss Prevention (DLP) solutions

across enterprise environments.

 Configure and maintain DLP policies for data classification, monitoring, and

protection.

 Monitor DLP alerts and incidents, investigate potential data leakage events,

and drive timely remediation.

 Work closely with Security Operations, IT, Cloud, and Business teams to

strengthen data protection controls.

 Identify sensitive data repositories and recommend security measures to

reduce data exposure.

 Manage DLP controls across endpoints, email systems, cloud applications,

and collaboration platforms.

 Perform root cause analysis for security incidents and provide corrective and

preventive actions.

 Develop and maintain DLP dashboards, reports, and metrics for management

review.

 Assist in regulatory compliance initiatives related to data protection and

privacy requirements.

 Conduct periodic reviews and fine-tuning of DLP policies to minimize false

positives.

 Participate in security audits, risk assessments, and compliance reviews.

 Create and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, and incident

response procedures.

Required Skills & Qualifications

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber

Security, or a related field.

 3-5 years of experience in Information Security, with hands-on experience in

DLP technologies.

 Experience with DLP solutions such as:

o Microsoft Purview DLP

o Symantec DLP

o Forcepoint DLP

o Trellix (McAfee) DLP

o Broadcom DLP

 Strong understanding of data classification, data protection, and information

security principles.

 Experience in endpoint, email, network, and cloud DLP implementations.

 Knowledge of Microsoft 365 Security, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online,

Teams, and OneDrive security controls.

 Familiarity with SIEM tools such as Splunk, Sentinel, QRadar, or LogRhythm.

 Understanding of security frameworks and standards such as ISO 27001,

NIST, PCI-DSS, and GDPR.

Strong hands-on experience with Forcepoint DLP is mandatory.

Hands-on experience in DLP implementation, deployment, configuration, and administration in enterprise environments.

Strong experience in DLP alert investigation, incident analysis, and data leakage incident handling.

title: Global Banking & Markets - Securities Settlements Group - Analyst - Bengaluru
descriptionHtml:
GLOBAL BANKING & MARKETS

We make markets in and clear client transactions on major stock, options, and futures exchanges worldwide. Through our global sales force, we maintain relationships with our clients, receiving orders and distributing investment research, trading ideas, market information and analysis.

OPERATIONS

Operations is a dynamic, multi-faceted function that partners with all parts of the firm to provide banking, securities, and asset management services to clients around the world. In addition, Operations provides essential risk management and controls to preserve and enhance the firm's assets and its reputation. For every new product launched and every trade executed, it is Operations that develops and manages the processes and controls that enable business flow.

YOUR IMPACT

Securities Settlements team has the benefit of being located in the nucleus of an investment bank so the exposure and interaction that the successful candidate will gain will be vast. The successful hire will interface with global team across divisions. The successful candidate will be expected to act as a change agent, by improving processes and procedures and contribute meaningfully to the overall strategy of the organization.

In depth on the job training will be provided, backed up with on-going support and oversight as the candidate will be responsible for an important function within the team. The role is ideal for a candidate who wants experience of a variety of Securities Settlements functions.

OUR IMPACT

Operations is a dynamic, multi-faceted function that partners with all areas of the firm to deliver banking, sales and trading and asset management capabilities to clients around the world. Alongside this vital service delivery role, Operations provides essential risk management and control, preserving and enhancing the firm’s assets and its reputation.

Operations span all product lines and markets, serving as internal business partners who develop the processes and controls, and help to specify the systems that deliver accuracy, timeliness, and integrity to our business.

Securities Settlements is operating under ‘Equities’ department. The Team’s primary function is to partner with key stakeholders (middle offices, desks, traders etc) to enable timely settlements with a focus on efficiency, control, and excellent client service.

BUSINESS UNIT OVERVIEW

Securities Settlements Operations provides operational support for multiple businesses including (but not limited to) Trading, Sales, Investment Banking, Private Wealth, etc. covering functions including Inventory & Liquidity Management, Settlements, Exception management and Reporting, and Strategic Projects. We support our international client base across global markets.

Traders & Clients execute Buy & Sell transactions in all major markets, with increasing presence within emerging markets. Upon Settlement Date, trades need to be matched and inventory made available to ensure successful exchange of securities and cash.

Securities Settlements Operations globally is located in London, Salt Lake City, Singapore and Bangalore.

The department’s key priorities are to mitigate risk, provide exceptional client service and drive strategic change.

JOB SUMMARY AND RESPONSBILITIES

The position available is with the Securities Settlements Operations team – Hyderabad location. The reporting line is to a Team Manager as first line management, with further supervision by the Vice President.

Key stakeholders and interactions will be with GS Trading and Sales Desks, Engineering and Operations Teams, Credit, Legal, Compliance and external counterparties.

The following tasks give an overview of what is required day to day:

  • Monitoring Settlement activity and ensuring securities are in the right place at the right time
  • Monitoring Firm inventory to ensure it is moved or converted to facilitate settlement
  • Working with the Trading Desk on securing borrows to facilitate settlement
  • Query resolution and interaction with trading desk and clients on failing trades
  • Investigating and resolving discrepancies of positions (cash and securities) in the firm’s books and records.
  • Completing daily checklist ensuring all controls, procedures and processes relating to the assigned functions are followed
  • Acting as a change agent solving problems at root cause whilst also taking / making opportunities to automate flows

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

We are looking for an enthusiastic and committed individual who is looking to operate in a dynamic working environment where communication and teamwork skills are essential.

  • Exceptional client service and relationship building are required to interact with our clients and the team.
  • The candidate should have a control focus and be achievement orientated to produce results to ensure that all risk is mitigated.
  • Degree / A level educated candidate would be preferred.
  • Strong organizational skills required.
  • Deadlines within this role are very strict with “zero tolerance.”
  • Prompt escalation and clear communication is paramount.
  • Be flexible, work on projects or aid other team members.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Work experience in Securities Settlements, Inventory Management, trade support or securities middle office role for 1 to 2 years.
  • Equities Industry and market knowledge would be an advantage.
  • Experience of vendor platforms (Easyway) would be an advantage
  • IAQ would be an advantage

ABOUT GOLDMAN SACHS

At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital, and ideas to help our clients, shareholders, and the communities
we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities, and investment
management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.
We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and
inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities
to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. about our culture, benefits,
and people at GS.com/careers.
We’re committed to finding reasonable accommodations for candidates with special needs or disabilities during our
recruiting process. : https://www.goldmansachs.com/careers/footer/disability-statement.html
© The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc., 2026. All rights reserved.

We Offer Best-In-Class Benefits
Healthcare & Medical Insurance
We offer a wide range of health and welfare programs that vary depending on office location. These generally include medical, dental, short-term disability, long-term disability, life, accidental death, labor accident and business travel accident insurance.
Holiday & Vacation Policies
We offer competitive vacation policies based on employee level and office location. We promote time off from work to recharge by providing generous vacation entitlements and a minimum of three weeks expected vacation usage each year.
Financial Wellness & Retirement
We assist employees in saving and planning for retirement, offer financial support for higher education, and provide a number of benefits to help employees prepare for the unexpected. We offer live financial education and content on a variety of topics to address the spectrum of employees’ priorities.
Health Services
We offer a medical advocacy service for employees and family members facing critical health situations, and counseling and referral services through the Employee Assistance Program (EAP). We provide Global Medical, Security and Travel Assistance and a Workplace Ergonomics Program. We also offer state-of-the-art on-site health centers in certain offices.
Fitness
To encourage employees to live a healthy and active lifestyle, some of our offices feature on-site fitness centers. For eligible employees we typically reimburse fees paid for a fitness club membership or activity (up to a pre-approved amount).
Child Care & Family Care
We offer on-site child care centers that provide full-time and emergency back-up care, as well as mother and baby rooms and homework rooms. In every office, we provide advice and counseling services, expectant parent resources and transitional programs for parents returning from parental leave. Adoption, surrogacy, egg donation and egg retrieval stipends are also available.
Benefits at Goldman Sachs
Read more about the full suite of class-leading benefits our firm has to offer.

title: Microsoft Control Access - Senior Consultant
descriptionHtml:
As an experienced Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will deliver high-quality work products within deadlines, actively leading, mentoring, and guiding junior team members. You will collaborate with onsite and offshore teams to understand functional requirements and ensure seamless project execution.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for…

  • Administer, design, and govern Microsoft Entra Conditional Access policies across production and non-production environments, including policy assignments, conditions, grant controls, session controls, naming standards, and exclusion governance.
  • Configure and support access controls for users, groups, roles, cloud applications, guests, workload identities, and devices, including multifactor authentication (MFA), authentication strengths, compliant or hybrid-joined device requirements, and risk-based policies.
  • Manage the policy lifecycle through What If analysis, report-only mode, phased rollouts, change records, testing, approvals, rollback planning, post-change validation, and emergency-access account monitoring.
  • Provide Level 3 troubleshooting for sign-in and access issues; analyze policy evaluation details, Microsoft Entra sign-in logs, KQL queries, and Microsoft Sentinel data; and manage incident, service request, problem, and change activities in ServiceNow.
  • Automate repeatable policy reporting, backup, drift detection, and administration using approved tools, including Microsoft Graph PowerShell; maintain dashboards, reports, runbooks, knowledge articles, and technical documentation.
  • Lead client operational reviews and policy-design workshops; coordinate onsite and offshore activities; mentor junior staff; communicate access impacts and remediation actions; and contribute technical insights to managed-services solution design.

The team

Deloitte's Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes:

  • Managing Identity Lifecycle
  • Security Operations
  • Threat Intelligence
  • Application Security
  • Business Transformation
  • Continuous Compliance.

Cyber Operate team focuses on efficiently running operations by enabling automation, reducing manual effort and adhering to Service Level Agreements (SLAs) based on the standards set by clients.

Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai

Shift Timings: 24/7 rotational shifts; on-call support based on project assignment

Qualifications

Required:

Must have skills/ Project experience/ Certifications

  • 6 -10 years total experience in IAM or cybersecurity operations, including at least 4 years designing and operating Microsoft Entra Conditional Access in an operational or managed services capacity.
  • Expert knowledge of Conditional Access: policy design, grant and session controls, authentication strengths, continuous access evaluation, token protection, report-only mode and What If analysis, risk-based policies (Entra ID Protection), device compliance (Intune), named locations, and emergency-access account design.
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID and hybrid identity: Active Directory, Entra Connect/Cloud Sync, PIM, B2B collaboration, SSO and federation (SAML, OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect), and MFA/passwordless authentication.
  • Solid understanding of Zero Trust and least privilege principles, and of compliance frameworks such as NIST SP 800-53/800-207, ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, and PCI DSS.
  • Technological skills in automation, PowerShell scripting, Microsoft Graph and REST APIs, and KQL for troubleshooting, reporting, and monitoring.
  • Deep understanding of operational processes, incident resolution, change management, and compliance management; proficiency with process documentation, SLAs, reporting, and ITSM practices (ServiceNow).
  • Experience leading support teams, mentoring juniors, and managing enhancement/implementation projects; able to communicate effectively with stakeholders and clients at all levels.
  • Preferred certifications: Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300); ITIL.

Preferred:

Good to have skills/ Project experience/ Certifications:

  • Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100), Azure Security Engineer (AZ-500), or Security Operations Analyst (SC-200).
  • Experience with Global Secure Access, Defender for Cloud Apps, Intune, Defender XDR, and Microsoft Sentinel.
  • Experience with Microsoft Security Copilot agents, or Conditional Access policy-as-code (Microsoft Graph, Terraform, Microsoft365DSC, CI/CD pipelines).
  • Hands-on experience with other identity platforms (e.g., Okta, Ping) or privileged access tools used in managed services.
  • Involvement in process improvement or internal training; CISSP, CISM, or CCSP certification

Education:

  • BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university
Our purpose

Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
Our people and culture

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
Professional development

At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.
Benefits to help you thrive


At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
Recruiting tips

From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.
