descriptionHtml:
Syndigo gets great products chosen. Every choice in commerce, whether by a shopper, a search engine, a marketplace, or an AI assistant, is made on product data, and our software makes that data complete and trusted and moves it across the industry's largest two-sided commerce network: 15,000+ brands and 3,500+ retailers. Companies like AutoZone, Colgate-Palmolive, Dole International, Unilever, and Walgreens trust Syndigo to get their products chosen. Learn more at www.syndigo.com.

**This is a hybrid position that requires 2 days per week in office at our Bangalore location**

Here at Syndigo, we're enabling our clients to deliver better eCommerce experiences. We've mastered the right data, right now. From creation to sale, that's the value our partners get from us - a holistic, truly differentiated end-to-end solution that closes the loop while increasing sales.

Basically, we're the accurate data behind how people feel when they shop online with confidence!

We cannot do all of this without our amazing people! Our employees make the magic happen here at Syndigo and we're growing rapidly! We're ready for you to collaborate with us to challenge the status quo!

We are seeking a highly motivated GxP Compliance Associate to join our team. The GxP Compliance Associate will support the quality assurance team by collecting audit evidence, performing spot checks, and conducting audits of systems to ensure compliance with GxP standards. This entry-level role will involve maintaining thorough documentation and assisting in the implementation of corrective actions to address identified non-compliances. The ideal candidate will be detail-oriented, organized, and eager to contribute to the continuous improvement of our compliance processes. The Audit Analyst will work closely with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Marketing, Product, Infosec, Legal, and others to help define deliverables and maintain records of compliance. Further the Audit Analyst will work with the information security team in performing cross functional reviews of systems within the IT/IS systems.

Responsibilities:

  • Audit Evidence Collection
    • Gather, organize, and manage documentation and records required for GxP audits.
    • Ensure all audit evidence is accurate, complete, and readily accessible for review.
  • Spot Checks and System Audits
    • Perform regular spot checks on various systems and processes to ensure ongoing compliance with GxP standards.
    • Conduct routine audits of in-scope systems.
    • Assist with Information security system/software audits where necessary
  • Documentation Maintenance
    • Maintain up-to-date and accurate documentation of all audit activities and findings.
    • Ensure proper filing and storage of all records in compliance with regulatory requirements.
  • Corrective Actions
    • Assist in identifying non-compliances and discrepancies during audits.
    • Collaborate with relevant departments to develop and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs).
    • Track the progress of CAPAs to ensure timely resolution and closure.
  • Communication and Reporting
    • Prepare detailed audit reports summarizing findings, observations, and recommendations.
    • Communicate audit results and compliance status to the GxP Audit Manager and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Continuous Improvement
    • Participate in training programs to stay current with GxP regulations and best practices.
    • Suggest improvements to audit processes and compliance procedures.

HOW WE'LL BE WINNING TOGETHER DAY TO DAY

Requirements:

  • Work experience: min. 2 years within an auditing role.
  • Prior experience in a regulated environment, such as pharmaceuticals or biotechnology is preferred but not required.
  • Prior experience or knowledge of software development and/or processes is preferred.
  • Languages: fluent in English, both written and oral.
  • Advanced command of MS Excel, Teams, PowerPoint, SharePoint and Word.

WE SHOULD TALK IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU

Skills:

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Basic understanding of GxP regulations and/or quality assurance principles.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

To achieve the best version of our organization, we know it takes new ideas, new approaches, new perspectives and new ways of thinking. A purpose we are 100% committed to cultivating. Diversity is woven into our fabric at Syndigo and it's how we stay an industry leader, innovating technology solutions that equip our customers with everything they need to be successful!

All are welcome here and we invite you to join our team if you are ready to help us continue that growth!

GDPR/CCPA

Syndigo, to process applications, holds onto data for a "reasonable time" after applications are submitted. This data is stored for Syndigo's internal use by HR/Recruiting Staff only. Verified requests for data deletion and exports will be completed upon request.

Syndigo Job Applicant Privacy Notice

At Syndigo, we care about your privacy. As you go through our recruitment process, we are committed to being transparent about how we process your personal data. To learn more about how Syndigo processes your personal data, go to our Job Applicant Privacy Notice.

title: Cyber Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Why qlub

The end of a great meal shouldn't be the slow part. Waiting for the check, finding someone to take payment, splitting a bill by hand. qlub removes that friction. Guests scan a QR code and pay in seconds. No app, no download, no waiting.

From Pay-at-Table and Digital Menus to Order-and-Pay, Payment Links, and SoftPOS terminals, we handle the full payment experience so restaurants can focus on what they do best: great hospitality. Less friction means faster table turnover, smoother operations, and higher profit.

We're a fast-scaling fintech backed by Mastercard, Mubadala, e& and Shorooq. $72M raised, live across multiple markets worldwide, and headcount doubled in the past year. We're building the teams that take us to the next stage.

The role

As qlub expands across markets, so do our security challenges. From protecting our payments platform to meeting regulatory requirements and earning customer trust, security plays a critical role in how we grow. We are looking for a Cybersecurity Engineer to own our day-to-day security compliance and customer assurance including maintaining security standards and certifications, managing audits and supporting customer security assessments.

This isn't a role limited to compliance checklists. You'll be part of our security team, working closely with engineering and teams across the business. You'll also have opportunities to contribute to threat detection, application security, cloud security and penetration testing. You'll have the freedom to solve real problems and make a visible impact on how we secure our platform.

Things move quickly here and not every challenge comes with a playbook. What matters is strong security fundamentals, curiosity, adaptability and the ability to figure things out and get things done.


What you’ll own

  • Own day-to-day security compliance and ISMS activities across ISO 27001, PCI DSS, SOC 2 readiness and applicable regulatory requirements.

  • Manage internal and external audits, certifications and assessments end to end including auditor engagement, evidence validation and corrective action closure.

  • Own customer security questionnaires, due diligence and security assessments, working directly with business stakeholders and customer security teams.

  • Maintain security policies, risk assessments and control documentation, assess control effectiveness and drive compliance findings to closure.

  • Coordinate third-party security reviews, support data protection and security awareness activities and maintain continuous compliance monitoring.

  • Contribute to security operations including SIEM/EDR monitoring, threat detection, incident investigations, cloud security and vulnerability management.

  • Support application security and DevSecOps initiatives including secure SDLC practices, CI/CD security integration, SAST/DAST/SCA and vulnerability validation.

  • Leverage automation and AI to streamline security assessments, compliance activities and operational workflows.


Who you are

  • You take initiative, exercise sound judgement and drive work forward independently.

  • You are curious, resourceful and quick to learn unfamiliar tools, technologies and frameworks.

  • You communicate clearly, collaborate across teams and stay effective when priorities change.

  • You actively embrace AI to solve problems, automate repetitive work and find smarter ways to get things done.


What you’ll need

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science or a related field.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity or information security, including security compliance, assurance or GRC.

  • Hands-on experience maintaining an ISO 27001 ISMS, coordinating audits, validating controls and managing compliance evidence.

  • Experience handling customer security questionnaires, due diligence assessments and working with auditors and cross-functional teams.

  • Working knowledge of PCI DSS, security risk management and frameworks such as NIST CSF.

  • Solid technical foundations in cloud and SaaS architectures, networking, identity and access management and web security including OWASP Top 10.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills with fluency in English.

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted tools for research, analysis and automation with the judgment to validate outputs and handle sensitive information responsibly.


Nice to have

  • Experience in fintech, payments or cloud-based SaaS environments.

  • Familiarity with UAE IA/NESA, SOC 2 or GDPR requirements.

  • Experience with GRC platforms and security workflow automation.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud security (AWS/GCP), SIEM/EDR platforms such as CrowdStrike/Splunk or detection engineering.

  • Practical experience conducting web, API or mobile penetration testing.

  • Relevant certifications such as ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, CISA, eWPTx or OSCP are valued.

What we offer

  • Real ownership over products that impact millions of diners and thousands of restaurants globally
  • The opportunity to solve challenging problems in payments, hospitality, and customer experience
  • A fast-moving environment where great ideas quickly become reality
  • Close collaboration with experienced operators, builders, and industry experts
  • A chance to leave a visible mark on one of the fastest-growing restaurant technology companies globally

Ready to build? Join us and help shape how the world pays at the table. If that excites you, apply now.

title: Offensive Security & Threat Hunting Engineer
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT US

Glomo builds cross-border payment infrastructure. Our network connects local payment rails across countries, so customers move money across borders in seconds. We are a licensed Payment Service Provider at GIFT IFSC, regulated by IFSCA, and the first of our kind in India. We are also a Visa Principal Member, the first non-bank acquirer in India to join the network, so we acquire and process Visa card payments directly. The team behind Glomo has more than 100 years of combined experience in building large payment products.

YOUR IMPACT

Glomo moves real money across borders and handles card data and customer KYC records. That makes us a target. This role exists to find the ways into our systems before an attacker does, and to catch the ones who get in anyway. You split your time between offence and hunting. On offence, you test our cloud, APIs, networks, and employee endpoints the way a real attacker would. On the hunting side, you work through endpoint, network, and identity logs for what our alerts missed. You work alongside the IT and Infrastructure team and see each finding through to the fix. Your testing also backs our PCI-DSS and regulatory audits.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Penetration testing. Run regular internal and external tests across our networks, cloud environments, APIs, and employee endpoints to uncover weak points and misconfigurations.

Threat hunting. Dig through endpoint telemetry (EDR), network logs, and identity provider logs for unauthorised access, lateral movement, and anomalies that our automated alerts did not catch.

Adversary simulation and purple teaming. Simulate realistic attacks, including credential theft, phishing, and AI-assisted attacks, then work with our IT and Infrastructure team to close the gaps you find.

Automation. Write scripts and use AI-assisted security tools so that vulnerability discovery and attack surface monitoring run continuously.

Reporting. Write up each finding so that an engineer can act on it: what you did, what it exposes, and how to fix it, in priority order. No bloated, copy-pasted scanner reports.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING

Experience. 3+ years of hands-on work in penetration testing, red teaming, or threat hunting.

Endpoint and network depth. You know Windows and Linux internals, Active Directory and cloud identity attacks, and how Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) tools work.

Tooling and scripting. You are comfortable with Burp Suite, Nmap, BloodHound, and Metasploit, you write SIEM and EDR queries, and you script in Python, PowerShell, or Bash.

AI awareness. You know how attackers use AI, for example for automated recon, you can test LLM and API security, and you use automation to scale your own testing.

Practical credentials. Hands-on certifications such as OSCP, CRTO, PNPT, or GCTI matter more to us than a purely theoretical degree.

GOOD TO HAVE

  • An active bug bounty profile on HackerOne or Bugcrowd

  • Open-source security tools that you built or contribute to

  • Security testing in payments or fintech, including PCI-DSS penetration test requirements

  • GCP and Kubernetes attack paths

  • Detection engineering: turning hunt findings into alert rules

WHY JOIN US

High autonomy

You own how we test, harden, and monitor our entire technical footprint.

Builder culture

Your findings go straight to the engineers who fix them. No endless bureaucracy.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Ground-floor opportunity at a fast-growing company, where your work directly sets our direction

  • Accelerated career growth: we invest in your development

  • Competitive compensation with equity ownership

  • Comprehensive health insurance, flexible time off, and a professional development budget

  • A close team that celebrates wins and supports each other

Compensation Range: ₹18L - ₹22L

title: Security Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced SOC Analyst to lead security monitoring, threat detection, incident investigation, and response activities. The candidate will be responsible for identifying potential security threats, analysing complex incidents, improving detection capabilities, and supporting the SOC team in maintaining an effective security monitoring environment.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with SIEM, EDR/XDR, threat intelligence, incident response, and security operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor and analyse security alerts generated through SIEM, EDR, and other security monitoring platforms.
  • Investigate and respond to complex security incidents, including malware infections, phishing attacks, ransomware, privilege escalation, and suspicious network activities.
  • Perform advanced log analysis, event correlation, threat hunting, and root cause analysis.
  • Develop, fine-tune, and optimise SIEM correlation rules, detection use cases, and alerting mechanisms.
  • Conduct proactive threat hunting using Indicators of Compromise (IOCs), Indicators of Attack (IOAs), and threat intelligence feeds.
  • Analyse network traffic, endpoint activities, authentication logs, and system events to identify malicious behaviour.
  • Lead incident response activities, including containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident analysis.
  • Map detected threats and attack techniques to the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
  • Prepare detailed incident reports, investigation findings, and security dashboards.
  • Coordinate with IT, infrastructure, and security teams to remediate identified vulnerabilities and security incidents.
  • Mentor junior SOC analysts and support L1/L2 SOC operations.
  • Participate in developing and improving SOC processes, incident response playbooks, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

Required Technical Skills

  • SIEM Tools: Splunk, IBM QRadar, Microsoft Sentinel, LogRhythm, or Wazuh.
  • EDR/XDR Tools: CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, SentinelOne, or Cortex XDR.
  • Network Security: Firewall logs, IDS/IPS, VPN, DNS, proxy logs, and network traffic analysis.
  • Incident Response: Malware analysis, phishing investigation, endpoint investigation, and forensic analysis.
  • Threat Intelligence: IOC analysis, threat intelligence platforms, and threat hunting.
  • Security Frameworks: MITRE ATT&CK, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, and incident response lifecycle.
  • Operating Systems: Windows, Linux, and Active Directory security.
  • Scripting: Python, PowerShell, or Bash for security automation and log analysis.
  • Cloud Security: Basic understanding of AWS, Azure, or GCP security monitoring.

Mandatory Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience in SIEM monitoring and incident investigation.
  • Advanced knowledge of security event correlation and threat detection.
  • Experience handling and responding to security incidents independently.
  • Strong understanding of network protocols, operating systems, and security architecture.
  • Experience in threat hunting and security log analysis.
  • Ability to guide and mentor junior SOC analysts.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
  • Certifications such as:
  • CompTIA CySA+
  • GCIA / GCIH / GCED
  • CEH
  • Splunk Enterprise Security Certified Admin
  • CISSP/ OSDA

Experience Requirements

  • 2–7 years of overall experience in Security Operations.
  • Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in SIEM and security incident investigation.
  • Experience working in a 24/7 SOC environment is preferred.
  • Prior experience handling enterprise-level security incidents is an added advantage.

Pay: Up to ₹700,000.00 per year

Benefits:

  • Health insurance
  • Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.
Job Summary

This job ensures the integrity and security of the company's cyber infrastructure by designing robust system architecture. It also entails solving complex engineering challenges. It involves documenting technical processes, reporting outcomes, and recommending innovative solutions. The role supports project teams and influences engineering staff, while maintaining a comprehensive understanding of network protocols and security strategies. The position requires flexibility to work variable schedules, including nights and weekends, as necessary.

Job Description

Senior CyberArk Engineer / CyberArk Developer

Experience: 6+ Years | Domain: Identity Security / Privileged Access Management (PAM)

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior CyberArk Engineer / Developer with 6+ years of hands-on experience in CyberArk PAM engineering, custom plugin development, enterprise onboarding, platform integrations, automation, upgrades, and operational support. The role focuses on CPM password management plugins, PSM session management connectors, CyberArk enhancements, Snyk finding remediation, L2/L3 troubleshooting, and enterprise-scale onboarding of accounts, servers, devices, and applications. PowerShell is mandatory, while Java and Python are preferred development skills.

Primary Focus

CyberArk PAM Engineering and Development

Development Preference

Java and Python optional / preferred

Experience Requirements

  • 6+ years of CyberArk PAM experience in enterprise environments.
  • Hands-on experience with CyberArk implementation, customization, maintenance, upgrades, and integrations.
  • Strong exposure to both engineering delivery and operational support functions.
  • Experience developing and supporting password management and session management plugins.

Core Responsibilities

CyberArk Development

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain CPM Password Management Plugins.
  • Develop and customize PSM Session Management Connectors for applications, databases, servers, and devices.
  • Build and enhance CyberArk integrations using REST APIs and automation frameworks.
  • Develop new CyberArk platform capabilities, enhancements, utilities, and reusable automation modules.
  • Perform code fixes, maintenance activities, peer reviews, and release readiness validation.
  • Automate operational processes using PowerShell; Java and Python experience is preferred.
  • Remediate Snyk findings and application security findings within agreed timelines.
  • Maintain source code, release artifacts, branches, and version history using Git.

CyberArk Engineering

  • Design, configure, implement, and support CyberArk PAM solutions across enterprise use cases.
  • Manage and support EPV, CPM, PSM, PVWA, PTA, CyberArk APIs, safes, platforms, and access policies.
  • Onboard privileged accounts, service accounts, servers, databases, applications, and network devices.
  • Conduct POCs for new applications, technologies, and device integrations with CyberArk.
  • Execute CyberArk upgrades, platform migrations, patching, health checks, and post-upgrade validations.
  • Integrate CyberArk with Active Directory, LDAP, Vault platforms, ticketing tools, and enterprise applications.
  • Perform L2/L3 troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and permanent fix implementation for production issues.

Operations & Support

  • Provide support through Slack, Email, and IT service management channels.
  • Troubleshoot onboarding, password rotation, reconciliation, session launch, and access workflow issues.
  • Resolve incidents, service requests, and JIRA tickets within defined SLA expectations.
  • Support production deployments, release validations, critical incident management, and escalations.
  • Create and maintain SOPs, technical documentation, knowledge articles, and handover guides.
  • Collaborate with Security, Infrastructure, Application, IAM, and Operations teams.

Required Technical Skills

CyberArk

  • Enterprise Password Vault (EPV)
  • Central Policy Manager (CPM)
  • Privileged Session Manager (PSM)
  • Password Vault Web Access (PVWA)
  • Privileged Threat Analytics (PTA)
  • CyberArk REST APIs
  • Safe Management
  • Platform Management
  • Discovery & Onboarding
  • Privileged Account Lifecycle Management
  • CyberArk Upgrades & Migration
  • CPM Plugin Development
  • PSM Connector Development

Development & Automation

  • PowerShell mandatory
  • REST API development
  • Git / GitHub
  • Secure coding practices
  • Automation design
  • Release support

Preferred Development Skills

  • Java
  • Python
  • Shell scripting
  • Reusable utility development
  • CI/CD pipeline exposure

Infrastructure & Integration

  • Active Directory
  • LDAP
  • Windows Server
  • Linux administration
  • HashiCorp Vault / OpenBao
  • Databases
  • Network devices
  • Enterprise application integrations

Tools

  • CyberArk
  • Git
  • JIRA
  • Snyk
  • Vault technologies
  • Active Directory
  • PowerShell
  • Java
  • Python

Preferred Certifications

  • CyberArk Defender
  • CyberArk Sentry
  • CyberArk CDE

Preferred Candidate Profile

  • Strong CyberArk PAM engineering and development background with practical experience in enterprise-scale environments.
  • Proven hands-on expertise in CPM Plugin Development and PSM Connector Development.
  • Strong understanding of privileged account onboarding, password rotation, reconciliation, session management, and access controls.
  • Ability to independently drive enhancements, troubleshooting, upgrades, onboarding activities, and operational improvements.
  • Good communication skills with the ability to work with security, infrastructure, application, and operations stakeholders.
  • Experience working in Agile environments using JIRA and Git.

Note

The role is focused on CyberArk PAM, CPM, PSM, integrations, onboarding, upgrades, automation, Snyk remediation, and operational support.

Comcast is an equal opportunity workplace. We will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

Base pay is one part of the Total Rewards that Comcast provides to compensate and recognize employees for their work. Most sales positions are eligible for a Commission under the terms of an applicable plan, while most non-sales positions are eligible for a Bonus. Additionally, Comcast provides best-in-class Benefits to eligible employees. We believe that benefits should connect you to the support you need when it matters most, and should help you care for those who matter most. That’s why we provide an array of options, expert guidance and always-on tools, that are personalized to meet the needs of your reality - to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. Please visit the compensation and benefits summary on our careers site for more details.

Education

Bachelor's Degree

While possessing the stated degree is preferred, Comcast also may consider applicants who hold some combination of coursework and experience, or who have extensive related professional experience.

Relevant Work Experience

5-7 Years

Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world.

A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary.

Job Summary





To support our extraordinary teams who build great products and contribute to our growth, we’re looking to add a Junior Engineer, Quality, in Chennai


What a typical day looks like:

  • Knowledge in Quality Management System, 7 Quality Tools/Terminology and Quality Core Tools.
  • Support new product launches by ensuring supplier quality compliance.
  • Follow up with suppliers for root cause analysis and corrective actions on quality issues
  • Review and improve supplier manufacturing processes, driving value and efficiency.
  • Have basic knowledge on continuous improvement process using Lean, Six Sigma, Poka‑Yoke and PFMEA techniques.
  • Provide concise, complete, and accurate documentation of inspection results relative to area of responsibility.
  • Conduct on-site/virtual audits to verify corrective actions related to supplier quality issues.
  • Report on Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to adhere to process and prevent occurrence of any non-conformity relating to product, process, or system.
  • Preparation & Validation of First Article Inspection
  • Participate in cross-functional teams in the development of new products or changes related to current products in meeting customer requirements.
  • Manage and coordinate supplier Material / Non-Material cost recovery for Supplier Quality issues.
  • Ensure readiness for internal and external audits.
  • Knowledge on ISO/IATF regulations & requirements
  • Undertake special projects as required and Provide data-driven decision support wherever needed.
    • Leverages data analytics and statistical methods to optimize manufacturing processes, improve product quality, and enhance operational efficiency


The experience we’re looking to add to our team:

  • BE/B.Tech in ECE, EEE, IC, Mechanical, or Mechatronics with 0–2 years of experience in APQP, PPAP, FMEA within a manufacturing environment, preferably in the EMS industry.
  • Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing principles and quality/business systems.
  • Strong understanding of APQP, PPAP, FMEA, and TS16949 standards.
  • Familiarity with measurement techniques and engineering drawing interpretation.
  • Good understanding of manufacturing processes.
  • Ability to work effectively in a diverse and dynamic environment.
  • Strong planning and prioritization skills.
  • Willing to work in flexible shifts.

title: Application Security Engineer - Fully Remote
descriptionHtml:
Top 3 Reasons To Join Us

  • 100% remote, with a global, diverse team
  • Working on the latest tech for the Insurtech Market Leader
  • Lead and shape how an AI-native security function finds and prevents vulnerabilities at the AI-native insurance platform of choice for the world’s leading insurers

About Us

At CoverGo, our mission is to empower all insurance companies to make insurance 100% digital and accessible to everyone.

  • We are a leading global no-code insurance platform for health, life, and P&C
  • We’re the winner of the Insurtech of the Year in all of Asia and other awards globally
  • We work with insurance enterprise clients such as AXA, Bupa, MSIG, Dai-ichi, Bank of China Group Insurance, and many more
  • We're an international, diverse team of over 200 people with 30 nationalities and team members working remotely from all over the world
  • We are fully funded and backed by reputable VC funds and strategic institutional investors
  • We have a global presence in Asia, EMEA and the Americas
  • We’ve grown our annualized revenue by over 30x since January 2021
  • We’re constantly working towards making CoverGo a workplace that you love coming to. We deeply believe that bringing together a diversity of thoughts, expressions, and perspectives is key to building the best culture for equally diverse communities all over the world

About The Role

CoverGo is hiring an Application Security Engineer to use AI to find and prevent vulnerabilities before they reach production, and to give engineering teams the tools and guardrails that stop vulnerabilities from being introduced in the first place. The Security team is small and growing, and works AI-first: everyone uses AI to automate their own work and to scale security across a large engineering organisation.

What You Will Do

  • Use AI tools such as Claude and OpenAI models to find and triage vulnerabilities in code, dependencies and designs before changes are merged.
  • Embed security checks into developer workflows and CI/CD pipelines so issues surface as code is written.
  • Select, configure and tune code-security tools such as GitHub Advanced Security, Snyk and Checkmarx, keeping the signal high enough that engineers act on the findings.
  • Build self-service tools, guardrails and guidance that help engineering teams prevent common vulnerability classes.
  • Partner with engineering leads and security champions across product teams to prioritise and fix findings.
  • Review security-relevant designs and changes, ranking risk by what an attacker could realistically reach.
  • Track and report on application-security risk and remediation progress.

What We Need

  • 3+ years in application security or a closely related security role.
  • An AI-native approach to securing software: you already use LLMs to find, detect and explain vulnerabilities.
  • Enough fluency in at least one modern programming language to read, understand and fix vulnerable code. A software-engineering background is not required.
  • Hands-on experience with code-security tools such as GitHub Advanced Security, Snyk or Checkmarx.
  • A solid grasp of common vulnerability classes, such as the OWASP Top 10, and how to prevent them.
  • A practical, enabling style of working with engineers.

Nice to have

  • Experience building custom security tooling or automations on LLM APIs.
  • Experience securing applications on AWS, Azure or GCP.
  • Experience in insurance, financial services or another regulated SaaS environment.

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • Paid Annual Leaves
  • Annual Performance Bonus
  • Health Insurance
  • Remote Work Allowance
  • Anniversary Bonus
  • Company activities and events
  • Learning and development plan

CoverGo Company Video

title: Red Team Engineer – Offensive Security / Advanced VAPT (5+ Years)
descriptionHtml:
Job Description – Red Team Engineer

Company: BriskInfosec Technology and Consulting Pvt. Ltd.

Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu

Work Mode: Work from Office (On-site)

Experience: 5+ Years

Employment Type: Full-time

CTC: As per competence and industry standards

Travel: Domestic and International (as required)

About BriskInfosec

BriskInfosec Technology and Consulting Pvt. Ltd. has been delivering cybersecurity services

since 2017, serving clients across 30+ countries. Our clientele spans OEMs, Banking and

Financial Services (BFSI), SaaS, Healthcare, and Trading industries.

We are looking for an experienced Red Team Engineer with strong hands-on offensive

security expertise, a research-driven mindset, and the ability to execute advanced red team

and adversary simulation engagements beyond traditional checklist-based VAPT.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and lead end-to-end red team and adversary simulation engagements,

from reconnaissance to final reporting.

  • Identify and exploit complex attack paths across Web Applications, APIs, Cloud,

Networks, Active Directory, and Mobile platforms.

  • Develop Proof of Concept (PoC) exploits, custom scripts, and tools for authorised

security engagements.

  • Conduct research on emerging attack techniques, AI-driven offensive security, and

vulnerabilities in AI/LLM-based systems.

  • Translate security research and emerging threat intelligence into practical testing

methodologies.

  • Execute highly confidential security engagements while maintaining strict discretion

and professionalism.

  • Present technical findings and actionable recommendations to clients, including

technical teams and senior leadership.

  • Prepare detailed security assessment reports with reproducible steps, supporting

evidence, and remediation guidance.

  • Mentor junior security engineers and contribute to strengthening the organisation's

red teaming capabilities.

  • Manage multiple engagements simultaneously while ensuring quality, priorities, and

delivery timelines.

  • Travel to domestic and international client locations as required.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in Offensive Security, VAPT, and Red

Teaming.

  • Strong practical experience in planning and executing red team engagements and

adversary simulations.

  • Experience working with at least two of the following industry domains:

o Banking and Financial Services (BFSI)

o OEM

o SaaS

o Healthcare

o Trading

  • Strong understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework, red team methodologies,

and Command and Control (C2) tools.

  • Proficiency in scripting and programming languages such as Python, Go, C, or similar.
  • Experience in exploit development, attack simulation, and custom security tool

development.

  • Demonstrable technical contributions through any one of the following:

o Bug bounty Hall of Fame recognition

o CVE publications

o CTF achievements

o Open-source security tools

o Technical research or security write-ups

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex

attack scenarios to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Strong technical documentation and report-writing skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and handle high-pressure client

engagements.

  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and a continuous learning

mindset.

  • High ethical standards, with a strong commitment to engagement scope, client data

protection, and confidentiality.

  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.

Good to Have

  • Industry-recognised offensive security certifications such as:

o OSCP

o OSEP

o CRTO

o CRTP / CRTE

o OSED

  • Experience conducting red team engagements in regulated environments.
  • Experience in AI/LLM security testing and emerging offensive security research.
  • Security conference presentations, published research, technical blogs, or

community contributions.

What We Offer

  • Exposure to global cybersecurity engagements across clients in 30+ countries.
  • Opportunities for domestic and international client visits.
  • Dedicated support and opportunities for Research and Development (R&D).
  • Exposure to diverse industries, technologies, and advanced attack surfaces.
  • Opportunities to explore emerging offensive security techniques and tools.
  • The opportunity to contribute to and shape BriskInfosec's Red Team and Offensive

Security practice.

  • Competitive compensation based on skills, experience, and industry standards.

Work Location:

This is an on-site position based in Chennai, Tamil Nadu. Candidates currently based in

Chennai or willing to relocate are preferred.

The role requires close collaboration with the offensive security team, particularly for attack

path planning, technical discussions, knowledge sharing, and mentoring.

Join BriskInfosec and help shape the next generation of offensive security.

Pay: From ₹40,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Power Platform & Dynamics 365 Engineer (Integrations, ALM & Security)
descriptionHtml:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Overall purpose:

Join our dynamic team at Regent College London as a Power Platform & Dynamics 365 Engineer (Integrations, ALM & Security), where you'll help evolve and harden our Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform services that support key Higher Education business processes (admissions, marketing, enrolment, student communications and student support).

In this role you'll design and deliver solutions across Dataverse (model-driven apps), Canvas apps, Power Automate and Power Pages. You'll bring strong engineering capability in API integrations and pro-code extensibility (e.g., plugins, JavaScript) and will help establish secure, reliable delivery practices across environments.

This role is based remotely (India), joining a UK-based function and working primarily to the UK time zone. You'll be part of a small, dedicated team delivering both strategic initiatives and continuous improvements.

The successful candidate will be a self-starter and strong individual contributor, comfortable owning work end-to-end without a dedicated QA team. You will also act as a technical multiplier by uplifting integration patterns, ALM/CI-CD, and security practices, and by mentoring other developers as they upskill.

Specific duties and responsibilities:

· Design, build and enhance Dataverse-based solutions (model-driven apps, tables, forms, views and business logic) aligned to the CRM product roadmap.

· Support day-to-day Dynamics 365/Dataverse configuration including adding fields, modifying forms/views, business rules, security roles, and general entity/app administration as part of shared team responsibilities.

· Design and build targeted Canvas apps (and reusable components where appropriate) for business scenarios that are better served by task-focused, UX-first experiences, integrating with Dataverse and other services.

· Implement custom logic where required using C# (plugins and/or custom workflow activities), JavaScript/TypeScript, and platform extensibility patterns.

· Design, develop and support API-based integrations between Dynamics 365/Dataverse and enterprise systems (including the Student Records System where applicable) using REST APIs, OAuth2/Entra ID, custom connectors and/or Azure integration services.

· Create, enhance and refactor Power Automate flows using resilient engineering practices (error handling, retries, logging, idempotency where relevant, connection references and environment variables).

· Contribute to the migration from legacy ADX/portal capabilities to Power Pages, including page/templates, forms, security/permissions, and safe integration patterns back to Dataverse and other services.

· Maintain disciplined solution management and automated deployments across environments using Azure DevOps (Power Platform Build Tools/PAC CLI), including versioning, release notes and deployment runbooks.

· Improve the security posture of the platform through least-privilege role design, team/access model reviews, auditing, and Power Pages permission modelling; collaborate with platform/tenant administrators on governance controls.

· Perform thorough testing, create reusable test scripts/checklists, and participate in peer reviews to ensure quality, performance and reliability.

· Triage and resolve defects/incidents promptly, provide third-line support for integrations/automations, and proactively monitor and improve platform health.

· Work closely with the Head of Enterprise Applications & CRM, Project Manager, developers and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, propose options, communicate trade-offs and maintain clear technical documentation.

Additional duties

· Contribute to consistent Agile ceremonies (refinement, planning, review and retrospectives) and support lightweight estimation and delivery forecasting for a small team.

· Help implement and document engineering standards (ALM, CI/CD, integration patterns, security reviews) and contribute to Centre of Excellence (CoE) practices where appropriate.

PERSON SPECIFICATION

EXPERIENCE & PERSONAL QUALITIES

Essential

· Full proficiency in English; confident communicating with UK-based stakeholders. Ability to work effectively as part of a small delivery team and collaborate across IT and business functions.

· 3-5 years of experience delivering solutions on Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Customer Engagement) and the Power Platform.

· Hands-on experience with Dataverse solution delivery (tables, forms, views, business rules/processes) in model-driven apps; able to contribute to Canvas apps where appropriate.

· Comfortable delivering both configuration-level enhancements (e.g., fields, forms, views, business rules) and engineering-level work (integrations, ALM/CI/CD, security).

· Experience designing and building Power Apps Canvas apps (responsive design, components and Dataverse integration).

· Experience delivering Power Pages (or ADX Studio Portals), including external user journeys and permissions modelling.

· Experience building and supporting API integrations (REST, OAuth2/Entra ID app registrations) and using tools such as Postman.

· Experience with pro-code extensibility for Dataverse (e.g., C# plugins/custom workflow activities) and/or client-side scripting (JavaScript).

· Strong Power Automate experience, including production-grade practices (error handling, monitoring and supportability).

· Experience working with Dev/UAT/Production environments and change/release management.

· Comfortable working independently without a dedicated QA team; able to plan, test and deliver end-to-end.

· Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills, with attention to security and data integrity..

Desirable

· Experience with Azure integration services (e.g., Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Key Vault).

· Experience implementing CI/CD for Power Platform using Azure DevOps pipelines (Power Platform Build Tools and/or PAC CLI).

· Experience with PCF controls and TypeScript.

· Experience in Higher Education or similarly regulated environments handling sensitive personal data.

TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE & SKILLSEssential

· Strong knowledge of Dataverse architecture, solution management (managed/unmanaged), and environment configuration (Dev/UAT/Prod).

· Strong knowledge of Dynamics 365 CE/model-driven app configuration.

· C#/.NET experience for Dataverse plugins and related development practices (source control, code review, debugging).

· JavaScript (and ideally TypeScript) for model-driven form scripting and client API usage.

· API integration design via authentication/authorisation (OAuth2), data mapping, error handling, retries, and monitoring/observability.

· Power Automate engineering: scalable flow design, connection references, environment variables and governance-aware connector use.

· ALM/CI-CD fundamentals with Azure DevOps and/or GitHub (build/release pipelines, approvals and deployment controls).

· Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum delivery practices.

Desirable

· Power Pages (Liquid, basic HTML/CSS/JavaScript) and portal deployment practices. Canvas app development (formulas, responsive design, components, Dataverse integration).

· Power Platform CoE Starter Kit familiarity and platform monitoring approaches.

· Data export and reporting patterns (e.g., datalake concepts, ETL, Power BI modelling fundamentals).

· Understanding of security best practices for external users and portals (least privilege, auditing, data protection).

· Azure administration familiarity relevant to integration delivery.

EDUCATION & PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONSEssential

· Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent level experience/training.

Desirable

· Microsoft Power Platform Developer certification (PL-400).

· Additional relevant Microsoft certifications (e.g., PL-600, MB-230, AZ-204) or equivalent experience.

Interested candidates can come for walk-in: MONDAY - FRIDAY[ 11am to 5pm]

Pay: ₹585,000.00 - ₹1,990,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: CCTV Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Atrity Info Solutions Private Limited is a leading offshore web development and system integration company based in India, delivering innovative software solutions, IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, and consultancy services to global clients. We provide enterprise IT solutions and security infrastructure services, helping organizations improve operational efficiency, infrastructure reliability, and security.

Role Description

The CCTV Engineer will be responsible for installing, configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting CCTV surveillance systems at client locations. The role involves working with IP and Analog CCTV cameras, DVRs, NVRs, networking equipment, and structured cabling to ensure reliable video surveillance operations.

The candidate should have hands-on technical experience, good troubleshooting skills, and the ability to coordinate with clients and project teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, and maintain CCTV surveillance systems.
  • Install and troubleshoot IP cameras, HD cameras, DVRs, NVRs, and XVRs.
  • Perform camera positioning, focusing, and configuration.
  • Configure IP addresses, subnet masks, gateways, and network connectivity.
  • Install and configure PoE switches, routers, and network video recorders.
  • Configure remote CCTV viewing through mobile applications and desktop software.
  • Perform preventive maintenance and routine CCTV system inspections.
  • Troubleshoot camera connectivity, video loss, recording, and playback issues.
  • Install and maintain structured cabling, including CAT6, CAT5e, and fiber optic cables.
  • Perform cable termination, testing, and troubleshooting.
  • Prepare installation reports and maintenance documentation.
  • Coordinate with clients and project teams for installation and service activities.

Key Competencies

  • Good knowledge of IP CCTV and Analog CCTV systems.
  • Hands-on experience with DVR, NVR, and XVR devices.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, LAN, and WAN.
  • Knowledge of PoE switches, routers, and network connectivity.
  • Familiarity with CCTV brands such as Hikvision, CP Plus, Dahua, and Honeywell.
  • Strong hardware and software troubleshooting skills.
  • Knowledge of cable termination and testing.
  • Good communication and customer-handling skills.
  • Ability to work independently and coordinate with technical teams.
  • Willingness to travel to client locations for business purposes.

Educational Qualification

  • Diploma / ITI / B.E. / B.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Science, or related fields.
  • Relevant CCTV installation, security systems, and networking experience preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Timely completion of CCTV installation projects.
  • Minimum repeat service calls and effective troubleshooting.
  • Quality of CCTV installation and structured cabling.
  • Quick resolution of technical complaints.
  • Customer satisfaction and service quality.
  • Proper maintenance records and technical documentation.

Experience: 1–3 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location: Chennai

Travel Requirement: Willingness to travel to client locations for business purposes.

Expected Joining: Immediate

If you are looking to build your career in CCTV, Surveillance, and Security Systems and contribute to Atrity’s growth and success, apply now and become a part of Atrity’s success story!

title: R&D Cybersecurity Compliance Lead Engineer - IDC
descriptionHtml:
Location:

Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India

Job ID:

R0150366

Date Posted:

2026-11-16

Company Name:

HITACHI ENERGY TECHNOLOGY SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED

Profession (Job Category):

Engineering & Science

Job Schedule:

Full time

Remote:

No

Job Description:

The Opportunity:
The role translates applicable regulations, standards, customer requirements, and internal policies into practical controls, repeatable methods, engineering guidance, and auditable evidence. It supports product teams through out the lifecycle—from applicability and risk assessment through secure development, conformity assessment, release, vulnerability handling, and post-market compliance. Coordinating pilot runs on new products or processes.


How you'll make an impact:

This role is responsible for driving end-to-end product cyber security compliance and secure product development by ensuring adherence to Hitachi Energy cyber security requirements, customer standards, and IEC 62443 (4-1, 4-2, and 3-3) standards.

The position owns and continuously improves the Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC), translates cyber security requirements into product capabilities, develops security architecture and design solutions, conducts threat modeling, risk assessments, vulnerability management, and release security clearances, while ensuring compliance with evolving regulations such as the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA).

Your Background:
Bachelor’s degree in engineering in electronics or computer science. Cybersecurity Certifications shall be an added advantage.

  • At least 8+ years of experience in cyber security related to industrial control system design and development, preferably in power industry.
  • SDLC Experience in the domain of cybersecurity, secure data communication, network security and compliances in Energy industries and associated systems according to IEC 62443 cyber security standard, EU CRA guidelines, and industry best practices for building highly resilient hardened software systems
  • Strong Knowledge of Industrial control system, SCADA Systems, Communication Gateways, Network architecture, System administration, Infrastructure (servers, workstation, switches, routers, firewalls) configuration, troubleshooting and root cause analysis.
  • Proven ability to translate legal, standards, and customer obligations into engineering controls, methods, guidance, and evidence.
  • Hands-on experience with cybersecurity risk assessment, threat modelling, attack-surface analysis, secure design reviews, vulnerability management, SBOM/SCA, hardening, and security verification.
  • Experience preparing compliance documentation, audit evidence, conformity inputs, assessment reports, and remediation plans.
  • Knowledge of industrial control systems, embedded products, software, firmware, networked components, and product lifecycle processes; power-industry experience is advantageous.

Accessibility and reasonable accommodation

Qualified individuals with a disability may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Hitachi Energy career site as a result of your disability. Job Description:

The Opportunity:
The role translates applicable regulations, standards, customer requirements, and internal policies into practical controls, repeatable methods, engineering guidance, and auditable evidence. It supports product teams through out the lifecycle—from applicability and risk assessment through secure development, conformity assessment, release, vulnerability handling, and post-market compliance. Coordinating pilot runs on new products or processes.

How you'll make an impact:

This role is responsible for driving end-to-end product cyber security compliance and secure product development by ensuring adherence to Hitachi Energy cyber security requirements, customer standards, and IEC 62443 (4-1, 4-2, and 3-3) standards.

The position owns and continuously improves the Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC), translates cyber security requirements into product capabilities, develops security architecture and design solutions, conducts threat modeling, risk assessments, vulnerability management, and release security clearances, while ensuring compliance with evolving regulations such as the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA).

descriptionHtml:
This is a Lead Cyber Security Technical Application Engineer role , reports to Technical Application Engineering Leader located in Chennai.
You will be Responsible to Positioning and Promoting Grid Automation Cyber Security offering and solutions in line with Grid Automation Strategy and according to the market requirement. He will also responsible for supporting ITR/OTR team in proposing and validation of cyber security solutions

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Positioning and Promoting Grid Automation Cyber Security offering and solutions in line with Grid Automation Strategy and according to the market requirement.
  • Work closely with customers in Promoting and Positioning Grid Automations Cyber Security offerings
  • Work closely with various regulatory bodies in the region, representing Grid Automation and contribute in shaping up cyber securing guidelines & features.
  • Responsible for supporting sales and tendering team in making technical offer for the cybersecurity requirement and validating the technical offer.
  • Responsible for necessary training to Sales, Tendering and Execution teams.
  • Presentation and training to customer on Grid Automaton Cyber offering.
  • Drive spec-in activity with the customer
  • Provide feedback to the Product Line on products gaps and features needed in the GE offering to meet and exceed market expectations
  • Develop action plans with guidance to respond to issues, approvals of new solutions and increasing market share with existing product portolio
  • Interact with external agencies to facilitate the compliances to cybersecurity related certifications.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical and Electronics engineering / Electronics & Communication / Computer Science with minimum 10 years of relevant experience in Operational Technology.
  • Knowledge of Security, Authentication, Authorization, Certificate Management and cryptography.
  • Good Knowledge on Cyber Security Standards – IEC62443, IEC62351, IEEE1686, NERC-CIP, ISO 27000 series.
  • Good knowledge on
    • Networking Topologies, Routing and Protocols
    • Firewall including NGFW, Syslog, RBAC, LDAP etc.
    • Substation / Control Center communication protocols like IEC 61850, Modbus, DNP 3.0, IEC60870-5-101/103/104
  • Good understanding of Cyber Security Testing based on relevant standards, which include VAPT / Pen testing.
  • Good Understanding of Cyber Security Vulnerability Assessment
  • Should have good knowledge on patch management services


Desired Characteristics



  • Strong oral and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal and leadership skills. Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems. Demonstrated ability to lead programs / projects. Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs. Established project management skills.

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes


Candidates should be aware that this role involves a client's critical infrastructure; shortlisted candidates would therefore be subject to heightened security checks as directed by our clients. All personal data will be handled with the utmost confidentiality and in accordance with our data protection policies, solely for recruitment and security purposes.

descriptionHtml:
Discover your future at Citi

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

Job Overview

Core Infrastructure & Security – Build Engineer

Job Overview: The Perimeter Security Build Engineer will play a crucial role in developing and implementing perimeter security solutions for our organization. This role emphasizes the hands-on deployment, and configuration of security systems at the network's edge, focusing on protecting against external threats. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in network security, with a particular emphasis on building and implementing robust security infrastructures.

Key Responsibilities:

Security Infrastructure Development:

  • Design, build, and deploy perimeter security solutions, including firewalls, intrusion detection systems (IDS), intrusion prevention systems (IPS), and VPNs.
  • Implement security measures that effectively safeguard the organization's network periphery.
  • Ensure new security solutions are seamlessly integrated into the existing network architecture.

Network Routing and Configuration:

  • Understand and manage network routing protocols and configurations.
  • Ensure optimal network performance and security through effective routing strategies.
  • Troubleshoot routing issues and optimize network routes for security and efficiency

Configuration and Implementation:

  • Configure security infrastructure for optimal protection and performance.
  • Collaborate with network architects and IT teams to ensure alignment of security measures with overall network strategy.

Documentation and Compliance:

  • Document build processes, configurations, and standard operating procedures.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant security policies and regulatory standards in all implementation tasks.

Collaboration and Communication:

  • Work closely with various internal teams and security vendors to enhance perimeter security.
  • Effectively communicate project statuses, challenges, and achievements to stakeholders.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or related field.
  • 2-4 years of experience in network security, with a focus on security infrastructure development and implementation.
  • Strong familiarity with security technologies, including but not limited to Checkpoint, Palo Alto Networks, and Cisco.
  • Knowledge of network protocols, routing, and firewall management.
  • Basic Understanding of automation scripting languages such as Python or PowerShell or Ansible is desirable.
  • Understanding of Cloud Security is an advantage.
  • Relevant certifications are highly desirable, including CompTIA Security+, CCNA, Check Point Certified Admin (CCSA), Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Administrator (PCNSA).

Skills:

  • Excellent technical skills with a strong focus on security infrastructure and problem-solving.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and tasks simultaneously.
  • Strong communication and teamwork capabilities.
  • Detail-oriented approach with a commitment to high-quality outcomes.

Work Environment:

  • This role may require occasional after-hours work for important implementations or urgent problem resolutions.
  • Hybrid-model work with office and remote days.
  • Weekend work is periodically expected with adequate off-days provided.

Career Path:

  • Opportunities for advancement into senior engineering roles, security architecture, or specialized cybersecurity areas.

Job description

  • Strong knowledge of production planning, scheduling, capacity planning, and resource allocation.
  • Good understanding of fabrication, machining, welding, painting, assembly, and dispatch processes.
  • Experience in ERP/MRP systems for production planning and inventory management.
  • Ability to prepare and monitor production schedules to meet customer delivery commitments.
  • Strong knowledge of material planning and coordination with Purchase and Stores departments.
  • Good understanding of BOM, routing, work orders, and production documentation.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Strong leadership and team coordination abilities.
  • Good communication skills with customers, subcontractors, suppliers & internal team.
  • Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office, and production planning tools.
  • Ability to handle multiple projects and prioritize production based on business requirements.
  • Stock maintenance & every month stock closing.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute production plans to meet customer delivery schedules.
  • Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly production schedules based on customer requirements and manufacturing capacity.
  • Monitor production progress and ensure adherence to the planned schedule.
  • Coordinate with Purchase, Stores, Production, Quality, and Dispatch teams for smooth project execution.
  • Review material availability and ensure timely procurement of raw materials and bought-out components.
  • Monitor machine loading, manpower utilization, and production capacity to maximize efficiency.
  • Identify production bottlenecks and implement corrective actions to minimize delays.
  • Conduct production review meetings and communicate priorities to all departments.
  • Track work orders, WIP (Work-in-Progress), and pending activities to ensure timely completion.
  • Coordinate with customers regarding delivery schedules, project status, and planning updates whenever required.
  • Ensure ERP/MRP transactions are updated accurately for production orders and inventory.
  • Analyze production performance, schedule adherence, and delivery metrics, and submit periodic reports to management.
  • Support new product development planning, prototype scheduling, and production ramp-up activities.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve productivity, reduce lead time, and optimize inventory.
  • Guide and mentor junior PPC engineers and planning executives.
  • Ensure compliance with company quality, safety, and operational procedures.
  • Collaborate with Department Heads to resolve production constraints and achieve on-time delivery targets.
  • Prepare and monitor monthly production plans for Fabrication, Machine Shop, Purchase, and Sales teams by tracking Plan vs. Actual performance and implementing corrective actions to achieve delivery targets.

descriptionHtml:
About Kinaxis:

About Kinaxis

Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
About the team:
Location
Chennai,India.

About the team

The Senior Information Security Analyst is a seasoned cybersecurity specialist responsible for advanced threat detection, incident response, requests, and ongoing enhancement of Security Operations across Corporate IT environments and the Kinaxis Maestro SaaS platform.

As part of Kinaxis’s global follow-the-sun incident response framework, this role serves as the primary first responder or escalation point for their time zone, providing initial investigative leadership for time-sensitive events and ensuring continuity of response across global shifts. The role functions as an escalation point for complex investigations, leads improvements in detection and response capabilities.
The position requires independent problem solving, strong judgment during security events, and the ability to collaborate effectively across IT, SaaS Operations, Product Development, and Business Systems teams. The role also contributes to strengthening operational processes and provides mentorship to analysts within the Security Operations team.
About the role:

What you will do

Incident Response
  • Serve as the first responder or an escalation point, local time zone, for security incidents in alignment with the global follow-the-sun coverage model, ensuring timely triage, containment actions, and appropriate escalation.
  • Lead investigation and response for complex, high-severity, or sensitive incidents that occur during local operating hours.
  • Provide escalation support, guidance, and quality review for Security Analysts during active investigations.
  • Direct containment, eradication, and recovery efforts, ensuring accurate documentation and effective handoff as required.
  • Coordinate communications and incident status updates for Security leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Participate in the global on-call schedule for high-priority events when incidents exceed local time zone coverage.
AI-Enabled Security Operations
  • Identify and implement responsible uses of AI and machine learning to improve alert triage, investigation, threat analysis, correlation, summarization, documentation, and operational decision-making.
  • Evaluate AI-enabled capabilities within existing and prospective security technologies and develop practical use cases that improve quality, consistency, or efficiency.
  • Validate AI-generated findings and recommendations before operational use, maintaining appropriate human oversight, data protection, access controls, and auditability.
  • Define and document AI use-case objectives, limitations, safeguards, validation requirements, and success measures.
  • Evaluate implemented AI and automation use cases for operational benefit, including reduced manual effort, improved analytical consistency, faster workflows, or stronger decision support.
  • Ability to evaluate AI-generated outputs critically and apply AI-enabled tools responsibly within established security, privacy, data-protection, and governance requirements.
  • Experience designing or operationalizing AI-enabled security use cases with human validation, data protection, and governance controls.
Threat Detection and Hunting
  • Develop, tune, and validate detection logic and analytics in SIEM and XDR platforms, aligned to MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Conduct structured threat hunting to identify anomalous activity, emerging threats, and monitoring gaps.
  • Integrate cyber threat intelligence into detection engineering, investigations, and operational processes.
  • Assess and improve telemetry coverage across endpoints, networks, cloud services, and SaaS platforms.
Security Tooling and Engineering
  • Maintain and optimize security tools supporting detection and response, including SIEM, XDR/EDR, SOAR, log management, and cloud-native security services.
  • Create and maintain operational playbooks, runbooks, and automation workflows to ensure consistent response across team
  • Partner with IT, SaaS Operations, and Engineering to enhance telemetry, logging, and secure configuration controls across the environment.
Security Advisory and Collaboration
  • Provide expert guidance on risk severity, remediation actions, and prioritization of security findings.
  • Support cross-functional teams by ensuring proposed changes, deployments, or configurations incorporate the appropriate security controls.

descriptionHtml:
At Gigamon, our purpose is to protect the hybrid networks and data of the largest, most complex organizations on the planet. Certified as a Great Place to Work, we offer a deep observability pipeline that efficiently delivers network-derived intelligence to cloud, security, and observability tools. This helps our customers to eliminate security blind spots, optimize network traffic, and dramatically reduce tool cost and complexity, enabling them to better secure and manage their hybrid cloud infrastructure. Gigamon has served more than 4,000 customers worldwide, including over 80 percent of Fortune 100 enterprises, 9 of the 10 largest mobile network providers, and hundreds of governments and educational organizations.

The Senior Director, Product Security & PSIRT, will lead large-enterprise product security programs across Gigamon’s hardware and software portfolio. This role will set the strategic direction for the PSIRT team, chair the PSIRT Steering Committee, and partner with VP and executive leadership to drive timely, risk-based decisions. Serving as the PSIRT technical advisor to the COO and CISO, the leader will establish consistent, repeatable practices for vulnerability research, testing, customer engagement, communications, knowledge base content, and coordinated disclosure. They will also develop Gigamon’s product red-team framework, evaluate appropriate security tools, and advise the CISO on the evolving product security tool landscape.

What you’ll do

  • Set the strategic direction, priorities, and operating model for Gigamon’s Product Security and PSIRT programs.
  • Lead and develop the PSIRT team, including mentoring junior PSIRT engineers and establishing clear expectations for performance, technical growth, and delivery.
  • Chair the PSIRT Steering Committee and partner with VP and executive leadership to assess material vulnerabilities, prioritize response activities, and drive accountability.
  • Serve as the PSIRT technical advisor to the COO and CISO, providing clear assessments of product security risks, response options, remediation progress, and business impact.
  • Establish consistent, repeatable processes for vulnerability intake, research, testing, triage, remediation tracking, customer engagement, communications, knowledge base articles, and coordinated disclosure.
  • Lead vulnerability research and testing across Gigamon’s hardware and software products, including attack-surface analysis, product behavior analysis, exploitability assessment, and validation of remediation.
  • Develop a product red-team framework covering engagement models, testing methodologies, objectives, reporting standards, risk prioritization, and remediation follow-through.
  • Coordinate product red-team and adversarial testing activities with internal teams and qualified external providers, as appropriate.
  • Evaluate the product security and red-team tool landscape and advise the CISO on tool selection, adoption, integration, and investment priorities.
  • Translate vulnerability research and adversarial testing results into practical security improvements and risk-based remediation plans.
  • Guide product and engineering teams in applying secure development practices, including threat modeling, static and dynamic application security testing, fuzzing, penetration testing, and secure release processes.
  • Oversee security advisories, customer notifications, frequently asked questions, remediation guidance, and other communications related to product vulnerabilities.
  • Establish release security governance, including security reviews, risk acceptance, exception management, and criteria for product security readiness.
  • Partner with product, engineering, threat research, detection, support, customer success, legal, and communications teams to coordinate vulnerability response and improve product security outcomes.
  • Identify appropriate opportunities to use automation and artificial intelligence in vulnerability research, testing, PSIRT operations, and security communications while maintaining oversight, quality, and accountability.
  • Communicate product security posture, material risks, response status, and remediation progress clearly to executive and cross-functional stakeholders.

What you’ve done

  • Bring at least 10 years of progressive PSIRT experience, including leadership of large-enterprise product security programs.
  • Led or scaled PSIRT, product security, vulnerability research, security engineering, or closely related programs across hardware, software, networking, or security products.
  • Established strategic direction, operating models, priorities, and measurable delivery expectations for product security teams.
  • Developed and mentored junior PSIRT engineers while building technical capability and supporting career growth.
  • Led vulnerability intake, triage, research, testing, remediation tracking, customer engagement, security advisories, and coordinated disclosure.
  • Developed or operated red-team, adversarial testing, penetration testing, or vulnerability research programs.
  • Created frameworks, methodologies, or operating models for product red-team activities where a formal capability was not previously established.
  • Evaluated security testing and product security tools and advised senior security leaders on technology selection, adoption, and investment.
  • Chaired or operated an executive-level security steering committee and partnered effectively with COO, CISO, VP, and executive leadership on risk decisions.
  • Served as a trusted technical advisor to senior executives on product security posture, material vulnerabilities, remediation strategies, and business risk.
  • Applied secure development practices, including threat modeling, static and dynamic application security testing, fuzzing, penetration testing, and secure release governance.
  • Translated complex vulnerabilities and adversarial findings into practical engineering actions, risk-based priorities, and clear executive decisions.
  • Set priorities and delivered measurable results through organizational change and competing business demands.
  • Worked effectively across distributed product and engineering organizations without relying solely on direct authority.
  • Applied knowledge of Linux, operating-system security, embedded systems, networking, cloud platforms, or platform engineering.
  • Applied automation or artificial intelligence to software security, vulnerability research, red teaming, PSIRT operations, or engineering workflows.
  • Earned a bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, cybersecurity, or a related field, or demonstrated equivalent professional experience.

Who you are

  • A strategic and technically credible product security leader who can set direction while engaging deeply with complex hardware and software security challenges.
  • An experienced PSIRT operator who establishes durable processes and delivers consistent, high-quality outcomes.
  • A builder who can develop practical red-team frameworks and mature emerging product security capabilities.
  • A pragmatic technology strategist who evaluates tools based on effectiveness, scalability, integration, operational fit, and cost.
  • A trusted technical advisor who provides clear, balanced guidance to the COO, CISO, and executive leadership.
  • A decisive executive partner who can chair a steering committee, establish accountability, and drive timely action.
  • A practical problem solver who helps product and engineering teams balance security, delivery, reliability, customer impact, and business requirements.
  • A clear communicator who explains technical vulnerabilities, remediation priorities, response decisions, and business implications without alarmism.
  • A customer-focused leader who values accurate, consistent, and actionable security communications.
  • A collaborative partner who builds trust across product, engineering, threat research, detection, support, customer success, legal, communications, and executive teams.
  • A people-focused leader who develops junior engineers, grows technical capability, and creates a high-performing, inclusive organization.
  • An accountable operator who sets priorities, follows through on commitments, and makes sound risk-based decisions.
  • A global-minded leader who works effectively across distributed teams and makes product security a shared responsibility.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
