title: Security Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced SOC Analyst to lead security monitoring, threat detection, incident investigation, and response activities. The candidate will be responsible for identifying potential security threats, analysing complex incidents, improving detection capabilities, and supporting the SOC team in maintaining an effective security monitoring environment.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with SIEM, EDR/XDR, threat intelligence, incident response, and security operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor and analyse security alerts generated through SIEM, EDR, and other security monitoring platforms.
  • Investigate and respond to complex security incidents, including malware infections, phishing attacks, ransomware, privilege escalation, and suspicious network activities.
  • Perform advanced log analysis, event correlation, threat hunting, and root cause analysis.
  • Develop, fine-tune, and optimise SIEM correlation rules, detection use cases, and alerting mechanisms.
  • Conduct proactive threat hunting using Indicators of Compromise (IOCs), Indicators of Attack (IOAs), and threat intelligence feeds.
  • Analyse network traffic, endpoint activities, authentication logs, and system events to identify malicious behaviour.
  • Lead incident response activities, including containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident analysis.
  • Map detected threats and attack techniques to the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
  • Prepare detailed incident reports, investigation findings, and security dashboards.
  • Coordinate with IT, infrastructure, and security teams to remediate identified vulnerabilities and security incidents.
  • Mentor junior SOC analysts and support L1/L2 SOC operations.
  • Participate in developing and improving SOC processes, incident response playbooks, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

Required Technical Skills

  • SIEM Tools: Splunk, IBM QRadar, Microsoft Sentinel, LogRhythm, or Wazuh.
  • EDR/XDR Tools: CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, SentinelOne, or Cortex XDR.
  • Network Security: Firewall logs, IDS/IPS, VPN, DNS, proxy logs, and network traffic analysis.
  • Incident Response: Malware analysis, phishing investigation, endpoint investigation, and forensic analysis.
  • Threat Intelligence: IOC analysis, threat intelligence platforms, and threat hunting.
  • Security Frameworks: MITRE ATT&CK, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, and incident response lifecycle.
  • Operating Systems: Windows, Linux, and Active Directory security.
  • Scripting: Python, PowerShell, or Bash for security automation and log analysis.
  • Cloud Security: Basic understanding of AWS, Azure, or GCP security monitoring.

Mandatory Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience in SIEM monitoring and incident investigation.
  • Advanced knowledge of security event correlation and threat detection.
  • Experience handling and responding to security incidents independently.
  • Strong understanding of network protocols, operating systems, and security architecture.
  • Experience in threat hunting and security log analysis.
  • Ability to guide and mentor junior SOC analysts.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
  • Certifications such as:
  • CompTIA CySA+
  • GCIA / GCIH / GCED
  • CEH
  • Splunk Enterprise Security Certified Admin
  • CISSP/ OSDA

Experience Requirements

  • 2–7 years of overall experience in Security Operations.
  • Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in SIEM and security incident investigation.
  • Experience working in a 24/7 SOC environment is preferred.
  • Prior experience handling enterprise-level security incidents is an added advantage.

Pay: Up to ₹700,000.00 per year

Benefits:

  • Health insurance
  • Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.
Job Summary

This job ensures the integrity and security of the company's cyber infrastructure by designing robust system architecture. It also entails solving complex engineering challenges. It involves documenting technical processes, reporting outcomes, and recommending innovative solutions. The role supports project teams and influences engineering staff, while maintaining a comprehensive understanding of network protocols and security strategies. The position requires flexibility to work variable schedules, including nights and weekends, as necessary.

Job Description

Senior CyberArk Engineer / CyberArk Developer

Experience: 6+ Years | Domain: Identity Security / Privileged Access Management (PAM)

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior CyberArk Engineer / Developer with 6+ years of hands-on experience in CyberArk PAM engineering, custom plugin development, enterprise onboarding, platform integrations, automation, upgrades, and operational support. The role focuses on CPM password management plugins, PSM session management connectors, CyberArk enhancements, Snyk finding remediation, L2/L3 troubleshooting, and enterprise-scale onboarding of accounts, servers, devices, and applications. PowerShell is mandatory, while Java and Python are preferred development skills.

Primary Focus

CyberArk PAM Engineering and Development

Development Preference

Java and Python optional / preferred

Experience Requirements

  • 6+ years of CyberArk PAM experience in enterprise environments.
  • Hands-on experience with CyberArk implementation, customization, maintenance, upgrades, and integrations.
  • Strong exposure to both engineering delivery and operational support functions.
  • Experience developing and supporting password management and session management plugins.

Core Responsibilities

CyberArk Development

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain CPM Password Management Plugins.
  • Develop and customize PSM Session Management Connectors for applications, databases, servers, and devices.
  • Build and enhance CyberArk integrations using REST APIs and automation frameworks.
  • Develop new CyberArk platform capabilities, enhancements, utilities, and reusable automation modules.
  • Perform code fixes, maintenance activities, peer reviews, and release readiness validation.
  • Automate operational processes using PowerShell; Java and Python experience is preferred.
  • Remediate Snyk findings and application security findings within agreed timelines.
  • Maintain source code, release artifacts, branches, and version history using Git.

CyberArk Engineering

  • Design, configure, implement, and support CyberArk PAM solutions across enterprise use cases.
  • Manage and support EPV, CPM, PSM, PVWA, PTA, CyberArk APIs, safes, platforms, and access policies.
  • Onboard privileged accounts, service accounts, servers, databases, applications, and network devices.
  • Conduct POCs for new applications, technologies, and device integrations with CyberArk.
  • Execute CyberArk upgrades, platform migrations, patching, health checks, and post-upgrade validations.
  • Integrate CyberArk with Active Directory, LDAP, Vault platforms, ticketing tools, and enterprise applications.
  • Perform L2/L3 troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and permanent fix implementation for production issues.

Operations & Support

  • Provide support through Slack, Email, and IT service management channels.
  • Troubleshoot onboarding, password rotation, reconciliation, session launch, and access workflow issues.
  • Resolve incidents, service requests, and JIRA tickets within defined SLA expectations.
  • Support production deployments, release validations, critical incident management, and escalations.
  • Create and maintain SOPs, technical documentation, knowledge articles, and handover guides.
  • Collaborate with Security, Infrastructure, Application, IAM, and Operations teams.

Required Technical Skills

CyberArk

  • Enterprise Password Vault (EPV)
  • Central Policy Manager (CPM)
  • Privileged Session Manager (PSM)
  • Password Vault Web Access (PVWA)
  • Privileged Threat Analytics (PTA)
  • CyberArk REST APIs
  • Safe Management
  • Platform Management
  • Discovery & Onboarding
  • Privileged Account Lifecycle Management
  • CyberArk Upgrades & Migration
  • CPM Plugin Development
  • PSM Connector Development

Development & Automation

  • PowerShell mandatory
  • REST API development
  • Git / GitHub
  • Secure coding practices
  • Automation design
  • Release support

Preferred Development Skills

  • Java
  • Python
  • Shell scripting
  • Reusable utility development
  • CI/CD pipeline exposure

Infrastructure & Integration

  • Active Directory
  • LDAP
  • Windows Server
  • Linux administration
  • HashiCorp Vault / OpenBao
  • Databases
  • Network devices
  • Enterprise application integrations

Tools

  • CyberArk
  • Git
  • JIRA
  • Snyk
  • Vault technologies
  • Active Directory
  • PowerShell
  • Java
  • Python

Preferred Certifications

  • CyberArk Defender
  • CyberArk Sentry
  • CyberArk CDE

Preferred Candidate Profile

title: Application Security Engineer - Fully Remote
descriptionHtml:
Top 3 Reasons To Join Us

  • 100% remote, with a global, diverse team
  • Working on the latest tech for the Insurtech Market Leader
  • Lead and shape how an AI-native security function finds and prevents vulnerabilities at the AI-native insurance platform of choice for the world’s leading insurers

About Us

At CoverGo, our mission is to empower all insurance companies to make insurance 100% digital and accessible to everyone.

  • We are a leading global no-code insurance platform for health, life, and P&C
  • We’re the winner of the Insurtech of the Year in all of Asia and other awards globally
  • We work with insurance enterprise clients such as AXA, Bupa, MSIG, Dai-ichi, Bank of China Group Insurance, and many more
  • We're an international, diverse team of over 200 people with 30 nationalities and team members working remotely from all over the world
  • We are fully funded and backed by reputable VC funds and strategic institutional investors
  • We have a global presence in Asia, EMEA and the Americas
  • We’ve grown our annualized revenue by over 30x since January 2021
  • We’re constantly working towards making CoverGo a workplace that you love coming to. We deeply believe that bringing together a diversity of thoughts, expressions, and perspectives is key to building the best culture for equally diverse communities all over the world

About The Role

CoverGo is hiring an Application Security Engineer to use AI to find and prevent vulnerabilities before they reach production, and to give engineering teams the tools and guardrails that stop vulnerabilities from being introduced in the first place. The Security team is small and growing, and works AI-first: everyone uses AI to automate their own work and to scale security across a large engineering organisation.

What You Will Do

  • Use AI tools such as Claude and OpenAI models to find and triage vulnerabilities in code, dependencies and designs before changes are merged.
  • Embed security checks into developer workflows and CI/CD pipelines so issues surface as code is written.
  • Select, configure and tune code-security tools such as GitHub Advanced Security, Snyk and Checkmarx, keeping the signal high enough that engineers act on the findings.
  • Build self-service tools, guardrails and guidance that help engineering teams prevent common vulnerability classes.
  • Partner with engineering leads and security champions across product teams to prioritise and fix findings.
  • Review security-relevant designs and changes, ranking risk by what an attacker could realistically reach.
  • Track and report on application-security risk and remediation progress.

What We Need

  • 3+ years in application security or a closely related security role.
  • An AI-native approach to securing software: you already use LLMs to find, detect and explain vulnerabilities.
  • Enough fluency in at least one modern programming language to read, understand and fix vulnerable code. A software-engineering background is not required.
  • Hands-on experience with code-security tools such as GitHub Advanced Security, Snyk or Checkmarx.
  • A solid grasp of common vulnerability classes, such as the OWASP Top 10, and how to prevent them.
  • A practical, enabling style of working with engineers.

Nice to have

  • Experience building custom security tooling or automations on LLM APIs.
  • Experience securing applications on AWS, Azure or GCP.
  • Experience in insurance, financial services or another regulated SaaS environment.

Top 3 Reasons To Join Us
100% remote, with a global, diverse team
Working on the latest tech for the Insurtech Market Leader
Lead and shape how an AI-native security function finds and prevents vulnerabilities at the AI-native insurance platform of choice for the world’s leading insurers

About Us

At CoverGo, our mission is to empower all insurance companies to make insurance 100% digital and accessible to everyone.

We are a leading global no-code insurance platform for health, life, and P&C
We’re the winner of the Insurtech of the Year in all of Asia and other awards globally
We work with insurance enterprise clients such as AXA, Bupa, MSIG, Dai-ichi, Bank of China Group Insurance, and many more
We're an international, diverse team of over 200 people with 30 nationalities and team members working remotely from all over the world
We are fully funded and backed by reputable VC funds and strategic institutional investors
We have a global presence in Asia, EMEA and the Americas
We’ve grown our annualized revenue by over 30x since January 2021
We’re constantly working towards making CoverGo a workplace that you love coming to. We deeply believe that bringing together a diversity of thoughts, expressions, and perspectives is key to building the best culture for equally diverse communities all over the world

About The Role

CoverGo is hiring an Application Security Engineer to use AI to find and prevent vulnerabilities before they reach production, and to give engineering teams the tools and guardrails that stop vulnerabilities from being introduced in the first place. The Security team is small and growing, and works AI-first: everyone uses AI to automate their own work and to scale security across a large engineering organisation.

What You Will Do
Use AI tools such as Claude and OpenAI models to find and triage vulnerabilities in code, dependencies and designs before changes are merged.
Embed security checks into developer workflows and CI/CD pipelines so issues surface as code is written.
Select, configure and tune code-security tools such as GitHub Advanced Security, Snyk and Checkmarx, keeping the signal high enough that engineers act on the findings.
Build self-service tools, guardrails and guidance that help engineering teams prevent common vulnerability classes.
Partner with engineering leads and security champions across product teams to prioritise and fix findings.
Review security-relevant designs and changes, ranking risk by what an attacker could realistically reach.
Track and report on application-security risk and remediation progress.

What We Need
3+ years in application security or a closely related security role.
An AI-native approach to securing software: you already use LLMs to find, detect and explain vulnerabilities.
Enough fluency in at least one modern programming language to read, understand and fix vulnerable code. A software-engineering background is not required.
Hands-on experience with code-security tools such as GitHub Advanced Security, Snyk or Checkmarx.
A solid grasp of common vulnerability classes, such as the OWASP Top 10, and how to prevent them.
A practical, enabling style of working with engineers.

Nice to have
Experience building custom security tooling or automations on LLM APIs.
Experience securing applications on AWS, Azure or GCP.
Experience in insurance, financial services or another regulated SaaS environment.

title: Red Team Engineer – Offensive Security / Advanced VAPT (5+ Years)
descriptionHtml:
Job Description – Red Team Engineer

Company: BriskInfosec Technology and Consulting Pvt. Ltd.

Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu

Work Mode: Work from Office (On-site)

Experience: 5+ Years

Employment Type: Full-time

CTC: As per competence and industry standards

Travel: Domestic and International (as required)

About BriskInfosec

BriskInfosec Technology and Consulting Pvt. Ltd. has been delivering cybersecurity services

since 2017, serving clients across 30+ countries. Our clientele spans OEMs, Banking and

Financial Services (BFSI), SaaS, Healthcare, and Trading industries.

We are looking for an experienced Red Team Engineer with strong hands-on offensive

security expertise, a research-driven mindset, and the ability to execute advanced red team

and adversary simulation engagements beyond traditional checklist-based VAPT.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and lead end-to-end red team and adversary simulation engagements,

from reconnaissance to final reporting.

  • Identify and exploit complex attack paths across Web Applications, APIs, Cloud,

Networks, Active Directory, and Mobile platforms.

  • Develop Proof of Concept (PoC) exploits, custom scripts, and tools for authorised

security engagements.

  • Conduct research on emerging attack techniques, AI-driven offensive security, and

vulnerabilities in AI/LLM-based systems.

  • Translate security research and emerging threat intelligence into practical testing

methodologies.

  • Execute highly confidential security engagements while maintaining strict discretion

and professionalism.

  • Present technical findings and actionable recommendations to clients, including

technical teams and senior leadership.

  • Prepare detailed security assessment reports with reproducible steps, supporting

evidence, and remediation guidance.

  • Mentor junior security engineers and contribute to strengthening the organisation's

red teaming capabilities.

  • Manage multiple engagements simultaneously while ensuring quality, priorities, and

delivery timelines.

  • Travel to domestic and international client locations as required.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in Offensive Security, VAPT, and Red

Teaming.

  • Strong practical experience in planning and executing red team engagements and

adversary simulations.

  • Experience working with at least two of the following industry domains:

o Banking and Financial Services (BFSI)

o OEM

o SaaS

o Healthcare

o Trading

  • Strong understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework, red team methodologies,

and Command and Control (C2) tools.

  • Proficiency in scripting and programming languages such as Python, Go, C, or similar.
  • Experience in exploit development, attack simulation, and custom security tool

development.

  • Demonstrable technical contributions through any one of the following:

o Bug bounty Hall of Fame recognition

o CVE publications

o CTF achievements

o Open-source security tools

o Technical research or security write-ups

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex

attack scenarios to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Strong technical documentation and report-writing skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and handle high-pressure client

engagements.

  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and a continuous learning

mindset.

  • High ethical standards, with a strong commitment to engagement scope, client data

protection, and confidentiality.

  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.

Good to Have

  • Industry-recognised offensive security certifications such as:

o OSCP

o OSEP

o CRTO

o CRTP / CRTE

o OSED

  • Experience conducting red team engagements in regulated environments.
  • Experience in AI/LLM security testing and emerging offensive security research.
  • Security conference presentations, published research, technical blogs, or

community contributions.

What We Offer

  • Exposure to global cybersecurity engagements across clients in 30+ countries.
  • Opportunities for domestic and international client visits.
  • Dedicated support and opportunities for Research and Development (R&D).
  • Exposure to diverse industries, technologies, and advanced attack surfaces.
  • Opportunities to explore emerging offensive security techniques and tools.
  • The opportunity to contribute to and shape BriskInfosec's Red Team and Offensive

Security practice.

  • Competitive compensation based on skills, experience, and industry standards.

Work Location:

This is an on-site position based in Chennai, Tamil Nadu. Candidates currently based in

Chennai or willing to relocate are preferred.

The role requires close collaboration with the offensive security team, particularly for attack

path planning, technical discussions, knowledge sharing, and mentoring.

Join BriskInfosec and help shape the next generation of offensive security.

Pay: From ₹40,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

descriptionHtml:
Join Teleperformance – Where Excellence Meets Opportunity!

Teleperformance is a leading provider of customer experience management, offering premier omnichannel support to top global companies. Our diverse service locations, including on-site and work-at-home programs, ensure flexibility and broad reach.

Why Choose Teleperformance?

We emphasize the importance of our employees, fostering enduring relationships within our teams and communities. Our dedication to employee satisfaction distinguishes us.

Utilize advanced support technologies and processes engineered to achieve outstanding results.

We cultivate lasting client relationships and make positive contributions to our local communities.

Become Part of an Exceptional Team!

Join Teleperformance, where our world-class workforce and innovative solutions drive success. Experience a workplace that values your development, supports your goals, and celebrates your accomplishments.

Job Description

Information Systems Security work focuses on preventing IT-based crime, hacking, intentional or inadvertent modification, disclosure, or destruction to an organization's information systems and IT assets and intellectual property including:

  • Designing, testing, and implementing secure operating systems, networks, and databases
  • Password auditing, network based and Web application based vulnerability scanning, virus management, and intrusion detection
  • Conducting risk audits and assessments, providing recommendations for application design
  • Monitoring and analyzing system access logs
  • Planning for security backup and system disaster recovery

Positions on this level are fully proficient in executing established standards. Works independently within set frames and follows set course. Has a knowledge base typically acquired from a professional/university degree and approximately 1-2 years of practical professional experience in a particular area. Develops own knowledge, shares best practice and develops relevant/appropriate solutions. Positions at this level are expected to continuously improve the day-to-day activities/processes.

Can be a formal team leader of more junior co-workers and may set day-to-day operational objectives.

Be One of Our People:
It is our mission to always provide an environment where our employees feel valued, inspired, and supported, so that they can bring their best selves to work every day. We believe that when employees are happy and healthy, they are more productive, creative, and engaged. We are committed to providing a workplace that is conducive to happiness and a healthy work-life balance. We also believe that to be our best selves, we need to be surrounded by people who are positive, supportive, and challenging. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion and diversity, where everyone feels welcome and valued. Teleperformance is an Equal Opportunity Employer

If you have questions or need an accommodation for any disability during this application, please contact your local Teleperformance location for assistance.

title: Power Platform & Dynamics 365 Engineer (Integrations, ALM & Security)
descriptionHtml:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Overall purpose:

Join our dynamic team at Regent College London as a Power Platform & Dynamics 365 Engineer (Integrations, ALM & Security), where you'll help evolve and harden our Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform services that support key Higher Education business processes (admissions, marketing, enrolment, student communications and student support).

In this role you'll design and deliver solutions across Dataverse (model-driven apps), Canvas apps, Power Automate and Power Pages. You'll bring strong engineering capability in API integrations and pro-code extensibility (e.g., plugins, JavaScript) and will help establish secure, reliable delivery practices across environments.

This role is based remotely (India), joining a UK-based function and working primarily to the UK time zone. You'll be part of a small, dedicated team delivering both strategic initiatives and continuous improvements.

The successful candidate will be a self-starter and strong individual contributor, comfortable owning work end-to-end without a dedicated QA team. You will also act as a technical multiplier by uplifting integration patterns, ALM/CI-CD, and security practices, and by mentoring other developers as they upskill.

Specific duties and responsibilities:

· Design, build and enhance Dataverse-based solutions (model-driven apps, tables, forms, views and business logic) aligned to the CRM product roadmap.

· Support day-to-day Dynamics 365/Dataverse configuration including adding fields, modifying forms/views, business rules, security roles, and general entity/app administration as part of shared team responsibilities.

· Design and build targeted Canvas apps (and reusable components where appropriate) for business scenarios that are better served by task-focused, UX-first experiences, integrating with Dataverse and other services.

· Implement custom logic where required using C# (plugins and/or custom workflow activities), JavaScript/TypeScript, and platform extensibility patterns.

· Design, develop and support API-based integrations between Dynamics 365/Dataverse and enterprise systems (including the Student Records System where applicable) using REST APIs, OAuth2/Entra ID, custom connectors and/or Azure integration services.

· Create, enhance and refactor Power Automate flows using resilient engineering practices (error handling, retries, logging, idempotency where relevant, connection references and environment variables).

· Contribute to the migration from legacy ADX/portal capabilities to Power Pages, including page/templates, forms, security/permissions, and safe integration patterns back to Dataverse and other services.

· Maintain disciplined solution management and automated deployments across environments using Azure DevOps (Power Platform Build Tools/PAC CLI), including versioning, release notes and deployment runbooks.

· Improve the security posture of the platform through least-privilege role design, team/access model reviews, auditing, and Power Pages permission modelling; collaborate with platform/tenant administrators on governance controls.

· Perform thorough testing, create reusable test scripts/checklists, and participate in peer reviews to ensure quality, performance and reliability.

· Triage and resolve defects/incidents promptly, provide third-line support for integrations/automations, and proactively monitor and improve platform health.

· Work closely with the Head of Enterprise Applications & CRM, Project Manager, developers and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, propose options, communicate trade-offs and maintain clear technical documentation.

Additional duties

· Contribute to consistent Agile ceremonies (refinement, planning, review and retrospectives) and support lightweight estimation and delivery forecasting for a small team.

· Help implement and document engineering standards (ALM, CI/CD, integration patterns, security reviews) and contribute to Centre of Excellence (CoE) practices where appropriate.

PERSON SPECIFICATION

EXPERIENCE & PERSONAL QUALITIES

Essential

· Full proficiency in English; confident communicating with UK-based stakeholders. Ability to work effectively as part of a small delivery team and collaborate across IT and business functions.

· 3-5 years of experience delivering solutions on Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Customer Engagement) and the Power Platform.

· Hands-on experience with Dataverse solution delivery (tables, forms, views, business rules/processes) in model-driven apps; able to contribute to Canvas apps where appropriate.

· Comfortable delivering both configuration-level enhancements (e.g., fields, forms, views, business rules) and engineering-level work (integrations, ALM/CI/CD, security).

· Experience designing and building Power Apps Canvas apps (responsive design, components and Dataverse integration).

· Experience delivering Power Pages (or ADX Studio Portals), including external user journeys and permissions modelling.

· Experience building and supporting API integrations (REST, OAuth2/Entra ID app registrations) and using tools such as Postman.

· Experience with pro-code extensibility for Dataverse (e.g., C# plugins/custom workflow activities) and/or client-side scripting (JavaScript).

· Strong Power Automate experience, including production-grade practices (error handling, monitoring and supportability).

· Experience working with Dev/UAT/Production environments and change/release management.

· Comfortable working independently without a dedicated QA team; able to plan, test and deliver end-to-end.

· Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills, with attention to security and data integrity..

Desirable

· Experience with Azure integration services (e.g., Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Key Vault).

· Experience implementing CI/CD for Power Platform using Azure DevOps pipelines (Power Platform Build Tools and/or PAC CLI).

· Experience with PCF controls and TypeScript.

· Experience in Higher Education or similarly regulated environments handling sensitive personal data.

TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE & SKILLSEssential

· Strong knowledge of Dataverse architecture, solution management (managed/unmanaged), and environment configuration (Dev/UAT/Prod).

· Strong knowledge of Dynamics 365 CE/model-driven app configuration.

· C#/.NET experience for Dataverse plugins and related development practices (source control, code review, debugging).

· JavaScript (and ideally TypeScript) for model-driven form scripting and client API usage.

· API integration design via authentication/authorisation (OAuth2), data mapping, error handling, retries, and monitoring/observability.

· Power Automate engineering: scalable flow design, connection references, environment variables and governance-aware connector use.

· ALM/CI-CD fundamentals with Azure DevOps and/or GitHub (build/release pipelines, approvals and deployment controls).

· Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum delivery practices.

Desirable

· Power Pages (Liquid, basic HTML/CSS/JavaScript) and portal deployment practices. Canvas app development (formulas, responsive design, components, Dataverse integration).

· Power Platform CoE Starter Kit familiarity and platform monitoring approaches.

· Data export and reporting patterns (e.g., datalake concepts, ETL, Power BI modelling fundamentals).

· Understanding of security best practices for external users and portals (least privilege, auditing, data protection).

· Azure administration familiarity relevant to integration delivery.

EDUCATION & PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONSEssential

· Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent level experience/training.

Desirable

· Microsoft Power Platform Developer certification (PL-400).

· Additional relevant Microsoft certifications (e.g., PL-600, MB-230, AZ-204) or equivalent experience.

Interested candidates can come for walk-in: MONDAY - FRIDAY[ 11am to 5pm]

Pay: ₹585,000.00 - ₹1,990,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

You will also act as a technical multiplier by uplifting integration patterns, ALM/CI-CD, and security practices, and by mentoring other developers as they upskill.

Specific duties and responsibilities:

· Design, build and enhance Dataverse-based solutions (model-driven apps, tables, forms, views and business logic) aligned to the CRM product roadmap.

· Support day-to-day Dynamics 365/Dataverse configuration including adding fields, modifying forms/views, business rules, security roles, and general entity/app administration as part of shared team responsibilities.

· Design and build targeted Canvas apps (and reusable components where appropriate) for business scenarios that are better served by task-focused, UX-first experiences, integrating with Dataverse and other services.

· Implement custom logic where required using C# (plugins and/or custom workflow activities), JavaScript/TypeScript, and platform extensibility patterns.

· Design, develop and support API-based integrations between Dynamics 365/Dataverse and enterprise systems (including the Student Records System where applicable) using REST APIs, OAuth2/Entra ID, custom connectors and/or Azure integration services.

· Create, enhance and refactor Power Automate flows using resilient engineering practices (error handling, retries, logging, idempotency where relevant, connection references and environment variables).

· Contribute to the migration from legacy ADX/portal capabilities to Power Pages, including page/templates, forms, security/permissions, and safe integration patterns back to Dataverse and other services.

· Maintain disciplined solution management and automated deployments across environments using Azure DevOps (Power Platform Build Tools/PAC CLI), including versioning, release notes and deployment runbooks.

· Improve the security posture of the platform through least-privilege role design, team/access model reviews, auditing, and Power Pages permission modelling; collaborate with platform/tenant administrators on governance controls.

· Perform thorough testing, create reusable test scripts/checklists, and participate in peer reviews to ensure quality, performance and reliability.

· Triage and resolve defects/incidents promptly, provide third-line support for integrations/automations, and proactively monitor and improve platform health.

· Work closely with the Head of Enterprise Applications & CRM, Project Manager, developers and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, propose options, communicate trade-offs and maintain clear technical documentation.

Additional duties

· Contribute to consistent Agile ceremonies (refinement, planning, review and retrospectives) and support lightweight estimation and delivery forecasting for a small team.

· Help implement and document engineering standards (ALM, CI/CD, integration patterns, security reviews) and contribute to Centre of Excellence (CoE) practices where appropriate.

*PERSON SPECIFICATION*

EXPERIENCE & PERSONAL QUALITIES

Essential

· Full proficiency in English; confident communicating with UK-based stakeholders. Ability to work effectively as part of a small delivery team and collaborate across IT and business functions.

· 3-5 years of experience delivering solutions on Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Customer Engagement) and the Power Platform.

· Hands-on experience with Dataverse solution delivery (tables, forms, views, business rules/processes) in model-driven apps; able to contribute to Canvas apps where appropriate.

· Comfortable delivering both configuration-level enhancements (e.g., fields, forms, views, business rules) and engineering-level work (integrations, ALM/CI/CD, security).

· Experience designing and building Power Apps Canvas apps (responsive design, components and Dataverse integration).

· Experience delivering Power Pages (or ADX Studio Portals), including external user journeys and permissions modelling.

· Experience building and supporting API integrations (REST, OAuth2/Entra ID app registrations) and using tools such as Postman.

· Experience with pro-code extensibility for Dataverse (e.g., C# plugins/custom workflow activities) and/or client-side scripting (JavaScript).

· Strong Power Automate experience, including production-grade practices (error handling, monitoring and supportability).

· Experience working with Dev/UAT/Production environments and change/release management.

· Comfortable working independently without a dedicated QA team; able to plan, test and deliver end-to-end.

· Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills, with attention to security and data integrity..

Desirable

· Experience with Azure integration services (e.g., Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Key Vault).

· Experience implementing CI/CD for Power Platform using Azure DevOps pipelines (Power Platform Build Tools and/or PAC CLI).

· Experience with PCF controls and TypeScript.

· Experience in Higher Education or similarly regulated environments handling sensitive personal data.

TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE & SKILLSEssential

· Strong knowledge of Dataverse architecture, solution management (managed/unmanaged), and environment configuration (Dev/UAT/Prod).

· Strong knowledge of Dynamics 365 CE/model-driven app configuration.

· C#/.NET experience for Dataverse plugins and related development practices (source control, code review, debugging).

· JavaScript (and ideally TypeScript) for model-driven form scripting and client API usage.

· API integration design via authentication/authorisation (OAuth2), data mapping, error handling, retries, and monitoring/observability.

· Power Automate engineering: scalable flow design, connection references, environment variables and governance-aware connector use.

· ALM/CI-CD fundamentals with Azure DevOps and/or GitHub (build/release pipelines, approvals and deployment controls).

· Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum delivery practices.

Desirable

· Power Pages (Liquid, basic HTML/CSS/JavaScript) and portal deployment practices. Canvas app development (formulas, responsive design, components, Dataverse integration).

· Power Platform CoE Starter Kit familiarity and platform monitoring approaches.

· Data export and reporting patterns (e.g., datalake concepts, ETL, Power BI modelling fundamentals).

· Understanding of security best practices for external users and portals (least privilege, auditing, data protection).

· Azure administration familiarity relevant to integration delivery.

EDUCATION & PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONSEssential

· Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent level experience/training.

Desirable

· Microsoft Power Platform Developer certification (PL-400).

· Additional relevant Microsoft certifications (e.g., PL-600, MB-230, AZ-204) or equivalent experience.

title: CCTV Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Atrity Info Solutions Private Limited is a leading offshore web development and system integration company based in India, delivering innovative software solutions, IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, and consultancy services to global clients. We provide enterprise IT solutions and security infrastructure services, helping organizations improve operational efficiency, infrastructure reliability, and security.

Role Description

The CCTV Engineer will be responsible for installing, configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting CCTV surveillance systems at client locations. The role involves working with IP and Analog CCTV cameras, DVRs, NVRs, networking equipment, and structured cabling to ensure reliable video surveillance operations.

The candidate should have hands-on technical experience, good troubleshooting skills, and the ability to coordinate with clients and project teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, and maintain CCTV surveillance systems.
  • Install and troubleshoot IP cameras, HD cameras, DVRs, NVRs, and XVRs.
  • Perform camera positioning, focusing, and configuration.
  • Configure IP addresses, subnet masks, gateways, and network connectivity.
  • Install and configure PoE switches, routers, and network video recorders.
  • Configure remote CCTV viewing through mobile applications and desktop software.
  • Perform preventive maintenance and routine CCTV system inspections.
  • Troubleshoot camera connectivity, video loss, recording, and playback issues.
  • Install and maintain structured cabling, including CAT6, CAT5e, and fiber optic cables.
  • Perform cable termination, testing, and troubleshooting.
  • Prepare installation reports and maintenance documentation.
  • Coordinate with clients and project teams for installation and service activities.

Key Competencies

  • Good knowledge of IP CCTV and Analog CCTV systems.
  • Hands-on experience with DVR, NVR, and XVR devices.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, LAN, and WAN.
  • Knowledge of PoE switches, routers, and network connectivity.
  • Familiarity with CCTV brands such as Hikvision, CP Plus, Dahua, and Honeywell.
  • Strong hardware and software troubleshooting skills.
  • Knowledge of cable termination and testing.
  • Good communication and customer-handling skills.
  • Ability to work independently and coordinate with technical teams.
  • Willingness to travel to client locations for business purposes.

Educational Qualification

  • Diploma / ITI / B.E. / B.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Science, or related fields.
  • Relevant CCTV installation, security systems, and networking experience preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Timely completion of CCTV installation projects.
  • Minimum repeat service calls and effective troubleshooting.
  • Quality of CCTV installation and structured cabling.
  • Quick resolution of technical complaints.
  • Customer satisfaction and service quality.
  • Proper maintenance records and technical documentation.

Experience: 1–3 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location: Chennai

Travel Requirement: Willingness to travel to client locations for business purposes.

Expected Joining: Immediate

If you are looking to build your career in CCTV, Surveillance, and Security Systems and contribute to Atrity’s growth and success, apply now and become a part of Atrity’s success story!

title: R&D Cybersecurity Compliance Lead Engineer - IDC
descriptionHtml:
Location:

Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India

Job ID:

R0150366

Date Posted:

2026-11-16

Company Name:

HITACHI ENERGY TECHNOLOGY SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED

Profession (Job Category):

Engineering & Science

Job Schedule:

Full time

Remote:

No

Job Description:

The Opportunity:
The role translates applicable regulations, standards, customer requirements, and internal policies into practical controls, repeatable methods, engineering guidance, and auditable evidence. It supports product teams through out the lifecycle—from applicability and risk assessment through secure development, conformity assessment, release, vulnerability handling, and post-market compliance. Coordinating pilot runs on new products or processes.


How you'll make an impact:

This role is responsible for driving end-to-end product cyber security compliance and secure product development by ensuring adherence to Hitachi Energy cyber security requirements, customer standards, and IEC 62443 (4-1, 4-2, and 3-3) standards.

The position owns and continuously improves the Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC), translates cyber security requirements into product capabilities, develops security architecture and design solutions, conducts threat modeling, risk assessments, vulnerability management, and release security clearances, while ensuring compliance with evolving regulations such as the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA).

Your Background:
Bachelor’s degree in engineering in electronics or computer science. Cybersecurity Certifications shall be an added advantage.

  • At least 8+ years of experience in cyber security related to industrial control system design and development, preferably in power industry.
  • SDLC Experience in the domain of cybersecurity, secure data communication, network security and compliances in Energy industries and associated systems according to IEC 62443 cyber security standard, EU CRA guidelines, and industry best practices for building highly resilient hardened software systems
  • Strong Knowledge of Industrial control system, SCADA Systems, Communication Gateways, Network architecture, System administration, Infrastructure (servers, workstation, switches, routers, firewalls) configuration, troubleshooting and root cause analysis.
  • Proven ability to translate legal, standards, and customer obligations into engineering controls, methods, guidance, and evidence.
  • Hands-on experience with cybersecurity risk assessment, threat modelling, attack-surface analysis, secure design reviews, vulnerability management, SBOM/SCA, hardening, and security verification.
  • Experience preparing compliance documentation, audit evidence, conformity inputs, assessment reports, and remediation plans.
  • Knowledge of industrial control systems, embedded products, software, firmware, networked components, and product lifecycle processes; power-industry experience is advantageous.

Accessibility and reasonable accommodation

Qualified individuals with a disability may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Hitachi Energy career site as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by completing a general inquiry form on our website. Please include your contact information and specific details about your required accommodation to support you during the job application process.


This is solely for job seekers with disabilities requiring accessibility assistance or an accommodation in the job application process. Messages left for other purposes will not receive a response.

These tools are designed to support our recruiters and do not replace human decision-making. Candidate data is processed in accordance with applicable data protection and employment laws as well as Hitachi's Global Data Privacy Notice.

Background Screening and Security Checks

As part of the hiring process, Hitachi Energy conducts pre-employment background checks that may include verification of employment history, education, criminal records, and other relevant information, in accordance with applicable laws.

For certain roles—particularly those involving access to sensitive information, financial responsibilities, client data, regulated environments, or security-sensitive functions—additional or more comprehensive background or security screenings may be required. These may include, but are not limited to, enhanced criminal history checks, credit history reviews (where legally permissible), sanctions screening, or other due diligence measures aligned with the responsibilities of the position.

The scope and depth of any background or security review will be determined based on the nature of the role and business necessity, and will always be conducted in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Candidates will be notified and, where required, asked to provide consent prior to the initiation of any such checks.

title: SOC Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

We are looking for a motivated SOC Analyst to join our Security Operations Center (SOC) and help protect the organisation’s digital environment. In this role, you will monitor security events, investigate alerts, and support the response to cybersecurity incidents using a range of security technologies.

You will work closely with internal teams and stakeholders across the business, communicating with both technical and non-technical audiences. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to operational documentation, playbooks, and process improvements while building experience in a collaborative, global cybersecurity environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor security alerts and events to identify potential threats, intrusions, or indicators of compromise.
  • Investigate, triage, and support the response to cybersecurity incidents in line with established procedures and playbooks.
  • Analyse alert and event data to assess severity, impact, and appropriate next steps.
  • Work with internal teams to support incident investigation, containment, and remediation activities.
  • Collaborate with the Cybersecurity Detection team to help improve detection use cases and monitoring capabilities.
  • Contribute to the tuning and optimisation of monitoring tools and detection rules to improve alert quality and reduce false positives.
  • Maintain clear and accurate documentation, including procedures, playbooks, and investigation notes.
  • Provide guidance to stakeholders on security risks and recommended actions where appropriate.
  • Identify opportunities to improve SOC processes and support automation initiatives that enhance operational efficiency.

Qualifications and Experience

  • A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience in cybersecurity, information security, IT operations, or a related technical area.
  • A foundational understanding of security monitoring, incident triage, and incident response processes.
  • Experience working in a global environment would be an advantage.

Skills and Knowledge

  • Knowledge of security technologies such as SIEM, EDR, firewalls, and related monitoring tools.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint; familiarity with other Microsoft Defender tools would be beneficial.
  • A good understanding of common security concepts, methodologies, and operational processes.
  • Knowledge of computer networks, operating systems, and basic scripting or programming.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with ServiceNow & ServiceNow Security Incident Response (SIR).
  • Experience supporting or implementing SOC process automation.
  • Exposure to working in a global or multi-regional security operations environment.

Relevant Certifications

  • Microsoft SC-200
  • Microsoft AZ-500
  • CompTIA Security+
  • CompTIA CySA+
  • Blue Team Level 1
  • Blue Team Level 2

We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. title: Senior SOC Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Role: Senior SOC Analyst

Location: Pune (Maharashtra)


Life Unlimited. As a SOC Analyst you will support the response efforts for the critical incidents on the Smith & Nephew network, systems, and applications, including the technical direction of the incident response, work with other global SOC team members, and reports to the Local SOC team lead. Partnering closely with other functions within the Cybersecurity, you will participate in multi-functional teamwork, communication, and documentation activities related to containing and remediating the incident.


What will you be doing?

  • (40%) Manage incident response activities for critical incidents, to include the initial triage, incident record, accuracy of data and reporting, incident timeline, root cause, and impact assessment
  • (40%) Uses our technology platforms and security tools to conduct investigations and collect/examine endpoint and network-based evidence
  • (10%) Write comprehensive reports including assessment-based findings, outcomes, and propositions for further system security improvement
    • (10%) On Call for Security Incidents as needed.

What will you need to be successful?

  • 3+ years of demonstrable experience in Cyber Incident Response that must include experience in:

  • Identification and response to existing and emerging threats
  • Identification of attacker tools, tactics, and procedures (TTPs)
  • Security data analysis from a variety of sources and tools
  • TCP/IP, DNS, SIEM, and EDR technologies (Splunk, Crowd-Strike, Carbon Black, etc.)
  • Windows' environments and related security controls (IDS/IPS, AV, Proxies, Firewalls, etc.)
  • Windows log analysis and memory forensics
  • Network traffic analysis
  • Ability to work flexible schedule that may include shift work
  • Detailed technical knowledge of database and operating system security
  • Experience with network security and networking technologies and with system, security, and network monitoring tools!
  • Detailed understanding of the latest security principles, techniques, and protocols
  • Familiarity with web related technologies (Web applications, Web Services, Service Oriented Architectures) and of network/web related protocols
  • Excellent Problem solving skills and ability to work under stress
  • Knowledge of cyber security standard frameworks such as ISO and NIST
    • Experience with different cloud computing platforms and the cloud security framework.

Competences:

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills!
  • Excellent customer service skills and problem resolution.
  • Experience in being able to handle and prioritize numerous tasks in an effective manner.
  • Ability to work independently without daily direction.
  • Understanding of back-channels typically used by actors for malicious activity.
  • Understanding of obfuscation techniques and standard methodologies for ensuring device non-attribution.
  • Understanding of one or more Technology Platforms (Windows, Linux, Middleware Applications, Database Applications) - specifically as they apply to successful security control mitigation and particularly to vulnerability management.
  • Understanding of distributed denial of service attack intelligence gathering, concepts, mitigation tools, and techniques.
  • Understanding of mobility security device and application risk and threat assessment.
  • Understanding of nation and non-nation state actors, hacktivist groups, advanced level of threats, and the "kill chain" methodology.
  • Familiarity with secure coding standard processes.
  • Strong communication & interpersonal skills, ability to multi-task, proven attention to details, excellent problem solving and follow-up skills required.

***Roles on this team are on a rotating schedule that includes weekend shifts.


You Unlimited.

We believe in crafting the greatest good for society. Our strongest investments are in our people and the patients we serve.

Inclusion + Belonging: Committed to Welcoming, Celebrating and Thriving., Learn more about Employee Inclusion Groups on our website ( https://www.smith-nephew.com/ ).

Other reasons why you will love it here!

  • Your Future: Major medical coverage + policy exclusions and insurance non-medical limit. Educational Assistance.
  • Work/Life Balance : Flexible Personal/Vacation Time Off, Privilege Leave, Floater Leave.
  • Flexibility : Hybrid Work Model (For most professional roles)
  • Your Wellbeing: Parents/Parents-in-Law’s Insurance (Employer Contribution of 8,000/- annually), Employee Assistance Program, Parental Leave.
  • Training: Hands-On, Team-Customized, Mentorship.

Stay connected by joining our Talent Community .

We're more than just a company - we're a community! Follow us on LinkedIn to see how we support and empower our employees and patients every day.


Check us out on Glassdoor for a glimpse behind the scenes and a sneak peek into You. Unlimited. , life, culture, and benefits at S+N.

Explore our website and learn more about our mission, our team, and the opportunities we offer.

title: Security PAM
descriptionHtml:
Senior Security PAM (Privileged Access Management) Engineer/Lead

Experience: 10-12 Years

Location : Pune (Hybrid)

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Privileged Access Management (PAM) Engineer/Lead with 10-12 years of IT and Cybersecurity experience to design, implement, manage, and enhance enterprise PAM solutions. The role will be responsible for securing privileged accounts, enforcing least-privilege access, managing privileged session monitoring, password vaulting, and ensuring compliance with organizational security policies and regulatory requirements.

The ideal candidate should have extensive experience with PAM platforms such as CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Delinea (Thycotic), One Identity Safeguard, or ARCON , along with strong expertise in IAM, Active Directory, cloud security, and security governance.

Key Responsibilities

PAM Architecture & Administration

  • Design, deploy, and support enterprise PAM solutions.
  • Manage privileged account onboarding, password vaulting, credential rotation, and session monitoring.
  • Implement privileged session management and privileged threat analytics.
  • Configure password policies, access controls, workflows, and approval mechanisms.
  • Integrate PAM solutions with enterprise applications, databases, servers, network devices, and cloud platforms.

Identity & Access Security

  • Implement least privilege and Zero Trust security principles.
  • Manage privileged accounts across:
    • Windows Servers
    • Linux/Unix Servers
    • Databases
    • Network Devices
    • Cloud Platforms
    • Service Accounts
  • Conduct privileged account discovery and remediation activities.
  • Enforce role-based and attribute-based access controls.

Cloud PAM & Hybrid Security

  • Secure privileged access across:
    • Azure
    • AWS
    • Google Cloud Platform
  • Implement Just-In-Time (JIT) access and Just Enough Administration (JEA).
  • Integrate PAM with cloud-native identity services.

Governance, Risk & Compliance

  • Support compliance initiatives including:
    • ISO 27001
    • SOX
    • PCI-DSS
    • HIPAA
    • GDPR
    • NIST
  • Conduct access reviews and privileged entitlement certifications.
  • Participate in internal and external security audits.
  • Prepare compliance reports and executive dashboards.

Security Operations

  • Monitor privileged account activities.
  • Investigate suspicious privileged access events.
  • Collaborate with SOC teams on incident response activities.
  • Support cyber threat hunting and forensic investigations involving privileged accounts.

Automation & Integration

  • Develop automation using:
    • PowerShell
    • Python
    • REST APIs
    • Shell Scripting
  • Integrate PAM with:
    • SIEM platforms
    • ITSM platforms
    • Identity Governance solutions
  • Automate account onboarding and lifecycle management.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Lead PAM projects and modernization initiatives.
  • Mentor junior PAM engineers and security analysts.
  • Work closely with security architects, infrastructure teams, auditors, and business stakeholders.
  • Provide executive-level reporting on PAM maturity and risk posture.

Required Technical Skills

PAM Platforms

  • CyberArk PAS
  • CyberArk EPM
  • CyberArk PSM
  • CyberArk CPM
  • BeyondTrust PAM
  • Delinea Secret Server
  • One Identity Safeguard
  • ARCON PAM

Identity & Directory Services

  • Active Directory
  • Azure Active Directory (Entra ID)
  • LDAP
  • SSO
  • Federation Services

Security Technologies

  • IAM
  • PIM
  • MFA
  • Zero Trust
  • PKI
  • EDR/XDR
  • SIEM
  • Vulnerability Management

Cloud Security

  • Azure Security
  • AWS IAM
  • GCP IAM
  • Kubernetes Security
  • Secrets Management

Scripting & Automation

  • PowerShell
  • Python
  • Bash/Shell Scripting
  • REST API Integration

Required Experience

  • 10-12 years of overall IT/Security experience.
  • 5+ years of dedicated Privileged Access Management experience.
  • Hands-on implementation experience of CyberArk or equivalent PAM solutions.
  • Experience managing enterprise-scale PAM environments.
  • Strong understanding of Identity & Access Management concepts.
  • Experience with hybrid cloud and multi-cloud privileged access governance.
  • Experience supporting security audits and compliance assessments.

Preferred Certifications

PAM / IAM Certifications

  • CyberArk Defender
  • CyberArk Sentry
  • CyberArk Guardian
  • CyberArk PAM Administration

Security Certifications

  • CISSP
  • CISM
  • CRISC
  • CEH
  • CompTIA Security+

Cloud Certifications

  • Microsoft Azure Security Engineer Associate
  • AWS Security Specialty
  • Google Cloud Security Engineer

Desired Competencies

  • Security leadership
  • Risk management
  • Stakeholder engagement
  • Problem-solving and analytical thinking
  • Executive communication
  • Project management
  • Compliance and governance expertise
  • Security architecture knowledge

KPIs / Success Metrics

  • % of privileged accounts onboarded to PAM
  • Reduction in standing privileged access
  • Privileged password rotation compliance
  • Audit findings closure rate
  • PAM platform availability
  • Access certification compliance
  • Reduction in privileged security incidents
  • JIT/JEA adoption percentage

Discover your future at Citi

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

Job Overview

Job Purpose

The Intermediate Analyst is responsible for reviewing, validating, and approving digital asset transactions processed by makers, while also executing complex or high-value instructions independently. This role ensures operational accuracy, security compliance, and timely execution of transactions on blockchain networks. The Intermediate Analyst also provides guidance to junior team members and contributes to maintaining a strong control environment.

Job Background / Context

The Digital Asset Custody Operations team ensures precise execution and confirmation of token transfers, reconciliations, and settlement reporting. This role combines quality assurance, oversight, and advanced transaction handling, while still maintaining active involvement in settlement processing within a 24/7 shift model to ensure continuous operational coverage.

Key Responsibilities

  • On-Chain Confirmation: Monitor blockchain explorers to ensure settlement completion within required timeframes through reviewing and validating instructions.


  • Process Adherence: Approve settlement transactions within defined authorization limits, ensuring compliance with internal procedures and security protocols.
  • Risk-Based handling: Execute high-value, urgent, or complex transactions requiring advanced verification steps.


  • Reconciliation: Compare on-chain transaction records with internal custody and settlement systems, manage complex breaks and support escalation of open breaks according to breaks escalation protocol.


  • Exception Handling: Investigate settlement exceptions, failed transactions, or delays, coordinating resolution with relevant teams.
  • Audit & Documentation: Maintain complete and accurate transaction logs, reports, and audit trails.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify recurring manual touchpoints and operational bottlenecks, actively proposing SOP enhancements and workflow fixes.


  • Training & Development: Assist in training and mentoring junior analysts on procedures and operational best practices.
  • Management Reporting: Support preparation of daily MIS, operational dashboards, and exception reports.
  • Shift Handover Rigor: Maintained disciplined end-of-shift logging and ensure seamless transition of pending transactions.


Qualifications & Skills Required

Education:

  • (good to have) Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Technology, Business Administration, or related field.

Experience:

  • 3–5 years of experience in settlements and reconciliations (digital asset or securities operations).
  • Prior checker or transaction authorization experience preferred.
  • Exposure to blockchain transaction flows, custody platforms, or on-chain reconciliation tools is advantageous.
  • Training of junior team members into independently performing officers.

Technical Skills:

  • Understanding of blockchain fundamentals and transaction verification methods.
  • Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel for reconciliation and reporting.

Core Competencies:

  • High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Good understanding of operational risk
  • Ability to collaborate with stakeholders from different functions, locations, and seniority levels.
  • Effective communication for escalation and problem solving.
  • Adaptability to continuously evolving digital asset technologies and processes.

Development Value

  • Gain in-depth experience in blockchain-based settlement oversight and operational risk management.
  • Opportunity to progress into team leadership or specialist roles within Digital Asset Operations.

title: Threat Management Lead
descriptionHtml:
Location: Pune Employment Type: full-time

Job Details



Position Summary

The Threat Management Lead will be responsible for strengthening the organization's cybersecurity threat detection and response capabilities through proactive threat hunting, detection engineering, and

threat intelligence analysis. The role will lead initiatives to identify emerging cyber threats, develop and optimize security detection mechanisms, and improve visibility across the organization's IT infrastructure, applications,and cloud environments.



The individual will leverage internal security telemetry, external threat intelligence feeds, and industry threat-sharing communities to identify potential attack patterns, develop actionable detection strategies,

and proactively uncover adversarial activities that may bypass conventional security controls.




The role requires prior hands-on experience as a SOC Analyst, along with strong expertise in threat detection, security monitoring, incident investigation, and threat hunting.



Key Responsibilities



Detection Engineering

  • Design, develop, implement, and continuously fine-tune custom threat detection rules and use cases.
  • Map detection capabilities and security monitoring coverage against the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
  • Identify detection gaps across endpoints, networks, applications, cloud platforms, and enterprise environments.
  • Develop and optimize SIEM detection rules,correlation logic, behavioral analytics, and automated alerts.
  • Collaborate with SOC and incident response teams to improve detection accuracy and minimize false positives.
  • Develop and enhance threat detection use cases to identify unauthorized access, suspicious activity, data exfiltration, and potential compromise involving sensitive healthcare information and patient data.
  • Design and optimize security monitoring mechanisms to detect anomalous access patterns, potential data breaches, and threats targeting systems that store, process, or transmit Electronic Protected Health Information (ePHI).


Threat Intelligence Management

  • Collect, analyze, and operationalize threat intelligence from internal security telemetry, commercial intelligence feeds, open-source intelligence (OSINT), and Information Sharing and Analysis Centers (ISACs).
  • Analyze emerging threat actors, attack techniques,indicators of compromise (IOCs), and adversarial tactics.
  • Translate threat intelligence into actionable detection rules, threat-hunting hypotheses, and security priorities.
  • Maintain awareness of evolving cyber threats,vulnerabilities, attack campaigns, and industry-specific risks.
  • Establish processes for integrating threat intelligence into security monitoring and incident response operations.


Proactive Threat Hunting

  • Lead proactive threat-hunting activities to identify suspicious behavior and advanced adversarial activities that may bypass automated security tools.
  • Develop threat-hunting hypotheses based on intelligence reports, MITRE ATT&CK techniques, and observed security events.
  • Investigate abnormal activities across endpoint, network, identity, application, and cloud environments.
  • Perform advanced log analysis, event correlation, and behavioral analysis to uncover hidden threats.
  • Document hunting findings and translate identified threats into improved detection mechanisms and security controls.


SOC Operations & Incident Investigation

  • Leverage previous SOC Analyst experience to support security monitoring, alert triage, incident investigation, and threat analysis.
  • Work closely with SOC analysts and incident response teams to improve threat detection and investigation processes.
  • Support root cause analysis of security incidents and recommend preventive and corrective security measures.
  • Improve SOC detection maturity through continuous feedback, knowledge sharing, and process optimization.


Leadership & Continuous Improvement

  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to SOC analysts and threat detection engineers.
  • Establish detection engineering and threat-hunting standards, methodologies, and operational metrics.
  • Track detection coverage, threat-hunting effectiveness, false-positive rates, and detection gaps.
  • Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, application security, and security operations teams to strengthen the organization's overall security posture.


Mandatory Skills & Qualifications

  • 8–10 years of experience in cybersecurity, with prior hands-on experience as a SOC Analyst.
  • Strong experience in threat detection engineering, threat intelligence analysis, and proactive threat hunting.
  • Hands-on experience with SIEM platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, IBM QRadar, or similar tools.
  • Strong understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
  • Experience developing, implementing, and tuning custom detection rules and correlation use cases.
  • Strong knowledge of endpoint, network, identity, application, and cloud security monitoring.
  • Experience analyzing IOCs, security logs, behavioral patterns, and threat intelligence feeds.
  • Strong understanding of security incident investigation, malware behavior, attack patterns, and cyber threat landscape.
  • Ability to translate threat intelligence and hunting findings into actionable detection capabilities.
  • Understanding of security threats and monitoring requirements relevant to healthcare environments, including threats targeting patient information, healthcare applications, and systems containing Electronic Protected Health Information (ePHI).
  • Knowledge of healthcare data security, patient information protection, and security monitoring requirements associated with sensitive healthcare information.
  • Strong analytical, investigative, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with EDR/XDR platforms such as CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender, or Sentinel One.
  • Knowledge of detection languages and framework such as Sigma, YARA, KQL, SPL, or EQL.
  • Experience with SOAR platforms and security automation.
  • Understanding of cloud security monitoring across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Relevant certifications such as GIAC Certified Detection Analyst (GCDA), GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA), GIAC Cyber Threat Intelligence (GCTI), or equivalent.
  • Experience working with commercial threat intelligence platforms and ISAC communities, HIPAA awareness


Experience & Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline.
  • 8–10 years of relevant cybersecurity experience.
  • Prior experience working in a Security Operations Center (SOC) is mandatory.
  • Experience leading or mentoring technical security teams is preferred.

title: Manager, Security Operations Centre
descriptionHtml:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale.


Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams.


How you’ll make an impact:

  • Lead, mentor and grow the Security Operations Center (SOC) team, including hiring, shift scheduling, training, performance management and career development.
  • Oversee daily alert triage, investigation and escalation across endpoint, identity, email, cloud and network, so cases are handled accurately and within SLA.
  • Partner with Security Engineering on detection content: share feedback on false positives, request new use cases based on what analysts see, and identify gaps in log source coverage.
  • Help prioritize and validate new data source onboarding into the SIEM so that analysts get usable, high-quality telemetry.
  • Build and maintain playbooks, runbooks and escalation procedures, and find candidates for SOAR automation.
  • Run the SOC's threat-hunting operations, including scheduled and intelligence-driven hunts based on current threats relevant to our industry.
  • Coordinate SOC participation in purple-team exercises and assess analyst detection, triage and response performance.
  • Turn hunt and exercise results into playbook updates, analyst training, and documented coverage gaps for Engineering.
  • Define and report SOC metrics (alert volume, MTTA/MTTR, SLA adherence, escalation quality, DLP trends) to security leadership.
  • Run quality reviews, tabletop exercises and ongoing training to raise analyst capability.
  • Excellent problem-solving, organizational, analytical and critical thinking skills including high discretion/judgment in decision making.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and interpersonal relationship skills including negotiating and relationship management skills with ability to drive achievement of objectives.
  • Strict attention to detail.
  • Ability to work and excel within a fast paced, dynamic, and constantly changing work environment.

What you’ll need (Required):

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field or equivalent work experience based on Edwards criteria Required.
  • 8+ years in cybersecurity, with at least 5+ in SOC operations or incident response.

What else we look for (Preferred):

  • Strong hands-on investigation experience using an enterprise SIEM (e.g., Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Google SecOps/Chronicle, QRadar) and EDR tools (e.g., CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender).
  • Proven ability to build processes, SLAs, metrics and documentation for an operations team.
  • Solid understanding of common attack patterns: phishing, credential compromise, malware, lateral movement and data exfiltration, mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Certifications such as GCIH, GCIA, GSOC, CySA+, Security+ or CISSP.
  • Experience in regulated industries (medical devices, healthcare, pharma), including HIPAA, GDPR or ISO 27001.
  • Experience with SOAR platforms or basic scripting (Python, PowerShell).
    • Experience working with an MSSP/MDR partner or in a follow-the-sun global SOC.
