Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

Position Summary
The Insider Risk Manager will help to establish and lead the Insider Risk team in Pune, India. This role is responsible for overseeing daily insider risk operations, coordinating investigations, and ensuring the team provides timely, consistent, and effective response support. The Insider Risk Manager will strengthen insider risk detection and response capabilities across the full incident lifecycle, including triage, investigation coordination, containment, remediation, and process improvement. The role requires strong technical expertise in incident response, SOC operations, and security tooling, as well as the leadership skills to hire, mentor, and develop a high-performing team in India.


Primary Duties and Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership: Lead the Insider Risk team in Pune, including hiring, onboarding, training, mentoring, coaching, and performance management for analysts and responders.
  • Incident Operations: Oversee daily insider risk detection and response activities, ensuring incidents are triaged, investigated, escalated, and resolved in a timely and consistent manner.
  • Escalation Management: Serve as the escalation point for high-priority or complex insider risk incidents, coordinating response actions and communications with global stakeholders.
  • Process Development: Develop, maintain, and continuously improve insider risk response playbooks, runbooks, standard operating procedures, and response workflows.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with HR, Legal, Privacy, CSIRT, IT, Compliance, and Corporate Security teams to align investigation processes, technology use, reporting standards, and stakeholder communications.
  • Cyber Defense Collaboration: Collaborate with threat intelligence, vulnerability management, digital forensics, and CSIRT teams to support a unified cyber defense strategy.
  • Reporting and Metrics: Provide executive-level reporting on incident trends, operational performance, key metrics, and emerging risks.
  • Continuous Improvement: Drive ongoing enhancements to insider risk detection rules, automation opportunities, response processes, and operational effectiveness.

Education and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related discipline required; Master’s degree preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of incident response methodology, SOC operations, and security frameworks (e.g., NIST, MITRE ATT&CK).
  • Familiarity with global privacy and compliance requirements relevant to incident handling.

Preferred Certifications

  • GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH)
  • GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA)
  • GIAC Certified Forensic Analyst (GCFA)
  • Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)
  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)

.

Work Experience

  • 8+ years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, with at least 6 years focused on Insider risk reponse, data loss prevention triage and investigation, SOC operations or incident response.
  • Minimum of 4 years in a people management role, leading incident response or SOC analyst teams.
  • Hands-on experience with SIEM, EDR, DLP, SOAR, and forensic tools.
  • Proven experience responding to advanced threats, large scale data exfiltration campaigns, data loss prevention detection engineering and tuning, and insider incidents.
  • Demonstrated success in building or scaling security operations and incident response teams in a global enterprise environment.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to brief technical and non-technical stakeholders during incidents.

What Cencora offers

Benefit offerings outside the US may vary by country and will be aligned to local market practice. The eligibility and effective date may differ for some benefits and for team members covered under collective bargaining agreements.

title: SOC Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

We are looking for a motivated SOC Analyst to join our Security Operations Center (SOC) and help protect the organisation’s digital environment. In this role, you will monitor security events, investigate alerts, and support the response to cybersecurity incidents using a range of security technologies.
You will work closely with internal teams and stakeholders across the business, communicating with both technical and non-technical audiences. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to operational documentation, playbooks, and process improvements while building experience in a collaborative, global cybersecurity environment.

We are looking for a motivated SOC Analyst to join our Security Operations Center (SOC) and help protect the organisation’s digital environment. In this role, you will monitor security events, investigate alerts, and support the response to cybersecurity incidents using a range of security technologies.

You will work closely with internal teams and stakeholders across the business, communicating with both technical and non-technical audiences. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to operational documentation, playbooks, and process improvements while building experience in a collaborative, global cybersecurity environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor security alerts and events to identify potential threats, intrusions, or indicators of compromise.
  • Investigate, triage, and support the response to cybersecurity incidents in line with established procedures and playbooks.
  • Analyse alert and event data to assess severity, impact, and appropriate next steps.
  • Work with internal teams to support incident investigation, containment, and remediation activities.
  • Collaborate with the Cybersecurity Detection team to help improve detection use cases and monitoring capabilities.
  • Contribute to the tuning and optimisation of monitoring tools and detection rules to improve alert quality and reduce false positives.
  • Maintain clear and accurate documentation, including procedures, playbooks, and investigation notes.
  • Provide guidance to stakeholders on security risks and recommended actions where appropriate.
  • Identify opportunities to improve SOC processes and support automation initiatives that enhance operational efficiency.

Qualifications and Experience

  • A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience in cybersecurity, information security, IT operations, or a related technical area.
  • A foundational understanding of security monitoring, incident triage, and incident response processes.
  • Experience working in a global environment would be an advantage.

Skills and Knowledge

  • Knowledge of security technologies such as SIEM, EDR, firewalls, and related monitoring tools.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint; familiarity with other Microsoft Defender tools would be beneficial.
  • A good understanding of common security concepts, methodologies, and operational processes.
  • Knowledge of computer networks, operating systems, and basic scripting or programming.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with ServiceNow & ServiceNow Security Incident Response (SIR).
  • Experience supporting or implementing SOC process automation.
  • Exposure to working in a global or multi-regional security operations environment.

Relevant Certifications

  • Microsoft SC-200
  • Microsoft AZ-500
  • CompTIA Security+
  • CompTIA CySA+
  • Blue Team Level 1
  • Blue Team Level 2

Who we are: We are a team of more than 72,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.

How we work: When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

To find out more about Healthineers’ specific businesses, please visit our company page here.

As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.

For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile also lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open. Register here to get started.

These scammers may attempt to collect your confidential personal or financial information. If you are concerned that an offer of employment with Siemens Healthineers might be a scam or that the recruiter is not legitimate, please verify by searching for the posting on the Siemens Healthineers career site.

Siemens Healthineers is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.

title: Senior SOC Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Role: Senior SOC Analyst

Location: Pune (Maharashtra)


Life Unlimited. As a SOC Analyst you will support the response efforts for the critical incidents on the Smith & Nephew network, systems, and applications, including the technical direction of the incident response, work with other global SOC team members, and reports to the Local SOC team lead. Partnering closely with other functions within the Cybersecurity, you will participate in multi-functional teamwork, communication, and documentation activities related to containing and remediating the incident.


What will you be doing?

  • (40%) Manage incident response activities for critical incidents, to include the initial triage, incident record, accuracy of data and reporting, incident timeline, root cause, and impact assessment
  • (40%) Uses our technology platforms and security tools to conduct investigations and collect/examine endpoint and network-based evidence
  • (10%) Write comprehensive reports including assessment-based findings, outcomes, and propositions for further system security improvement
    • (10%) On Call for Security Incidents as needed.

What will you need to be successful?

  • 3+ years of demonstrable experience in Cyber Incident Response that must include experience in:

  • Identification and response to existing and emerging threats
  • Identification of attacker tools, tactics, and procedures (TTPs)
  • Security data analysis from a variety of sources and tools
  • TCP/IP, DNS, SIEM, and EDR technologies (Splunk, Crowd-Strike, Carbon Black, etc.)
  • Windows' environments and related security controls (IDS/IPS, AV, Proxies, Firewalls, etc.)
  • Windows log analysis and memory forensics
  • Network traffic analysis
  • Ability to work flexible schedule that may include shift work
  • Detailed technical knowledge of database and operating system security
  • Experience with network security and networking technologies and with system, security, and network monitoring tools!
  • Detailed understanding of the latest security principles, techniques, and protocols
  • Familiarity with web related technologies (Web applications, Web Services, Service Oriented Architectures) and of network/web related protocols
  • Excellent Problem solving skills and ability to work under stress
  • Knowledge of cyber security standard frameworks such as ISO and NIST
    • Experience with different cloud computing platforms and the cloud security framework.

Competences:

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills!
  • Excellent customer service skills and problem resolution.
  • Experience in being able to handle and prioritize numerous tasks in an effective manner.
  • Ability to work independently without daily direction.
  • Understanding of back-channels typically used by actors for malicious activity.
  • Understanding of obfuscation techniques and standard methodologies for ensuring device non-attribution.
  • Understanding of one or more Technology Platforms (Windows, Linux, Middleware Applications, Database Applications) - specifically as they apply to successful security control mitigation and particularly to vulnerability management.
  • Understanding of distributed denial of service attack intelligence gathering, concepts, mitigation tools, and techniques.
  • Understanding of mobility security device and application risk and threat assessment.
  • Understanding of nation and non-nation state actors, hacktivist groups, advanced level of threats, and the "kill chain" methodology.
  • Familiarity with secure coding standard processes.
  • Strong communication & interpersonal skills, ability to multi-task, proven attention to details, excellent problem solving and follow-up skills required.

***Roles on this team are on a rotating schedule that includes weekend shifts.


You Unlimited.

We believe in crafting the greatest good for society. Our strongest investments are in our people and the patients we serve.

Inclusion + Belonging: Committed to Welcoming, Celebrating and Thriving., Learn more about Employee Inclusion Groups on our website ( https://www.smith-nephew.com/ ).

Other reasons why you will love it here!

  • Your Future: Major medical coverage + policy exclusions and insurance non-medical limit. Educational Assistance.
  • Work/Life Balance : Flexible Personal/Vacation Time Off, Privilege Leave, Floater Leave.
  • Flexibility : Hybrid Work Model (For most professional roles)
  • Your Wellbeing: Parents/Parents-in-Law’s Insurance (Employer Contribution of 8,000/- annually), Employee Assistance Program, Parental Leave.
  • Training: Hands-On, Team-Customized, Mentorship.

Stay connected by joining our Talent Community .

We're more than just a company - we're a community! Follow us on LinkedIn to see how we support and empower our employees and patients every day.


Check us out on Glassdoor for a glimpse behind the scenes and a sneak peek into You. Unlimited. , life, culture, and benefits at S+N.

Explore our website and learn more about our mission, our team, and the opportunities we offer.

title: Security PAM
descriptionHtml:
Senior Security PAM (Privileged Access Management) Engineer/Lead

Experience: 10-12 Years

Location : Pune (Hybrid)

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Privileged Access Management (PAM) Engineer/Lead with 10-12 years of IT and Cybersecurity experience to design, implement, manage, and enhance enterprise PAM solutions. The role will be responsible for securing privileged accounts, enforcing least-privilege access, managing privileged session monitoring, password vaulting, and ensuring compliance with organizational security policies and regulatory requirements.

The ideal candidate should have extensive experience with PAM platforms such as CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Delinea (Thycotic), One Identity Safeguard, or ARCON , along with strong expertise in IAM, Active Directory, cloud security, and security governance.

Key Responsibilities

PAM Architecture & Administration

  • Design, deploy, and support enterprise PAM solutions.
  • Manage privileged account onboarding, password vaulting, credential rotation, and session monitoring.
  • Implement privileged session management and privileged threat analytics.
  • Configure password policies, access controls, workflows, and approval mechanisms.
  • Integrate PAM solutions with enterprise applications, databases, servers, network devices, and cloud platforms.

Identity & Access Security

  • Implement least privilege and Zero Trust security principles.
  • Manage privileged accounts across:
    • Windows Servers
    • Linux/Unix Servers
    • Databases
    • Network Devices
    • Cloud Platforms
    • Service Accounts
  • Conduct privileged account discovery and remediation activities.
  • Enforce role-based and attribute-based access controls.

Cloud PAM & Hybrid Security

  • Secure privileged access across:
    • Azure
    • AWS
    • Google Cloud Platform
  • Implement Just-In-Time (JIT) access and Just Enough Administration (JEA).
  • Integrate PAM with cloud-native identity services.

Governance, Risk & Compliance

  • Support compliance initiatives including:
    • ISO 27001
    • SOX
    • PCI-DSS
    • HIPAA
    • GDPR
    • NIST
  • Conduct access reviews and privileged entitlement certifications.
  • Participate in internal and external security audits.
  • Prepare compliance reports and executive dashboards.

Security Operations

  • Monitor privileged account activities.
  • Investigate suspicious privileged access events.
  • Collaborate with SOC teams on incident response activities.
  • Support cyber threat hunting and forensic investigations involving privileged accounts.

Automation & Integration

  • Develop automation using:
    • PowerShell
    • Python
    • REST APIs
    • Shell Scripting
  • Integrate PAM with:
    • SIEM platforms
    • ITSM platforms
    • Identity Governance solutions
  • Automate account onboarding and lifecycle management.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Lead PAM projects and modernization initiatives.
  • Mentor junior PAM engineers and security analysts.
  • Work closely with security architects, infrastructure teams, auditors, and business stakeholders.
  • Provide executive-level reporting on PAM maturity and risk posture.

Required Technical Skills

PAM Platforms

  • CyberArk PAS
  • CyberArk EPM
  • CyberArk PSM
  • CyberArk CPM
  • BeyondTrust PAM
  • Delinea Secret Server
  • One Identity Safeguard
  • ARCON PAM

Identity & Directory Services

  • Active Directory
  • Azure Active Directory (Entra ID)
  • LDAP
  • SSO
  • Federation Services

Security Technologies

  • IAM
  • PIM
  • MFA
  • Zero Trust
  • PKI
  • EDR/XDR
  • SIEM
  • Vulnerability Management

Cloud Security

  • Azure Security
  • AWS IAM
  • GCP IAM
  • Kubernetes Security
  • Secrets Management

Scripting & Automation

  • PowerShell
  • Python
  • Bash/Shell Scripting
  • REST API Integration

Required Experience

  • 10-12 years of overall IT/Security experience.
  • 5+ years of dedicated Privileged Access Management experience.
  • Hands-on implementation experience of CyberArk or equivalent PAM solutions.
  • Experience managing enterprise-scale PAM environments.
  • Strong understanding of Identity & Access Management concepts.
  • Experience with hybrid cloud and multi-cloud privileged access governance.
  • Experience supporting security audits and compliance assessments.

Preferred Certifications

PAM / IAM Certifications

  • CyberArk Defender
  • CyberArk Sentry
  • CyberArk Guardian
  • CyberArk PAM Administration

Security Certifications

  • CISSP
  • CISM
  • CRISC
  • CEH
  • CompTIA Security+

Cloud Certifications

  • Microsoft Azure Security Engineer Associate
  • AWS Security Specialty
  • Google Cloud Security Engineer

Desired Competencies

  • Security leadership
  • Risk management
  • Stakeholder engagement
  • Problem-solving and analytical thinking
  • Executive communication
  • Project management
  • Compliance and governance expertise
  • Security architecture knowledge

KPIs / Success Metrics

  • % of privileged accounts onboarded to PAM
  • Reduction in standing privileged access
  • Privileged password rotation compliance
  • Audit findings closure rate
  • PAM platform availability
  • Access certification compliance
  • Reduction in privileged security incidents
  • JIT/JEA adoption percentage

title: Securities & Derivatives Intmd Analyst (Digital Asset Custody Operations) - PUNE
descriptionHtml:
Discover your future at Citi

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

Job Overview

Job Purpose

The Intermediate Analyst is responsible for reviewing, validating, and approving digital asset transactions processed by makers, while also executing complex or high-value instructions independently. This role ensures operational accuracy, security compliance, and timely execution of transactions on blockchain networks. The Intermediate Analyst also provides guidance to junior team members and contributes to maintaining a strong control environment.

Job Background / Context

The Digital Asset Custody Operations team ensures precise execution and confirmation of token transfers, reconciliations, and settlement reporting. This role combines quality assurance, oversight, and advanced transaction handling, while still maintaining active involvement in settlement processing within a 24/7 shift model to ensure continuous operational coverage.

Key Responsibilities

  • On-Chain Confirmation: Monitor blockchain explorers to ensure settlement completion within required timeframes through reviewing and validating instructions.


  • Process Adherence: Approve settlement transactions within defined authorization limits, ensuring compliance with internal procedures and security protocols.
  • Risk-Based handling: Execute high-value, urgent, or complex transactions requiring advanced verification steps.


  • Reconciliation: Compare on-chain transaction records with internal custody and settlement systems, manage complex breaks and support escalation of open breaks according to breaks escalation protocol.


  • Exception Handling: Investigate settlement exceptions, failed transactions, or delays, coordinating resolution with relevant teams.
  • Audit & Documentation: Maintain complete and accurate transaction logs, reports, and audit trails.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify recurring manual touchpoints and operational bottlenecks, actively proposing SOP enhancements and workflow fixes.


  • Training & Development: Assist in training and mentoring junior analysts on procedures and operational best practices.
  • Management Reporting: Support preparation of daily MIS, operational dashboards, and exception reports.
  • Shift Handover Rigor: Maintained disciplined end-of-shift logging and ensure seamless transition of pending transactions.


Qualifications & Skills Required

Education:

  • (good to have) Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Technology, Business Administration, or related field.

Experience:

  • 3–5 years of experience in settlements and reconciliations (digital asset or securities operations).
  • Prior checker or transaction authorization experience preferred.
  • Exposure to blockchain transaction flows, custody platforms, or on-chain reconciliation tools is advantageous.
  • Training of junior team members into independently performing officers.

Technical Skills:

  • Understanding of blockchain fundamentals and transaction verification methods.
  • Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel for reconciliation and reporting.

Core Competencies:

  • High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Good understanding of operational risk
  • Ability to collaborate with stakeholders from different functions, locations, and seniority levels.
  • Effective communication for escalation and problem solving.
  • Adaptability to continuously evolving digital asset technologies and processes.

Development Value

  • Gain in-depth experience in blockchain-based settlement oversight and operational risk management.
  • Opportunity to progress into team leadership or specialist roles within Digital Asset Operations.

Full time

Please see the requirements listed above.

title: Threat Management Lead
descriptionHtml:
Location: Pune Employment Type: full-time

Job Details



Position Summary

The Threat Management Lead will be responsible for strengthening the organization's cybersecurity threat detection and response capabilities through proactive threat hunting, detection engineering, and

threat intelligence analysis. The role will lead initiatives to identify emerging cyber threats, develop and optimize security detection mechanisms, and improve visibility across the organization's IT infrastructure, applications,and cloud environments.



The individual will leverage internal security telemetry, external threat intelligence feeds, and industry threat-sharing communities to identify potential attack patterns, develop actionable detection strategies,

and proactively uncover adversarial activities that may bypass conventional security controls.




The role requires prior hands-on experience as a SOC Analyst, along with strong expertise in threat detection, security monitoring, incident investigation, and threat hunting.



Key Responsibilities



Detection Engineering

  • Design, develop, implement, and continuously fine-tune custom threat detection rules and use cases.
  • Map detection capabilities and security monitoring coverage against the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
  • Identify detection gaps across endpoints, networks, applications, cloud platforms, and enterprise environments.
  • Develop and optimize SIEM detection rules,correlation logic, behavioral analytics, and automated alerts.
  • Collaborate with SOC and incident response teams to improve detection accuracy and minimize false positives.
  • Develop and enhance threat detection use cases to identify unauthorized access, suspicious activity, data exfiltration, and potential compromise involving sensitive healthcare information and patient data.
  • Design and optimize security monitoring mechanisms to detect anomalous access patterns, potential data breaches, and threats targeting systems that store, process, or transmit Electronic Protected Health Information (ePHI).


Threat Intelligence Management

  • Collect, analyze, and operationalize threat intelligence from internal security telemetry, commercial intelligence feeds, open-source intelligence (OSINT), and Information Sharing and Analysis Centers (ISACs).
  • Analyze emerging threat actors, attack techniques,indicators of compromise (IOCs), and adversarial tactics.
  • Translate threat intelligence into actionable detection rules, threat-hunting hypotheses, and security priorities.
  • Maintain awareness of evolving cyber threats,vulnerabilities, attack campaigns, and industry-specific risks.
  • Establish processes for integrating threat intelligence into security monitoring and incident response operations.


Proactive Threat Hunting

  • Lead proactive threat-hunting activities to identify suspicious behavior and advanced adversarial activities that may bypass automated security tools.
  • Develop threat-hunting hypotheses based on intelligence reports, MITRE ATT&CK techniques, and observed security events.
  • Investigate abnormal activities across endpoint, network, identity, application, and cloud environments.
  • Perform advanced log analysis, event correlation, and behavioral analysis to uncover hidden threats.
  • Document hunting findings and translate identified threats into improved detection mechanisms and security controls.


SOC Operations & Incident Investigation

  • Leverage previous SOC Analyst experience to support security monitoring, alert triage, incident investigation, and threat analysis.
  • Work closely with SOC analysts and incident response teams to improve threat detection and investigation processes.
  • Support root cause analysis of security incidents and recommend preventive and corrective security measures.
  • Improve SOC detection maturity through continuous feedback, knowledge sharing, and process optimization.


Leadership & Continuous Improvement

  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to SOC analysts and threat detection engineers.
  • Establish detection engineering and threat-hunting standards, methodologies, and operational metrics.
  • Track detection coverage, threat-hunting effectiveness, false-positive rates, and detection gaps.
  • Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, application security, and security operations teams to strengthen the organization's overall security posture.


Mandatory Skills & Qualifications

  • 8–10 years of experience in cybersecurity, with prior hands-on experience as a SOC Analyst.
  • Strong experience in threat detection engineering, threat intelligence analysis, and proactive threat hunting.
  • Hands-on experience with SIEM platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, IBM QRadar, or similar tools.
  • Strong understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
  • Experience developing, implementing, and tuning custom detection rules and correlation use cases.
  • Strong knowledge of endpoint, network, identity, application, and cloud security monitoring.
  • Experience analyzing IOCs, security logs, behavioral patterns, and threat intelligence feeds.
  • Strong understanding of security incident investigation, malware behavior, attack patterns, and cyber threat landscape.
  • Ability to translate threat intelligence and hunting findings into actionable detection capabilities.
  • Understanding of security threats and monitoring requirements relevant to healthcare environments, including threats targeting patient information, healthcare applications, and systems containing Electronic Protected Health Information (ePHI).
  • Knowledge of healthcare data security, patient information protection, and security monitoring requirements associated with sensitive healthcare information.
  • Strong analytical, investigative, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with EDR/XDR platforms such as CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender, or Sentinel One.
  • Knowledge of detection languages and framework such as Sigma, YARA, KQL, SPL, or EQL.
  • Experience with SOAR platforms and security automation.
  • Understanding of cloud security monitoring across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Relevant certifications such as GIAC Certified Detection Analyst (GCDA), GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA), GIAC Cyber Threat Intelligence (GCTI), or equivalent.
  • Experience working with commercial threat intelligence platforms and ISAC communities, HIPAA awareness


Experience & Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline.
  • 8–10 years of relevant cybersecurity experience.
  • Prior experience working in a Security Operations Center (SOC) is mandatory.
  • Experience leading or mentoring technical security teams is preferred.

title: Manager, Security Operations Centre
descriptionHtml:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale.


Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams.


How you’ll make an impact:

  • Lead, mentor and grow the Security Operations Center (SOC) team, including hiring, shift scheduling, training, performance management and career development.
  • Oversee daily alert triage, investigation and escalation across endpoint, identity, email, cloud and network, so cases are handled accurately and within SLA.
  • Partner with Security Engineering on detection content: share feedback on false positives, request new use cases based on what analysts see, and identify gaps in log source coverage.
  • Help prioritize and validate new data source onboarding into the SIEM so that analysts get usable, high-quality telemetry.
  • Build and maintain playbooks, runbooks and escalation procedures, and find candidates for SOAR automation.
  • Run the SOC's threat-hunting operations, including scheduled and intelligence-driven hunts based on current threats relevant to our industry.
  • Coordinate SOC participation in purple-team exercises and assess analyst detection, triage and response performance.
  • Turn hunt and exercise results into playbook updates, analyst training, and documented coverage gaps for Engineering.
  • Define and report SOC metrics (alert volume, MTTA/MTTR, SLA adherence, escalation quality, DLP trends) to security leadership.
  • Run quality reviews, tabletop exercises and ongoing training to raise analyst capability.
  • Excellent problem-solving, organizational, analytical and critical thinking skills including high discretion/judgment in decision making.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and interpersonal relationship skills including negotiating and relationship management skills with ability to drive achievement of objectives.
  • Strict attention to detail.
  • Ability to work and excel within a fast paced, dynamic, and constantly changing work environment.

What you’ll need (Required):

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field or equivalent work experience based on Edwards criteria Required.
  • 8+ years in cybersecurity, with at least 5+ in SOC operations or incident response.

What else we look for (Preferred):

  • Strong hands-on investigation experience using an enterprise SIEM (e.g., Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Google SecOps/Chronicle, QRadar) and EDR tools (e.g., CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender).
  • Proven ability to build processes, SLAs, metrics and documentation for an operations team.
  • Solid understanding of common attack patterns: phishing, credential compromise, malware, lateral movement and data exfiltration, mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Certifications such as GCIH, GCIA, GSOC, CySA+, Security+ or CISSP.
  • Experience in regulated industries (medical devices, healthcare, pharma), including HIPAA, GDPR or ISO 27001.
  • Experience with SOAR platforms or basic scripting (Python, PowerShell).
    • Experience working with an MSSP/MDR partner or in a follow-the-sun global SOC.

Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

Position Summary
The Insider Risk Manager will help to establish and lead the Insider Risk team in Pune, India. This role is responsible for overseeing daily insider risk operations, coordinating investigations, and ensuring the team provides timely, consistent, and effective response support. The Insider Risk Manager will strengthen insider risk detection and response capabilities across the full incident lifecycle, including triage, investigation coordination, containment, remediation, and process improvement. The role requires strong technical expertise in incident response, SOC operations, and security tooling, as well as the leadership skills to hire, mentor, and develop a high-performing team in India.


Primary Duties and Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership: Lead the Insider Risk team in Pune, including hiring, onboarding, training, mentoring, coaching, and performance management for analysts and responders.
  • Incident Operations: Oversee daily insider risk detection and response activities, ensuring incidents are triaged, investigated, escalated, and resolved in a timely and consistent manner.
  • Escalation Management: Serve as the escalation point for high-priority or complex insider risk incidents, coordinating response actions and communications with global stakeholders.
  • Process Development: Develop, maintain, and continuously improve insider risk response playbooks, runbooks, standard operating procedures, and response workflows.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with HR, Legal, Privacy, CSIRT, IT, Compliance, and Corporate Security teams to align investigation processes, technology use, reporting standards, and stakeholder communications.
  • Cyber Defense Collaboration: Collaborate with threat intelligence, vulnerability management, digital forensics, and CSIRT teams to support a unified cyber defense strategy.
  • Reporting and Metrics: Provide executive-level reporting on incident trends, operational performance, key metrics, and emerging risks.
  • Continuous Improvement: Drive ongoing enhancements to insider risk detection rules, automation opportunities, response processes, and operational effectiveness.

Education and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related discipline required; Master’s degree preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of incident response methodology, SOC operations, and security frameworks (e.g., NIST, MITRE ATT&CK).
  • Familiarity with global privacy and compliance requirements relevant to incident handling.

Preferred Certifications

  • GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH)
  • GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA)

title: SOC Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

We are looking for a motivated SOC Analyst to join our Security Operations Center (SOC) and help protect the organisation’s digital environment. In this role, you will monitor security events, investigate alerts, and support the response to cybersecurity incidents using a range of security technologies.
You will work closely with internal teams and stakeholders across the business, communicating with both technical and non-technical audiences. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to operational documentation, playbooks, and process improvements while building experience in a collaborative, global cybersecurity environment.

We are looking for a motivated SOC Analyst to join our Security Operations Center (SOC) and help protect the organisation’s digital environment. In this role, you will monitor security events, investigate alerts, and support the response to cybersecurity incidents using a range of security technologies.

You will work closely with internal teams and stakeholders across the business, communicating with both technical and non-technical audiences. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to operational documentation, playbooks, and process improvements while building experience in a collaborative, global cybersecurity environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor security alerts and events to identify potential threats, intrusions, or indicators of compromise.
  • Investigate, triage, and support the response to cybersecurity incidents in line with established procedures and playbooks.
  • Analyse alert and event data to assess severity, impact, and appropriate next steps.
  • Work with internal teams to support incident investigation, containment, and remediation activities.
  • Collaborate with the Cybersecurity Detection team to help improve detection use cases and monitoring capabilities.
  • Contribute to the tuning and optimisation of monitoring tools and detection rules to improve alert quality and reduce false positives.
  • Maintain clear and accurate documentation, including procedures, playbooks, and investigation notes.
  • Provide guidance to stakeholders on security risks and recommended actions where appropriate.
  • Identify opportunities to improve SOC processes and support automation initiatives that enhance operational efficiency.

Qualifications and Experience

  • A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience in cybersecurity, information security, IT operations, or a related technical area.
  • A foundational understanding of security monitoring, incident triage, and incident response processes.
  • Experience working in a global environment would be an advantage.

Skills and Knowledge

  • Knowledge of security technologies such as SIEM, EDR, firewalls, and related monitoring tools.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint; familiarity with other Microsoft Defender tools would be beneficial.
  • A good understanding of common security concepts, methodologies, and operational processes.
  • Knowledge of computer networks, operating systems, and basic scripting or programming.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with ServiceNow & ServiceNow Security Incident Response (SIR).
  • Experience supporting or implementing SOC process automation.
  • Exposure to working in a global or multi-regional security operations environment.

Relevant Certifications

  • Microsoft SC-200
  • Microsoft AZ-500
  • CompTIA Security+
  • CompTIA CySA+
  • Blue Team Level 1
  • Blue Team Level 2

Who we are: We are a team of more than 72,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.

How we work: When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

To find out more about Healthineers’ specific businesses, please visit our company page here.

As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.

Data Privacy: We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile also lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open. Register here to get started.

Beware of Job Scams: Please beware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as Siemens Healthineers recruiters/employees. These scammers may attempt to collect your confidential personal or financial information. If you are concerned that an offer of employment with Siemens Healthineers might be a scam or that the recruiter is not legitimate, please verify by searching for the posting on the Siemens Healthineers career site.

To all recruitment agencies: Siemens Healthineers does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other company location. Siemens Healthineers is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.

descriptionHtml:
Role: Senior SOC Analyst

Location: Pune (Maharashtra)


Life Unlimited. As a SOC Analyst you will support the response efforts for the critical incidents on the Smith & Nephew network, systems, and applications, including the technical direction of the incident response, work with other global SOC team members, and reports to the Local SOC team lead. Partnering closely with other functions within the Cybersecurity, you will participate in multi-functional teamwork, communication, and documentation activities related to containing and remediating the incident.


What will you be doing?

  • (40%) Manage incident response activities for critical incidents, to include the initial triage, incident record, accuracy of data and reporting, incident timeline, root cause, and impact assessment
  • (40%) Uses our technology platforms and security tools to conduct investigations and collect/examine endpoint and network-based evidence
  • (10%) Write comprehensive reports including assessment-based findings, outcomes, and propositions for further system security improvement
    • (10%) On Call for Security Incidents as needed.

What will you need to be successful?

  • 3+ years of demonstrable experience in Cyber Incident Response that must include experience in:

  • Identification and response to existing and emerging threats
  • Identification of attacker tools, tactics, and procedures (TTPs)
  • Security data analysis from a variety of sources and tools
  • TCP/IP, DNS, SIEM, and EDR technologies (Splunk, Crowd-Strike, Carbon Black, etc.)
  • Windows' environments and related security controls (IDS/IPS, AV, Proxies, Firewalls, etc.)
  • Windows log analysis and memory forensics
  • Network traffic analysis
  • Ability to work flexible schedule that may include shift work
  • Detailed technical knowledge of database and operating system security
  • Experience with network security and networking technologies and with system, security, and network monitoring tools!
  • Detailed understanding of the latest security principles, techniques, and protocols
  • Familiarity with web related technologies (Web applications, Web Services, Service Oriented Architectures) and of network/web related protocols
  • Excellent Problem solving skills and ability to work under stress
  • Knowledge of cyber security standard frameworks such as ISO and NIST
    • Experience with different cloud computing platforms and the cloud security framework.

Competences:

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills!
  • Excellent customer service skills and problem resolution.
  • Experience in being able to handle and prioritize numerous tasks in an effective manner.
  • Ability to work independently without daily direction.
  • Understanding of back-channels typically used by actors for malicious activity.
  • Understanding of obfuscation techniques and standard methodologies for ensuring device non-attribution.
  • Understanding of one or more Technology Platforms (Windows, Linux, Middleware Applications, Database Applications) - specifically as they apply to successful security control mitigation and particularly to vulnerability management.
  • Understanding of distributed denial of service attack intelligence gathering, concepts, mitigation tools, and techniques.
  • Understanding of mobility security device and application risk and threat assessment.
  • Understanding of nation and non-nation state actors, hacktivist groups, advanced level of threats, and the "kill chain" methodology.
  • Familiarity with secure coding standard processes.
  • Strong communication & interpersonal skills, ability to multi-task, proven attention to details, excellent problem solving and follow-up skills required.

***Roles on this team are on a rotating schedule that includes weekend shifts.


You Unlimited.

We believe in crafting the greatest good for society. Our strongest investments are in our people and the patients we serve.

Inclusion + Belonging: Committed to Welcoming, Celebrating and Thriving., Learn more about Employee Inclusion Groups on our website ( https://www.smith-nephew.com/ ).

Other reasons why you will love it here!

  • Your Future: Major medical coverage + policy exclusions and insurance non-medical limit. Educational Assistance.
  • Work/Life Balance : Flexible Personal/Vacation Time Off, Privilege Leave, Floater Leave.
  • Flexibility : Hybrid Work Model (For most professional roles)
  • Your Wellbeing: Parents/Parents-in-Law’s Insurance (Employer Contribution of 8,000/- annually), Employee Assistance Program, Parental Leave.
  • Training: Hands-On, Team-Customized, Mentorship.

Stay connected by joining our Talent Community .

We're more than just a company - we're a community! Follow us on LinkedIn to see how we support and empower our employees and patients every day.


Check us out on Glassdoor for a glimpse behind the scenes and a sneak peek into You. Unlimited. , life, culture, and benefits at S+N.

title: Security PAM
descriptionHtml:
Senior Security PAM (Privileged Access Management) Engineer/Lead

Experience: 10-12 Years

Location : Pune (Hybrid)

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Privileged Access Management (PAM) Engineer/Lead with 10-12 years of IT and Cybersecurity experience to design, implement, manage, and enhance enterprise PAM solutions. The role will be responsible for securing privileged accounts, enforcing least-privilege access, managing privileged session monitoring, password vaulting, and ensuring compliance with organizational security policies and regulatory requirements.

The ideal candidate should have extensive experience with PAM platforms such as CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Delinea (Thycotic), One Identity Safeguard, or ARCON , along with strong expertise in IAM, Active Directory, cloud security, and security governance.

Key Responsibilities

PAM Architecture & Administration

  • Design, deploy, and support enterprise PAM solutions.
  • Manage privileged account onboarding, password vaulting, credential rotation, and session monitoring.
  • Implement privileged session management and privileged threat analytics.
  • Configure password policies, access controls, workflows, and approval mechanisms.
  • Integrate PAM solutions with enterprise applications, databases, servers, network devices, and cloud platforms.

Identity & Access Security

  • Implement least privilege and Zero Trust security principles.
  • Manage privileged accounts across:
    • Windows Servers
    • Linux/Unix Servers
    • Databases
    • Network Devices
    • Cloud Platforms
    • Service Accounts
  • Conduct privileged account discovery and remediation activities.
  • Enforce role-based and attribute-based access controls.

Cloud PAM & Hybrid Security

  • Secure privileged access across:
    • Azure
    • AWS
    • Google Cloud Platform
  • Implement Just-In-Time (JIT) access and Just Enough Administration (JEA).
  • Integrate PAM with cloud-native identity services.

Governance, Risk & Compliance

  • Support compliance initiatives including:
    • ISO 27001
    • SOX
    • PCI-DSS
    • HIPAA
    • GDPR
    • NIST
  • Conduct access reviews and privileged entitlement certifications.
  • Participate in internal and external security audits.
  • Prepare compliance reports and executive dashboards.

Security Operations

  • Monitor privileged account activities.
  • Investigate suspicious privileged access events.
  • Collaborate with SOC teams on incident response activities.
  • Support cyber threat hunting and forensic investigations involving privileged accounts.

Automation & Integration

  • Develop automation using:
    • PowerShell
    • Python
    • REST APIs
    • Shell Scripting
  • Integrate PAM with:
    • SIEM platforms
    • ITSM platforms
    • Identity Governance solutions
  • Automate account onboarding and lifecycle management.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Lead PAM projects and modernization initiatives.
  • Mentor junior PAM engineers and security analysts.
  • Work closely with security architects, infrastructure teams, auditors, and business stakeholders.
  • Provide executive-level reporting on PAM maturity and risk posture.

Required Technical Skills

PAM Platforms

  • CyberArk PAS
  • CyberArk EPM
  • CyberArk PSM
  • CyberArk CPM
  • BeyondTrust PAM
  • Delinea Secret Server
  • One Identity Safeguard
  • ARCON PAM

title: Securities & Derivatives Intmd Analyst (Digital Asset Custody Operations) - PUNE
descriptionHtml:
Discover your future at Citi

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

Job Overview

Job Purpose

The Intermediate Analyst is responsible for reviewing, validating, and approving digital asset transactions processed by makers, while also executing complex or high-value instructions independently. This role ensures operational accuracy, security compliance, and timely execution of transactions on blockchain networks. The Intermediate Analyst also provides guidance to junior team members and contributes to maintaining a strong control environment.

Job Background / Context

The Digital Asset Custody Operations team ensures precise execution and confirmation of token transfers, reconciliations, and settlement reporting. This role combines quality assurance, oversight, and advanced transaction handling, while still maintaining active involvement in settlement processing within a 24/7 shift model to ensure continuous operational coverage.

Key Responsibilities

  • On-Chain Confirmation: Monitor blockchain explorers to ensure settlement completion within required timeframes through reviewing and validating instructions.


  • Process Adherence: Approve settlement transactions within defined authorization limits, ensuring compliance with internal procedures and security protocols.
  • Risk-Based handling: Execute high-value, urgent, or complex transactions requiring advanced verification steps.


  • Reconciliation: Compare on-chain transaction records with internal custody and settlement systems, manage complex breaks and support escalation of open breaks according to breaks escalation protocol.


  • Exception Handling: Investigate settlement exceptions, failed transactions, or delays, coordinating resolution with relevant teams.
  • Audit & Documentation: Maintain complete and accurate transaction logs, reports, and audit trails.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify recurring manual touchpoints and operational bottlenecks, actively proposing SOP enhancements and workflow fixes.


  • Training & Development: Assist in training and mentoring junior analysts on procedures and operational best practices.
  • Management Reporting: Support preparation of daily MIS, operational dashboards, and exception reports.
  • Shift Handover Rigor: Maintained disciplined end-of-shift logging and ensure seamless transition of pending transactions.


Qualifications & Skills Required

Education:

  • (good to have) Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Technology, Business Administration, or related field.

Experience:

  • 3–5 years of experience in settlements and reconciliations (digital asset or securities operations).
  • Prior checker or transaction authorization experience preferred.
  • Exposure to blockchain transaction flows, custody platforms, or on-chain reconciliation tools is advantageous.
  • Training of junior team members into independently performing officers.

Technical Skills:

  • Understanding of blockchain fundamentals and transaction verification methods.
  • Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel for reconciliation and reporting.

Core Competencies:

  • High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Good understanding of operational risk
  • Ability to collaborate with stakeholders from different functions, locations, and seniority levels.
  • Effective communication for escalation and problem solving.
  • Adaptability to continuously evolving digital asset technologies and processes.

Development Value

  • Gain in-depth experience in blockchain-based settlement oversight and operational risk management.
  • Opportunity to progress into team leadership or specialist roles within Digital Asset Operations.

Securities and Derivatives Processing

-

Full time

Please see the requirements listed above.

For complementary skills, please see above and/or contact the recruiter.

title: Threat Management Lead
descriptionHtml:
Location: Pune Employment Type: full-time

Job Details



Position Summary

The Threat Management Lead will be responsible for strengthening the organization's cybersecurity threat detection and response capabilities through proactive threat hunting, detection engineering, and

threat intelligence analysis. The role will lead initiatives to identify emerging cyber threats, develop and optimize security detection mechanisms, and improve visibility across the organization's IT infrastructure, applications,and cloud environments.



The individual will leverage internal security telemetry, external threat intelligence feeds, and industry threat-sharing communities to identify potential attack patterns, develop actionable detection strategies,

and proactively uncover adversarial activities that may bypass conventional security controls.




The role requires prior hands-on experience as a SOC Analyst, along with strong expertise in threat detection, security monitoring, incident investigation, and threat hunting.



Key Responsibilities



Detection Engineering

  • Design, develop, implement, and continuously fine-tune custom threat detection rules and use cases.
  • Map detection capabilities and security monitoring coverage against the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
  • Identify detection gaps across endpoints, networks, applications, cloud platforms, and enterprise environments.
  • Develop and optimize SIEM detection rules,correlation logic, behavioral analytics, and automated alerts.
  • Collaborate with SOC and incident response teams to improve detection accuracy and minimize false positives.
  • Develop and enhance threat detection use cases to identify unauthorized access, suspicious activity, data exfiltration, and potential compromise involving sensitive healthcare information and patient data.
  • Design and optimize security monitoring mechanisms to detect anomalous access patterns, potential data breaches, and threats targeting systems that store, process, or transmit Electronic Protected Health Information (ePHI).


Threat Intelligence Management

  • Collect, analyze, and operationalize threat intelligence from internal security telemetry, commercial intelligence feeds, open-source intelligence (OSINT), and Information Sharing and Analysis Centers (ISACs).
  • Analyze emerging threat actors, attack techniques,indicators of compromise (IOCs), and adversarial tactics.
  • Translate threat intelligence into actionable detection rules, threat-hunting hypotheses, and security priorities.
  • Maintain awareness of evolving cyber threats,vulnerabilities, attack campaigns, and industry-specific risks.
  • Establish processes for integrating threat intelligence into security monitoring and incident response operations.


Proactive Threat Hunting

  • Lead proactive threat-hunting activities to identify suspicious behavior and advanced adversarial activities that may bypass automated security tools.
  • Develop threat-hunting hypotheses based on intelligence reports, MITRE ATT&CK techniques, and observed security events.
  • Investigate abnormal activities across endpoint, network, identity, application, and cloud environments.
  • Perform advanced log analysis, event correlation, and behavioral analysis to uncover hidden threats.
  • Document hunting findings and translate identified threats into improved detection mechanisms and security controls.


SOC Operations & Incident Investigation

  • Leverage previous SOC Analyst experience to support security monitoring, alert triage, incident investigation, and threat analysis.
  • Work closely with SOC analysts and incident response teams to improve threat detection and investigation processes.
  • Support root cause analysis of security incidents and recommend preventive and corrective security measures.
  • Improve SOC detection maturity through continuous feedback, knowledge sharing, and process optimization.


Leadership & Continuous Improvement

  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to SOC analysts and threat detection engineers.
  • Establish detection engineering and threat-hunting standards, methodologies, and operational metrics.
  • Track detection coverage, threat-hunting effectiveness, false-positive rates, and detection gaps.
  • Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, application security, and security operations teams to strengthen the organization's overall security posture.


Mandatory Skills & Qualifications

  • 8–10 years of experience in cybersecurity, with prior hands-on experience as a SOC Analyst.
  • Strong experience in threat detection engineering, threat intelligence analysis, and proactive threat hunting.
  • Hands-on experience with SIEM platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, IBM QRadar, or similar tools.
  • Strong understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
  • Experience developing, implementing, and tuning custom detection rules and correlation use cases.
  • Strong knowledge of endpoint, network, identity, application, and cloud security monitoring.
  • Experience analyzing IOCs, security logs, behavioral patterns, and threat intelligence feeds.
  • Strong understanding of security incident investigation, malware behavior, attack patterns, and cyber threat landscape.
  • Ability to translate threat intelligence and hunting findings into actionable detection capabilities.
  • Understanding of security threats and monitoring requirements relevant to healthcare environments, including threats targeting patient information, healthcare applications, and systems containing Electronic Protected Health Information (ePHI).
  • Knowledge of healthcare data security, patient information protection, and security monitoring requirements associated with sensitive healthcare information.
  • Strong analytical, investigative, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with EDR/XDR platforms such as CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender, or Sentinel One.
  • Knowledge of detection languages and framework such as Sigma, YARA, KQL, SPL, or EQL.
  • Experience with SOAR platforms and security automation.
  • Understanding of cloud security monitoring across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Relevant certifications such as GIAC Certified Detection Analyst (GCDA), GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA), GIAC Cyber Threat Intelligence (GCTI), or equivalent.
  • Experience working with commercial threat intelligence platforms and ISAC communities, HIPAA awareness


Experience & Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline.
  • 8–10 years of relevant cybersecurity experience.
  • Prior experience working in a Security Operations Center (SOC) is mandatory.
  • Experience leading or mentoring technical security teams is preferred.

title: Manager, Security Operations Centre
descriptionHtml:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale.


Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams.


How you’ll make an impact:

  • Lead, mentor and grow the Security Operations Center (SOC) team, including hiring, shift scheduling, training, performance management and career development.
  • Oversee daily alert triage, investigation and escalation across endpoint, identity, email, cloud and network, so cases are handled accurately and within SLA.
  • Partner with Security Engineering on detection content: share feedback on false positives, request new use cases based on what analysts see, and identify gaps in log source coverage.
  • Help prioritize and validate new data source onboarding into the SIEM so that analysts get usable, high-quality telemetry.
  • Build and maintain playbooks, runbooks and escalation procedures, and find candidates for SOAR automation.
  • Run the SOC's threat-hunting operations, including scheduled and intelligence-driven hunts based on current threats relevant to our industry.
  • Coordinate SOC participation in purple-team exercises and assess analyst detection, triage and response performance.
  • Turn hunt and exercise results into playbook updates, analyst training, and documented coverage gaps for Engineering.
  • Define and report SOC metrics (alert volume, MTTA/MTTR, SLA adherence, escalation quality, DLP trends) to security leadership.
  • Run quality reviews, tabletop exercises and ongoing training to raise analyst capability.
  • Excellent problem-solving, organizational, analytical and critical thinking skills including high discretion/judgment in decision making.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and interpersonal relationship skills including negotiating and relationship management skills with ability to drive achievement of objectives.
  • Strict attention to detail.
  • Ability to work and excel within a fast paced, dynamic, and constantly changing work environment.

What you’ll need (Required):

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field or equivalent work experience based on Edwards criteria Required.
  • 8+ years in cybersecurity, with at least 5+ in SOC operations or incident response.

What else we look for (Preferred):

  • Strong hands-on investigation experience using an enterprise SIEM (e.g., Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Google SecOps/Chronicle, QRadar) and EDR tools (e.g., CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender).
  • Proven ability to build processes, SLAs, metrics and documentation for an operations team.
  • Solid understanding of common attack patterns: phishing, credential compromise, malware, lateral movement and data exfiltration, mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Certifications such as GCIH, GCIA, GSOC, CySA+, Security+ or CISSP.
  • Experience in regulated industries (medical devices, healthcare, pharma), including HIPAA, GDPR or ISO 27001.
  • Experience with SOAR platforms or basic scripting (Python, PowerShell).
    • Experience working with an MSSP/MDR partner or in a follow-the-sun global SOC.

Position Summary
The Insider Risk Manager will help to establish and lead the Insider Risk team in Pune, India. This role is responsible for overseeing daily insider risk operations, coordinating investigations, and ensuring the team provides timely, consistent, and effective response support.   • Familiarity with global privacy and compliance requirements relevant to incident handling.

Preferred Certifications

.

  • Hands-on experience with SIEM, EDR, DLP, SOAR, and forensic tools.
  • Proven experience responding to advanced threats, large scale data exfiltration campaigns, data loss prevention detection engineering and tuning, and insider incidents.

title: Cloud Identity Engineer (Microsoft Entra ID)
descriptionHtml:
About GCA

GCA Technology Services is a managed services provider (MSP) and consultancy that specializes exclusively in Identity and Access Management (IAM). For more than 20 years, we have helped organizations design, run, and improve the systems that control who has access to what. We hire selectively for integrity, passion, and expertise, and we work as a team of experts, not as individuals filling seats. Our work is client-driven: this position is opening to support a new GCA client, and over your tenure you can expect to work with multiple clients.

About the Role

You will own the Microsoft Entra ID platform for GCA's new client, which has a large hybrid Active Directory and Entra environment. As client needs change, you will move between clients. You will work alongside other GCA IAM engineers, and you are expected to lead most technical meetings with client stakeholders while only rarely needing a GCA escalation. You will make informed technical decisions on your own, escalating only when a decision carries material risk or falls outside your authority.

Responsibilities

  • Design, configure, and operate Conditional Access, multifactor authentication and authentication methods, Privileged Identity Management, and Identity Protection.
  • Onboard and troubleshoot application and single sign-on integrations, app registrations, and enterprise application consent.
  • Run access reviews and manage entitlements as part of identity governance.
  • Act as the primary technical contact for Entra: gather requirements, recommend designs, and lead working sessions with client stakeholders.
  • Follow each client's change management process, and document decisions and configurations.
  • Take on tickets, engineering, and project work as directed, across the full range of IAM needs.
  • Assist with Active Directory and hybrid identity work when it overlaps with Entra.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on identity engineering experience.
  • Hands-on production experience administering Entra ID at enterprise scale (thousands of users), including Conditional Access, MFA, PIM, and Identity Protection.
  • SSO integration experience (SAML, OIDC/OAuth), app registrations, and enterprise applications.
  • Access reviews, entitlement management, and identity governance fundamentals.
  • Able to run requirements and design meetings independently, with clear spoken and written English.
  • Sound judgment: makes informed technical decisions independently and escalates only when risk or scope warrants.
  • Comfortable working inside a client's change management process and writing clear documentation.
  • Hands-on experience rolling out passkeys, FIDO2, and Temporary Access Pass.
  • Microsoft SC-300 (Identity and Access Administrator) certification or equivalent.

Preferred Qualifications

  • HR-driven lifecycle provisioning and joiner, mover, and leaver workflows.
  • External and guest identities (B2B and cross-tenant access).
  • Device-aware access: hybrid join and Intune compliance signals used in Conditional Access.
  • Sign-in and audit log integration with a SIEM, and response to Identity Protection risk events.
  • Automation with Microsoft Graph and PowerShell.
  • Working knowledge of hybrid identity (Entra Cloud Sync or Entra Connect with Active Directory).

Bonus (Nice to Have)

  • Workload identity hygiene (service principals, app secrets and certificates).
  • Experience guiding or mentoring other engineers.

Working Arrangement

  • Employment: full-time employee (consultant), 40 hours per week.
  • Pay: ₹22,00,000 to ₹33,00,000 per year
  • Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific Time. In India this is an evening and overnight shift, about 9:30 PM to 6:30 AM IST (8:30 PM to 5:30 AM during US daylight saving time). Candidates must be able to work this schedule reliably.
  • Occasional work outside core hours may be needed for pre-scheduled change windows, arranged in advance.
  • Location: remote, based in India.
  • Language: fluent spoken and written English. This role works directly with client staff.
  • Day-to-day work is directed by GCA and its clients through each client's ticketing system and team meetings.
  • Assignment: the current need is driven by a new GCA client. As an MSP and consultancy, GCA expects you to work with multiple clients over your tenure.

Pay: ₹2,200,000.00 - ₹3,300,000.00 per year

Benefits:

  • Paid sick time
  • Paid time off
  • Work from home

Work Location: Remote

title: Cloud Network Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Profile: Cloud Network Engineer

Skills: AWS, Azure, GCP, Cloud Networking, VPC, VNET

Experience: 6+ Years

Working Hours: 3 hours per day Between 6 AM IST to 11 AM IST or 7 PM IST to 1 AM IST

Working Days: Monday To Friday

Location: Remote

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Cloud Network Engineer to design, implement, manage, and optimize secure and scalable cloud networking infrastructure. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with cloud networking services across AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), along with expertise in traditional networking concepts, network security, routing, and connectivity.

The candidate will be responsible for building reliable cloud network architectures, managing hybrid and multi-cloud connectivity, troubleshooting network issues, and ensuring high availability, performance, and security across cloud environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, and manage cloud network architectures across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP.
  • Configure and maintain VPCs, VNETs, subnets, route tables, NAT gateways, internet gateways, and network security groups.
  • Implement hybrid cloud connectivity using VPN, Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, and Cloud Interconnect.
  • Manage routing protocols and networking technologies, including BGP, OSPF, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and VLANs.
  • Configure and manage firewalls, load balancers, WAF, proxies, and network access control policies.
  • Monitor network performance, availability, latency, and bandwidth utilization.
  • Troubleshoot complex network connectivity, routing, DNS, and security-related issues.
  • Implement network segmentation, private connectivity, and secure access solutions.
  • Automate network provisioning and configuration using Terraform, Python, Ansible, or similar tools.
  • Collaborate with Cloud, DevOps, Security, and Infrastructure teams to ensure reliable cloud operations.
  • Develop network documentation, architecture diagrams, operational procedures, and troubleshooting guides.
  • Support disaster recovery, high availability, and business continuity initiatives.

Required Technical Skills

  • Strong understanding of cloud networking architecture.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS VPC, Azure Virtual Network, or GCP VPC.
  • Knowledge of routing, switching, subnetting, CIDR, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and NAT.
  • Experience with BGP, OSPF, IPsec VPN, and site-to-site connectivity.
  • Knowledge of cloud firewalls, security groups, ACLs, and network security policies.
  • Experience with load balancing and traffic management.
  • Understanding of hybrid and multi-cloud networking.
  • Experience with network monitoring and troubleshooting tools.
  • Scripting and automation experience using Python, Terraform, or Ansible.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AWS Transit Gateway, Azure Virtual WAN, or GCP Network Connectivity Center.
  • Knowledge of SD-WAN, SASE, Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), and software-defined networking.
  • Experience with Cisco, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Check Point, or other enterprise networking technologies.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes networking and container networking concepts.
  • Relevant certifications such as:
  • AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Network Engineer Associate
  • Cisco CCNP / CCIE
  • Google Professional Cloud Network Engineer

Pay: From ₹28,000.00 per month

Benefits:

  • Flexible schedule
  • Work from home

Experience:

  • Cloud: 5 years (Required)
  • Network engineering: 5 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote
