title: Security Engineer II - Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Security Engineer

About the Role

As a Security Engineer, you will be responsible for the design and development of Identity and Access Governance systems and microservices responsible for authentication, authorization, and single sign-on app integrations. You will build new Features, APIs, Rules, Workflows, Analytics, Tasks, and Reports for the Information Security org. You will also assist in defining Identity Security controls, best practices, and compliance controls for Uber’s internal workforce and services while staying at the forefront of security trends and software engineering best practices.

Design and build extensible access governance features, centralized and adaptive access management systems, and Risk Models for the organization.

The team is going through an exciting transformation of Identity and Access management solutions, and a strong engineer with an ability to think out-of-the-box and leverage AI/ML is going to be a tremendous addition to this team.

What the Candidate Will Do
  • Identity Architecture & Zero Trust: Design, build, and deploy resilient, scalable identity architectures and microservices incorporating Zero Trust principles and adaptive access management controls across internal Uber systems.
  • Authentication & Federation: Engineer and support robust authentication frameworks, SSO application integrations, MFA policies, and federation protocols across cloud and hybrid environments.
  • Lifecycle & Governance (JML & NHI): Implement and maintain automated Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) workflows, birthright provisioning, and Non-Human Identity (NHI) access governance across core platforms like SailPoint IIQ and LDAP.
  • Automation & Engineering: Apply software engineering best practices to build automated tooling, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), custom interfaces using JavaScript/CSS, and leverage AI productivity tools like Cursor or GitHub Copilot.
  • Collaboration & Consulting: Serve as technical lead on cross-functional engagements, authoring high-quality engineering design docs and acting as the voice of the security team while advocating for user empathy.
  • Compliance & Audits: Enforce RBAC/ABAC models, design access certification campaigns, and ensure alignment with identity security controls, best practices, and regulatory compliance standards.

Basic Qualifications
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in Information Security or Cybersecurity.
  • Experience with developing complex software systems scaling to millions of users with production-quality deployment, monitoring, and reliability.
  • Experience with large-scale distributed storage and database systems (SQL e.g. MySQL).
  • Experience with Web and Middleware technologies such as Nginx, Tomcat, and WebLogic.
  • Traffic management, service, and session load balancing skills (primarily HAProxy, NLB, and F5) are an added benefit.
  • Proven experience leveraging AI coding tools like Cursor or GitHub Copilot to enhance developer productivity.

title: Application Security Engineer - Fully Remote
descriptionHtml:
Top 3 Reasons To Join Us

  • 100% remote, with a global, diverse team
  • Working on the latest tech for the Insurtech Market Leader
  • Lead and shape how an AI-native security function finds and prevents vulnerabilities at the AI-native insurance platform of choice for the world’s leading insurers

About Us

At CoverGo, our mission is to empower all insurance companies to make insurance 100% digital and accessible to everyone.

  • We are a leading global no-code insurance platform for health, life, and P&C
  • We’re the winner of the Insurtech of the Year in all of Asia and other awards globally
  • We work with insurance enterprise clients such as AXA, Bupa, MSIG, Dai-ichi, Bank of China Group Insurance, and many more
  • We're an international, diverse team of over 200 people with 30 nationalities and team members working remotely from all over the world
  • We are fully funded and backed by reputable VC funds and strategic institutional investors
  • We have a global presence in Asia, EMEA and the Americas
  • We’ve grown our annualized revenue by over 30x since January 2021
  • We’re constantly working towards making CoverGo a workplace that you love coming to. We deeply believe that bringing together a diversity of thoughts, expressions, and perspectives is key to building the best culture for equally diverse communities all over the world

About The Role

CoverGo is hiring an Application Security Engineer to use AI to find and prevent vulnerabilities before they reach production, and to give engineering teams the tools and guardrails that stop vulnerabilities from being introduced in the first place. The Security team is small and growing, and works AI-first: everyone uses AI to automate their own work and to scale security across a large engineering organisation.

What You Will Do

  • Use AI tools such as Claude and OpenAI models to find and triage vulnerabilities in code, dependencies and designs before changes are merged.
  • Embed security checks into developer workflows and CI/CD pipelines so issues surface as code is written.
  • Select, configure and tune code-security tools such as GitHub Advanced Security, Snyk and Checkmarx, keeping the signal high enough that engineers act on the findings.
  • Build self-service tools, guardrails and guidance that help engineering teams prevent common vulnerability classes.
  • Partner with engineering leads and security champions across product teams to prioritise and fix findings.
  • Review security-relevant designs and changes, ranking risk by what an attacker could realistically reach.
  • Track and report on application-security risk and remediation progress.

What We Need

  • 3+ years in application security or a closely related security role.
  • An AI-native approach to securing software: you already use LLMs to find, detect and explain vulnerabilities.
  • Enough fluency in at least one modern programming language to read, understand and fix vulnerable code. A software-engineering background is not required.
  • Hands-on experience with code-security tools such as GitHub Advanced Security, Snyk or Checkmarx.
  • A solid grasp of common vulnerability classes, such as the OWASP Top 10, and how to prevent them.
  • A practical, enabling style of working with engineers.

Nice to have

  • Experience building custom security tooling or automations on LLM APIs.
  • Experience securing applications on AWS, Azure or GCP.
  • Experience in insurance, financial services or another regulated SaaS environment.

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • Paid Annual Leaves
  • Annual Performance Bonus
  • Health Insurance
  • Remote Work Allowance
  • Anniversary Bonus
  • Company activities and events
  • Learning and development plan

CoverGo Company Video

descriptionHtml:
Project description

We are seeking three Cloud Engineers to join POD4, focusing on the large-scale automation and standardization of cloud infrastructure across a multi-cloud environment. You will play a pivotal role in enabling Business Units (BUs) to adopt modern deployment patterns, moving away from manual configurations toward fully automated, scalable Infrastructure as Code (IaC) models in both AWS and Azure.

Responsibilities

IaC Development: Design, develop, and deploy cloud resources using Terraform to ensure consistent and repeatable infrastructure across AWS and Azure.

Image Engineering: Create and maintain server "Golden Images" by leveraging Packer and Ansible for automated configuration management.

Scripting & Automation: Utilize PowerShell, Bash, and Python to automate routine cloud tasks and streamline deployment workflows.

BU Enablement: Act as a DevOps consultant for various Business Units, supporting and guiding them in the transition to Terraform-based cloud deployments.

title: Network Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
FireMon delivers Network Security Policy Control for the Modern Enterprise.

Most enterprises run firewalls from multiple vendors alongside cloud security groups and microsegmentation platforms, and no single console can say whether it all works together. We believe policy is the control plane for network security: it defines what the environment should do, and the infrastructure carries it out. FireMon gives security teams one place to see, govern, and prove that their policy is doing what they intend, across on-prem, cloud, and hybrid environments.

The Network Security Engineer is responsible for Network Security software development, including collaborating on developing requirements, writing technical specifications, designing, coding, and working with a team on testing and deployment. This is a key, hands-on software development position that will work closely with other team members to develop new features and functions.


About the role

  • Partner with Product Management, Development, and other Engineers to install and support firewall management solutions for internal research and development (R&D).
  • Provide technical expertise during the application development process to support products and solutions from various vendors, including firewalls, routers, switches, IPS, proxies, and more.
  • Build and maintain test labs, assist in software design, and provide technical assistance to developers.
  • Assist in testing software solutions.
  • Gather all the technical requirements for integrating with the security devices. This includes reading administrator guides, user guides, CLI guides, etc.
  • Learn the security device's inner workings and convert that logic into a structure that the application can use.
  • Work in conjunction with product managers, architects, and developers to schedule, architect, and design software integration with the security devices.
  • Setup, manage and maintain security devices in the test lab to provide support for R&D and integration testing.
  • Create and execute test cases to ensure proper code functionality within the application.
  • Serve as a support escalation point for complex support issues involving device integration.
  • Create internal KB documentation for known configurations to assist with support issues.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or another related field of study or equivalent experience
  • 3 or more years of network design and support
  • Cisco, Check Point, Juniper, Palo Alto expertise
  • Expertise in the area of networking and/or security
  • Experience with packet trace and analysis techniques and tools
  • Experience with network security tools such as firewalls, IPS, routers, switches, proxies, etc.
  • Familiarity with virtualization technologies and platforms
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, presentation, and writing skills
  • Outstanding problem-solving skills, including the ability to meet a business requirement with a technical solution
  • Must be willing to work in a fast-paced environment with multiple roles and demonstrate high emotional intelligence
  • Regex experience
  • Flexible and able to handle and prioritize multiple tasks
  • Possess a positive attitude and work well with others
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior AI Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Senior AI Security Engineer

Location: Remote
Compensation: ₹3.28 LPM
Employment Type: Contractor Assignment
Engagement Duration: 4 Weeks
Experience Required: 5+ Years
Work Commitment: Full-time (40 hours/week) or Part-time (20 hours/week)
Time Zone Requirement: Minimum 4 hours of overlap with PST

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior AI Security Engineer to evaluate the effectiveness of Static Application Security Testing (SAST) tools in identifying vulnerabilities within Generative AI (GenAI) applications.

The role involves building and testing small, runnable AI agent and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) codebases containing realistic security vulnerabilities, particularly Sensitive Information Disclosure (SID) and Excessive Agency (EA).

You will develop vulnerable, fixed, and near-miss code variants, analyze security findings, validate results through testing, and document root causes and recommended security controls.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build runnable AI agent and RAG repositories containing realistic vulnerabilities across tool calling, memory, and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Develop vulnerable, fixed, and hard-negative code variations with minimal security-relevant differences.
  • Analyze and annotate source-to-sink paths, data flows, action paths, security controls, and root causes.
  • Identify and assess Sensitive Information Disclosure and Excessive Agency vulnerabilities.
  • Define authorization contexts, trust boundaries, and access control requirements.
  • Develop deterministic tests to validate vulnerable, fixed, and negative scenarios.
  • Evaluate security findings and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies.
  • Participate in security calibration, documentation, and peer review.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in Application Security, Product Security, or Security-focused Software Engineering.
  • Strong experience in secure code reviews and vulnerability assessment.
  • Hands-on knowledge of source-to-sink analysis, taint analysis, and SAST tools such as CodeQL or Semgrep.
  • Practical experience building LLM agents or RAG applications using:
  • LangChain
  • LlamaIndex
  • OpenAI / Anthropic SDKs
  • Model Context Protocol (MCP)
  • Strong understanding of authorization concepts, including OAuth, IAM, identity management, trust boundaries, multi-tenancy, and document-level access controls.
  • Production-level programming experience in Python and/or TypeScript.
  • Ability to distinguish genuine security vulnerabilities from false positives and non-findings.

Good to Have

  • Knowledge of OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and GenAI security risks.
  • Experience with MCP security and AI agent threat modeling.
  • Background in security evaluations, vulnerability research, or AI application security testing.

Engagement & Compensation

  • Compensation: ₹3.28 LPM
  • Duration: 4 weeks
  • Work Type: Remote contractor assignment
  • Commitment: Full-time (40 hours/week) or Part-time (20 hours/week)
  • PST Overlap: 4 hours mandatory
  • Benefits: This is a contractor assignment and does not include medical benefits or paid leave.

Selection Process / Vetting

Candidates will undergo the following evaluation stages:

  • ICF (Initial Competency/Technical Evaluation): Assessment of relevant technical knowledge and practical expertise.
  • Profile Review: Evaluation of professional experience, technical background, and relevant project exposure.

Both stages are mandatory for shortlisted candidates.

Who Should Apply?

This opportunity is ideal for experienced Application Security Engineers, Product Security Engineers, AI Security Engineers, and Security-focused Software Developers who have hands-on experience securing LLM-powered applications, AI agents, and RAG systems.

Interested candidates are encouraged to apply with an updated resume highlighting relevant AI security, LLM, SAST, and application security experience.

Pay: From ₹328,000.00 per month

Experience:

  • Cybersecurity Expert: 4 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

* Identify and assess Sensitive Information Disclosure and Excessive Agency vulnerabilities.
* Define authorization contexts, trust boundaries, and access control requirements.
* Develop deterministic tests to validate vulnerable, fixed, and negative scenarios.
* Evaluate security findings and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies.
* Participate in security calibration, documentation, and peer review.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* Minimum *5+ years of experience* in Application Security, Product Security, or Security-focused Software Engineering.
* Strong experience in secure code reviews and vulnerability assessment.
* Hands-on knowledge of source-to-sink analysis, taint analysis, and SAST tools such as CodeQL or Semgrep.
* Practical experience building LLM agents or RAG applications using:
* LangChain
* LlamaIndex
* OpenAI / Anthropic SDKs
* Model Context Protocol (MCP)
* Strong understanding of authorization concepts, including OAuth, IAM, identity management, trust boundaries, multi-tenancy, and document-level access controls.
* Production-level programming experience in Python and/or TypeScript.
* Ability to distinguish genuine security vulnerabilities from false positives and non-findings.

Good to Have

* Knowledge of OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and GenAI security risks.
* Experience with MCP security and AI agent threat modeling.
* Background in security evaluations, vulnerability research, or AI application security testing.

Engagement & Compensation

* *Compensation:* ₹3.28 LPM
* *Duration:* 4 weeks
* *Work Type:* Remote contractor assignment
* *Commitment:* Full-time (40 hours/week) or Part-time (20 hours/week)
* *PST Overlap:* 4 hours mandatory
* *Benefits:* This is a contractor assignment and does not include medical benefits or paid leave.

Selection Process / Vetting

Candidates will undergo the following evaluation stages:

* *ICF (Initial Competency/Technical Evaluation):* Assessment of relevant technical knowledge and practical expertise.
* *Profile Review:* Evaluation of professional experience, technical background, and relevant project exposure.

Both stages are mandatory for shortlisted candidates.

Who Should Apply?

This opportunity is ideal for experienced Application Security Engineers, Product Security Engineers, AI Security Engineers, and Security-focused Software Developers who have hands-on experience securing LLM-powered applications, AI agents, and RAG systems.

*Interested candidates are encouraged to apply with an updated resume highlighting relevant AI security, LLM, SAST, and application security experience.*

title: Security Engineer - Identity
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to take the lead in cutting-edge security engineering projects?

We are looking for a seasoned professional with deep Identity & Access Management experience, a strong background in cyber security, and a genuine passion for driving innovation in our growing security practice.

In this role, you’ll play a pivotal part in shaping and delivering key security initiatives. You’ll collaborate with talented teams, lead complex engineering efforts, and help elevate our security capabilities to the next level.

About Us

We are The Missing Link - one of Australia’s most awarded IT providers, now backed by global powerhouse Infosys. For over 28 years, we have helped businesses succeed with cutting-edge Cyber Security, IT & Cloud, and Automation solutions. With 200+ team members and a culture built on inclusion, innovation, and impact, we offer a workplace where you are valued, challenged, and supported to grow.

We are THE MISSING LINK between where you are and where you want to be.

Role and Responsibilities

The Security Engineer - Identity will work independently on large enterprise-scale projects and peer review documentation, and will be involved in:

  • Running design workshops with Enterprise Architects to create Detailed Level Designs for identity and access management solutions.
  • Designing and implementing identity governance and privileged access policies, including SoD, birthright access, certification, and policy violation remediation.
  • Implementing and configuring identity solutions including CyberArk Sentry, CyberArk CDE, CyberArk EPM, SailPoint and Saviynt.
  • Developing and customising connectors for onboarding target systems, including Active Directory, Azure Entra ID, Workday and SAP.
  • Configuring and maintaining identity workflows, access requests, certification, role management, provisioning tasks and rules.
  • Integrating identity solutions with enterprise systems and SaaS platforms using REST APIs, SCIM or custom connectors.
  • Creating dashboards and reports to support compliance, audit and business requirements.

This is an exceptional opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company in the cyber security space. We are committed to your development, offering ongoing training, coaching, and support to help you thrive and advance your career.


Requirements
  • Bachelor’s Degree in IT.
  • 3-5 years of experience working with Identity and Access Management solutions.
  • Experience with CyberArk Sentry and CyberArk CDE, including relevant implementation and configuration experience.
  • A SailPoint or Saviynt certification is required, with practical experience working with identity governance solutions.
  • Working knowledge of Azure Entra ID and experience with CyberArk EPM is required.
  • Strong understanding of identity lifecycle processes, RBAC, access certification and privileged access management.
  • Experience integrating identity solutions with both on-prem and cloud-based applications.
  • Proficiency with REST APIs, JSON, PowerShell, JavaScript and SQL.
  • Experience configuring workflows, access request policies, provisioning tasks and identity security controls.

Highly Desirable:

  • Understanding and working knowledge of frameworks and compliance standards, including but not limited to Essential Eight and NIST.

Benefits


A great company culture is very important to The Missing Link. Keeping everyone happy is one of our top priorities.

We genuinely care about our people and our culture. Here’s what you can expect:

  • A supportive, collaborative, and respectful environment
  • Strong focus on training, mentoring, and company‑paid certifications
  • Clear opportunities for career growth and advancement
  • Hybrid working arrangements based in Pune, India
  • A culture that encourages learning, innovation, and continuous improvement

title: Senior Software Security Engineer Lead
descriptionHtml:
Role - Software Security Engineer – Pod Lead

Rate - 2.73 LPM

Type of Role - Short-term contract

Engagement Type - Short Term Contract (3 month )

Availability - 8 hours per day with an overlap of 4 hours with PST.

Specifics - Cybersecurity engineers with any programming language background - 6 + YOE

Skill

6+ years of professional software engineering experience.

Expert-level proficiency in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C/C++, C#, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Kotlin, or Swift.

Strong understanding of software security concepts, including CWE, CVE, and the OWASP Top 10

Role Overview

We are seeking a Lead Software Security Engineer to lead a team of trainers who will develop high-quality training and evaluation tasks for frontier AI coding models and step in to perform tasks when there is a high volume. You will transform real-world open-source vulnerabilities—including CVEs, security advisories, and bug reports—into Harbor-format audit-and-patch tasks across multiple programming languages.

This role combines software security research, vulnerability reproduction, benchmark development, automated testing, and technical review. The goal is to create realistic tasks that evaluate whether AI systems can identify, understand, exploit, and securely remediate software vulnerabilities without relying on superficial pattern matching or known patches.

What does day-to-day look like

Plan task deliveries by batch, assign work across pod members, and track daily throughput against phase-specific targets.

Monitor pod progress, identify bottlenecks, and ensure tasks move through each stage of production on schedule.

Lead weekly client reporting, communicate delivery status, and raise risks early, including tooling issues, rate limits, safety blocks, and resource constraints.

Collaborate with the client to clarify requirements and align on scope, task volume, and difficulty changes.

Conduct final reviews of completed tasks to ensure they meet the required quality, security, reproducibility, and evaluation standards.

Calibrate Pod Leads and trainers on CWE classification, verifier robustness, task difficulty, and acceptance criteria.

Use throughput and quality data to forecast staffing needs for each project phase.

Initiate hiring and onboarding waves approximately three weeks ahead of projected capacity requirements.

Maintain clear documentation of delivery plans, risks, quality findings, throughput metrics, and staffing forecasts.

Requirements

6+ years of professional software engineering experience.

Expert-level proficiency in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C/C++, C#, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Kotlin, or Swift.

Strong understanding of software security concepts, including CWE, CVE, and the OWASP Top 10.

Ability to reproduce vulnerabilities and write proof-of-vulnerability tests.

Hands-on experience with security tooling, including sanitizers, fuzzers, and static-analysis tools such as CodeQL or Semgrep.

Strong proficiency with Git, Linux, Bash, and Docker.

Excellent technical writing and documentation skills.

Ability to work independently in a fully remote, research-oriented environment.

Strong judgment on verifier robustness and on scoring AI patches. Clear, supportive communicator with some experience mentoring others.

Proven track record on this project or equivalent security-dataset work.

Pay: From ₹250,000.00 per month

Experience:

  • professional software engineering : 6 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

title: Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Overview


In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day and we need you as a Critical Environment Platform Engineer.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a (CIPS) Platform Engineer you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. You will be part of a team that is responsible for operating the Critical Infrastructure Platform across our unified global datacenters; managing the demand planning and capacity utilization; and responsible for running the physical infrastructure (including supply chain, hardware, power, security, and workflow teams). We emphasize automation, data driven engineering, cost-effectiveness, and environmental sustainability. You will join a team of Platform Engineers who are passionate about designing, building, and operating the world's most advanced cloud infrastructures. You will work on cutting-edge technologies and projects that enable Microsoft to deliver innovative solutions and services to our customers while collaborating with other teams across the company and learning from the best in the industry. If you are looking for a challenging and rewarding career, this is the role for you. This is a flexible work opportunity role offering the option for partial remote work from home.

As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 150 datacenters and 1 million servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Do you want to empower billions across the world? Come and join us in CO+I and be at the forefront of the action!


Responsibilities


Responsibilities:

Technical Knowledge and Expertise

  • Support a hybrid Continuous Integration (CI)/Continuous Delivery/Deployment (CD) DevOps virtualized infrastructure consisting of Windows & Linux Server Operating System, Hyper-V, Active Directory, Domain Name System, PowerShell scripting, with a focus on data protection technologies, service metrics and Key Performance Indicator (KPI) reporting, documentation skills, along with interpersonal awareness, proactivity, and a proven ability to manage and drive delivery of multiple simultaneous cross-group dependent server and service-based projects at scale.

  • Perform, maintain, and continuously improve automated operating system installation and configuration.

  • Configure and maintain hands-on bare metal enterprise-class server systems, including automated periodic firmware and driver updates at scale, Redundant Array of Independent Disks (RAID) and Intelligent Platform Management Interface (IPMI) configurations and hardware troubleshooting.

Operational Excellence

  • Monitor servers, ensure service levels and KPIs are met and maintained, provide security conscience outcomes maintaining compliance alignment, and ensure 24/7/365 service and infrastructure operations support with continuous optimizations.

  • Transition manual operational processes to automation while leveraging CI/CD DevOps principles.

Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing

  • Partner with a global team while helping bring projects to successful outcomes and delivering rigorous documentation artifacts.

  • Share responsibility for automating, securing, configuring, and delivering support of the Critical Environments infrastructure & related programs and projects in existing and future datacenters.

Other

  • Embody our culture and values.



Qualifications


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree or Trade Certification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Data Science, Cybersecurity, or related field OR equivalent experience.

  • OR equivalent experience

Background Check Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND an internship in software engineering, network engineering, service engineering, or systems engineering OR equivalent experience.
  • Familiarity with enterprise large-scale cloud or distributed systems.
  • Basic understanding of Windows Server OS and UNIX-based operating systems including enterprise-level Linux distributions performing automated system installation and configuration, file system concepts, resource monitoring, user administration, package management, and process control & management.
  • Demonstrate basic understanding of Configuration management with PowerShell DSC, Puppet, Chef or similar.
  • Project or lab work with server & tooling platforms for multiple infrastructure services such as Windows Server 2022/2019, Linux Server distributions, Hyper-V, Azure Arc, MIT Kerberos, Active Directory, DNS, PowerShell/Python infrastructure-as-code scripting, data protection technologies, service monitoring, incident alarming, compliance, and other services to aid in fulfilling operational monitoring, audit logging of events, compliance requirements, outages, or security-related issues.


This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.


Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process.

descriptionHtml:
SENIOR CLOUD SECURITY Engineer
Job Summary:
As an integral member of the Information Security Team, the Sr. Cloud Security Engineer role will be responsible for growing and leading many information security functions at Reltio. As a Sr. Cloud Security Engineer, you will use your technical experience to assess, design, engineer and implement various security and operational controls in Reltio's multi-cloud environment. These controls will be aligned and focused on achieving compliance with Reltio's security standards.

The Sr. Cloud Security Engineer will partner with other technology teams for initiatives related to security strategy and implementation. descriptionHtml:
Bengaluru, India | Full time | Home-based | R1575304


Principal Cloud Engineer

We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Principal Cloud Engineer to lead the design, architecture, implementation, and optimization of enterprise-scale cloud infrastructure and platforms across Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft Azure and overall Cloud FinOps

The ideal candidate will combine strategic enterprise architecture and operations leadership with deep, hands-on technical experience. This individual will define cloud standards, develop multi-cloud solutions including high availability and disaster recovery, modernize enterprise infrastructure, and drive cloud finops initiatives

The Principal Cloud Engineer will play a critical role in defining the cloud and AI infrastructure strategy, including infrastructure supporting Generative AI, machine learning, GPU workloads, and enterprise AI platforms.

Key Responsibilities

1. Hands-On AWS Architecture & Operations

  • Design, implement, and optimize enterprise-grade AWS infrastructure and cloud-native solutions.
  • Demonstrate hands-on expertise with:
    • AWS Organizations, Control Tower, multi-account strategy, and landing zones.
    • Amazon VPC, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, Route 53, PrivateLink, and network security.
    • EC2, EKS, ECS, Lambda, Auto Scaling, and serverless architectures.
    • S3, EBS, EFS, FSx, RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB, and data storage services.
    • IAM, AWS Identity Center, KMS, Secrets Manager, GuardDuty, Security Hub, and CloudTrail.
    • CloudWatch, AWS Config, Systems Manager, and operational monitoring.
    • CloudFormation, Terraform, CDK, and infrastructure automation.
    • AWS Backup, Elastic Disaster Recovery, and cross-region resilience.
  • Design and implement secure, highly available, fault-tolerant, and multi-region AWS architectures.
  • Establish automated infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and deployment pipelines.
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, networking, performance, availability, and security issues.

2. Hands-On Microsoft Azure Architecture & Engineering

  • Architect, implement, and manage enterprise-scale Microsoft Azure environments.
  • Demonstrate hands-on expertise with:
    • Azure Landing Zones, Management Groups, Subscriptions, and Azure Policy.
    • Azure Virtual Networks, VNet Peering, Virtual WAN, ExpressRoute, Private Link, and Azure Firewall.
    • Azure Virtual Machines, VM Scale Sets, AKS, Azure Functions, and App Services.
    • Azure Storage, Azure Files, Azure Managed Disks, and Azure NetApp Files.
    • Azure SQL, Azure Database services, and data platform integrations.
    • Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, Managed Identities, Key Vault, and Defender for Cloud.
    • Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, and Microsoft Sentinel.
    • Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery, and cross-region disaster recovery.
    • Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates, and Azure DevOps.
  • Establish enterprise governance, identity, security, networking, and operational standards.
  • Design resilient Azure architectures using availability zones, paired regions, and geo-redundant services.
  • Lead cloud infrastructure modernization and migration initiatives.

3. Cloud FinOps & Cost Optimization

  • Establish and lead enterprise Cloud Financial Operations (FinOps) strategy and governance.
  • Develop cloud financial management practices across AWS and Azure.
  • Implement cloud cost visibility, accountability, forecasting, budgeting, and chargeback/showback models.
  • Establish tagging standards, cost allocation, resource ownership, and financial governance.
  • Optimize cloud spending through:
    • Rightsizing and workload optimization.
    • Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, and Azure Reservations.
    • Compute scheduling and automated resource shutdown.
    • Storage lifecycle management and tiering.
    • Kubernetes and container resource optimization.
    • Network and data transfer cost optimization.
    • GPU and AI infrastructure utilization optimization.
  • Implement AWS Cost Explorer, AWS Budgets, and AWS Cost and Usage Reports.
  • Implement Azure Cost Management, budgets, and cost allocation.
  • Develop FinOps dashboards, executive reporting, and cost optimization KPIs.
  • Partner with Finance, Procurement, Engineering, and Infrastructure teams to improve cloud financial accountability.
  • Establish continuous cost optimization practices while maintaining performance, security, and availability.

4. Cloud Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity

  • Define enterprise cloud disaster recovery (DR), business continuity, and resiliency architecture across AWS and Azure.
  • Design and implement disaster recovery strategies for mission-critical applications, databases, infrastructure, and enterprise platforms.
  • Establish Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO) based on business criticality.
  • Architect and implement:
    • Multi-region and cross-region disaster recovery.
    • Availability Zone and regional resilience.
    • Backup, replication, and recovery automation.
    • Active-active and active-passive architectures.
    • Pilot light, warm standby, and hot standby recovery models.
    • Immutable backups and ransomware-resilient recovery.
    • Database replication and point-in-time recovery.
  • Implement AWS Backup, AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery, Azure Backup, and Azure Site Recovery.
  • Develop automated recovery orchestration and infrastructure rebuild capabilities using Infrastructure as Code.
  • Establish DR testing, recovery validation, failover/failback procedures, and operational runbooks.
  • Lead disaster recovery exercises, business continuity assessments, and recovery readiness reviews.
  • Define DR metrics, reporting, and compliance evidence for executive stakeholders and auditors.

5. AI Infrastructure & Generative AI

  • Implement enterprise AI infrastructure architecture supporting machine learning, Generative AI, and large language model workloads.
  • Support cost-efficient infrastructure for AI/ML training, inference, GPU Infrastructure and model deployment.
  • Leverage AWS services such as Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, EC2 GPU instances, and EKS.
  • Leverage Azure services such as Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI, AKS, and GPU-enabled virtual machines.
  • Optimize GPU utilization, model inference costs, compute capacity, and AI workload performance.
  • Collaborate with data science, data engineering, and application development teams to enable enterprise AI adoption.

6. Cloud Governance & Compliance

  • Embed security-by-design principles into cloud architecture and engineering.
  • Establish Zero Trust architecture, identity governance, privileged access management, and least-privilege controls.
  • Design secure cloud networking, encryption, secrets management, and key management strategies.
  • Implement cloud security posture management and continuous compliance monitoring.
  • Align cloud solutions with relevant standards and frameworks, including NIST, CIS Benchmarks, SOC 2, ISO 27001, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Partner with cybersecurity teams to address vulnerabilities, threats, and cloud security risks.
  • Support Infrastructure as Code (IaC) standards and reusable automation frameworks.
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure provisioning and application deployment.
  • Enable self-service infrastructure provisioning through standardized cloud platform services.

7. Technical Leadership

  • Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance across infrastructure, cloud engineering, DevOps, security, and application teams.
  • Lead architecture reviews, design workshops, technical assessments, and solution evaluations.
  • Develop architecture diagrams, technical design documents, reference architectures, and implementation roadmaps.
  • Influence enterprise technology decisions and cloud investment strategies.
  • Mentor senior engineers, architects, and technical leads.
  • Communicate complex technical concepts effectively to executive leadership and business stakeholders.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • 15+ years of experience in enterprise IT & Cloud infrastructure, AI Platform and Cloud FinOps
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience designing, implementing, and managing AWS and/or Microsoft Azure environments.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in designing and supporting Cloud FinOps including FinOps architecture, FinOps tools, and FinOps process for showback, chargeback, cost optimization and executive reporting
  • Strong experience designing and implementing enterprise disaster recovery and business continuity solutions across AWS and Azure
  • Extensive experience with enterprise networking, compute, storage, databases, security, and identity management.
  • Experience designing infrastructure for AI/ML, GPU workloads, and Generative AI platforms.
  • Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and technical decision-making capabilities.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and technical leadership skills.

Preferred Certifications

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional.
  • AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty.
  • AWS Certified Security – Specialty.
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
  • Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert.
  • FinOps Certified Practitioner or FinOps Certified Professional.
  • Kubernetes certifications such as CKA or CKAD.
  • Relevant AI/ML cloud certifications.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com

IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

Where you'll work

Home-based

You’ll work remotely, with the flexibility to do your best work from home. Supported by collaborative tools and a global team, you’ll stay connected while enjoying the autonomy and balance that comes with a fully remote role.


Culture

Culture at IQVIA is built on a shared belief: that when people are empowered with better data, smarter technology and deeper expertise, they can change what’s possible for patients. Across every team and every corner of the globe, you’ll find colleagues who genuinely care — about the mission and about each other. That’s what makes this a place where people tend to stay, grow and do the best work of their careers.

title: Infrastructure Security Engineer- VM & Remediation
descriptionHtml:
Cordance is dedicated to accelerating the growth of vertically focused business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies through acquisition and long-term tactical and financial guidance. We’re experienced operators and subject-matter experts with a passion for software and building businesses. We partner with founders to help them scale their businesses and realize their companies’ full potential.

We look for businesses with strong leadership and high potential for profitable growth, and work together to increase year-over-year revenue, company efficiency, and impact. Cordance envisions that all companies we work with achieve their full potential. We embrace what makes each company great and build on those foundations. We believe in elevating a company as it scales, delivering dignity to the organization and its employees, and sharing a passion for building a legacy.

Vulnerability assessment

  • Run authenticated and unauthenticated vulnerability scans across Windows and Linux servers, virtual machines, cloud workloads, and network devices.
  • Validate findings manually to remove false positives before they reach a remediation queue.
  • Review configurations against CIS Benchmarks and internal hardening standards.
  • Assess cloud security posture in AWS and Azure: IAM, security groups and NSGs, storage exposure, and public endpoints.
  • Maintain accurate asset inventory and scan coverage, and flag unmanaged or unscanned assets.
  • Prioritise findings by exploitability, asset criticality, and exposure, using CVSS, EPSS, and the CISA KEV catalogue.
  • Agree remediation timelines with asset owners and document exceptions with compensating controls.

Remediation and patching

  • Apply operating system and third-party patches on Windows (WSUS, SCCM/MECM, Intune) and Linux (yum/dnf, apt, Ansible).
  • Harden servers: disable weak protocols and ciphers, remove insecure services, fix permissions, and enforce secure baselines through Group Policy and configuration management.
  • Fix network findings: firewall rule clean-up, switch and router hardening, TLS and SSH configuration, and segmentation gaps.
  • Remediate cloud misconfigurations, and patch VM images and templates so issues do not return.
  • Plan changes through change management with tested rollback steps, and work within maintenance windows to avoid outages.
  • Re-scan to confirm closure, and close findings only when the vulnerability is confirmed resolved.
  • Support incident response when an actively exploited vulnerability needs emergency patching.

Reporting and communication

  • Report open risk, finding age, and SLA compliance to security leadership and business unit owners.
  • Record remediation evidence for audits such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, and PCI DSS where in scope.
  • Write runbooks and automation scripts so business unit teams can repeat fixes on their own.
  • Explain risk to system owners and non-technical stakeholders, and agree on realistic maintenance windows.

Please note that we do not accept unsolicited resumes, work on a Corp-to-Corp basis, or engage with non-vetted external agencies.

Why Join Us?

At Cordance, we believe in taking care of our team members. When you join us, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance:

  • Health and Wellness:
    • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Coverage begins on your first day of employment.
  • Retirement Savings:
    • 401K Plan (US): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested.
    • RRSP (CAN): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested.
  • Paid Time Off:
    • Flexible PTO: Enjoy uncapped paid time off to balance your work and personal life.
  • Parental Leave:
    • 12 weeks paid leave for all employees.
  • Remote Work Support:
    • Monthly Stipend: Receive $75 USD / $140 CAD per month for phone and internet if you work remotely.
  • Holidays:
    • Generous Holiday Schedule: Benefit from an extensive list of holidays to recharge and spend time with loved ones.

Join us and be part of a company that values your contributions and well-being from day one!

EEOC & ADA Statement:
Cordance and its companies provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, creed, sex, nationality, ancestry, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
Cordance and its companies comply with federal and state disability laws and make reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact Human Resources.
This applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.
Final candidate must be able to pass a background check.
To view applicant notices required under federal and state law, please visit: https://cordance.co/applicant-notices/

title: Security Operations Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Join a global Contract Resource Organization (CRO) where innovation meets purpose. At Worldwide Clinical Trials , we're driven by a shared commitment to improving lives through high-quality clinical research. Our teams are empowered to think creatively, take ownership, and deliver meaningful work that helps bring life-changing therapies to patients around the world.


With more than 4,000 professionals across the globe, we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, growth is encouraged, and every contribution makes an impact. Whether you're building your career or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and help shape the future of clinical research.


Make an Impact as a Senior Security Operations Engineer at Worldwide


Effective cybersecurity starts with knowing what assets exist, who owns them, and how they're protected. As a Senior Security Operations Engineer (Asset Intelligence), you'll play a critical role in maintaining the trusted asset data that underpins security operations across Worldwide's global environment.

In this role, you'll own the technical health and effectiveness of our cyber asset intelligence platform, helping ensure security teams have accurate, actionable visibility across identity, endpoint, cloud, network, and vulnerability management ecosystems. Your work will directly support incident response, vulnerability management, security reporting, and audit readiness.

You'll collaborate across technology and security teams to improve asset visibility, automate processes, solve complex data quality challenges, and strengthen the foundation of Worldwide's cybersecurity program.


Where You'll Work

This is a REMOTE role open to candidates based in Remote. You will collaborate with global teams across multiple time zones.


What You'll Do

  • Administer and optimize the Axonius cyber asset intelligence platform, including integrations, dashboards, automation workflows, queries, and reporting.
  • Integrate and troubleshoot data sources across Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Azure, Rapid7, and other enterprise security technologies.
  • Reconcile and normalize asset data from multiple sources to improve accuracy, eliminate duplication, and maintain trusted inventory records.
  • Identify unmanaged, unknown, or unowned assets and partner with stakeholders to bring them under appropriate governance and security controls.
  • Maintain asset ownership, criticality, lifecycle, and control coverage information to support operational and executive decision-making.
  • Build dashboards and reporting that provide visibility into asset inventory completeness, data quality, security coverage, and platform health.
  • Deliver validated asset intelligence that enables effective vulnerability management, patching activities, and incident response operations.
  • Automate ticketing, owner notifications, and investigation workflows to improve operational efficiency and response times.
    • Document platform configurations, processes, and audit evidence supporting CIS Control 1 and related compliance requirements.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in security engineering, security operations, systems administration, or a related technical discipline.
  • Hands-on experience administering Axonius or a comparable cyber asset management platform, including integrations, automation, and data quality management.
  • Experience working with Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Azure, and vulnerability management solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of APIs, data normalization, and reconciling information from multiple enterprise technology sources.
  • Working knowledge of CIS Controls and the role asset intelligence plays in vulnerability, endpoint, and identity security programs.
  • Strong documentation, communication, and analytical skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams.
    • Proficiency in English; Security+, SSCP, Microsoft SC-200, or Axonius certifications are preferred.

Discover the Difference


We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do. Discover the Difference at Worldwide Clinical Trials. Explore additional opportunities on our careers page, visit http://www.worldwide.com/careers , or connect with us on LinkedIn .

title: Senior Software Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About the role

Destinare Services is seeking a Senior Software Security Engineer to develop training and evaluation tasks for advanced AI coding models. You will turn real-world software vulnerabilities into practical audit-and-patch tasks, helping evaluate whether AI systems can identify, understand, reproduce, and securely fix security issues.

This role combines software security research, vulnerability reproduction, benchmark development, automated testing, and technical review. You will work with open-source projects and multiple programming languages.

Responsibilities

  • Research vulnerabilities using CVEs, security advisories, bug reports, and open-source repositories.
  • Classify vulnerabilities using the most specific applicable CWE and map them to OWASP Top 10 categories where appropriate.
  • Reproduce vulnerabilities and write reliable proof-of-vulnerability tests.
  • Create realistic audit-and-patch tasks across languages such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C/C++, C#, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Kotlin, and Swift.
  • Write task instructions that describe the security issue without revealing the vulnerable code, exploit details, or expected fix.
  • Build reproducible Docker environments with pinned dependencies and clear setup instructions.
  • Design verifiers that resist test manipulation, hardcoded solutions, and other forms of gaming.
  • Review AI-generated patches and reasoning using clear technical rubrics.
  • Document vulnerability context, reproduction steps, expected behavior, patch requirements, and review decisions.

Required qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.

About the role

Destinare Services is seeking a Senior Software Security Engineer to develop training and evaluation tasks for advanced AI coding models. You will turn real-world software vulnerabilities into practical audit-and-patch tasks, helping evaluate whether AI systems can identify, understand, reproduce, and securely fix security issues.

* Build reproducible Docker environments with pinned dependencies and clear setup instructions.

title: Senior Modern Workplace Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About TGH Software Solutions

TGH Software Solutions is an IT consulting and technology services company delivering enterprise technology solutions across integration, data engineering, quality engineering, automation, and digital platforms. We work with customers and partners to solve complex technology challenges through skilled teams, strong delivery practices, and a customerfocused approach.

Role Overview :

We are looking for a senior Modern Workplace Engineer, on a contract basis, to harden a customer's Microsoft 365, Intune and Entra ID environment and build the capability of the internal endpoint and identity team to operate it independently. The role combines hands-on configuration with structured knowledge transfer to the internal team.

Key Responsibilities

Assessment & Remediation Planning • Assess the current Intune, Entra ID, Defender, Mimecast and Teams configuration and deliver a prioritized remediation plan within the first 30 days. Identity & Conditional Access (Microsoft Entra ID)

  • Design and implement Conditional Access policy, including authentication strength, device compliance, break glass accounts and staged enforcement. Endpoint & Device Management (Intune)
  • Standardize device provisioning through Windows Autopilot, enrollment restrictions and compliance and configuration profiles.
  • Design and operate Windows update management, including update rings, feature update policy, deployment reporting and conflict resolution.
  • Implement web and application control across Defender for Endpoint, Mimecast and Intune, defining which platform owns each control and removing overlapping or conflicting policy.
  • Apply device hardening, including security baselines, BitLocker, Windows LAPS and removal of standing local administrator rights. Email Security (Mimecast)
  • Integrate Mimecast with Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, covering email security policy, authentication and coexistence with Defender for Office 365. Microsoft Teams & Teams Phone
  • Configure and secure Microsoft Teams, including meeting and messaging policy, external and guest access, and management of Teams Rooms and Teams phone devices through Intune.

Design and automate Teams Phone user provisioning, covering licensing, number assignment, voice routing and calling policy, and resolve synchronization issues between Teams and the NTT calling service.

  • Support the AudioCodes session border controller configuration for Direct Routing, including call routing to NTT and telephony handoff to the CRM. Configuration as Code & Change Management
  • Establish configuration as code, source control and drift detection for Intune and Entra ID policy.
  • Define the change process for endpoint and identity policy, covering pilot deployment, peer review, monitoring and rollback.

Documentation & Knowledge Transfer • Deliver runbooks and configuration documentation for each control area.

  • Coach associates through paired delivery, moving ownership of each control area to the internal team by the end of the engagement, and provide a capability assessment of each team member.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in enterprise Microsoft endpoint and identity management.
  • Demonstrated delivery across Intune, Entra ID Conditional Access, Windows Autopilot, Microsoft Teams administration and Defender for Endpoint in organizations of 1,000 or more users.
  • Experience with Teams Phone delivered through Direct Routing, including user and number provisioning automation.
  • Experience operating Mimecast alongside Microsoft 365 security tooling.
  • Experience managing Windows feature upgrades at enterprise scale.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft365DSC, Graph API and PowerShell automation.
  • Track record of formal knowledge transfer to internal teams.

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Microsoft certifications such as MD-102 (Endpoint Administrator), SC-300 (Identity and Access Administrator) or SC100 (Cybersecurity Architect).
  • Experience configuring AudioCodes session border controllers.
  • Experience integrating Teams telephony with CRM or contact center platforms.
  • Experience in financial services or other regulated environments, including SEC registered advisers.
  • Familiarity with CIS benchmarks and Microsoft security baselines.

Deliverables

  • Assessment report and remediation plan.
  • Hardened configuration across all control areas, documented and held in source control.
  • Endpoint and identity change procedure.
  • Runbooks for each control area.
  • Team capability assessment and handover plan.

Pay: ₹575,000.00 - ₹1,960,000.00 per year

title: Senior Platform / Infrastructure Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About FirstWork

FirstWork is an applied AI company building the next generation of workforce operations technology.

We work with companies across staffing, logistics, healthcare, and retail that manage large frontline workforces. These businesses deal with complex, highly manual processes involving hiring, onboarding, document verification, compliance, training, and ongoing workforce management.

We're using AI agents to automate these workflows, working alongside human teams and integrating with the systems businesses already use.

Having raised $15M in our Series A, led by Earlybird Venture Capital, bringing our total funding to $20M, we're entering an exciting phase of growth. With established enterprise customers and a growing product footprint, we're expanding beyond hiring and onboarding to build a comprehensive AI-powered workforce operations platform.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Platform / Infrastructure Engineer to help build and scale the infrastructure powering FirstWork's multi-tenant HR and workforce compliance platform.

Our platform supports customers across multiple regions, making reliability, security, scalability, and data residency critical to what we build.

You'll join our Infrastructure & Platform team, which owns the foundations that enable the rest of engineering to move faster and ship safely. From AWS infrastructure and Kubernetes to CI/CD, observability, reliability, and platform security, you'll have the opportunity to shape the systems that power our entire engineering organization.

We believe infrastructure should be treated as a product, with engineering teams as its customers.

What Makes This Opportunity Exciting?

  • High ownership: Take ownership of critical infrastructure decisions and shape our platform architecture.

  • Real production scale: Build systems supporting enterprise customers across multiple regions.

  • Engineering-wide impact: Improve the speed, reliability, and security of every team's development and deployment workflows.

  • Modern infrastructure: Work with AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitOps, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, and more.

  • Meaningful challenges: Solve problems around multi-region architecture, data residency, tenant isolation, reliability, and cloud cost optimization.

What You'll Do

  • Own and scale multi-region AWS infrastructure using Terraform and GitOps workflows.

  • Manage production Kubernetes (EKS) environments, including cluster lifecycle, autoscaling, workload isolation, ingress, and secrets management.

  • Build and improve developer infrastructure, including CI/CD pipelines, self-hosted runners, container standards, and deployment workflows.

  • Lead observability and reliability initiatives across metrics, logs, traces, alerting, SLOs, dashboards, and runbooks.

  • Improve incident response processes, on-call tooling, escalation policies, and postmortem practices.

  • Strengthen platform security through IAM, network boundaries, tenant isolation, vulnerability management, and supply-chain security.

  • Partner with backend engineering teams on performance, background processing, queues, workers, and capacity planning.

  • Drive infrastructure cost optimization through monitoring, workload right-sizing, and architectural improvements.

  • Lead major infrastructure initiatives such as regional expansions, cluster migrations, and cloud migrations.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, DevOps, or SRE roles, managing production systems.

  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS services such as EKS, EC2, VPC, IAM, RDS, SQS, ECR, and CloudWatch, or equivalent cloud platforms.

  • Deep production experience with Kubernetes, including Helm, autoscaling, networking, and troubleshooting.

  • Strong Infrastructure as Code experience with Terraform and familiarity with GitOps practices.

  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD systems using GitHub Actions or similar tools, including self-hosted runners.

  • Solid understanding of observability, monitoring, alerting, and production reliability.

  • Strong knowledge of Linux, networking, DNS, TLS, and CDNs or edge platforms such as Cloudflare.

  • Programming or scripting experience in Python, Go, or Bash.

  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to create clear design documents, runbooks, and technical documentation.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing multi-region or data-residency-driven architectures.

  • Familiarity with Python/Django services, Celery, or Temporal workflows.

  • Experience with ClickHouse or other analytical stores used for telemetry.

  • Experience setting up on-call platforms such as PagerDuty, Opsgenie, or GoAlert.

  • GCP experience or hands-on experience leading cloud migrations.

  • Knowledge of security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001.

  • Experience using AI coding agents and LLM tooling in infrastructure workflows.

Why Join FirstWork?

  • High ownership: Make meaningful architectural decisions and take responsibility for critical systems.

  • Visible impact: Your work will directly influence how quickly and reliably the entire engineering organization ships.

descriptionText:
About FirstWork

FirstWork is an applied AI company building the next generation of workforce operations technology.

We work with companies across staffing, logistics, healthcare, and retail that manage large frontline workforces. These businesses deal with complex, highly manual processes involving hiring, onboarding, document verification, compliance, training, and ongoing workforce management.

We're using AI agents to automate these workflows, working alongside human teams and integrating with the systems businesses already use.

Having raised $15M in our Series A, led by Earlybird Venture Capital, bringing our total funding to $20M, we're entering an exciting phase of growth. With established enterprise customers and a growing product footprint, we're expanding beyond hiring and onboarding to build a comprehensive AI-powered workforce operations platform.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Platform / Infrastructure Engineer to help build and scale the infrastructure powering FirstWork's multi-tenant HR and workforce compliance platform.

Our platform supports customers across multiple regions, making reliability, security, scalability, and data residency critical to what we build.

You'll join our Infrastructure & Platform team, which owns the foundations that enable the rest of engineering to move faster and ship safely. From AWS infrastructure and Kubernetes to CI/CD, observability, reliability, and platform security, you'll have the opportunity to shape the systems that power our entire engineering organization.

We believe infrastructure should be treated as a product, with engineering teams as its customers.

What Makes This Opportunity Exciting?

High ownership: Take ownership of critical infrastructure decisions and shape our platform architecture.

Real production scale: Build systems supporting enterprise customers across multiple regions.

Engineering-wide impact: Improve the speed, reliability, and security of every team's development and deployment workflows.

Modern infrastructure: Work with AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitOps, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, and more.

Meaningful challenges: Solve problems around multi-region architecture, data residency, tenant isolation, reliability, and cloud cost optimization.

Own and scale multi-region AWS infrastructure using Terraform and GitOps workflows.

Manage production Kubernetes (EKS) environments, including cluster lifecycle, autoscaling, workload isolation, ingress, and secrets management.

Build and improve developer infrastructure, including CI/CD pipelines, self-hosted runners, container standards, and deployment workflows.

Lead observability and reliability initiatives across metrics, logs, traces, alerting, SLOs, dashboards, and runbooks.

Improve incident response processes, on-call tooling, escalation policies, and postmortem practices.

Strengthen platform security through IAM, network boundaries, tenant isolation, vulnerability management, and supply-chain security.

Partner with backend engineering teams on performance, background processing, queues, workers, and capacity planning.

Drive infrastructure cost optimization through monitoring, workload right-sizing, and architectural improvements.

Lead major infrastructure initiatives such as regional expansions, cluster migrations, and cloud migrations.

What We're Looking For

5+ years of experience in Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, DevOps, or SRE roles, managing production systems.

Strong hands-on experience with AWS services such as EKS, EC2, VPC, IAM, RDS, SQS, ECR, and CloudWatch, or equivalent cloud platforms.

Programming or scripting experience in Python, Go, or Bash.

Experience designing multi-region or data-residency-driven architectures.

descriptionHtml:
Why qlub

The end of a great meal shouldn't be the slow part. Waiting for the check, finding someone to take payment, splitting a bill by hand. qlub removes that friction. Guests scan a QR code and pay in seconds. No app, no download, no waiting.

From Pay-at-Table and Digital Menus to Order-and-Pay, Payment Links, and SoftPOS terminals, we handle the full payment experience so restaurants can focus on what they do best: great hospitality. Less friction means faster table turnover, smoother operations, and higher profit.

We're a fast-scaling fintech backed by Mastercard, Mubadala, e& and Shorooq. $72M raised, live across multiple markets worldwide, and headcount doubled in the past year. We're building the teams that take us to the next stage.

The role

As qlub expands across markets, so do our security challenges. From protecting our payments platform to meeting regulatory requirements and earning customer trust, security plays a critical role in how we grow. We are looking for a Cybersecurity Engineer to own our day-to-day security compliance and customer assurance including maintaining security standards and certifications, managing audits and supporting customer security assessments.

This isn't a role limited to compliance checklists. You'll be part of our security team, working closely with engineering and teams across the business. You'll also have opportunities to contribute to threat detection, application security, cloud security and penetration testing. You'll have the freedom to solve real problems and make a visible impact on how we secure our platform.

Things move quickly here and not every challenge comes with a playbook. What matters is strong security fundamentals, curiosity, adaptability and the ability to figure things out and get things done.


What you’ll own

  • Own day-to-day security compliance and ISMS activities across ISO 27001, PCI DSS, SOC 2 readiness and applicable regulatory requirements.

  • Manage internal and external audits, certifications and assessments end to end including auditor engagement, evidence validation and corrective action closure.

  • Own customer security questionnaires, due diligence and security assessments, working directly with business stakeholders and customer security teams.

  • Maintain security policies, risk assessments and control documentation, assess control effectiveness and drive compliance findings to closure.

  • Coordinate third-party security reviews, support data protection and security awareness activities and maintain continuous compliance monitoring.

  • Contribute to security operations including SIEM/EDR monitoring, threat detection, incident investigations, cloud security and vulnerability management.

  • Support application security and DevSecOps initiatives including secure SDLC practices, CI/CD security integration, SAST/DAST/SCA and vulnerability validation.

  • Leverage automation and AI to streamline security assessments, compliance activities and operational workflows.


Who you are

  • You take initiative, exercise sound judgement and drive work forward independently.

  • You are curious, resourceful and quick to learn unfamiliar tools, technologies and frameworks.

  • You communicate clearly, collaborate across teams and stay effective when priorities change.

  • You actively embrace AI to solve problems, automate repetitive work and find smarter ways to get things done.


What you’ll need

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science or a related field.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity or information security, including security compliance, assurance or GRC.

  • Hands-on experience maintaining an ISO 27001 ISMS, coordinating audits, validating controls and managing compliance evidence.

  • Experience handling customer security questionnaires, due diligence assessments and working with auditors and cross-functional teams.

  • Working knowledge of PCI DSS, security risk management and frameworks such as NIST CSF.

  • Solid technical foundations in cloud and SaaS architectures, networking, identity and access management and web security including OWASP Top 10.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills with fluency in English.

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted tools for research, analysis and automation with the judgment to validate outputs and handle sensitive information responsibly.


Nice to have

  • Experience in fintech, payments or cloud-based SaaS environments.

  • Familiarity with UAE IA/NESA, SOC 2 or GDPR requirements.

  • Experience with GRC platforms and security workflow automation.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud security (AWS/GCP), SIEM/EDR platforms such as CrowdStrike/Splunk or detection engineering.

  • Practical experience conducting web, API or mobile penetration testing.

  • Relevant certifications such as ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, CISA, eWPTx or OSCP are valued.

What we offer

  • Real ownership over products that impact millions of diners and thousands of restaurants globally
  • The opportunity to solve challenging problems in payments, hospitality, and customer experience
  • A fast-moving environment where great ideas quickly become reality
  • Close collaboration with experienced operators, builders, and industry experts
  • A chance to leave a visible mark on one of the fastest-growing restaurant technology companies globally

Ready to build? Join us and help shape how the world pays at the table. If that excites you, apply now.
