title: Principal Network Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Description

JOB DESCRIPTION

Principal Network Security Engineer

IT Infrastructure Engineering | Enterprise Network Security

Job Title

Principal Network Security Engineer

Job Function

IT – Infrastructure Engineering

Band / Level

Group Lead, IT

Reports To

Head of Technology Engineering

Location

India, Remote

Direct Reports

None (senior individual contributor)

Role Summary

The Principal Network Security Engineer owns the enterprise network security architecture, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for Kraft Heinz, protecting our manufacturing plants, distribution centers, corporate offices, and Azure cloud environments.

As a senior individual contributor and the final design authority, the Principal Engineer partners with the CISO organization, Infrastructure leadership, Cloud, OT/Manufacturing Engineering, and Enterprise Architecture to set network security direction and investment priorities, influence executive decisions, and raise the capability of engineers globally.

What’s on the Menu

Enterprise Network Security Strategy & Governance

  • Own and be accountable for the enterprise network security strategy and multi-year roadmap spanning LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, wireless, data center, OT/plant networks, remote access, and Azure connectivity, aligned to the enterprise cybersecurity program and risk appetite.
  • Serve as the final technical decision-maker and design authority for network security architecture; chair network security design reviews and approve exceptions to standards.
  • Define and publish network security standards, reference architectures, and secure configuration baselines, and drive their adoption globally.
  • Document and maintain the current-state and target-state network security architecture, including topology, control coverage, and risk gaps, and translate the difference into a prioritized, funded transition roadmap.
  • Own the network security investment plan: build and present business cases, prioritize spend, and drive platform lifecycle decisions with senior IT leadership, the CISO, and business stakeholders as part of multi-year budgeting.

Zero Trust, Segmentation & Secure Access

  • Architect and lead the enterprise Zero Trust network strategy, including identity-aware access, ZTNA, and the evolution toward a SASE/SSE operating model (e.g., Zscaler ZIA/ZPA).
  • Define macro- and micro-segmentation patterns across campus, data center, cloud, and plant environments to contain lateral movement and reduce attack surface.
  • Own network access control architecture (e.g., Aruba ClearPass, 802.1X, device posture and profiling) for corporate, guest, IoT, and OT devices.
  • Set the architecture for next-generation firewall platforms (e.g., Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet), including policy design, rule-base hygiene, threat prevention, decryption strategy, and centralized management.

OT / Manufacturing Network Security

  • Lead security architecture for plant and manufacturing networks in partnership with OT and Manufacturing Engineering, applying ISA/IEC 62443 and Purdue-model principles to IT/OT boundaries, DMZs, and remote vendor access.
  • Design secure, resilient connectivity that protects production availability and food safety while enabling Industry 4.0, analytics, and cloud integration initiatives.

Cloud & Hybrid Network Security

  • Define secure Azure network architecture, including hub-and-spoke/Virtual WAN topology, Azure Firewall or NVA designs, NSGs, private endpoints, ExpressRoute and VPN security, and route control.
  • Partner with Cloud, Platform, and Application teams so that security controls are built into landing zones and enable, rather than constrain, application modernization.

Detection, Response & Resilience

  • Partner with the Security Operations Center and incident response teams to ensure network telemetry (flow logs, firewall, DNS, NDR) is designed for visibility and integrated with SIEM/SOAR platforms.
  • Act as senior technical escalation point during major network incidents; lead deep root-cause analysis and drive architectural remediation.
  • Own threat-informed network security design using standard frameworks (e.g., MITRE ATT&CK) and ensure the network security component of the enterprise threat model is current.

Automation, Engineering Excellence & Compliance

  • Champion network security as code: policy automation, configuration compliance, and infrastructure-as-code using tools such as Ansible, Terraform, Python, and platform APIs.
  • Ensure network security architecture meets regulatory and audit requirements (e.g., SOX, NIST CSF, PCI DSS where applicable, data privacy regulations) and support internal and external audits.
  • Lead vendor and technology evaluations, proofs of concept, and strategic platform decisions; manage key technical vendor relationships and roadmaps.

Technical Leadership & Talent Development

  • Mentor and develop senior and lead engineers and architects across regions; build a community of practice for network security engineering.
  • Raise the technical bar through design standards, peer review, knowledge sharing, and documentation.
  • Represent Kraft Heinz’s network security direction in cross-functional forums and, where appropriate, with industry peers and partners.

What You Bring

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 15+ years of progressive network engineering experience, including 7+ years focused on network security architecture in a large, global, multi-site enterprise.
  • Proven track record as the design authority for enterprise-scale network security programs (e.g., Zero Trust, SASE/SSE adoption, segmentation, firewall platform consolidation).
  • Deep, hands-on expertise with next-generation firewalls (Palo Alto Networks and/or Fortinet), secure web and private access (Zscaler or equivalent), and NAC (Aruba ClearPass or equivalent).
  • Expert knowledge of routing and switching (BGP, OSPF, SD-WAN, VRFs/segmentation), VPN technologies, DNS/DHCP/IPAM, and network services.
  • Strong Azure network security experience, including ExpressRoute, VNET design, Azure Firewall/NVAs, NSGs, and private endpoints.
  • Working knowledge of security frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, and CIS Controls
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders, build consensus across IT, security, and business teams, and communicate complex risk in business terms.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience securing manufacturing, OT, or ICS environments using ISA/IEC 62443 and Purdue-model architectures.
  • Experience with network automation and infrastructure-as-code (Python, Ansible, Terraform, CI/CD for network policy).
  • Experience integrating network telemetry with SIEM/SOAR and NDR platforms.
  • Experience in consumer-packaged goods (CPG), food and beverage, or similarly regulated global manufacturing environments.
  • Industry certifications such as CISSP, CCIE Security, PCNSE, Fortinet NSE 7/8, Zscaler ZDTE, GICSP, or Azure Network Engineer Associate.


Location(s)

Bengaluru - Brookfield GCC



Kraft Heinz is an Equal Opportunity Employer – Underrepresented Ethnic Minority Groups/Women/Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity and other protected classes .

title: Senior Security Engineer (Any Programming)
descriptionHtml:
Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Security Engineer to develop high-quality training and evaluation tasks for frontier AI coding models. You will transform real-world open-source vulnerabilities—including CVEs, security advisories, and bug reports—into Harbor-format audit-and-patch tasks across multiple programming languages.

This role combines software security research, vulnerability reproduction, benchmark development, automated testing, and technical review. The goal is to create realistic tasks that evaluate whether AI systems can identify, understand, exploit, and securely remediate software vulnerabilities without relying on superficial pattern matching or known patches.

What does day-to-day look like

  • Source and analyze real-world vulnerabilities from CVEs, security advisories, bug reports, and open-source repositories.
  • Classify vulnerabilities using the most specific applicable CWE and map them to relevant OWASP Top 10 categories where appropriate.
  • Reproduce vulnerabilities and develop reliable proof-of-vulnerability tests.
  • Build Harbor-format audit-and-patch tasks across languages such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C/C++, C#, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Kotlin, and Swift.
  • Write realistic task instructions that describe the security issue without revealing the vulnerable code, exploit details, or expected fix.
  • Create reproducible Docker-based environments with pinned dependencies and clear setup procedures.
  • Harden verifiers against gaming, overfitting, test manipulation, and hardcoded solutions.
  • Screen out tasks that can be solved by copying a well-known upstream patch without understanding the vulnerability.
  • Review and score AI-generated patches and reasoning using clearly defined technical rubrics.
  • Document vulnerability context, reproduction steps, expected behavior, patch requirements, test methodology, and review decisions.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Expert-level proficiency in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C/C++, C#, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Kotlin, or Swift.
  • Strong understanding of software security concepts, including CWE, CVE, and the OWASP Top 10.
  • Ability to reproduce vulnerabilities and write proof-of-vulnerability tests.
  • Hands-on experience with security tooling, including sanitizers, fuzzers, and static-analysis tools such as CodeQL or Semgrep.
  • Strong proficiency with Git, Linux, Bash, and Docker.
  • Excellent technical writing and documentation skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote, research-oriented environment.

Benefits:

  • Work from home

Application Question(s):

  • Are you fine with this Short term contract(3 Months)?
  • Can you join Immediately for this role?
  • Please mention your LinkedIn URL*
  • Do you have experience with any one of the languages(Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C/C++, C#, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP)?

Experience:

  • Software security: 5 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

* Reproduce vulnerabilities and develop reliable proof-of-vulnerability tests.
* Build Harbor-format audit-and-patch tasks across languages such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C/C++, C#, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Kotlin, and Swift.
* Write realistic task instructions that describe the security issue without revealing the vulnerable code, exploit details, or expected fix.
* Create reproducible Docker-based environments with pinned dependencies and clear setup procedures.
* Harden verifiers against gaming, overfitting, test manipulation, and hardcoded solutions.
* Screen out tasks that can be solved by copying a well-known upstream patch without understanding the vulnerability.
* Review and score AI-generated patches and reasoning using clearly defined technical rubrics.
* Document vulnerability context, reproduction steps, expected behavior, patch requirements, test methodology, and review decisions.

*Requirements*

* *5+ years* of professional software engineering experience.
* Expert-level proficiency in *at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C/C++, C#, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Kotlin, or Swift.*
* Strong understanding of software security concepts, including CWE, CVE, and the OWASP Top 10.
* Ability to reproduce vulnerabilities and write proof-of-vulnerability tests.
* Hands-on experience with security tooling, including sanitizers, fuzzers, and static-analysis tools such as CodeQL or Semgrep.
* Strong proficiency with Git, Linux, Bash, and Docker.
* Excellent technical writing and documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently in a fully remote, research-oriented environment.

Benefits:

title: DevOps Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Point Wild helps customers monitor, manage, and protect against the risks associated with their identities and personal information in a digital world. Backed by WndrCo, Warburg Pincus and General Catalyst, Point Wild is dedicated to creating the world's most comprehensive portfolio of industry-leading cybersecurity solutions. Our vision is to become THE go-to resource for every cyber protection need individuals may face - today and in the future.

Join us for the ride!

About the Role:

We're looking for an experienced DevOps Engineer to build, operate, and optimize the cloud infrastructure and continuous-delivery systems behind our Lat61 platform on Google Cloud. You'll help keep our production environments reliable, scalable, and secure, supporting smooth deployment pipelines and efficient day-to-day operations.

You'll work closely with the platform team to strengthen our DevOps practices: managing infrastructure as code, automating operational workflows, and upholding our security and compliance standards. We're a high-trust, outcome-focused team that values ownership and pragmatic problem-solving.


Day to Day:

  • GCP Infrastructure & Operations: Deploy, manage, and maintain workloads on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), under the team's architectural guidance.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Build and maintain infrastructure with Terraform, following GitOps workflows and the team's established patterns.
  • CI/CD Pipelines: Build and maintain automated deployment pipelines with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and ArgoCD for reliable, repeatable releases.
  • Networking & Traffic Management: Support enterprise networking, help configure the service mesh (Istio mTLS, VirtualServices), and manage API gateways (Kong) for secure traffic routing.
  • Observability & Incident Response: Contribute to telemetry, log aggregation, and alerting; help troubleshoot and resolve production issues.
  • Security & Compliance: Support security controls (VPC-SC, IAM, Org Policies), manage secrets, help maintain compliance standards (e.g., SOC 2), and participate in the on-call rotation.

What you bring to the table:

  • At least 5 years of hands-on DevOps / platform / SRE experience operating production systems.
  • GCP & Kubernetes: Solid production experience on GCP and GKE (cluster operations, Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD).
  • Infrastructure as Code: Strong, practical Terraform experience and GitOps workflows in a team environment.
  • CI/CD: Proven experience designing and building multi-stage deployment pipelines.
  • Networking: Working knowledge of Istio and API gateways (Kong), with comfort troubleshooting service-to-service communication.
  • Security: Hands-on experience with secret management and access controls (Auth0, Dex, External Secrets, SOPS, IAM).
  • Databases: Operational familiarity with Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL), BigQuery, and common data stores (e.g., ClickHouse / Elasticsearch).
  • At least upper-intermediate spoken and written English.

It would be great if you also had:

  • Automation: Pulumi/Ansible for host configuration and infrastructure automation.
  • Certifications: GCP Associate Cloud Engineer, or a foundational Kubernetes certification (e.g., CKA / CKAD).
  • Observability tooling: Hands-on experience with Loki, Grafana, or similar.
  • Scripting: Bash or Python for operational tooling and automation.


As part of Point Wild, you will:

Solve real customer problems. Point Wild's point solutions allow consumers to address their immediate cyber protection needs. Our mandate is to continuously anticipate our customers' evolving digital security needs to create best-in-class solutions aimed at keeping them safe.

See your impact. We are a scrappy, nimble organization where individual contributions are needed and valued. You will see your impact every day.

Accelerate your career. As we expand, you will have the opportunity to learn new technologies, products, and markets in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.

Most importantly, you'll get to work with other talented people at a company where people matter. If you want to put your fingerprint on an organization and leapfrog your growth, this is the place for you.

In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination or harassment based on "protected categories," Point Wild is committed to being an inclusive community where all feel welcome. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at Point Wild.

Important privacy information for United States based job applicants can be found here.

title: Senior Cybersecurity Engineer – GenAI Application Security
descriptionHtml:
Destinare Services is a global IT recruitment firm connecting technology companies with skilled engineering talent across AI, machine learning, data, and backend engineering. We specialize in remote-first roles and support innovative, research-driven teams worldwide. Learn more at www.destinareservices.com.

Role Overview

We’re looking for an experienced security engineer to create and evaluate security tasks for generative AI applications. You’ll work with applications that use agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and connected tools. You’ll identify vulnerabilities, build vulnerable and patched versions, and write tests that demonstrate the issue and confirm the fix.

Responsibilities

  • Source or build GenAI applications, including agent and RAG systems.
  • Identify risks such as prompt injection, sensitive information disclosure, and excessive agency or tool use.
  • Trace data and actions across files, callbacks, registries, and background jobs to find security-control gaps.
  • Assess authentication, authorization, least privilege, tenant isolation, trust boundaries, and approval flows.
  • Create vulnerable and patched code versions, with exploit and reproduction tests for each vulnerability mechanism.
  • Document findings, code locations, reproduction steps, affected controls, and remediation recommendations.
  • Review CodeQL or Semgrep findings and SARIF output; investigate logic and authorization issues that pattern-based scanning may miss.
  • Review upstream security patches and commit history, and use Docker, Git, and relevant LLM frameworks and tracing tools.
  • Demonstrate model behavior with a live model where practical.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in application or product security, secure code review, penetration testing, or vulnerability research.
  • Strong data-flow reasoning and ability to explain how a vulnerability path works.
  • Strong knowledge of authorization, tenant isolation, trust boundaries, least privilege, and approval flows.
  • Knowledge of the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, especially LLM02: Sensitive Information Disclosure and LLM03: Excessive Agency.
  • Familiarity with prompt injection, tool abuse, and relevant CWE categories.
  • Experience writing tests that demonstrate vulnerable behavior and verify that a patch prevents it.
  • Experience with CodeQL or Semgrep and interpreting SARIF results.
  • Production coding experience and familiarity with agents, MCP, RAG, memory, and tools such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs, and OpenTelemetry.
  • Strong Git and Docker skills, clear technical writing, and ability to work independently.

Application

Please apply through Indeed. Include your relevant application-security and GenAI security experience in your resume.

Pay: Up to ₹1,800,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

  • How many years of professional experience do you have in application or product security, secure code review, penetration testing, or vulnerability research?

descriptionHtml:
About Mindvectors

Mindvectors Technologies LLP (www.mindvectorstech.com) delivers enterprise cloud solutions, cybersecurity, IT infrastructure, software solutions and managed technology services. We are expanding our Microsoft 365 practice to support customer email environments, cloud implementation, migration and ongoing managed services.

Role Overview

Join Mindvectors’ specialist panel for scoped customer projects and technical support assignments. Independently deliver Microsoft 365 implementations, Exchange Online and email migrations, complex troubleshooting, security and architecture reviews, and presales consultation, with work allocated by expertise and availability.

Responsibilities

Projects: Microsoft 365 & Exchange Online

Implement or optimize new or existing Microsoft 365 tenants and Exchange Online environments.

Configure email domains, DNS, mail routing, connectors, mailboxes, email policies and security baselines.

Deliver documented solution design, implementation, testing, handover and acceptance.

Email Migrations

Deliver Google Workspace, Zoho Mail, IMAP, on-premises Exchange and Microsoft 365 tenant-to-tenant migrations.

Plan Exchange hybrid scenarios where applicable; evaluate dependencies, tool requirements and downtime.

Perform technical assessments, pilots, mailbox migration, cutover, rollback preparations and validation.

Provide post-migration stabilization and issue remediation against agreed scope.

On-Demand Incident & Escalation Support

Investigate critical Exchange Online mail flow, deliverability, SMTP relay and authentication incidents.

Troubleshoot failed migrations, Outlook connectivity, DNS, SPF, DKIM, DMARC and connector configuration.

Provide root-cause analysis, corrective action plans and resolution notes.

Support defined customer technical calls and escalation windows.

Identity, Collaboration & Security

Assess or configure Entra ID, MFA, Conditional Access and identity integration.

Support Microsoft Defender for Office 365, Exchange Online Protection and security improvement projects.

Work on Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Purview and Intune assignments where qualified.

Architecture, Presales & Automation

Join technical discovery sessions; advise on licensing architecture, scope, migration approach and effort.

Draft solution designs, statements of work, implementation estimates and risk registers.

Use PowerShell or Microsoft Graph to automate appropriate administration and reporting tasks.

Required Technical Skills

Proven Microsoft 365 / Exchange Online delivery and advanced email troubleshooting skills.

Practical experience independently completing enterprise migrations.

Strong understanding of DNS, mail flow, email authentication, Entra ID and security.

Ability to estimate work, document deliverables and communicate with customers professionally.

Preferred Experience

Hybrid and tenant-to-tenant migrations; BitTitan, Quest or equivalent migration tools.

Microsoft CSP/MSP experience and Microsoft technical certifications.

Defender, Purview, Intune, Microsoft Graph and advanced scripting.

Performance Expectations

Quality and timeliness of accepted project deliverables and milestone sign-off.

Effective technical escalation resolution and documentation.

Accurate effort estimates, proactive risk identification and customer handover quality.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

  • Expected Salary

Experience:

  • M365 Administrator: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: Remote

descriptionHtml:
Job Information

  • Date Opened 11/16/2026
  • Job Type Full time
  • Industry IT Services
  • Remote Job

Job Description

This is a remote position.

Squad (TDR, IAM, VM, SecOps) Senior Associate Operations L2


The Cybersecurity L2 Analyst acts as an advanced technical contributor responsible for incident investigation, platform operations, vulnerability analysis, IAM operations, and cross-tower support across TDR, IAM, VM, and SecOps. This role performs deeper analysis than L1, handles escalations, optimizes detection logic, drives improvements, and ensures operational excellence. The L2 Analyst collaborates with L3, engineering teams, platform teams, and client stakeholders to ensure a stable, resilient, and effective cybersecurity environment.


Share and collaborate effectively with others, creating a positive team spirit.


Identify and make suggestions for improvements when problems and/or opportunities arise.


Validate data and analysis for accuracy and relevance.


Follow risk management and compliance procedures.


Keep up to date with developments in your area of specialty.


Communicate confidently in a clear, concise, and articulate manner - verbally and in written form.


Seek opportunities to learn about the wider economy alongside the business models/corporate governance and/or regulatory environment of our clients.


Uphold the firm's code of ethics and business conduct.




Required Skills & Qualifications


3–6 years of relevant experience in SOC, VM, IAM, or SecOps operations.


Strong hands-on experience with SIEM, EDR, VM tools, IAM platforms, Network Security tools like Web, Email gateway, DLP and ITSM systems.


Proficient in creating detection logic, correlation rules, and performing threat analysis.


Solid understanding of networking, OS security, identity governance, and vulnerability assessment methodologies.


Strong communication, documentation, and analytical skills.


Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.


Preferred Skills


Experience with scripting (Python, PowerShell, Bash).


Knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP).


Understanding of MITRE ATT&CK, vulnerability scoring, threat intelligence.


Security certifications such as Security+, CEH, AZ-900, ITIL & other relevant skill certifications.


Key Responsibilities:


Security Monitoring & Incident Response


Monitor SIEM, EDR, and threat intel dashboards for advanced threat patterns.


Conduct deep-dive investigations into suspicious activity and escalate to L3 as needed.


Execute containment, eradication, and remediation actions on confirmed incidents (where preapproved).


Perform advanced alert tuning, write detection logic, correlation rules, and enrichment logic.


Document investigation steps, timelines, actions taken, conclusions, and lessons learned.


Vulnerability Management & Risk Analysis


Perform daily health checks on scanners, credential states, asset discovery, and SLA breach monitoring.


Run and analyze network, container, cloud, agent-based, and web-app scans.


Maintain credential hygiene, tag governance, and asset deduplication.


Validate false positives, categorize exceptions, and assign remediation tasks.


Configure RBVM systems with threat-feed weighting, MITRE ATT&CK mapping, and crown-jewel tagging.


Manage and document exception workflow, review compensating controls, evidence validation, and SLA adjustments.


IAM Operations (L2 Level)


Perform manual provisioning into enterprise applications (AD, SAP, JDE, Oracle).


Manage certificate lifecycle activities, ensuring renewals before expiry.


Execute SOP-driven IAM workflows for PAM, IGA, and Access Management.


Validate IAM tickets for completeness, risk, and compliance before escalating.


Provide evidence for audits related to provisioning/deprovisioning.


Operational Reporting & SLA Governance


Produce weekly and monthly operational metrics, SLA reports, and deviation analysis.


Identify outliers, noise patterns, abnormalities, and propose tuning or process enhancements.


Application & System Maintenance (TDR, IAM, VM, SecOps)


Perform routine platform health checks, backup verification, scheduled job validation, and ensure system stability.


Validate multi-source log ingestion, troubleshoot ingestion failures, and coordinate with platform teams for fixes.


Handle break-fix scenarios, analyze root causes, and implement corrective actions.


Manage user administration for security tools (access, roles, entitlements).


Ticketing, Queue Management & Workflow Assurance


Oversee remediation ticket queues, ensuring ageing tickets are escalated or followed up appropriately & the mailbox for the inbound mails.


Validate support requests (false positives, exceptions, reassignments) before escalating to L3.




Documentation, Knowledge Management & Training


Maintain detailed documentation of daily operations, incident logs, troubleshooting steps, configuration changes, and platform updates.


Create and update SOPs, runbooks, playbooks, training documents, and knowledge articles.


Provide training and knowledge transfer to L1 analysts and new joiners.


Continuous Improvement & Automation


Identify opportunities for automation using SOAR, scripting, AI or workflow tools.


Participate in Policy tuning and optimization of tools across SOC, IAM, VM, and SecOps.


Compliance & Governance Support


Assist in maintaining compliance with standards such as ISO 27001, SOC2, NIST, GDPR.


Support audit readiness through artifact preparation and evidence maintenance.


Cross-Team Collaboration


Work with cybersecurity architects, platform engineers, and client SMEs to address systemic issues.


Participate in war rooms, incident post-mortems, and Root cause analysis discussions.


Customer Communication


Provide timely updates to clients on investigations, remediation progress, and ticket status.


Participate in operational review meetings to present operational insights.

title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
descriptionHtml:
Job Details

The Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team at one.com India is the core technical force within the Monitoring and 3rd Level department. We own the availability, performance, and infrastructure health of our global hosting environment. Our team proactively detects, diagnoses, and resolves infrastructure anomalies and system-level outages before they impact our users, and we act as the definitive 3rd-level engineering authority when major service or product disruptions occur.
We are expanding our department with a Site Reliability Engineer who specializes in deep infrastructure diagnostics and system-level troubleshooting. In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining and optimizing the uptime of our massive footprint of Shared, Dedicated, and OpenStack-based VPS environments, alongside modern containerized applications. A core focus of this position is utilizing our unified, in-house monitoring application (powered by a Prometheus backend) to proactively track infrastructure health, interpret complex system metrics, and rapidly isolate the root cause of service degradations.
As an SRE III, you will own critical incidents, mentor junior SREs (SRE I/II) within the department, and ensure seamless monitoring visibility across legacy systems, Plesk setups, and Kubernetes clusters.

Key Responsibilities

  • Proactive Infrastructure Monitoring: Utilize our in-house monitoring application to maintain constant visibility over our environments. Analyze metric trends and implement robust, symptom-based alerting thresholds across Shared, Dedicated, VPS, and Kubernetes environments to catch issues before they impact products.
  • 3rd Level Customer issues and Infrastructure Outage Resolution: Act as the primary technical responder and diagnostic expert during critical service or product outages, performing deep-system troubleshooting under pressure.
  • Diverse Platform Support: Diagnose and maintain maximum uptime and performance for traditional webhosting tech stacks, Plesk control panels, and multi-tenant OpenStack VPS environments.
  • Proactive Problem Management: Analyze long-term metric trends using advanced PromQL to identify systemic performance bottlenecks, hardware degradations, or configuration drift, driving deep Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
  • Internal Department Mentorship: Coach and guide SRE I and SRE II engineers within the department to elevate the team's collective diagnostic capabilities and troubleshooting workflows using our in-house monitoring application.

Core Technical Experience

  • Advanced Linux Internals: Deep, low-level understanding of Linux operating systems (CPU scheduling, memory management, I/O bottlenecks, kernel logs, file systems, and network stack troubleshooting).
  • Applied Prometheus & PromQL Expertise: Strong proficiency as a power user of Prometheus-backed monitoring tools. Expert-level ability to write highly optimized PromQL queries for complex alerting, dashboarding, and live incident troubleshooting.
  • Multi-Tenant Hosting Ecosystems: Extensive hands-on experience diagnosing failures in both traditional Shared/Dedicated Linux hosting architectures and modern Plesk control panel environments.
  • OpenStack & Virtualization Monitoring: Practical experience monitoring and troubleshooting Virtual Private Servers (VPS) and hypervisor behavior within an OpenStack cloud environment.
  • Kubernetes Workload Monitoring: Proven track record of tracking the health of containerized applications, utilizing tools like Prometheus Operator or Kube-State-Metrics to isolate pod, node, or cluster-level issues.

title: DevOps Engineer — AWS
descriptionHtml:
8–10 years Full-time On-site — Ahmedabad (no remote / work from home) Infrastructure & DevOps

Our platforms carry live transactions for restaurants and enterprises across India, the USA, Europe and the Middle East. We're looking for a DevOps engineer who owns AWS end to end — architecture, automation, security, cost and uptime — and treats infrastructure as a product with users, not a queue of tickets.

What you'll do

  • Own our AWS estate: VPC design, EC2/ECS/EKS workloads, RDS, S3, CloudFront, Route 53 and IAM — architected for uptime and least privilege.
  • Codify all of it in Terraform (or CloudFormation) so environments are reproducible and reviewable instead of hand-built and undocumented.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) that take a merge to production safely — including rollbacks that genuinely work under pressure.
  • Containerise services with Docker and run them with sensible autoscaling, health checks and zero-downtime deployments.
  • Put monitoring, logging and alerting in place (CloudWatch, Prometheus/Grafana, ELK) so we hear about problems before our clients do.
  • Harden environments for payment-grade workloads: secrets management, network segmentation, encryption in transit and at rest, and audit trails that satisfy PCI-DSS review.
  • Own backups, disaster recovery and the runbooks that make a bad day survivable — and rehearse them rather than assume them.
  • Keep the AWS bill honest through right-sizing, reserved capacity, storage lifecycle policies and per-environment cost visibility.
  • Support the engineering teams day to day: Linux and nginx troubleshooting, PostgreSQL/MySQL operations, and unblocking releases.

What you bring

  • 8–10 years in DevOps, SRE or infrastructure engineering, with deep AWS specialisation (certification welcome; production scars preferred).
  • Production Terraform or CloudFormation experience — you have built environments from an empty account upward.
  • Strong Docker skills and container orchestration in production (ECS and/or EKS).
  • End-to-end CI/CD ownership — GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Jenkins — including artefacts, caching and secure secret handling.
  • Confident Linux administration and scripting (Bash/Python), nginx configuration, TLS and DNS.
  • Monitoring and incident-response experience: you have been on call, and you improved the system until the pager stopped firing.
  • Database operations on PostgreSQL and/or MySQL — backups, restores, replication and performance basics.

Bonus points

  • Security and compliance exposure: PCI-DSS, HIPAA or GDPR-driven controls.
  • Kubernetes at scale, service meshes, or multi-region architectures.
  • Cost-optimisation wins you can put a number against.
  • Supporting mobile release infrastructure — build servers, artefact stores, OTA distribution.
AWSTerraformDockerECS / EKSGitHub ActionsLinux & nginxMonitoring & alertingPostgreSQL / MySQLPCI-DSS hardening
Applications go straight to harshit@hashmedia.in — we reply to everyone.

title: ISMS Manager (Fully Remote)
descriptionHtml:
Top 3 Reasons To Join Us

  • 100% remote, with a global, diverse team
  • Working on the latest tech for the Insurtech Market Leader
  • Lead and shape how an AI-native security function finds and prevents vulnerabilities at the AI-native insurance platform of choice for the world’s leading insurers

About Us

At CoverGo, our mission is to empower all insurance companies to make insurance 100% digital and accessible to everyone.

  • We are a leading global no-code insurance platform for health, life, and P&C
  • We’re the winner of the Insurtech of the Year in all of Asia and other awards globally
  • We work with insurance enterprise clients such as AXA, Bupa, MSIG, Dai-ichi, Bank of China Group Insurance, and many more
  • We're an international, diverse team of over 200 people with 30 nationalities and team members working remotely from all over the world
  • We are fully funded and backed by reputable VC funds and strategic institutional investors
  • We have a global presence in Asia, EMEA and the Americas
  • We’ve grown our annualized revenue by over 30x since January 2021
  • We’re constantly working towards making CoverGo a workplace that you love coming to. We deeply believe that bringing together a diversity of thoughts, expressions, and perspectives is key to building the best culture for equally diverse communities all over the world

About The Role

CoverGo is hiring an ISMS Manager to own our internal and external audit programme and give management independent assurance on the state of our cybersecurity compliance and risk management. The Security team is small and growing, and works AI-first: everyone uses AI to automate their own work and to scale security across a large engineering organisation.

What You Will Do

  • Own the internal and external audit programme, including ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certification and surveillance audits.
  • Set up and run an internal audit framework: audit plan, scoping, control testing, findings and follow-up.
  • Design custom control frameworks that establish clear ownership and accountability in a matrix organisation, where several teams share responsibility for the same systems.
  • Define technical controls for the engineering organisation and test that they operate as designed.
  • Report to management on compliance status, control effectiveness and risk, with clear findings and named owners.
  • Maintain the risk register and drive remediation through to closure.
  • Prepare audit evidence for customer security reviews and due diligence.
  • Use AI to automate evidence collection, control testing and reporting.

What We Need

  • 3+ years in information security governance, risk and compliance, or audit.
  • Hands-on experience leading ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certifications through to a successful audit.
  • A track record of building internal audit frameworks with custom controls, not just adopting a standard template.
  • Experience designing control frameworks that assign accountability across a matrix organisation.
  • Enough technical depth to define and test controls for engineering teams, such as access management, change management, secure development and cloud configuration.
  • Practical experience using AI to automate compliance and audit workflows.
  • Clear writing for both engineers and executives.

Nice to have

  • ISO 27001 Lead Auditor or CISA certification.
  • Experience in insurance, financial services or another regulated SaaS environment.

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • Paid Annual Leaves
  • Annual Performance Bonus
  • Health Insurance
  • Remote Work Allowance
  • Anniversary Bonus
  • Company activities and events
  • Learning and development plan

CoverGo Company Video

By submitting your application, you confirm that you have read, understood, and accepted the content of CoverGo’s Privacy Notice and you consent to the processing of your data as part of this application.

title: Principal Technical Consultant - AI Security
descriptionHtml:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.
We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.


The Principal Technical Consultant (Forward Deployed Engineer) for AI Security is a senior, customer-facing technical leader responsible for deploying, integrating, and operationalizing AI security capabilities in real-world customer and enterprise environments, with a focus on securing AI systems, LLM applications, and agentic workflows. This role works at the intersection of engineering, AI, security, data, and customer success to translate complex requirements into scalable, production-ready solutions.

This individual partners closely with security leaders, AI engineers, data scientists, platform teams, and infrastructure stakeholders to implement AI security controls, secure AI development pipelines, integrate security tooling for AI systems, and accelerate time to value. The ideal candidate brings 10+ years of security experience and combines deep technical expertise in AI systems, model and data security, and cloud platforms with proven experience developing technical proposals and statements of work, leading cross-team collaboration, and driving customer-facing delivery at a principal level.

Responsibilities

Customer and Stakeholder Delivery

  • Serve as the senior technical lead for deploying and operationalizing AI security solutions in customer or enterprise environments
  • Develop technical proposals, statements of work, and solution architectures that scope AI security engagements and support business development efforts
  • Translate business, operational, and AI security requirements into deployable architectures and implementation plans
  • Partner with internal and external stakeholders to ensure solutions are aligned to AI governance, compliance requirements, and long-term platform strategy
  • Act as a trusted advisor and technical point of contact during onboarding, implementation, rollout, and optimization phases

Solution Implementation and Integration

  • Design and implement integrations across AI platforms, model registries, LLM gateways, vector databases, and AI-enabled security tooling
  • Build and configure cloud-native data ingestion, normalization, and enrichment pipelines for AI telemetry, model activity logs, and prompt/response data
  • Integrate APIs, webhooks, message queues, and automation workflows across AI operations, identity, cloud, and application ecosystems supporting AI systems
  • Develop reusable deployment patterns, templates, and technical assets to accelerate future AI security implementations

AI Security Operations

  • Operationalize security controls and guardrails for AI systems, including prompt injection defense, model access controls, data leakage prevention, and agentic workflow monitoring
  • Secure non-human identities (NHI), including service accounts, API keys, tokens, and autonomous agent credentials, across AI and agentic workflows
  • Work with AI, detection engineering, and data teams to implement red teaming, adversarial testing, model risk scoring, and anomaly detection for AI systems
  • Help define data requirements, feedback loops, and operational guardrails needed to secure AI systems in production environments
  • Ensure deployed solutions are practical, measurable, and aligned to AI governance and risk objectives

Automation and Reliability

  • Implement secure and governed automation for AI security monitoring, investigation, and response use cases across heterogeneous environments
  • Support resiliency, observability, performance, and scale requirements for deployed AI security solutions
  • Troubleshoot integration issues, deployment blockers, and production challenges in partnership with AI, platform, cloud, and security teams
  • Improve reliability and maintainability through documentation, testing, monitoring, and standardized engineering practices

Cross-Functional Teaming

  • Work cross-team collaboration across AI Engineering, Security Engineering, Data Science, Infrastructure, Sales, and product or customer teams
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including executive audiences
  • Mentor and develop engineers and consultants, contributing to best practices for AI security implementation, delivery, and technical solution design
  • Provide field feedback to influence platform roadmap, product direction, and architectural standards
  • Support the practice in pre-sales activities, proposal development, and client presentations

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in security engineering, AI engineering, platform engineering, forward deployed engineering, solutions consulting, or related technical roles, with demonstrated progression to a principal or senior consulting level
  • Hands-on experience securing AI systems, LLM applications, or AI production pipelines
  • Experience deploying cloud-native architectures on at least one major cloud provider such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • Strong background in data integration, telemetry pipelines, normalization, and security analytics workflows applied to AI systems
  • Experience working directly with customers, executive stakeholders, or cross-functional delivery teams in implementation-focused environments
  • Proven experience developing technical proposals, statements of work, and scoping documents for customer engagements
  • Ability to lead technical engagements, drive execution, and influence outcomes without direct authority
  • Demonstrated ability to enable cross-team collaboration across engineering, security, data science, and business stakeholders

Technical Skills

  • Strong understanding of AI security risks, including prompt injection, model theft, data poisoning, adversarial attacks, and agentic AI risks, alongside foundational cloud, identity, and endpoint security
  • Experience with scripting and automation using tools such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash
  • Familiarity with APIs and integration patterns including REST, webhooks, and event-driven workflows
  • Working knowledge of AI concepts including LLMs, vector search, retrieval-augmented generation, model evaluation, and AI assistants or agents
  • Strong problem-solving skills, execution mindset, and ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-moving environments

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with implementation and integration of OpenAI models, specifically Daybreak Blue and/or Red.
  • Experience with implementation and integration of Anthropic models.
  • Experience with AI red teaming, adversarial AI testing, or AI governance frameworks such as the NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, or the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
  • Familiarity with the MITRE ATLAS (Adversarial Threat Landscape for Artificial-Intelligence Systems) knowledge base for AI-specific attack techniques and mitigations
  • Experience deploying solutions in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments
  • Familiarity with infrastructure as code, CI/CD workflows, and AI production delivery practices
  • Experience building reusable implementation frameworks or field engineering playbooks
  • Relevant certifications are a plus, including cloud, security, or AI-specific certifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
Why AHEAD:
Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between.
We fuel growth by stacking our office with top-notch technologies in a multi-million-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning.
India Employment Benefits include:
Comprehensive health insurance coverage for employees, with options to extend coverage to dependents
Paid time off and company holidays, along with additional leave benefits as per policy
Flexible work arrangements, supporting work-life balance
Learning and development opportunities to support continuous growth and upskilling
Employee wellness initiatives and programs focused on physical and mental well-being
Retirement and statutory benefits in line with India regulations
Inclusive and people-first culture, with a strong focus on collaboration and ownership

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Demonstrated ability to enable cross-team collaboration across engineering, security, data science, and business stakeholders
Technical Skills
Strong understanding of AI security risks, including prompt injection, model theft, data poisoning, adversarial attacks, and agentic AI risks, alongside foundational cloud, identity, and endpoint security
Experience with scripting and automation using tools such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash

title: GCC | Product Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Cordance is dedicated to accelerating the growth of vertically focused business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies through acquisition and long-term tactical and financial guidance. We’re experienced operators and subject-matter experts with a passion for software and building businesses. We partner with founders to help them scale their businesses and realize their companies’ full potential.

We look for businesses with strong leadership and high potential for profitable growth, and work together to increase year-over-year revenue, company efficiency, and impact. Cordance envisions that all companies we work with achieve their full potential. We embrace what makes each company great and build on those foundations. We believe in elevating a company as it scales, delivering dignity to the organization and its employees, and sharing a passion for building a legacy.

What you will do

Development and remediation

  • Fix vulnerabilities directly in application code, in whatever language or framework the application uses, and add tests that prove the fix.
  • Fix root causes, not single instances: build shared validation, output encoding, parameterized queries, and authorization checks that remove whole classes of vulnerabilities.
  • Upgrade vulnerable libraries, frameworks, and third-party components, resolve breaking changes, and keep builds and tests passing.
  • Build internal security tooling and automation: scanner integrations, triage and reporting scripts, and checks that catch issues before release.
  • Integrate SAST, DAST, and SCA tooling such as Aikido into CI/CD pipelines, and tune the rules to cut noise.
  • Fix infrastructure and configuration issues: web server and TLS settings, cloud IAM and network rules, container and Kubernetes configuration, infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD pipeline hardening.
  • Where code or infrastructure is owned by another team, raise the change yourself as a pull request and drive it to merge.

Security testing

  • Test web applications and APIs for exploitable vulnerabilities.
  • Review code and design for flaws in authentication, authorization, session handling, data flows, and secrets management.
  • Run and tune vulnerability scans across applications, hosts, or cloud accounts, and prioritize findings by exploitability and business impact alongside CVSS.
  • Retest fixes and close findings only when the vulnerability is confirmed resolved.

Reporting and communication

  • Write clear findings and fix notes with reproduction steps, evidence, risk rating, and the change made.
  • Agree on realistic remediation timelines with engineers, and share secure coding patterns so the same issues stop recurring.

What you bring

Experience

  • 5+ years total: approx. 3.5 years building and shipping production software as a developer, and approx. 1.5+ years of hands-on security work such as VAPT, application security, or secure code review.
  • A track record of fixing security issues in code.

Development expertise

  • Production-level depth in at least two of: Java, C#/.NET, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, PHP, Go, Swift, or Kotlin. Comfortable reading and changing code in languages you know less well.
  • Able to land a correct, tested fix in an unfamiliar codebase without breaking existing behavior.
  • Web and API development: REST and GraphQL services; authentication with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and JWT; session management; databases and ORMs.
  • Unit and integration testing, Git-based workflows, pull requests, and code review.
  • CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Working knowledge of Nginx, Apache, IIS, and TLS configuration.
  • Scripting in Python, Bash, or PowerShell to automate testing and remediation.

Communication

  • Clear written findings and the ability to explain risk and trade-offs to engineers and business stakeholders.

Nice to have

  • Web and API: manual testing with Burp Suite Professional; OWASP Top 10 and ASVS; injection, authentication and session flaws, access control (IDOR/BOLA), SSRF, and OAuth and JWT weaknesses.
  • Secure code review: spotting vulnerable patterns in code and using SAST and SCA results to find and fix real issues.
  • Built security tools, Burp extensions, or custom SAST rules (for example, Semgrep or CodeQL).
  • Threat modeling and secure design review experience.
  • Familiarity with compliance evidence requirements (ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS) as they relate to vulnerability remediation.

What success looks like

  • Vulnerabilities reach merged, tested fixes within agreed timelines.
  • Recurring vulnerability classes decline because fixes address root causes.
  • The tooling and automation you build catch issues before release and cut manual triage.
  • Development teams see you as a fellow engineer who ships fixes alongside them.
  • Cloud misconfiguration and patch exposure windows stay short.

Please note that we do not accept unsolicited resumes, work on a Corp-to-Corp basis, or engage with non-vetted external agencies.

Why Join Us?

At Cordance, we believe in taking care of our team members. When you join us, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance:

  • Health and Wellness:
    • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Coverage begins on your first day of employment.
  • Retirement Savings:
    • 401K Plan (US): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested.
    • RRSP (CAN): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested.
  • Paid Time Off:
    • Flexible PTO: Enjoy uncapped paid time off to balance your work and personal life.
  • Parental Leave:
    • 12 weeks paid leave for all employees.
  • Remote Work Support:
    • Monthly Stipend: Receive $75 USD / $140 CAD per month for phone and internet if you work remotely.
  • Holidays:
    • Generous Holiday Schedule: Benefit from an extensive list of holidays to recharge and spend time with loved ones.

Join us and be part of a company that values your contributions and well-being from day one!

Mandatory Technical Skills

  • Oracle EPM IaaS / Hyperion administration.
  • End-to-end implementation, upgrade and support of Oracle EPM products.
  • Design and migration of EPM products and components between environments.

  • EPM security administration and enterprise security standards.
  • PowerShell, Linux Shell Scripting and Python.
  • RHEL and Windows operating systems.
  • EPM Automate, EPM Maestro or other associated third-party EPM tools.
  • SSO integration with Oracle EPM products.
  • Monitoring and alerting using enterprise tools.

Key Responsibilities

  • Implement, upgrade and support Oracle EPM IaaS and Hyperion products.
  • Design and migrate EPM products and components from one environment to another.
  • Configure and manage Oracle EPM products, including HFM, FDMEE, DRM, DRG and FCM.
  • Set up new integrations using FDMEE and automate data loading processes.
  • Understand and support Oracle EPM SaaS products such as ARCS, TRCS and EPBCS.
  • Manage EPM product security and implement enterprise security standards.
  • Independently troubleshoot and resolve Oracle EPM IaaS issues.
  • Develop and maintain scripts using PowerShell, Linux Shell Scripting and Python.
  • Work with RHEL and Windows operating systems.
  • Integrate Oracle EPM IaaS and SaaS applications.
  • Configure monitoring and alerting with enterprise tools.
  • Support SSO integration across the Oracle EPM product suite.

Preferred Skills

  • Knowledge of Oracle EPM SaaS products such as ARCS, TRCS and EPBCS.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and support migrations from colo, hosted, legacy, and existing cloud environments into AWS.
  • Assess current-state infrastructure, document dependencies, identify risks, and create practical migration, cutover, rollback, and validation plans.
  • Map source environments — including networking, IAM, storage, databases, DNS, certificates, security controls, observability, and deployment workflows — into appropriate AWS target architectures.
  • Build, maintain, and standardize cloud infrastructure using Terraform or OpenTofu, with awareness of AWS CDK/CloudFormation, Azure Bicep, Pulumi, and other cloudnative IaC tools.
  • Operate and improve multi-account AWS environments using AWS Organizations and related governance patterns.
  • Help establish a centralized cloud operating model across AWS, with a path toward Azure and GCP.
  • Design and support cloud networking, IAM, security, logging, monitoring, backups, disaster recovery, and high availability patterns.
  • Build and improve CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure deployments.
  • Define opinionated best practices for infrastructure automation, CI/CD, observability, reliability, security, and cloud operations.
  • Implement monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, dashboards, and service health indicators so issues are detected quickly and resolved effectively.
  • Build automation and self-healing workflows so common production failures can be corrected automatically where possible.
  • Participate in production support, incident response, escalation, and on-call processes as needed.
  • Partner with engineering teams to containerize legacy applications using Docker and deploy to ECS, EKS, Kubernetes, or similar platforms.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate infrastructure analysis, IaC creation, pipeline development, troubleshooting, documentation, incident response, and operational automation.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, systems engineering, or similar roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience operating production workloads in AWS.
  • Experience migrating infrastructure from colo, data center, hosted, legacy, or existing cloud environments into AWS.
  • Experience with cloud-to-cloud migrations, including service mapping, data migration, networking, identity/access, DNS, cutover, rollback, and validation.
  • Strong production experience with Terraform or OpenTofu, including modules, remote state, environments, plan/apply workflows, secrets handling, policy checks, and CI/CD integration.
  • Experience with AWS networking, including VPCs, subnets, routing, VPNs, load balancers, DNS, certificates, NAT gateways, and security groups.
  • Experience with AWS Organizations, IAM, centralized logging, cloud governance, and multi-account patterns.
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery.
  • Experience with observability, including monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, metrics, traces, and service health indicators.
  • Experience owning or supporting production uptime, including incident response, oncall or escalation workflows, runbooks, alerting, and post-incident improvement.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across infrastructure, networking, application, and cloud layers.
  • Demonstrated use of AI tools in infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, or software delivery workflows.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work across multiple engineering teams and business units.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Azure and/or GCP in addition to AWS.
  • Direct experience migrating workloads from Azure to AWS, GCP to AWS, or other cloud providers into AWS.
  • Experience with Azure Bicep, AWS CDK/CloudFormation, Pulumi, or other infrastructure-as-code approaches.
  • Experience with AWS Control Tower, IAM Identity Center, CloudTrail, Config, GuardDuty, Security Hub, or similar governance and security services.
  • Experience with Azure management group.

• Build and improve CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure deployments.

• Define opinionated best practices for infrastructure automation, CI/CD, observability, reliability, security, and cloud operations.

• Implement monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, dashboards, and service health indicators so issues are detected quickly and resolved effectively.

• Build automation and self-healing workflows so common production failures can be corrected automatically where possible.

• Participate in production support, incident response, escalation, and on-call processes as needed.

• Partner with engineering teams to containerize legacy applications using Docker and deploy to ECS, EKS, Kubernetes, or similar platforms.

• Use AI tools to accelerate infrastructure analysis, IaC creation, pipeline development, troubleshooting, documentation, incident response, and operational automation.

Required Qualifications

• 7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, systems engineering, or similar roles.

• Strong hands-on experience operating production workloads in AWS.

• Experience migrating infrastructure from colo, data center, hosted, legacy, or existing cloud environments into AWS.

• Experience with cloud-to-cloud migrations, including service mapping, data migration, networking, identity/access, DNS, cutover, rollback, and validation.

• Strong production experience with Terraform or OpenTofu, including modules, remote state, environments, plan/apply workflows, secrets handling, policy checks, and CI/CD integration.

• Experience with AWS networking, including VPCs, subnets, routing, VPNs, load balancers, DNS, certificates, NAT gateways, and security groups.

• Experience with AWS Organizations, IAM, centralized logging, cloud governance, and multi-account patterns.

• Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery.

• Experience with observability, including monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, metrics, traces, and service health indicators.

• Experience owning or supporting production uptime, including incident response, oncall or escalation workflows, runbooks, alerting, and post-incident improvement.

• Strong troubleshooting skills across infrastructure, networking, application, and cloud layers.

• Demonstrated use of AI tools in infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, or software delivery workflows.

• Strong communication skills and ability to work across multiple engineering teams and business units.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Azure and/or GCP in addition to AWS.

• Direct experience migrating workloads from Azure to AWS, GCP to AWS, or other cloud providers into AWS.

• Experience with Azure Bicep, AWS CDK/CloudFormation, Pulumi, or other infrastructure-as-code approaches.

• Experience with AWS Control Tower, IAM Identity Center, CloudTrail, Config, GuardDuty, Security Hub, or similar governance and security services.

• Experience with Azure management group.

title: NOC & Incident Management Lead
descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

Join us on our mission to elevate customer experiences for people around the world. As a member of the Everise family, you will be part of a global experience company that believes in being people-first, celebrating diversity and incubating innovation. Our dedication to our purpose and people is being recognized by our employees and the industry. Our 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor and our shiny, growing wall of Best Place to Work awards is a testament to our investment in our culture. Through the power of diversity, we celebrate all cultures for their uniqueness and strengths. With 13 centers around the world and a robust work at home program, we believe great things happen when we work with people who think differently from us. Find a job you’ll love today!


Job description


1. Requisition Details

Type Full-time

Business Function Global Information Technology

Role Level Lead / Manager

Department IT Operations / Network Operations

Work Arrangement 24x7 rotational / business requirement


2. Business Justification

This position is required to strengthen 24x7 monitoring, major incident coordination, service restoration and recurring-issue prevention for infrastructure supporting BPO client operations. The role will provide a single operational lead for high-impact network and connectivity incidents, improve stakeholder communication, and drive disciplined Incident and Problem Management using ServiceNow and SolarWinds.


3. Position Summary

The NOC & Incident Management Lead will oversee Network Operations Centre activities and coordinate resolution of infrastructure and connectivity incidents affecting business operations and client services. The role requires practical knowledge of LAN, WAN, firewalls, endpoint connectivity and monitoring, together with strong experience in Incident Management, Problem Management, ServiceNow ticketing and cross-functional coordination.


4. Key Responsibilities

NOC Operations and Monitoring

  • Lead day-to-day NOC operations supporting a 24x7 BPO environment.
  • Monitor network and infrastructure availability through SolarWinds and other approved monitoring tools.
  • Ensure alerts are validated, prioritised, assigned and tracked to closure.
  • Maintain effective shift handovers, escalation discipline and operational reporting.
  • Identify service degradation early and coordinate preventive action before business impact increases.

Incident and Major Incident Management

  • Own and coordinate Priority 1 and Priority 2 incidents from identification through service restoration.
  • Open and lead incident bridges, assign actions and engage the required technical, vendor, business and client teams.
  • Assess business impact, establish priority and provide clear, timely stakeholder updates.
  • Maintain incident timelines, decisions, ownership and recovery actions in ServiceNow.
  • Conduct post-incident reviews for significant outages and ensure follow-up actions are completed.

Problem Management

  • Identify recurring or high-impact infrastructure, network and connectivity issues.
  • Initiate and manage Problem records, Root Cause Analysis and corrective action plans.
  • Track permanent fixes, known errors and workarounds through completion.
  • Analyse incident trends and recommend monitoring, process and automation improvements.

Network and Client Connectivity Support

  • Perform initial diagnosis of LAN, WAN, firewall, VPN, internet, DNS, DHCP, latency, packet loss and endpoint connectivity issues.
  • Isolate the likely failure domain and engage the correct infrastructure, network, telecom, security, application, endpoint, vendor or client team.
  • Coordinate troubleshooting for BPO client connectivity across delivery centres, cloud environments, client networks and service providers.
  • Communicate technical findings in clear business language, including user, site and client impact.

Team and Process Leadership

  • Guide NOC engineers and support teams during incidents and daily operations.
  • Maintain runbooks, troubleshooting guides, escalation matrices and major incident procedures.
  • Coach team members on structured troubleshooting, ticket quality and stakeholder communication.
  • Support service reviews with incident trends, corrective actions and operational performance data.


5. Candidate Requirements


Experience 8 to 10 years of experience in IT infrastructure, NOC, network operations, service operations or a related support function.

Operational Environment Demonstrated experience supporting 24x7 operations, preferably within BPO, contact centre or another high-availability production environment.

Incident Management Strong experience managing high-priority incidents, major incident bridges, escalations, stakeholder updates and service restoration.

Problem Management Experience in recurring incident analysis, Root Cause Analysis, known errors and corrective action tracking.

Networking Good working knowledge of LAN, WAN, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing and switching fundamentals, internet circuits, VPNs and firewalls.

Endpoint Support Practical experience troubleshooting endpoint network access, Wi-Fi, VPN and related connectivity issues.

Tools Strong hands-on experience with ServiceNow Incident and Problem Management and SolarWinds network monitoring.

Communication Ability to communicate technical issues, business impact, recovery status and risks clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Education Bachelors degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field. Relevant equivalent experience may be considered.

Preferred Certification IT service management, networking or infrastructure operations certification is desirable but not mandatory.


6. Core Competencies

Structured troubleshooting and analytical thinking Calm and decisive incident leadership

Strong ownership and follow-through Cross-functional and vendor coordination

Clear client and stakeholder communication Prioritisation in a 24x7 environment

Accurate documentation and reporting Continuous improvement mindset


7. Indicative Success Measures

  • Service availability and monitoring effectiveness
  • Incident acknowledgement and service restoration performance
  • Major incident process compliance and communication quality
  • Reduction in repeat incidents and timely Root Cause Analysis completion
  • Closure of corrective and preventive actions
  • ServiceNow ticket quality, ownership and ageing
  • Monitoring alert quality and reduction of avoidable business-impacting incidents

Role: Incident Management

Industry Type: BPM / BPO

Department: IT & Information Security

Employment Type: Full Time, Permanent

Role Category: IT Infrastructure Services

If you’ve got the skills to succeed and the motivation to make it happen, we look forward to hearing from you.

descriptionHtml:
Ciklum is looking for a Expert DevOps Engineer to join our team full-time in India.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

As a Expert DevOps Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide technical leadership and vision for the DevOps team, defining and implementing best practices for infrastructure automation, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud security
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to define cloud infrastructure strategy and roadmap, aligning with overall business goals
  • Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing DevOps team, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning
  • Continuously evaluate and improve DevOps processes, driving automation, efficiency, and agility within the software delivery lifecycle
  • Maintain a deep understanding of Azure services, IaC tools, and DevOps methodologies to solve complex technical challenges
  • Effectively communicate technical concepts to various stakeholders, including developers, senior management, and clients
  • Identify and address technical debt within the infrastructure, proactively implementing solutions for long-term maintainability and scalability

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience with a proven track record of success
  • 7+ years of experience in a DevOps engineering role with significant leadership experience
  • Proven experience in designing, architecting, and implementing large-scale, secure, and reliable Azure solutions
  • Extensive experience designing, implementing, and troubleshooting complex CI/CD pipelines
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor high-performing DevOps teams
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills
  • Relevant Azure certifications are highly preferred (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, Azure Security Engineer Associate)
  • Strong strategic and business acumen

Desirable:

  • Cloud: Unmatched expertise in Azure services, best practices, and architectural patterns
  • IaC Mastery: Advanced proficiency in ARM, Bicep, Terraform, or other IaC tools with the ability to design and manage complex infrastructure as code templates
  • Scripting and Programming Expertise: Strong scripting skills (Powershell, Bash) and proficiency with one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go) for building robust automation solutions
  • Security Champion: Deep understanding of cloud security best practices, security automation, compliance requirements (SOC 2, ISO), and incident response strategies
  • Leadership and Communication: Excellent leadership skills, fostering a positive team environment, inspiring innovation, and effectively communicating technical concepts to diverse audiences
  • Multi-Cloud: Experience with other cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, etc.)
  • Personal skills

What’s in it for you?

  • Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
  • Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
  • Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
  • Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
  • Care: We’ve got you covered with company-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial & legal consultations

About us:

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.
